guang-shi-luo-bo-niu-nan.zh: 将白萝卜块倒入炖着牛腩的锅中。
guang-shi-luo-bo-niu-nan.en: A hand tips daikon chunks into the pot of braised brisket.

guang-shi-luo-bo-niu-nan.zh: 用筷子试软透的萝卜，锅中牛腩和萝卜浸在浓汁里。
guang-shi-luo-bo-niu-nan.en: A hand tests a tender daikon piece with chopsticks in a pot of brisket and thick sauce.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 用小匙挖去青椒里的籽和白筋。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: A spoon removes seeds and white ribs from a green pepper.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 用筷子朝一个方向搅拌葱姜猪肉馅。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: Chopsticks stir the pork filling with scallion and ginger in one direction.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 用筷子把肉馅压进撒过淀粉的青椒。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: Chopsticks press pork filling into a starch-dusted green pepper.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 青椒开口朝下，立在油锅中煎肉面。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: Stuffed peppers stand open-end down in an oiled pan to sear the meat.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 往煎出褐斑的青椒锅里倒入焖汁。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: Braising sauce is poured into the pan of browned stuffed peppers.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 温度计从青椒开口插入肉馅中心。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: A thermometer is inserted through the pepper opening into the filling.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 用锅铲轻推青椒，锅中酱汁冒泡收浓。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: A spatula gently moves the peppers as the sauce bubbles and reduces.

gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.zh: 用锅铲托起熟青椒装盘，盘中有余汁。
gui-lin-shi-ba-niang.en: A spatula supports a cooked stuffed pepper on a plate with sauce.

gui-ling-gao.zh: 手持刮刀搅拌小锅中均匀的深色粉液。
gui-ling-gao.en: A hand stirs smooth dark slurry in a small saucepan.

gui-ling-gao.zh: 手用勺搅拌冒着热气的透明糖水。
gui-ling-gao.en: A hand stirs steaming clear sugar water with a spoon.

gui-ling-gao.zh: 一边搅拌锅里的深色粉液，一边缓缓倒入热糖水。
gui-ling-gao.en: Hot sugar water is poured slowly into dark slurry while it is stirred.

gui-ling-gao.zh: 小火上用刮刀搅拌浓稠、冒小泡的深色液体。
gui-ling-gao.en: A hand scrapes thick, gently bubbling dark mixture over a low flame.

gui-ling-gao.zh: 将冒热气的深色浓液从锅中分入四只小碗。
gui-ling-gao.en: Steaming thick dark liquid is poured from a saucepan into four bowls.

gui-ling-gao.zh: 手用刀切开碗中凝固的深色龟苓膏。
gui-ling-gao.en: A hand cuts the set dark guilinggao in a bowl with a knife.

gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.zh: 手持滤网沥干红枣，旁边碗中放着桂圆肉。
gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.en: A hand drains jujubes in a sieve beside a bowl of longan flesh.

gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.zh: 手在电饭锅中搅拌清水、糯米、红枣和桂圆。
gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.en: A hand stirs water, glutinous rice, jujubes and longan in a rice cooker.

gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.zh: 手按电饭锅按钮，锅中米和干果浸在水里。
gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.en: A hand presses the rice cooker button while rice and dried fruit sit in water.

gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.zh: 手舀起电饭锅里的粥，查看米粒和软果肉。
gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.en: A hand lifts congee from the rice cooker to check the rice and softened fruit.

gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.zh: 汤锅留着盖缝，小火煮粥，手持勺轻搅。
gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.en: A hand gently stirs congee in a partly covered soup pot over a low flame.

gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.zh: 手把桂圆红枣粥从汤锅舀入碗中。
gui-yuan-hong-zao-zhou.en: A hand ladles longan and jujube congee from a soup pot into a bowl.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手用纸巾吸干鸡块，旁边摆着土豆条和香料。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: Hands pat chicken pieces dry beside potatoes and aromatics.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手用漏勺捞出金黄的土豆条，锅中油冒着细泡。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: A hand lifts golden potato batons from gently bubbling oil.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手用漏勺捞起浅金黄的鸡块，油中有姜片和花椒。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: A hand lifts pale golden chicken from oil with ginger and Sichuan peppercorns.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手翻炒糍粑辣椒、豆瓣和姜片，锅中油色发红。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: A hand stirs chili paste, bean paste and ginger in red oil.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手沿锅边倒入啤酒，锅中是辣椒鸡块和香叶。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: A hand pours beer along the pot edge over chili-coated chicken and bay leaves.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手将温度计插入鸡块，锅里还有土豆条和蒜瓣。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into chicken among potatoes and garlic cloves.

gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.zh: 手将裹着红油辣椒汁的鸡块、土豆和蒜苗盛入盘中。
gui-zhou-la-zi-ji.en: A hand plates chili-coated chicken with potatoes and green garlic shoots.

guo-ta-dou-fu.zh: 手向厨房纸上平放的干豆腐片轻撒盐。
guo-ta-dou-fu.en: A hand lightly salts dry tofu slices laid flat on kitchen paper.

guo-ta-dou-fu.zh: 手搅拌煨汁，旁边备好淀粉、蛋液和葱姜末。
guo-ta-dou-fu.en: A hand stirs the sauce beside starch, beaten egg, minced ginger and scallions.

guo-ta-dou-fu.zh: 手将薄裹淀粉的豆腐片蘸入蛋液。
guo-ta-dou-fu.en: A hand dips a lightly dusted tofu slice into beaten egg.

guo-ta-dou-fu.zh: 手用薄铲托起锅中煎至金黄的豆腐片。
guo-ta-dou-fu.en: A hand lifts a golden tofu slice from the pan with a thin spatula.

guo-ta-dou-fu.zh: 手沿锅边倒入煨汁，豆腐周围冒着小泡。
guo-ta-dou-fu.en: A hand pours sauce along the pan edge as small bubbles surround the tofu.

guo-ta-dou-fu.zh: 手把金黄豆腐盛入有余汁和葱绿的盘中。
guo-ta-dou-fu.en: A hand plates golden tofu with a little sauce and green scallions.

gyeran-jjim.zh: 手提起打蛋器，均匀的葱花蛋液滴回冷锅。
gyeran-jjim.en: A hand lifts a whisk as smooth egg and scallion mixture drips into the cold pot.

gyeran-jjim.zh: 手将锅盖盖向装着葱花蛋液的小陶锅。
gyeran-jjim.en: A hand lowers a lid onto a small earthenware pot of egg and scallion mixture.

gyeran-jjim.zh: 盖着的陶锅在小火上加热，锅边冒出蒸汽。
gyeran-jjim.en: A covered earthenware pot heats over a small flame as steam escapes.

gyeran-jjim.zh: 手揭开锅盖，锅里的葱花蒸蛋已鼓起定形。
gyeran-jjim.en: A hand lifts the lid to reveal puffed, set steamed egg with scallions.

gyeran-jjim.zh: 手把温度探针插进蓬松蒸蛋的中心。
gyeran-jjim.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the center of the puffed steamed egg.

gyeran-jjim.zh: 手向隔热垫上的葱花蒸蛋淋香油，旁边放着米饭。
gyeran-jjim.en: A hand drizzles sesame oil over steamed egg on a trivet beside a bowl of rice.

gyeran-mari.zh: 用筷子搅拌均匀混有葱花和胡萝卜末的蛋液。
gyeran-mari.en: Stir beaten egg mixed evenly with finely chopped scallion and carrot.

gyeran-mari.zh: 用厨房纸将油摊成薄膜，小火加热平底锅。
gyeran-mari.en: Spread a thin film of oil with kitchen paper in a pan over low heat.

gyeran-mari.zh: 用铲子卷起湿润的蛋皮，锅底留着未卷的蛋皮。
gyeran-mari.en: Roll up the moist egg sheet with a spatula, leaving a flat section in the pan.

gyeran-mari.zh: 向锅中蛋卷旁倒入蛋液，让蛋液铺开。
gyeran-mari.en: Pour more egg mixture beside the roll and let it spread in the pan.

gyeran-mari.zh: 将探针从蛋卷端部插入中心测温，锅底保持小火。
gyeran-mari.en: Insert a probe into the center of the roll from one end over low heat.

gyeran-mari.zh: 在案板上切鸡蛋卷，切面露出相连的卷层。
gyeran-mari.en: Slice the omelette on a cutting board, revealing connected layers.

gyudon.zh: 双手分开薄牛肉片，旁边放着洋葱片和两碗白饭。
gyudon.en: Hands separate thin beef slices beside sliced onion and two bowls of rice.

gyudon.zh: 用筷子搅动沸腾煮汁中的洋葱片。
gyudon.en: Chopsticks stir onion slices in bubbling broth.

gyudon.zh: 用筷子拨开煮汁中部分变色的牛肉片。
gyudon.en: Chopsticks separate partly cooked beef slices in broth.

gyudon.zh: 用筷子夹起软洋葱，锅中牛肉变色且留有煮汁。
gyudon.en: Chopsticks lift a soft onion slice above cooked beef and broth.

gyudon.zh: 用勺把煮汁浇在牛肉洋葱饭上，旁边还有一碗。
gyudon.en: A ladle pours broth over a beef and onion rice bowl beside another bowl.

hachis-parmentier.zh: 用细签检查水煮土豆块是否熟透。
hachis-parmentier.en: A hand tests a potato chunk in a saucepan of water with a skewer.

hachis-parmentier.zh: 双手将熟牛肉拆成短纤维，旁边的面包芯浸在牛奶中。
hachis-parmentier.en: Hands pull cooked beef into short fibers beside bread soaking in milk.

hachis-parmentier.zh: 用勺拌匀熟牛肉、面包芯和香料蔬菜。
hachis-parmentier.en: A spoon mixes cooked beef, bread and aromatic vegetables.

hachis-parmentier.zh: 用匙背在土豆泥上划出浅纹，黄油正在融化。
hachis-parmentier.en: A spoon leaves shallow grooves in mashed potatoes as butter melts.

hachis-parmentier.zh: 将细面包糠薄撒在铺好的土豆泥上。
hachis-parmentier.en: A hand scatters fine breadcrumbs over the mashed potato layer.

hachis-parmentier.zh: 用铲子盛起金黄的牧羊人派，露出肉馅和土豆泥。
hachis-parmentier.en: A spatula lifts a serving of golden-topped pie, revealing beef and mashed potato layers.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 手在案板上切鱿鱼，旁边放着虾块和蘸汁。
haemul-pajeon.en: Hands cut squid on a board beside chopped shrimp and dipping sauce.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 勺子提起面糊，面糊连续流回碗中。
haemul-pajeon.en: Batter flows continuously from a raised spoon back into the bowl.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 手用勺将葱段、鱿鱼和虾拌入面糊。
haemul-pajeon.en: A hand folds scallions, squid, and shrimp into batter with a spoon.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 铲子在火上的平底锅中摊平海鲜葱饼面糊。
haemul-pajeon.en: A spatula spreads seafood and scallion batter thinly in a heated skillet.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 铲子轻抬饼边，露出金黄底面，油流向饼底。
haemul-pajeon.en: A spatula lifts the pancake edge to reveal a golden underside as oil flows beneath.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 铲子轻压锅中金黄的海鲜葱饼。
haemul-pajeon.en: A spatula presses the golden seafood scallion pancake in the skillet.

haemul-pajeon.zh: 手拿起切好的海鲜葱饼，送向一旁的蘸汁。
haemul-pajeon.en: A hand lifts a cut piece of seafood scallion pancake toward the dipping sauce.

hambagu.zh: 用锅铲翻炒洋葱细末，洋葱已变透明柔软。
hambagu.en: A spatula stirs finely chopped onion until soft and translucent.

hambagu.zh: 用手拌合洋葱、面包糠和肉末，肉馅黏成团。
hambagu.en: A hand mixes onion, panko and ground meat into a sticky mass.

hambagu.zh: 四块生肉排摆在案板上，一只手在中央压浅凹。
hambagu.en: A hand presses a shallow dimple into one of four raw patties on a board.

hambagu.zh: 锅铲翻起一块肉排，露出煎至褐黄的底面。
hambagu.en: A spatula turns a patty to reveal its golden-brown underside.

hambagu.zh: 小火焖过的肉排留在锅中，温度计从侧面插入一块肉排。
hambagu.en: A thermometer is inserted into the side of a patty in the pan after simmering over low heat.

hambagu.zh: 用勺子将红褐色酱汁淋在盘中的汉堡肉排上。
hambagu.en: A spoon pours reddish-brown sauce over a plated hamburger steak.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 手在碗中抓匀裹薄浆的生牛肉片。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A hand mixes thinly marinated raw beef in a bowl.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 手搅匀蚝油汁，旁边摆着切好的芥兰和配菜。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A hand stirs oyster sauce beside prepared gai lan and vegetables.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 手从滚水中捞起鲜绿的芥兰。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A hand lifts bright green gai lan from boiling water.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 锅铲翻动摊开的牛肉片，肉的表面已变色。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A spatula turns spread-out beef slices whose surfaces have browned.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 手沿锅边倒入绍兴酒，锅中炒着洋葱、平菇和姜蒜。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A hand pours Shaoxing wine along the wok edge over onions, mushrooms, ginger and garlic.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 锅铲翻炒牛肉和配菜，透亮的蚝油汁正在冒泡。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A spatula tosses beef and vegetables in bubbling, glossy oyster sauce.

hao-you-niu-rou.zh: 手把牛肉和配菜盛在芥兰围成的盘中央。
hao-you-niu-rou.en: A hand serves beef and vegetables in the center of a plate ringed with gai lan.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手在案板上切香菇，旁边摆着掰散的菌菇和切好的配料。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: Hands slice shiitake beside separated mushrooms and prepared aromatics and peppers.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手用勺子搅拌碗中均匀的乳白色水淀粉。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: Hands stir a smooth, milky starch slurry in a bowl.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手用漏勺从沸水中捞起一朵完整的西兰花。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: A hand lifts an intact broccoli floret from boiling water with a slotted spoon.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手将三种菌菇倒入沸水锅中。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: A hand tips three kinds of mushrooms into a pot of boiling water.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手用锅铲翻炒油中的菜椒块、辣椒圈和姜末。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: A hand stir-fries bell pepper, chili rings and minced ginger in oil.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手向菌菇和菜椒中倒入酱汁，锅底的汁正冒泡。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: Hands pour sauce into mushrooms and bell pepper as the liquid bubbles in the wok.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手向冒泡的菌菇汁中少量淋入水淀粉，同时用锅铲推匀。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: Hands pour a little starch slurry into bubbling mushrooms while pushing them with a spatula.

hao-you-san-xian-gu.zh: 手把亮汁菌菇盛入盘中，旁边配着西兰花。
hao-you-san-xian-gu.en: Hands plate glossy mushrooms alongside broccoli.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 手把洗净的生菜叶放入漏篮沥水。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: A hand places washed romaine leaves in a colander to drain.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 手搅匀碗中的酱汁，旁边放着蒜末。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: A hand stirs the sauce beside minced garlic on a board.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 手向大火沸腾的油水中撒盐。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: A hand adds salt to vigorously boiling water with oil.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 手用锅铲将鲜绿生菜压入沸水。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: A hand presses bright green lettuce into boiling water with a spatula.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 手轻摇漏篮，沥去生菜上的水。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: A hand gently shakes water from lettuce in a colander.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 调好的酱汁倒入小火锅中的浅金色蒜末。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: Mixed sauce pours into lightly golden garlic over low heat.

hao-you-sheng-cai.zh: 手将蒜蓉蚝油汁浇在盘中的生菜上。
hao-you-sheng-cai.en: A hand pours garlic oyster sauce over plated lettuce.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 双手将腊肠斜切成均匀薄片。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: Hands slice Chinese sausage diagonally into even thin pieces.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 双手沿荷兰豆边缘拉去老筋。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: Hands pull the tough string from the edge of a snow pea.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 荷兰豆被倒入沸水中，锅里的豆荚鲜绿完整。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: Snow peas are added to boiling water, where the pods remain bright green and intact.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 手提滤勺沥干鲜绿的荷兰豆。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: A hand holds a strainer to drain bright green snow peas.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 小火下用锅铲翻动微微卷边的腊肠片。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: A spatula turns sausage slices with slightly curled edges over low heat.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 锅铲在中大火上翻炒荷兰豆和腊肠片。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: A spatula stir-fries snow peas and sausage slices over medium-high heat.

he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.zh: 手沿锅边倒入生抽，锅里有荷兰豆和腊肠片。
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang.en: A hand pours light soy sauce along the edge of a wok containing snow peas and sausage.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 向蒸屉里松铺的细面淋油，锅中水沸腾冒汽。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Oil is drizzled over loosely arranged thin noodles as water boils and steam rises.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 五花肉切薄片，旁边备好蒜薹、葱、姜和蒜。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Pork belly is sliced thinly beside prepared garlic scapes, scallion, ginger and garlic.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 肉片在锅中变色出油，加入葱姜蒜和料酒翻炒。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Pork belly browns and releases fat in the wok with scallion, ginger, garlic and cooking wine.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 向肉片和蒜薹的调味菜汤里倒水，汤汁沸腾。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Water is poured into bubbling seasoned broth with pork belly and garlic scapes.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 向肉菜面条分次淋回菜汤，拌至湿润上色。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Broth is poured over noodles, pork and garlic scapes as they are mixed until evenly moistened.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 面和肉菜在蒸屉中复蒸，用筷子夹起面条检查。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Noodles, pork and garlic scapes steam while a strand is lifted with chopsticks for checking.

he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.zh: 用筷子抖散盘中的肉菜面条，淋入香油。
he-nan-zheng-mian-tiao.en: Sesame oil is drizzled onto plated noodles, pork and garlic scapes as chopsticks loosen them.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 双手在案板上将牛肉切成均匀的短条。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: Hands cut beef into even short strips on a cutting board.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 手在碗中抓匀牛柳，肉表面挂着薄浆。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: A hand mixes beef strips in a bowl until lightly coated.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 双手切洋葱条，案板上摆着红黄彩椒条。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: Hands slice onion beside strips of red and yellow bell pepper.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 手用锅铲将牛柳单层铺在热油锅中。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: A hand spreads beef strips in a single layer in an oiled hot wok.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 手用锅铲将表面变褐的牛柳盛入碗中。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: A hand lifts browned beef strips from the wok into a bowl.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 手将炒好的牛柳倒回盛有洋葱和彩椒的锅中。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: A hand returns cooked beef strips to the wok with onion and bell pepper.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 手向锅里的牛柳、洋葱和彩椒撒入盐和黑胡椒。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: A hand sprinkles salt and black pepper over beef, onion, and bell pepper in the wok.

hei-jiao-niu-liu.zh: 双手用锅铲将牛柳、洋葱和彩椒盛入红边盘中。
hei-jiao-niu-liu.en: Hands use a spatula to plate beef, onion, and bell pepper on a red-rimmed plate.

hei-zhi-ma-hu.zh: 手持滤网沥去泡软糯米的水。
hei-zhi-ma-hu.en: A hand drains soaked glutinous rice in a sieve.

hei-zhi-ma-hu.zh: 手用勺子在小火上翻动平底锅里的黑芝麻。
hei-zhi-ma-hu.en: A hand stirs black sesame seeds in a frying pan over a low flame.

hei-zhi-ma-hu.zh: 手从搅拌杯中舀起细滑的黑芝麻米浆。
hei-zhi-ma-hu.en: A hand lifts smooth black sesame and rice slurry from the blender.

hei-zhi-ma-hu.zh: 手用刮刀搅动锅中微稠冒泡的芝麻米浆。
hei-zhi-ma-hu.en: A hand stirs the slightly thickened, bubbling sesame and rice mixture in a saucepan.

hei-zhi-ma-hu.zh: 手舀起黑芝麻糊，细糊连续流回碗中。
hei-zhi-ma-hu.en: A hand lifts black sesame soup, letting a smooth stream flow back into the bowl.

hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.zh: 手持木铲在小火干锅中翻炒黑芝麻。
hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.en: A hand stirs black sesame seeds in a dry pan over low heat.

hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.zh: 手用刮刀拌匀碗中细腻的黑芝麻馅。
hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.en: A hand mixes smooth black sesame filling in a bowl with a spatula.

hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.zh: 双手把冷硬的黑芝麻馅搓成小球。
hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.en: Hands roll firm chilled black sesame filling into a small ball.

hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.zh: 双手在碗中按揉光滑无裂的糯米团。
hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.en: Hands press and knead smooth glutinous rice dough in a bowl.

hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.zh: 双手托住芝麻馅，向上推拢糯米皮。
hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.en: Hands support sesame filling and push the rice dough wrapper upward around it.

hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.zh: 手将煮熟的汤圆连汤舀入碗中。
hei-zhi-ma-tang-yuan.en: A hand ladles cooked tangyuan and broth into a bowl.

hobak-jeon.zh: 用厨房纸轻按西葫芦圆片上的水珠。
hobak-jeon.en: A hand gently blots water from zucchini rounds with kitchen paper.

hobak-jeon.zh: 手将西葫芦片沾上薄粉，旁边放着蛋液和蘸汁。
hobak-jeon.en: A hand lightly coats a zucchini round in flour beside beaten egg and dipping sauce.

hobak-jeon.zh: 手将裹蛋液的瓜片放入锅中，瓜片之间留有空隙。
hobak-jeon.en: A hand places an egg-coated zucchini round among spaced slices in the pan.

hobak-jeon.zh: 用锅铲翻转西葫芦片，露出浅金黄的蛋衣。
hobak-jeon.en: A spatula flips a zucchini round to reveal its lightly golden egg coating.

hobak-jeon.zh: 手将煎好的西葫芦片摆上盘，旁边另放蘸汁。
hobak-jeon.en: A hand places a cooked zucchini round on a plate beside dipping sauce.

hollandaise.zh: 液态澄清黄油旁放着搅拌碗、打蛋器和凉水。
hollandaise.en: Liquid clarified butter sits beside a mixing bowl, whisk, and cool water.

hollandaise.zh: 小火加热水浴，搅拌碗底悬在微冒泡的水面上方。
hollandaise.en: A mixing bowl rests above gently bubbling water over a low flame.

hollandaise.zh: 提起打蛋器，浅黄色蛋黄液落下并留下带状痕迹。
hollandaise.en: A lifted whisk leaves a ribbon of pale yolk mixture on the surface.

hollandaise.zh: 一边滴入澄清黄油，一边搅打光滑的蛋黄液。
hollandaise.en: A hand whisks the smooth yolk mixture as clarified butter is added drop by drop.

hollandaise.zh: 一边细流倒入澄清黄油，一边搅打浓滑的酱。
hollandaise.en: A hand whisks the smooth thick sauce as clarified butter is poured in a thin stream.

hollandaise.zh: 用勺将荷兰酱淋在芦笋上，旁边放着酱船和柠檬。
hollandaise.en: A hand spoons hollandaise over asparagus beside a gravy boat and lemon.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手将去皮冬瓜切成均匀小块，旁边放着姜末和葱花。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: Hands cut peeled winter melon into even cubes beside minced ginger and chopped scallion.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手翻动油锅里的冬瓜块，部分表面呈浅金色。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: A hand turns winter melon cubes in oil, with some surfaces pale golden.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手将酱汁倒入姜末中，锅里的酱汁刚刚冒泡。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: A hand pours sauce over minced ginger as the sauce begins to bubble.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手沿锅边倒水，冬瓜块在大火上煮着。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: A hand pours water along the edge of the wok as winter melon cooks over high heat.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手用筷子测试棕红色汤汁中的冬瓜块。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: A hand tests a winter melon cube with chopsticks in brown-red sauce.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手将撒了葱花的冬瓜盛出，锅中留下汤汁。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: A hand lifts scallion-topped winter melon from the wok, leaving sauce behind.

hong-shao-dong-gua.zh: 手将亮泽的酱汁浇在盘中的冬瓜块上。
hong-shao-dong-gua.en: A hand spoons glossy sauce over the plated winter melon.

hong-shao-ji-chi.zh: 手在生鸡翅厚处划浅刀，旁边摆着姜葱蒜和香料。
hong-shao-ji-chi.en: A hand scores raw chicken wings beside prepared ginger, scallion, garlic and spices.

hong-shao-ji-chi.zh: 手撇去鸡翅和姜片轻沸时浮起的灰沫。
hong-shao-ji-chi.en: A hand skims gray foam from gently simmering chicken wings and ginger.

hong-shao-ji-chi.zh: 手在小火上搅拌红褐色糖汁，焯过的鸡翅放在一旁。
hong-shao-ji-chi.en: A hand stirs reddish-brown caramel over low heat beside blanched chicken wings.

hong-shao-ji-chi.zh: 手沿锅边倒入调料，锅里是上色的鸡翅和香料。
hong-shao-ji-chi.en: A hand pours seasoning along the wok’s edge around colored chicken wings and aromatics.

hong-shao-ji-chi.zh: 手往鸡翅和香料中倒热水，汤汁接近没过鸡翅。
hong-shao-ji-chi.en: A hand pours hot water into the wok until the liquid nearly covers the chicken wings and aromatics.

hong-shao-ji-chi.zh: 关火后，手往裹着浓汁的鸡翅上撒芝麻和葱花。
hong-shao-ji-chi.en: With the heat off, a hand sprinkles sesame and scallions over sauce-coated chicken wings.

hong-shao-li-yu.zh: 手在鲤鱼身上划斜口，旁边摆着切好的配料。
hong-shao-li-yu.en: A hand scores a carp beside the prepared aromatics and pork belly.

hong-shao-li-yu.zh: 手用漏铲托起炸至表皮定形的鲤鱼沥油。
hong-shao-li-yu.en: A hand lifts the lightly fried carp on a slotted spatula to drain.

hong-shao-li-yu.zh: 手翻炒边缘微黄的五花肉和葱姜蒜辣椒。
hong-shao-li-yu.en: A hand stir-fries lightly browned pork belly with leek, ginger, garlic and chilies.

hong-shao-li-yu.zh: 手掀起锅盖，鱼和五花肉在酱汁中轻轻冒泡。
hong-shao-li-yu.en: A hand lifts the lid over carp and pork belly gently simmering in sauce.

hong-shao-li-yu.zh: 手用叉子拨开鱼肉，露出不透明的白色鱼片。
hong-shao-li-yu.en: A hand uses a fork to separate opaque white flakes of fish.

hong-shao-li-yu.zh: 手把浓亮的烧汁和五花肉淋在盘中的鲤鱼上。
hong-shao-li-yu.en: A hand spoons glossy sauce and pork belly over the plated carp.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 双手在案板上斜切茄块，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜和蒜。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: Hands cut eggplant diagonally on a board beside prepared vegetables and garlic.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 筷子提起面糊，浓稠的面糊成带落回碗中。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: Chopsticks lift the batter, which falls back into the bowl in a thick ribbon.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 筷子夹起挂糊的茄块，多余面糊滴回碗中。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: Chopsticks lift a battered eggplant piece as excess batter drips back into the bowl.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 筷子从冒泡的油锅中夹起金黄茄块沥油。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: Chopsticks lift a golden eggplant piece from bubbling oil to drain.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲翻炒番茄、青椒、洋葱和葱蒜，番茄开始出汁。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: A spatula stirs tomato, green pepper, onion, scallion and garlic as the tomato releases juice.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲轻推汤汁中的茄块和蔬菜，锅底小火加热。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: A spatula gently pushes eggplant and vegetables through simmering broth over a low flame.

hong-shao-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲将裹着浓汁的茄块和蔬菜盛入盘中。
hong-shao-qie-zi.en: A spatula transfers eggplant and vegetables coated in thick sauce onto a plate.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 整条五花肉在沸水中焯至外层发白，水面浮出泡沫。
hong-shao-rou.en: A whole strip of pork belly blanches in boiling water, its exterior pale and foam rising to the surface.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 用刀将焯过的带皮五花肉切成大小相近的肉块。
hong-shao-rou.en: Hands cut blanched skin-on pork belly into evenly sized cubes.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 小火下用铲子轻推锅中红褐色的糖液。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand gently stirs reddish-brown caramel over low heat.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 五花肉块裹上糖色，手沿锅边倒入绍兴酒。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand pours Shaoxing wine along the edge of the pot of caramel-coated pork belly.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 五花肉与姜、八角、辣椒、桂皮和葱在锅中小火微沸。
hong-shao-rou.en: Pork belly simmers gently with ginger, star anise, chilies, cinnamon and scallions.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 用筷子插入锅中较厚的五花肉块，检查软度。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand inserts chopsticks into a thick piece of pork belly to check its tenderness.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 大火翻动五花肉，亮汁裹住肉块，锅底留有少量汁。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand turns pork belly over high heat as glossy sauce coats the pieces and a little remains in the pot.

hong-shao-yu.zh: 用厨房纸吸干划过刀的鱼，旁边摆着切好的香料。
hong-shao-yu.en: A hand pats the scored fish dry beside the prepared aromatics.

hong-shao-yu.zh: 用锅铲轻推浅金色的鱼，锅里油正在滋滋冒泡。
hong-shao-yu.en: A spatula gently nudges the pale golden fish in sizzling oil.

hong-shao-yu.zh: 鱼推到锅边，姜丝、蒜和干辣椒在空出的油里翻炒。
hong-shao-yu.en: Ginger, garlic and dried chili are stirred in oil beside the fish.

hong-shao-yu.zh: 鱼在锅中轻沸，用勺子将汤汁浇到鱼背上。
hong-shao-yu.en: A ladle pours gently simmering sauce over the fish in the pan.

hong-shao-yu.zh: 往轻沸的鱼锅里加入小米椒圈和一勺蚝油。
hong-shao-yu.en: Fresh chili rings and a spoonful of oyster sauce are added to the simmering fish.

hong-shao-yu.zh: 将收浓的烧汁浇在盘中的鱼和葱花上。
hong-shao-yu.en: Reduced sauce is poured over the plated fish and scallions.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 手用镊子从分块的鱼头中挑出碎骨。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: A hand removes a bone fragment from cut fish head with tweezers.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 手切姜片，旁边摆着葱、蒜、辣椒圈和香菜。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: Hands slice ginger beside prepared scallions, garlic, chili rings and cilantro.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 手将鱼头块与葱叶、姜片和腌汁拌匀。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: A hand mixes fish head pieces with scallion leaves, ginger and marinade.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 小火翻炒姜片、葱白、蒜、八角和干辣椒。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: A hand stirs ginger, scallion whites, garlic, star anise and dried chilies over low heat.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 手向鱼头和香料的锅中倒入烧汁。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: Hands pour seasoned liquid into the pan of fish head and aromatics.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 揭盖用筷子检查轻沸汤中鱼肉的熟度。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: Hands lift the lid and use chopsticks to check fish in gently simmering broth.

hong-shao-yu-tou.zh: 手将热汁浇在撒有香菜和辣椒圈的鱼头上。
hong-shao-yu-tou.en: A hand spoons hot sauce over fish head garnished with cilantro and chili rings.

hong-shao-zhu-ti.zh: 用漏勺撇去猪蹄、葱姜汤面的浮沫。
hong-shao-zhu-ti.en: A hand skims foam from pork trotters simmering with scallion and ginger.

hong-shao-zhu-ti.zh: 离火翻拌猪蹄，让红褐色糖色裹住表面。
hong-shao-zhu-ti.en: A hand tosses pork trotters off the heat in reddish brown caramel.

hong-shao-zhu-ti.zh: 往盛有猪蹄和香料的锅里倒入热水。
hong-shao-zhu-ti.en: A hand pours hot water into a pot of pork trotters and spices.

hong-shao-zhu-ti.zh: 锁好的压力锅在小火上冒出少量蒸汽。
hong-shao-zhu-ti.en: A locked pressure cooker releases a little steam over low heat.

hong-shao-zhu-ti.zh: 用筷子扎锅中软化的猪蹄皮筋，肉开始离骨。
hong-shao-zhu-ti.en: Chopsticks test the tender skin and tendon as meat begins to pull away from the bone.

hong-shao-zhu-ti.zh: 翻动红亮猪蹄，锅底仍留有流动的卤汁。
hong-shao-zhu-ti.en: A hand turns glossy pork trotters in a wok with sauce still flowing at the bottom.

hong-you-chao-shou.zh: 用滤网滤出葱姜水，旁边放着切好的葱绿。
hong-you-chao-shou.en: Strain scallion and ginger water beside chopped scallion greens.

hong-you-chao-shou.zh: 用筷子朝一个方向搅拌黏稠的猪肉馅。
hong-you-chao-shou.en: Stir the sticky pork filling in one direction with chopsticks.

hong-you-chao-shou.zh: 双手压紧对折的抄手皮，旁边备有肉馅和封口水。
hong-you-chao-shou.en: Press a folded wonton wrapper closed beside pork filling and sealing water.

hong-you-chao-shou.zh: 四碗红油汁中散着蒜泥和辣椒细渣，一只手正在搅拌。
hong-you-chao-shou.en: Stir one of four bowls of chili oil sauce flecked with garlic and chili.

hong-you-chao-shou.zh: 抄手浮在翻滚的水中，用温度计探入肉馅。
hong-you-chao-shou.en: Probe the filling of a wonton floating in vigorously boiling water.

hong-you-chao-shou.zh: 用勺轻拌碗中沾满红油汁的抄手，撒有葱绿。
hong-you-chao-shou.en: Gently turn chili-oil-coated wontons topped with scallion greens.

hong-zao-jiang-cha.zh: 手从切开的红枣中取核，旁边摆着姜片。
hong-zao-jiang-cha.en: A hand removes a pit from a split red date beside sliced ginger.

hong-zao-jiang-cha.zh: 红枣和姜片在加盖的小锅里持续沸腾。
hong-zao-jiang-cha.en: Red dates and ginger slices boil steadily in a covered saucepan.

hong-zao-jiang-cha.zh: 红枣和姜片在加盖的小锅里轻轻冒泡。
hong-zao-jiang-cha.en: Red dates and ginger slices simmer gently in a covered saucepan.

hong-zao-jiang-cha.zh: 手将姜枣茶倒过细筛，滤入小杯。
hong-zao-jiang-cha.en: A hand pours ginger and red date tea through a fine strainer into a cup.

hong-zao-jiang-cha.zh: 手端起一杯温热的姜枣茶，旁边还有一杯。
hong-zao-jiang-cha.en: A hand lifts a cup of warm ginger and red date tea beside a second cup.

horenso-no-gomaae.zh: 双手在流水下洗净菠菜茎根处的泥沙。
horenso-no-gomaae.en: Hands wash grit from the base of spinach under running water.

horenso-no-gomaae.zh: 用木铲在小火上翻动烘至浅金色的白芝麻。
horenso-no-gomaae.en: A wooden spatula stirs white sesame seeds until pale golden over a small flame.

horenso-no-gomaae.zh: 用研杵搅拌带有细颗粒的浓稠芝麻拌汁。
horenso-no-gomaae.en: A pestle stirs thick sesame dressing with fine granules in a mortar.

horenso-no-gomaae.zh: 用筷子将菠菜叶压入沸水，叶片刚刚变软。
horenso-no-gomaae.en: Chopsticks press spinach into boiling water as the leaves begin to wilt.

horenso-no-gomaae.zh: 双手轻轻挤出一小束菠菜的水分。
horenso-no-gomaae.en: Hands gently squeeze water from a small bundle of spinach.

horenso-no-gomaae.zh: 用筷子将拌好的芝麻菠菜分入小碗。
horenso-no-gomaae.en: Chopsticks portion sesame-coated spinach into a small bowl.

hotteok.zh: 用刮刀在大碗中聚拢黏软的面团。
hotteok.en: A spatula gathers soft, sticky dough in a large bowl.

hotteok.zh: 盖好的碗里面团膨起，表面布满气泡。
hotteok.en: The dough rises under a covered bowl, with bubbles across its surface.

hotteok.zh: 一手扶碗，一手拌匀红糖、肉桂和核桃碎。
hotteok.en: One hand steadies the bowl while the other mixes brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped walnuts.

hotteok.zh: 双手将包着糖馅的面皮边缘捏拢。
hotteok.en: Hands pinch the edges of the dough around the sugar filling.

hotteok.zh: 中火锅中有两块面团，正用宽铲压扁一块。
hotteok.en: A wide spatula presses one of two dough rounds in a pan over medium heat.

hotteok.zh: 两块金黄糖饼在小火锅中加盖焖煮。
hotteok.en: Two golden pancakes cook under a lid over low heat.

hotteok.zh: 双手掰开盘中的糖饼，露出核桃糖浆馅。
hotteok.en: Hands open a plated pancake to reveal walnut syrup filling.

hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.zh: 双手在冷水下清洗蛤蜊，旁边备好蒜末、辣椒和罗勒。
hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.en: Hands rinse clams under cold water beside minced garlic, sliced chilies and basil.

hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.zh: 锅中蒜末在热油里炒至边缘浅金。
hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.en: Minced garlic is stirred in hot oil until its edges turn pale gold.

hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.zh: 双手将蛤蜊和辣椒片倒入拌匀辣椒膏的锅中。
hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.en: Hands pour clams and sliced chilies into the pan of chili paste and oil.

hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.zh: 揭开锅盖，蛤蜊已经张口，锅底有棕红色汁。
hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.en: A hand lifts the lid to reveal opened clams in reddish-brown juices.

hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.zh: 锅铲从底部翻起蛤蜊，让汁和辣椒膏混匀。
hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.en: A spatula lifts clams from the bottom of the pan, mixing their juices with chili paste.

hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.zh: 将锅底薄汁浇在装盘的蛤蜊、辣椒和罗勒上。
hoy-lai-pad-nam-prik-pao.en: Thin pan juices are poured over plated clams, chilies and basil.

hu-la-tang.zh: 双手将松弛的面团连贯拉开。
hu-la-tang.en: Hands stretch the rested dough into a continuous sheet.

hu-la-tang.zh: 双手在乳白色水中揉洗面团。
hu-la-tang.en: Hands knead dough in milky water to wash out the starch.

hu-la-tang.zh: 双手将松弛的面筋拉成薄片，旁边放着浆水。
hu-la-tang.en: Hands stretch rested gluten into a thin sheet beside the reserved starch water.

hu-la-tang.zh: 牛肉汤沸腾后，用勺撇去浮沫。
hu-la-tang.en: A ladle skims foam from the boiling beef broth.

hu-la-tang.zh: 将泡发的木耳切丝，旁边放着黄花菜和粉条。
hu-la-tang.en: A hand slices soaked wood ear mushrooms beside daylily buds and glass noodles.

hu-la-tang.zh: 将牛肉丁和备好的汤料倒入煮着面筋的汤锅。
hu-la-tang.en: Diced beef and prepared ingredients are tipped into broth with floating gluten.

hu-la-tang.zh: 边推动汤料，边往微沸的锅里倒入洗面浆水。
hu-la-tang.en: Starch water is poured into the simmering soup as a ladle pushes the ingredients.

hu-la-tang.zh: 往盛好的胡辣汤中加入醋。
hu-la-tang.en: Vinegar is added to a bowl of hu la tang.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 双手将青椒纵向切成条，切好的椒条放在案板上。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: Hands slice a green pepper lengthwise into strips on a cutting board.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 手在小碗里搅拌酸甜汁，案板旁放着蒜末。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: Hands stir sweet and sour sauce in a bowl beside minced garlic.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 手将青椒条单层摆入有油的平底锅中。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: A hand arranges green pepper strips in a single layer in an oiled pan.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 锅铲轻压青椒，椒皮已出现褐色斑纹和皱褶。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: A spatula presses peppers with browned, wrinkled skins in the pan.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 青椒推到锅边，锅铲在中央的油里煸炒浅色蒜末。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: A spatula cooks pale minced garlic in oil with peppers pushed to the edge.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 手将酸甜汁倒入锅中，青椒和蒜末周围的酱汁冒泡。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: A hand pours sweet and sour sauce into the pan as it bubbles around peppers and minced garlic.

hu-pi-qing-jiao.zh: 手用锅铲将带褐斑和蒜粒的青椒盛入盘中。
hu-pi-qing-jiao.en: A hand plates blistered green peppers and garlic with a spatula.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手用镊子拔去水中猪肘皮上的残毛。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand plucks a stray hair from a pork hock soaking in water with tweezers.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 锅中肘子与葱姜蒜沸煮，料酒正倒入锅中。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: Wine is poured into a pot of boiling pork hock, scallion, ginger, and garlic.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手用长夹将擦干的肘子沿锅边放入热油。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand uses long tongs to lower the dried pork hock into hot oil along the pot's edge.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手用长夹翻动油锅中炸至浅棕的肘子。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand turns the light-brown pork hock in hot oil with long tongs.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手沿锅边向起细泡的红棕色糖液倒入热水。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand pours hot water along the edge of a pan of bubbling reddish-brown caramel.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手向盛有肘子、香料和葱姜蒜的压力锅倒入调味汁。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand pours seasoning into a pressure cooker holding pork hock, spices, scallion, ginger, and garlic.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手向锅中冒泡的红棕色炖汁撒盐。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand sprinkles salt into bubbling reddish-brown braising liquid.

hu-pi-zhou-zi.zh: 手将红亮的薄芡汁浇在盘中的虎皮肘子上。
hu-pi-zhou-zi.en: A hand ladles glossy reddish-brown sauce over the plated pork hock.

hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.zh: 双手在盐水中轻搓毛豆荚。
hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.en: Hands gently rub edamame pods in salt water.

hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.zh: 用剪刀剪去毛豆荚的一小角。
hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.en: Scissors snip a small tip off an edamame pod.

hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.zh: 用勺拨散轻滚水中的毛豆和话梅。
hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.en: A spoon separates edamame and preserved plums in gently simmering water.

hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.zh: 用勺轻翻煮汁中的毛豆和话梅。
hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.en: A spoon gently turns edamame and preserved plums in simmering broth.

hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.zh: 双手剥开熟毛豆荚，查看豆仁。
hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.en: Hands open a cooked edamame pod to inspect the beans.

hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.zh: 将毛豆和少量煮汁盛入话梅碗中。
hua-mei-zhu-mao-dou.en: Edamame and a little cooking broth are spooned into a bowl with preserved plums.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 手在碗中拆开拌了油和酱油的猪肉片。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: A hand separates pork slices coated with oil and soy sauce in a bowl.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 手在案板上将黄瓜斜切成薄片。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: Hands slice a cucumber diagonally into thin pieces on a cutting board.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 手用厨房纸轻轻吸干碗中黄瓜片的表面水分。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: Hands gently blot cucumber slices in a bowl with kitchen paper.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 手在案板上切蒜末，旁边放着辣椒段、黄瓜片和肉片。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: Hands mince garlic beside chili rings and bowls of cucumber and pork slices.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 锅中油里翻炒浅色蒜末和红辣椒段。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: Pale minced garlic and red chili rings are stirred in oil in a wok.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 锅铲将已变浅色的猪肉片在锅中划散。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: A spatula separates opaque pork slices in a wok.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 大火下翻炒黄瓜片、肉片、蒜末和辣椒段。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: Cucumber slices, pork, garlic and chili are tossed in a wok over high heat.

huang-gua-chao-rou.zh: 手将黄瓜炒肉从锅中盛入白盘。
huang-gua-chao-rou.en: Hands transfer stir-fried cucumber and pork from the wok to a white plate.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 手持刀将黄瓜切成均匀薄片。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: Hands slice a cucumber into evenly thin rounds.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 手将蒜瓣对半切，旁边放着葱花。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: Hands halve garlic cloves beside chopped scallions.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 手用厨房纸轻吸皮蛋块表面的水分。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: A hand gently blots century egg wedges with kitchen paper.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 小火中轻翻油里的皮蛋和蒜块，表面略呈金黄。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: A hand gently turns lightly golden century egg and garlic in oil over low heat.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 清水沿锅边倒入，皮蛋和蒜在大火中沸腾。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: Water is poured along the edge of a wok of boiling century egg and garlic over high heat.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 关火后轻推汤里的黄瓜薄片，锅中还有皮蛋和蒜。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: A hand gently separates cucumber slices in the hot broth with century egg and garlic, with the heat off.

huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.zh: 手向盛好的黄瓜皮蛋汤上撒葱花。
huang-gua-pi-dan-tang.en: A hand sprinkles chopped scallions over a bowl of cucumber and century egg soup.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手将泡软的香菇切片，旁边放着泡发水。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand slices softened shiitake mushrooms beside a bowl of soaking liquid.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手用厨房纸吸干鸡块，旁边摆着切好的配料。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand pats the chicken pieces dry beside the prepared ingredients.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手在小火上推动糖油，锅中冒出浅棕色细泡。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand stirs sugar and oil over low heat until fine light brown bubbles appear.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手翻炒裹上糖色的鸡块，锅中有姜片和辣椒圈。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand stirs caramel-coated chicken with ginger slices and chili rings.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手沿锅边倒入香菇水，锅里有鸡块、香菇和土豆。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand pours mushroom soaking liquid into a pot of chicken, shiitake and potatoes.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手盖着锅盖，鸡块和香菇在锅中轻轻冒泡。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand holds the lid over gently simmering chicken and shiitake.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手舀起浓汁，酱汁从勺边流到鸡块上。
huang-men-ji.en: A hand lifts a spoonful of sauce that flows onto the chicken.

huang-men-ji.zh: 手将鸡块、香菇和青椒盛入碗中。
huang-men-ji.en: Hands transfer the chicken, shiitake and green peppers into a serving bowl.

huang-you-jian-xia.zh: 用剪刀剪开生虾背壳，旁边放着厨房纸。
huang-you-jian-xia.en: Hands cut open the back shell of a raw shrimp, with kitchen paper nearby.

huang-you-jian-xia.zh: 手在碗里搅拌酱汁，旁边备好盐、黄油和黑胡椒。
huang-you-jian-xia.en: Hands stir sauce in a bowl beside salt, butter, and black pepper.

huang-you-jian-xia.zh: 手将生虾放入铺有油的热锅，虾摊成一层。
huang-you-jian-xia.en: A hand places raw shrimp in a single layer in a hot oiled pan.

huang-you-jian-xia.zh: 用夹子翻动锅里的虾，虾壳变橙，开背处发白。
huang-you-jian-xia.en: Tongs turn shrimp in the pan as their shells turn orange and split backs whiten.

huang-you-jian-xia.zh: 手把酱汁倒入锅中，锅里的虾已变橙、虾肉发白。
huang-you-jian-xia.en: A hand pours sauce over orange shrimp with white flesh in the pan.

huang-you-jian-xia.zh: 用夹子把裹着薄酱的虾从锅中夹到盘里。
huang-you-jian-xia.en: Tongs transfer shrimp coated in a thin sauce from the pan to a plate.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 手把葱结放入盛有五花肉和姜片的冷水锅中。
hui-guo-rou.en: A hand adds knotted scallions to a pot of pork belly and ginger in cold water.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 手持温度计测量轻沸锅中的五花肉。
hui-guo-rou.en: A hand checks the temperature of pork belly in a gently simmering pot.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 手用菜刀将煮熟的带皮五花肉切成薄片。
hui-guo-rou.en: Hands slice cooked skin-on pork belly thinly with a cleaver.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 手剁细豆瓣酱，旁边摆着切好的青椒、青蒜和姜。
hui-guo-rou.en: Hands mince chili bean paste beside sliced green chili, green garlic and ginger.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 手舀出锅中煸出多余的油，肉片边缘微卷。
hui-guo-rou.en: A hand scoops excess rendered oil from the wok as the pork slices curl at the edges.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 肉片拨到锅边，手用锅铲炒出豆瓣酱红油。
hui-guo-rou.en: Pork slices sit at the side of the wok while a hand stirs chili bean paste in red oil.

hui-guo-rou.zh: 手翻炒裹着红油的肉片、青椒、姜片和翠绿青蒜。
hui-guo-rou.en: A hand stir-fries pork, green chili, ginger and bright green garlic in red oil.

insalata-caprese.zh: 手持刀将番茄横切成完整的圆片。
insalata-caprese.en: A hand slices a tomato crosswise into intact rounds.

insalata-caprese.zh: 手用厨房纸轻轻吸干马苏里拉切片。
insalata-caprese.en: A hand gently blots mozzarella slices with kitchen paper.

insalata-caprese.zh: 手将马苏里拉片与番茄片交替铺在盘中。
insalata-caprese.en: A hand arranges mozzarella and tomato slices alternately on a plate.

insalata-caprese.zh: 手将罗勒叶夹入番茄和奶酪片之间。
insalata-caprese.en: A hand tucks a basil leaf between the tomato and cheese slices.

insalata-caprese.zh: 手将橄榄油淋在番茄、奶酪和罗勒上。
insalata-caprese.en: A hand pours olive oil over the tomato, mozzarella, and basil.

insalata-di-riso.zh: 手用饭勺把沥干的米饭薄薄摊在浅盘里。
insalata-di-riso.en: A hand spreads drained rice in a thin layer on a shallow platter.

insalata-di-riso.zh: 手把黑橄榄和碎鳀鱼倒入装有番茄和金枪鱼的碗。
insalata-di-riso.en: A hand pours black olives and chopped anchovies into a bowl of tomatoes and tuna.

insalata-di-riso.zh: 手用勺子轻拌米饭、番茄、金枪鱼、橄榄和欧芹。
insalata-di-riso.en: A hand gently folds rice, tomatoes, tuna, olives and parsley with a spoon.

janchi-guksu.zh: 锅里的鳀鱼和昆布加热至中央与边缘冒泡。
janchi-guksu.en: Anchovies and kelp heat in a pot until bubbles appear at the center and edges.

janchi-guksu.zh: 手将汤酱油倒入冒着蒸汽的金色清汤。
janchi-guksu.en: A hand pours soup soy sauce into steaming golden broth.

janchi-guksu.zh: 双手挤出西葫芦丝的水分，旁边放着胡萝卜丝和香菇片。
janchi-guksu.en: Hands squeeze water from zucchini strips beside carrot strips and sliced shiitake.

janchi-guksu.zh: 手翻炒胡萝卜丝和香菇，旁边盛着翠绿的西葫芦丝。
janchi-guksu.en: A hand stir-fries carrot and shiitake beside a dish of green zucchini strips.

janchi-guksu.zh: 双手将卷起的熟蛋皮切成细丝。
janchi-guksu.en: Hands cut a rolled cooked egg sheet into thin strips.

janchi-guksu.zh: 手在水龙头下冲洗滤篮里的细面。
janchi-guksu.en: A hand rinses thin noodles in a colander under running water.

janchi-guksu.zh: 手在两碗清汤面中的一碗上摆放蛋丝。
janchi-guksu.en: A hand places egg strips on one of two bowls of noodle soup.

jangjorim.zh: 锅中香料蔬菜沸腾，旁边备有切好的牛胸肉。
jangjorim.en: Aromatic vegetables boil in a pot beside cut brisket.

jangjorim.zh: 用漏勺撇去牛肉汤表面的浮沫。
jangjorim.en: A hand skims foam from the surface of the beef broth.

jangjorim.zh: 双手剥去熟鸡蛋的蛋壳，旁边放着两个熟蛋。
jangjorim.en: Hands peel a hard-boiled egg beside two peeled eggs.

jangjorim.zh: 往冒泡的牛肉汤中倒入酱油，旁边备着糖和味醂。
jangjorim.en: A hand pours soy sauce into bubbling beef broth beside sugar and mirin.

jangjorim.zh: 用叉子顺纹挑开褐色牛肉，锅中卤汁轻轻冒泡。
jangjorim.en: A fork pulls along the grain of browned beef in gently bubbling sauce.

jangjorim.zh: 关火后用叉子顺纹撕牛肉，锅里有卤蛋和青椒。
jangjorim.en: Forks shred beef along the grain with braised eggs and green peppers in the pot.

jangjorim.zh: 用筷子将牛肉丝夹入小碟，旁边是米饭和分装盒。
jangjorim.en: Chopsticks place shredded beef on a plate beside rice and a storage container.

japanese-curry.zh: 用饭勺翻松锅里的短粒白饭。
japanese-curry.en: A hand fluffs cooked short-grain rice with a rice paddle.

japanese-curry.zh: 在案板上切土豆，旁边摆着鸡肉、胡萝卜和洋葱。
japanese-curry.en: A hand cuts potato beside prepared chicken, carrot, and onion.

japanese-curry.zh: 中火翻炒鸡肉和蔬菜，鸡肉表面已变白。
japanese-curry.en: A hand stirs chicken and vegetables over medium heat until the chicken is white on the surface.

japanese-curry.zh: 用竹签戳锅中的土豆，检查是否煮软。
japanese-curry.en: A hand tests a potato in the pot with a bamboo skewer.

japanese-curry.zh: 小火刮底搅拌，鸡肉和蔬菜裹着浓稠咖喱酱。
japanese-curry.en: A hand scrapes and stirs chicken and vegetables in thick curry sauce over low heat.

japanese-curry.zh: 将鸡肉蔬菜咖喱舀在白饭旁。
japanese-curry.en: A hand ladles chicken and vegetable curry beside the rice.

japchae.zh: 案板上正切胡萝卜丝，旁边摆着切好的配菜。
japchae.en: A hand cuts carrot into matchsticks beside the prepared vegetables.

japchae.zh: 小火上用锅铲掀起已凝固的薄蛋皮。
japchae.en: A spatula lifts the edge of the set egg sheet over low heat.

japchae.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞起焯软的菠菜。
japchae.en: A slotted spoon lifts wilted spinach from boiling water.

japchae.zh: 用筷子从沸水中夹起煮至透明的粉丝。
japchae.en: Chopsticks lift translucent cooked glass noodles from boiling water.

japchae.zh: 锅中翻炒洋葱丝和葱段，旁边备有蘑菇片。
japchae.en: Onion and scallion are stir-fried beside a bowl of sliced mushrooms.

japchae.zh: 锅中翻炒略软但仍挺立的胡萝卜丝和甜椒丝。
japchae.en: Carrot and bell pepper strips are stir-fried until slightly softened.

japchae.zh: 锅中翻炒熟透的牛肉条和柔软发亮的香菇。
japchae.en: Cooked beef strips and glossy shiitake mushrooms are stir-fried.

japchae.zh: 用两把勺翻拌粉丝、牛肉、蔬菜、蛋皮和芝麻。
japchae.en: Two spoons toss glass noodles with beef, vegetables, egg and sesame.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 双手在案板上将带油花的猪肩肉切成薄片。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: Hands slice marbled pork shoulder thinly on a cutting board.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 一手扶碗，一手用勺搅匀红色腌料。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: One hand steadies a bowl while the other stirs the red marinade.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 手将猪肉片、洋葱和葱段与红色腌料拌匀。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: A hand mixes pork slices, onion and scallion with red marinade.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 手用夹子将腌猪肉、洋葱和葱段在热锅中摊开。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: A hand spreads marinated pork, onion and scallion in a hot pan with tongs.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 手用探针检查锅中边缘微褐的猪肉片。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: A hand checks a lightly browned pork slice in the pan with a probe.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 手用夹子翻炒第二批猪肉、洋葱和葱段。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: A hand stir-fries the second batch of pork, onion and scallion with tongs.

jeyuk-bokkeum.zh: 手用筷子拌匀盘中的辣炒猪肉，旁边放着米饭。
jeyuk-bokkeum.en: A hand mixes the spicy pork on a plate with chopsticks beside a bowl of rice.

ji-cai-da-hun-tun.zh: 双手用菜刀将荠菜切成细末。
ji-cai-da-hun-tun.en: Hands finely chop shepherd’s purse with a cleaver.

ji-cai-da-hun-tun.zh: 筷子搅拌荠菜猪肉馅，黏馅附在筷子上。
ji-cai-da-hun-tun.en: Chopsticks stir sticky pork and shepherd’s purse filling that clings to them.

ji-cai-da-hun-tun.zh: 双手将馄饨皮两角折向中央，旁边放着包好的馄饨。
ji-cai-da-hun-tun.en: Hands fold the wonton wrapper corners toward the center beside a tray of wrapped wontons.

ji-cai-da-hun-tun.zh: 鸡汤锅边冒小泡，手正往汤里加入香油。
ji-cai-da-hun-tun.en: A hand adds sesame oil to chicken broth bubbling gently at the edges.

ji-cai-da-hun-tun.zh: 馄饨浮在轻沸的水中，手用温度计测量漏勺里的馄饨。
ji-cai-da-hun-tun.en: A hand probes a wonton in a slotted spoon as others float in gently simmering water.

ji-cai-da-hun-tun.zh: 手往清汤馄饨上撒葱花。
ji-cai-da-hun-tun.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over wontons in clear broth.

ji-dan-geng.zh: 一手撒盐，一手用筷子搅匀碗里的蛋液。
ji-dan-geng.en: One hand sprinkles salt while the other stirs the beaten eggs with chopsticks.

ji-dan-geng.zh: 一手倒入温水，一手用筷子轻搅蛋液。
ji-dan-geng.en: One hand pours warm water while the other gently stirs the beaten eggs with chopsticks.

ji-dan-geng.zh: 蛋液经过细筛流入浅碗。
ji-dan-geng.en: The egg mixture flows through a fine strainer into a shallow bowl.

ji-dan-geng.zh: 蒸锅内的浅碗盖着小碟，锅底小火轻蒸。
ji-dan-geng.en: A saucer covers the shallow bowl inside a steamer over a low flame.

ji-dan-geng.zh: 手持温度计探针插入平整蛋羹的中心。
ji-dan-geng.en: A hand inserts a food thermometer probe into the center of the smooth custard.

ji-dan-geng.zh: 用勺将生抽和香油淋在平整的蛋羹上。
ji-dan-geng.en: A spoon drizzles light soy sauce and sesame oil over the smooth custard.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 手从碗中缓缓拉长柔软的面团。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: A hand gently stretches the soft dough from a bowl.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 双手在案板上把面团按成中厚边薄的圆片。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: Hands press dough into a round with a thick center and thin edges.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 双手提起面皮，包住中央的油酥。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: Hands lift the dough around a portion of flour and oil paste.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 手将饼坯放入有油的平底锅，旁边备好葱花蛋液。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: A hand places a dough round in an oiled skillet beside beaten egg and scallions.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 筷子挑开鼓起的饼皮，将葱花蛋液灌入空腔。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: Chopsticks lift the puffed bread as scallion and egg mixture is poured into its cavity.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 手从饼边开口插入温度计，检查锅中金黄的圆饼。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: A hand inserts a thermometer through the edge of the golden pancake in the skillet.

ji-dan-guan-bing.zh: 手将夹有鸡蛋、生菜和酱料的金黄饼折起装盘。
ji-dan-guan-bing.en: A hand folds a golden pancake filled with egg, lettuce and sauce on a plate.

ji-dan-hua.zh: 用筷子搅打碗中的鸡蛋，蛋液颜色均匀。
ji-dan-hua.en: Beat the egg in a bowl with chopsticks until evenly colored.

ji-dan-hua.zh: 将一小勺盐撒入盛有清水的小锅。
ji-dan-hua.en: Sprinkle a small spoonful of salt into a saucepan of water.

ji-dan-hua.zh: 用筷子轻搅小锅中沸腾的水。
ji-dan-hua.en: Gently stir the boiling water in the saucepan with chopsticks.

ji-dan-hua.zh: 将蛋液成细流淋入微沸的水中，用筷子划散。
ji-dan-hua.en: Pour beaten egg in a thin stream into gently simmering water while stirring with chopsticks.

ji-dan-hua.zh: 用温度计测量锅中不透明的蛋花汤。
ji-dan-hua.en: Measure the temperature of the soup with opaque egg ribbons using a food thermometer.

ji-dan-hua.zh: 将柔软的蛋花和汤汁从小锅倒入碗中。
ji-dan-hua.en: Pour the soft egg ribbons and broth from the saucepan into a bowl.

ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.zh: 手持刀将黄瓜切成均匀的半圆片。
ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.en: A hand cuts cucumber into even semicircular slices.

ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.zh: 手切火腿半圆片，旁边备有碎椒、生抽和两份盐。
ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.en: Hands slice ham into semicircles beside chopped chili, soy sauce and two portions of salt.

ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.zh: 小火下用锅铲划开刚凝固、表面光亮的蛋块。
ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.en: A spatula separates glossy, just-set egg curds over low heat.

ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.zh: 大火下用锅铲翻炒油亮的黄瓜半圆片。
ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.en: A spatula stir-fries glossy cucumber semicircles over high heat.

ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.zh: 大火下翻拌黄瓜、蛋块、火腿片和碎红椒。
ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.en: A spatula folds cucumber, egg, ham and chopped red chili together over high heat.

ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.zh: 用锅铲将黄瓜、鸡蛋和火腿盛入白盘。
ji-dan-huo-tui-chao-huang-gua.en: A spatula transfers cucumber, egg and ham onto a white plate.

jia-chang-dou-fu.zh: 手用厨房纸轻压三角豆腐片吸干水分。
jia-chang-dou-fu.en: Hands pat triangular tofu slices dry with kitchen paper.

jia-chang-dou-fu.zh: 手搅匀调味汁，案板上摆好配菜和豆瓣。
jia-chang-dou-fu.en: Hands stir the sauce beside prepared vegetables, aromatics and doubanjiang.

jia-chang-dou-fu.zh: 锅中单层煎豆腐，铲子翻出金黄的一面。
jia-chang-dou-fu.en: A spatula turns a tofu triangle golden side up in the pan.

jia-chang-dou-fu.zh: 小火翻炒豆瓣和姜蒜葱白，锅中油已变红。
jia-chang-dou-fu.en: Doubanjiang, ginger, garlic and scallion are stirred in red oil over low heat.

jia-chang-dou-fu.zh: 锅中翻炒菱形胡萝卜片和鲜亮青椒。
jia-chang-dou-fu.en: A spatula stir-fries diamond-cut carrots and bright green peppers.

jia-chang-dou-fu.zh: 铲子轻托豆腐翻面，锅中酱汁冒泡挂在豆腐上。
jia-chang-dou-fu.en: A spatula gently lifts tofu as bubbling sauce coats it with the vegetables.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 舀起的面糊连续流回碗中。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: Smooth batter flows in a continuous ribbon from a spoon into the bowl.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 切细葱花，旁边备好腐乳泥、酱料和油条。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: Hands chop scallions beside mashed fermented tofu, sauce and youtiao.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 倾斜平底锅，让面糊铺满锅底。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: A hand tilts the pan to spread the batter across its base.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 用勺背铺匀饼上的蛋液，撒上葱花。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: A spoon spreads egg over the crepe with scallions scattered on top.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 用铲子将饼翻面，蛋面朝向锅底。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: A spatula turns the crepe so the egg side faces the pan.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 小火下将饼边折向刷酱的油条。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: Over low heat, a spatula folds the crepe toward the sauced youtiao.

jian-bing-guo-zi.zh: 包好的鸡蛋葱花煎饼果子盛在盘中。
jian-bing-guo-zi.en: A finished egg and scallion jianbing guozi sits on a plate.

jian-jiao.zh: 手将速冻饺子间隔排入铺了薄油的冷锅。
jian-jiao.en: A hand spaces frozen dumplings in a cold pan coated with a thin layer of oil.

jian-jiao.zh: 手向冷锅中的饺子缓缓倒水，水位约到饺子一半。
jian-jiao.en: A hand slowly pours water into the cold pan until it reaches halfway up the dumplings.

jian-jiao.zh: 饺子在盖着玻璃锅盖的锅中冒泡煮着。
jian-jiao.en: Dumplings simmer in bubbling water under a glass lid.

jian-jiao.zh: 手将温度计探针插入锅中最大饺子的中心。
jian-jiao.en: A hand inserts a thermometer probe into the center of the largest dumpling in the pan.

jian-jiao.zh: 手轻摇锅柄，饺子底部在薄油中滋滋作响。
jian-jiao.en: A hand gently shakes the pan as the dumplings sizzle in a thin layer of oil.

jian-jiao.zh: 手用夹子将金黄的煎饺摆在撒有芝麻和葱花的盘中。
jian-jiao.en: A hand uses tongs to place golden pan-fried dumplings on a plate with sesame and scallions.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 手把牛肉薄片和姜片抓匀。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: Hands mix thin beef slices with ginger slices.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 手切尖椒段，旁边摆着蒜末和葱段。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: Hands cut green chilies beside minced garlic and scallion segments.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 筷子夹起腌牛肉沥汁，姜片放在一旁。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: Chopsticks lift marinated beef to drain, with ginger set aside.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 浅金色蒜末在油中，手将尖椒倒入锅中。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: A hand adds green chilies to pale golden garlic in oil.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 锅铲把牛肉薄片摊开，锅中有尖椒段。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: A spatula spreads thin beef slices in the wok with green chilies.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 手向变色的牛肉和尖椒中倒入葱段与少量腌汁。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: A hand adds scallions and a little marinade to browned beef and green chilies.

jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.zh: 手用锅铲将尖椒牛肉盛入盘中。
jian-jiao-chao-niu-rou.en: Hands serve beef and green chilies onto a plate with a spatula.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 用厨房纸擦干盆里的牛蛙块。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: Hands pat the raw bullfrog pieces dry with a paper towel.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 牛蛙块拌上薄浆，旁边摆着切好的配料。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: A hand coats bullfrog pieces in a thin marinade beside prepared aromatics and peppers.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 锅中油面起波纹，用铲轻轻推开牛蛙块。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: A spatula gently separates bullfrog pieces in rippling oil.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 关火后用勺舀出多余的油，锅中留少量油。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: A ladle transfers excess oil from the unheated wok into a bowl.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 沿锅边倒入啤酒，锅中泡椒和豆瓣已炒出红油。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: Beer is poured down the side of the wok into the red oil and aromatics.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 将温度计插进汤汁中最厚的蛙腿肉。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: A thermometer probes the thickest frog leg as it simmers in sauce.

jian-jiao-niu-wa.zh: 往盛好的红油牛蛙上撒葱花。
jian-jiao-niu-wa.en: A hand scatters scallions over the plated bullfrog in red sauce.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手把胡萝卜切成细条，旁边放着黄瓜条。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: A hand cuts carrot into thin strips beside cucumber strips.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手将干荞麦面放入沸水中，用筷子拨开。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands lower dry soba into boiling water and separate it with chopsticks.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 锅中荞麦面适度翻滚，筷子夹起一根面条。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: Chopsticks lift one soba noodle from a moderately boiling pot.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手用冷水冲洗筛中的荞麦面，并用筷子拨开。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands rinse soba in a sieve under cold water and separate it with chopsticks.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手抖动筛子沥干荞麦面，旁边放着蔬菜条。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands shake a sieve of soba dry beside the vegetable strips.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手用筷子把荞麦面、蔬菜条和油辣椒挑拌均匀。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands toss soba, vegetable strips, and chili crisp with chopsticks.

jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手用筷子拌匀荞麦面、蔬菜条和油辣椒。
jiang-ban-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands toss soba, vegetable strips, and chili crisp together with chopsticks.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 双手用刀将鸡胸肉切成大小均匀的丁。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: Hands cut chicken breast into evenly sized cubes.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 双手在碗中抓拌鸡丁，肉表面均匀裹上薄浆。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: Hands mix chicken cubes in a bowl until evenly coated with a thin marinade.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 双手将去籽黄瓜切成方丁，旁边放着调好的酱汁。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: Hands dice deseeded cucumber beside a bowl of mixed sauce.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 锅铲翻炒分散的鸡丁，鸡肉表面已经变白。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: A spatula stirs separated chicken cubes with opaque white surfaces.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 锅铲搅炒浓亮的葱花酱汁，划过处露出锅底。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: A spatula stirs thick glossy scallion sauce, exposing a track of pan bottom.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 锅铲翻炒鸡丁，每块都裹着酱汁。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: A spatula tosses chicken cubes coated in glossy sauce.

jiang-bao-ji-ding.zh: 双手将酱汁鸡丁和黄瓜丁从锅中盛到盘里。
jiang-bao-ji-ding.en: Hands transfer sauced chicken and cucumber cubes from the pan to a plate.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 用手将带骨鸡块与酱油和料酒拌匀。
jiang-chao-ji.en: A hand mixes bone-in chicken with soy sauce and Shaoxing wine.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 用筷子夹起腌鸡块沥汁，旁边备有姜片、蒜和辣椒。
jiang-chao-ji.en: Chopsticks lift marinated chicken to drain beside prepared ginger, garlic and chilies.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 用锅铲翻炒油中的姜片，姜片边缘渐软。
jiang-chao-ji.en: A spatula stirs ginger slices in oil until their edges soften.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 翻炒鸡块和姜片，鸡肉表面变色并析出油。
jiang-chao-ji.en: Chicken and ginger are stir-fried until the chicken turns opaque and releases oil.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 翻炒鸡块、姜片、辣椒和蒜，使鸡块均匀上色。
jiang-chao-ji.en: Chicken, ginger, chilies and garlic are stir-fried until evenly colored.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 将温度计插入焖煮中的厚鸡块，锅底留有汤汁。
jiang-chao-ji.en: A thermometer probes a thick chicken piece as it simmers in sauce.

jiang-chao-ji.zh: 将裹着薄亮酱汁的姜炒鸡盛入白盘。
jiang-chao-ji.en: Glossy ginger chicken is transferred from the wok to a white plate.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 用木槌敲裂生蟹的大钳，旁边摆着蟹身和蟹盖。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: A hand cracks a raw crab claw with a mallet beside the body halves and shell.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 手在生蟹切面撒薄粉，旁边备好姜片和分开的葱段。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: A hand dusts the cut surface of raw crab with flour beside prepared ginger and separate scallion sections.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 锅中煎蟹块，手用锅铲托起一块蟹身。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: Crab pieces sear in oil as a hand lifts one with a spatula.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 姜片和葱白在锅中热油里冒泡，手持锅铲翻炒。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: Ginger and scallion whites bubble in hot oil as a hand stirs them.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 揭开锅盖，锅中蟹壳已红，姜片和葱白在少量汁中。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: A hand lifts the lid to reveal red crab with ginger and scallion whites in a little liquid.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 手将探针插入蟹钳的白色肉中检查熟度。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: A hand inserts a probe into the white meat of a crab claw.

jiang-cong-chao-xie.zh: 手将姜葱蟹从锅中盛入红边白盘。
jiang-cong-chao-xie.en: Hands transfer ginger scallion crab from a wok to a red-rimmed white platter.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 双手将盐焗鸡粉和油抹在生鸡腿上。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: Hands rub salt-baked chicken seasoning and oil onto raw chicken legs.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 鸡腿平铺在蒸锅里的浅碗中，蒸汽升起。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: Chicken legs lie in a shallow bowl in a steamer as steam rises.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 手持温度计插入熟鸡腿最厚处，碗中留有鸡汁。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the thickest part of a cooked chicken leg above its juices.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 手用勺拌匀碗里的姜末、葱段、糖和盐。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: A hand stirs minced ginger, scallions, sugar and salt in a bowl.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 手将热油从小锅淋到姜葱上，接触处起泡。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: A hand pours hot oil from a saucepan onto ginger and scallions, which bubble on contact.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 双手把熟鸡肉撕成粗丝，鸡骨放在一旁。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: Hands tear cooked chicken into coarse strips, with a bone set aside.

jiang-cong-lao-ji.zh: 双手轻拌鸡丝、姜末和葱段。
jiang-cong-lao-ji.en: Hands gently toss chicken strips with minced ginger and scallions.

jiang-dun-xie.zh: 手持刀将生蟹切半，案板上摆着姜和葱。
jiang-dun-xie.en: Hands cut a raw crab in half beside prepared ginger and scallions.

jiang-dun-xie.zh: 手持锅铲推散冒细泡的姜末黄豆酱。
jiang-dun-xie.en: A hand spreads bubbling soybean paste and minced ginger in a wok.

jiang-dun-xie.zh: 双手将炒好的姜末黄豆酱倒入浅盘。
jiang-dun-xie.en: Hands pour cooked soybean sauce with minced ginger into a shallow plate.

jiang-dun-xie.zh: 手将生蟹块摆在酱汁上，盘中有姜片和葱段。
jiang-dun-xie.en: A hand arranges raw crab over sauce with ginger slices and scallion segments.

jiang-dun-xie.zh: 双手将生蟹盘放入水沸腾的蒸锅。
jiang-dun-xie.en: Hands lower a plate of raw crab into a steamer over boiling water.

jiang-dun-xie.zh: 手在盛有酱汁的熟蟹上撒葱花。
jiang-dun-xie.en: A hand sprinkles chopped scallions over cooked crab in sauce.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 手在姜片和花椒的腌液中翻动牛腱。
jiang-niu-rou.en: A hand turns beef shank in a marinade with ginger and Sichuan peppercorns.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 用漏勺撇去焯牛腱时水面上的浮沫。
jiang-niu-rou.en: A skimmer removes foam from the water around beef shank chunks.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 往牛腱和香料的卤汁中加入黄豆酱。
jiang-niu-rou.en: A spoon adds soybean paste to beef and spices in braising liquid.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 盖着锅盖小火炖牛腱，卤汁轻微冒泡。
jiang-niu-rou.en: Beef shank gently bubbles in a covered pot over low heat.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 用叉子轻提卤汁中的牛腱块，检查软度。
jiang-niu-rou.en: A fork lifts a piece of beef shank from the broth to test its tenderness.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 牛腱块分放在浅盒里，盒盖松松盖着。
jiang-niu-rou.en: Beef shank pieces sit apart in a shallow container under a loose lid.

jiang-niu-rou.zh: 在案板上将牛腱逆纹切成薄片。
jiang-niu-rou.en: Hands slice beef shank thinly across the grain on a cutting board.

jiang-pai-gu.zh: 手持漏勺撇去排骨姜片沸水中的浮沫。
jiang-pai-gu.en: A hand skims foam from boiling ribs and ginger with a slotted spoon.

jiang-pai-gu.zh: 手将排骨倒入冒细泡的浅琥珀色糖油中。
jiang-pai-gu.en: A hand tips ribs into bubbling light amber caramel and oil.

jiang-pai-gu.zh: 手将酱料和香料粉倒入排骨、蒜瓣和米椒中。
jiang-pai-gu.en: A hand pours sauce and spice powder over ribs, garlic and chili.

jiang-pai-gu.zh: 手沿锅边倒入热水，锅中排骨将被汤汁没过。
jiang-pai-gu.en: A hand pours hot water along the wok edge until it nearly covers the ribs.

jiang-pai-gu.zh: 手用勺向微沸的排骨汤中倒入少量老抽。
jiang-pai-gu.en: A hand adds a spoonful of dark soy sauce to gently simmering ribs.

jiang-pai-gu.zh: 手用锅铲翻动排骨，锅底留有流动的酱汁。
jiang-pai-gu.en: A hand turns the ribs with a spatula over a pool of sauce.

jiang-zhuang-nai.zh: 用细筛压出姜汁，旁边的小碗里盛着姜汁。
jiang-zhuang-nai.en: Fresh ginger juice is pressed through a fine sieve, with another bowl of juice nearby.

jiang-zhuang-nai.zh: 小火加热冒热气的牛奶，用温度计测量奶温。
jiang-zhuang-nai.en: A thermometer checks steaming milk in a saucepan over a low flame.

jiang-zhuang-nai.zh: 将热奶连续倒入姜汁，碗中液体呈浅黄色。
jiang-zhuang-nai.en: Hot milk pours in a continuous stream into ginger juice, forming a pale yellow liquid.

jiang-zhuang-nai.zh: 用温度计复测锅中热奶，旁边备着一碗姜汁。
jiang-zhuang-nai.en: A thermometer rechecks the hot milk beside a bowl of ginger juice.

jiang-zhuang-nai.zh: 两碗姜撞奶盖着小碟，静置在台面上。
jiang-zhuang-nai.en: Two bowls of ginger milk rest undisturbed under saucers.

jiang-zhuang-nai.zh: 勺子从碗边舀起一小块柔软的姜汁奶凝。
jiang-zhuang-nai.en: A spoon lifts a small soft piece of ginger milk curd from the edge of the bowl.

jiao-bai-chao-rou.zh: 手切茭白片，肉条、姜丝和蒜分开放好。
jiao-bai-chao-rou.en: Hands slice water bamboo, with pork strips, ginger and garlic set separately nearby.

jiao-bai-chao-rou.zh: 手在碗中抓拌薄浆肉条，碗底没有积水。
jiao-bai-chao-rou.en: A hand mixes thinly coated pork strips in a bowl without pooled liquid.

jiao-bai-chao-rou.zh: 漏勺从沸水中捞出茭白片沥水。
jiao-bai-chao-rou.en: A slotted spoon lifts water bamboo slices from boiling water to drain.

jiao-bai-chao-rou.zh: 锅铲在热锅中拨散表面变白的肉条。
jiao-bai-chao-rou.en: A spatula separates pork strips whose surfaces have turned white in a hot wok.

jiao-bai-chao-rou.zh: 茭白片倒入锅中，姜丝与蒜末刚炒香。
jiao-bai-chao-rou.en: Water bamboo slices are tipped into a wok with ginger and lightly golden minced garlic.

jiao-bai-chao-rou.zh: 锅铲翻炒茭白和肉条，食材裹着薄薄亮汁。
jiao-bai-chao-rou.en: A spatula tosses water bamboo and pork strips coated in a thin glossy sauce.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 手持菜刀将去骨猪排切成粗条，旁边放着葱姜水。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: Hands cut boneless pork chops into thick strips beside a bowl of scallion-ginger water.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 一边拌椒盐肉条，一边倒入滤过的葱姜水。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: A hand mixes seasoned pork strips while strained scallion-ginger water is poured in.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 筷子提起炸糊，面糊连续流回碗中。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: Chopsticks lift batter that flows in a continuous ribbon back into the bowl.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 筷子夹起薄薄挂糊的肉条，旁边是淀粉和拍粉肉条。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: Chopsticks lift a thinly battered pork strip beside starch and dusted pork.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 筷子从油锅夹起浅金色排条，旁边放着沥油网架。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: Chopsticks lift a pale golden pork strip from the oil beside a draining rack.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 筷子从油锅夹起金黄色的复炸排条。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: Chopsticks lift a golden twice-fried pork strip from the oil.

jiao-yan-pai-tiao.zh: 手向盘中摊开的金黄排条撒椒盐。
jiao-yan-pai-tiao.en: A hand sprinkles seasoned salt over golden pork strips spread on a plate.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 熟玉米从锅中倒入漏篮沥水。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: Cooked corn is poured from a pot into a colander to drain.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 双手轻晃垫纸的盘子，吸去玉米表面水分。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: Hands gently shake corn on a paper-lined plate to absorb surface moisture.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 手将淀粉撒在分散的玉米粒上。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: A hand sprinkles starch over separated corn kernels.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 少量裹粉玉米下油锅试煎，周围冒出细泡。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: A few coated corn kernels are tested in oil, with fine bubbles around them.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 锅铲从下方轻轻托起单层玉米粒。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: A spatula gently lifts a single layer of corn kernels from underneath.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 浅黄色玉米粒从锅中盛到厨房纸上吸油。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: Pale golden corn kernels are transferred from the pan onto kitchen paper to absorb oil.

jiao-yan-yu-mi.zh: 手将芝麻和椒盐撒在装盘的玉米上。
jiao-yan-yu-mi.en: A hand sprinkles sesame and seasoned salt over the plated corn.

jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.zh: 手用布擦干开背生虾，旁边备好蒜末、香菜和黄油。
jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.en: A hand pats a split raw prawn dry beside minced garlic, cilantro, and butter.

jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.zh: 手将青芥末和糖搅入酱汁，盐和料酒放在一旁。
jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.en: A hand stirs wasabi and sugar into the sauce, with salt and cooking wine nearby.

jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.zh: 锅中虾单层煎至壳红，手用夹子翻动一只虾。
jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.en: Prawns sear in a single layer until red as a hand turns one with tongs.

jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.zh: 小火下翻拌红虾、蒜末和正在融化的黄油。
jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.en: A hand turns red prawns with minced garlic and melting butter over low heat.

jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.zh: 手翻拌酱汁轻沸的虾，开背处虾肉呈不透明白色。
jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.en: A hand turns prawns in gently bubbling sauce, revealing opaque white flesh.

jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.zh: 手在装盘的酱汁虾上放香菜，旁边是锅和料酒。
jie-mo-huang-you-luo-shi-xia.en: A hand adds cilantro to plated sauced prawns beside the pan and cooking wine.

jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.zh: 用剪刀剪开生虾背壳，旁边备好蒜末和辣椒圈。
jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.en: Kitchen scissors cut open a raw prawn’s back shell beside minced garlic and chili rings.

jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.zh: 用勺搅拌碗中的芥末淀粉酱汁。
jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.en: A spoon stirs the wasabi and starch sauce in a bowl.

jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.zh: 中火煎虾，用夹子翻开一面已经变红的虾。
jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.en: Prawns fry over medium heat as tongs turn one with a reddened shell.

jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.zh: 小火翻拌红虾、蒜末、辣椒圈和正在融化的黄油。
jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.en: Red prawns, minced garlic, chili rings and melting butter are stirred over low heat.

jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.zh: 夹开锅中虾背，检查厚肉是否呈不透明的珍珠白。
jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.en: Tongs open a prawn in the pan to check its opaque pearly white flesh.

jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.zh: 用夹子将裹着浓汁的虾盛入盘中。
jie-mo-luo-shi-xia.en: Tongs transfer sauce-coated prawns onto a serving plate.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 锅中鸡蛋轻沸，手拿切开的熟蛋检查蛋黄。
jin-qian-dan.en: Eggs simmer gently as a hand checks the firm yolk of a cut egg.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 手在切蒜末，旁边备有辣椒、葱花、料汁和冷却的鸡蛋。
jin-qian-dan.en: Hands mince garlic beside chopped chilies, scallions, sauce, and cooling eggs.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 手用刀横切熟鸡蛋，旁边放着玉米淀粉。
jin-qian-dan.en: Hands slice a boiled egg crosswise beside a plate of cornstarch.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 蛋片在油锅中单层煎至边缘浅金黄，宽铲托起一片翻面。
jin-qian-dan.en: Egg slices fry in one layer until pale golden at the edges, and a spatula turns one.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 蛋片拨到锅的一侧，手将青红辣椒和蒜末倒入油中。
jin-qian-dan.en: Egg slices sit to one side while a hand adds green and red chilies and minced garlic to the oil.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 蛋片和辣椒拨到一侧，锅铲在泛红的油中炒豆瓣酱。
jin-qian-dan.en: Egg slices and chilies sit to one side while a spatula fries chili bean paste in reddened oil.

jin-qian-dan.zh: 手用锅铲把裹汁的蛋片和辣椒盛入盘中。
jin-qian-dan.en: A hand uses a spatula to plate sauce-coated egg slices and chilies.

jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.zh: 用厨房纸吸干豆腐圆片，旁边放着金针菇、蒜末和小米椒。
jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.en: A hand blots tofu rounds beside enoki mushrooms, minced garlic and chopped chilies.

jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.zh: 用宽铲翻起底面金黄的豆腐圆片。
jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.en: A broad spatula turns a tofu round with a golden underside.

jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.zh: 用勺搅匀碗里的棕色料汁。
jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.en: A hand stirs brown sauce in a bowl.

jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.zh: 用锅铲翻炒软塌的金针菇、小米椒和蒜末。
jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.en: A spatula turns softened enoki mushrooms with chilies and minced garlic.

jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.zh: 小火下给铺着豆腐和金针菇的锅盖上盖子。
jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.en: A hand covers the gently simmering tofu and enoki over low heat.

jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.zh: 用宽铲将裹着酱汁的豆腐和金针菇托入盘中。
jin-zhen-gu-ri-ben-dou-fu-bao.en: A broad spatula transfers sauced tofu and enoki onto a plate.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 双手将去根的金针菇拆成小束。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: Hands pull trimmed enoki mushrooms into small bundles.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 双手在案板上将金针菇切成短段。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: Hands cut enoki mushrooms into short pieces on a cutting board.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 锅里的金针菇汤翻滚沸腾，勺子正在翻松菌菇。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: A spoon loosens enoki mushrooms in a pot at a rolling boil.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 用勺子将沸腾汤中漂起的金针菇轻轻推入水里。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: A spoon gently pushes floating enoki mushrooms beneath the boiling broth.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 蛋液细细淋入轻沸的金针菇汤，形成蛋花。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: A thin stream of beaten egg forms ribbons in gently simmering enoki soup.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 用小勺向轻沸的金针菇蛋花汤撒入白色调味料。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: A small spoon sprinkles white seasoning into gently simmering enoki and egg soup.

jin-zhen-gu-tang.zh: 用勺子向碗里的金针菇汤滴入香油。
jin-zhen-gu-tang.en: A spoon drips sesame oil onto a bowl of enoki soup.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 用手抓拌碗中上浆的生肉丝，旁边放着姜末。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: A hand mixes coated raw pork strips in a bowl beside minced ginger.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 用勺搅匀酱汁，旁边盘中放着葱段和葱丝。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: A spoon stirs smooth sauce beside a plate of scallion segments and shreds.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 用筷子从沸水中夹起柔软的千张。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: Chopsticks lift a soft tofu sheet from boiling water.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 用筷子在锅中拨散外层变白的肉丝。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: Chopsticks separate pork strips with opaque white exteriors in a pan.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 用铲子搅动锅中浓稠的酱汁和葱段，锅底留下一道痕迹。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: A spatula draws a trail through thick sauce and scallion segments in a pan.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 用铲子翻拌锅中均匀裹酱的肉丝。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: A spatula tosses pork strips evenly coated with sauce in a pan.

jing-jiang-rou-si.zh: 手用千张卷起肉丝和葱丝，旁边摆着肉盘和千张。
jing-jiang-rou-si.en: A hand rolls pork and scallion in a tofu sheet beside the plated dish and extra sheets.

jiu-cai-chao-dan.zh: 双手切韭菜，粗根段和嫩叶分开放在案板上。
jiu-cai-chao-dan.en: Hands slice chives, keeping the thicker base pieces and tender leaves in separate piles.

jiu-cai-chao-dan.zh: 双手用筷子搅拌碗中均匀的蛋液。
jiu-cai-chao-dan.en: Hands stir evenly beaten egg in a bowl with chopsticks.

jiu-cai-chao-dan.zh: 锅铲把凝固的蛋液从边缘推向中间。
jiu-cai-chao-dan.en: A spatula pushes set egg from the edge toward the liquid center.

jiu-cai-chao-dan.zh: 大火上用锅铲翻炒鲜绿、略软的韭菜段。
jiu-cai-chao-dan.en: A spatula tosses bright green, slightly softened chives over high heat.

jiu-cai-chao-dan.zh: 一手撒盐，一手将韭菜和蛋块从锅底轻翻。
jiu-cai-chao-dan.en: One hand sprinkles salt while the other gently folds chives and egg from the bottom of the wok.

jiu-cai-chao-dan.zh: 双手用锅铲将韭菜和柔软蛋块从锅中盛入盘中。
jiu-cai-chao-dan.en: Hands use a spatula to transfer chives and soft egg pieces from the wok to a plate.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 热水细细倒入面粉，筷子将面粉拌成絮状。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: Hot water is poured into flour while chopsticks stir it into shaggy flakes.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 手在案板上切碎韭菜，虾丁和蛋液分碗放好。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: Hands chop chives on a board, with diced shrimp and beaten eggs in separate bowls.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 锅铲翻炒不透明的虾丁，炒好的蛋碎放在一旁。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: A spatula turns opaque diced shrimp in a pan beside a bowl of scrambled egg.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 手向韭菜、蛋碎和熟虾丁的馅中撒盐。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: A hand sprinkles salt over the chive, egg and cooked shrimp filling.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 双手捏紧半月形面皮的边缘，旁边放着馅和圆皮。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: Hands seal the edge of a half-moon wrapper beside the filling and round wrappers.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 锅铲翻起盒子，露出煎至金黄的一面。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: A spatula turns a pocket in the pan, revealing its golden side.

jiu-cai-he-zi.zh: 手用夹子将金黄的盒子放上盘，切开的盒子露出馅料。
jiu-cai-he-zi.en: A hand plates golden pockets with tongs, beside one cut open to show the filling.

jiu-niang-lao-zao.zh: 向电饭煲里的糯米倒水。
jiu-niang-lao-zao.en: Pour water over glutinous rice in the rice cooker.

jiu-niang-lao-zao.zh: 用温度计测量摊开的熟糯米饭。
jiu-niang-lao-zao.en: Check the temperature of the spread-out cooked glutinous rice.

jiu-niang-lao-zao.zh: 用饭勺翻拌湿润的糯米饭，旁边放着曲液。
jiu-niang-lao-zao.en: Fold the moist glutinous rice with a paddle, with starter liquid beside it.

jiu-niang-lao-zao.zh: 用勺子在发酵容器里的糯米饭中央挖孔。
jiu-niang-lao-zao.en: Use a spoon to make a well in the rice in the fermentation container.

jiu-niang-lao-zao.zh: 揭开发酵容器，查看米饭中央渗出的清液。
jiu-niang-lao-zao.en: Lift the lid to inspect the clear liquid in the well of fermented rice.

jiu-niang-lao-zao.zh: 向一碗酒酿中倒入凉白开。
jiu-niang-lao-zao.en: Pour cooled boiled water into a bowl of fermented rice.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 案板上摆着肉丁和菜丁，手在碗里搅匀水淀粉。
jjajangmyeon.en: Diced pork and vegetables sit on a board while hands stir the starch slurry in a bowl.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 锅中翻炒五花肉丁，肉面金黄并渗出油脂。
jjajangmyeon.en: Pork belly cubes are stirred in a wok until golden and their fat renders.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 锅中翻炒五花肉和四种菜丁，洋葱边缘变透明。
jjajangmyeon.en: Pork belly and four diced vegetables are stirred in a wok as the onion edges turn translucent.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 肉菜推在锅边，锅中央的春酱在油中冒细泡。
jjajangmyeon.en: Pork and vegetables ring the wok while black bean paste bubbles gently in oil at the center.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 肉菜在酱汁中小火煮着，手用筷子试扎土豆。
jjajangmyeon.en: Pork and vegetables simmer in sauce while a hand tests a potato cube with chopsticks.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 手往裹着肉菜的浓亮酱汁中倒香油并搅拌。
jjajangmyeon.en: Hands pour sesame oil into the glossy sauce coating the pork and vegetables and stir.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 手用筷子把粗鲜面放入大火滚沸的水中。
jjajangmyeon.en: A hand lowers thick fresh noodles into vigorously boiling water with chopsticks.

jjajangmyeon.zh: 手将肉菜炸酱浇在面上，碗中央放着黄瓜丝。
jjajangmyeon.en: A hand ladles pork and vegetable black bean sauce onto noodles topped with cucumber matchsticks.

jok.zh: 料理机将猪肉馅搅打成细腻黏稠的肉泥。
jok.en: A food processor blends the pork mixture into a smooth, sticky paste.

jok.zh: 手将沥干的香米倒入翻滚的沸水中。
jok.en: A hand pours drained jasmine rice into vigorously boiling water.

jok.zh: 手轻搅锅中浓稠的粥底，锅盖留缝。
jok.en: A hand gently stirs thick rice congee under an ajar lid.

jok.zh: 双手用两把勺子将肉馅舀入冒泡的高汤。
jok.en: Two hands use spoons to lower pork mixture into bubbling stock.

jok.zh: 肉丸粥从勺边连续流回小火煮着的锅中。
jok.en: Meatball congee flows continuously from a ladle into the simmering pot.

jok.zh: 手在肉丸粥上撒葱花，碗中已有姜丝。
jok.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over meatball congee topped with ginger.

jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.zh: 双手沿躯干剖开乳鸽，旁边备好玉米、香菇和姜片。
jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.en: Hands split a squab lengthwise beside prepared corn, shiitake and ginger.

jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.zh: 大火焯水后用漏勺捞出变色的乳鸽，锅中浮着姜片和浮沫。
jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.en: A slotted spoon lifts pale blanched squab from boiling water with ginger and scum.

jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.zh: 往装有乳鸽、玉米、香菇和姜片的炖锅中倒清水。
jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.en: Water is poured into a pot containing squab, corn, shiitake and ginger.

jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.zh: 乳鸽和配料在半盖的炖锅中小火轻煨，汤面冒出细泡。
jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.en: Squab and vegetables simmer gently under a partly closed lid, with small bubbles in the broth.

jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.zh: 用食品温度计从侧面探入炖锅中的鸽胸肉。
jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.en: A food thermometer probes the squab breast from the side in the pot.

jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.zh: 用筷子从乳鸽、玉米和香菇汤中夹出姜片，旁边放着碗。
jun-gu-dun-ru-ge.en: Chopsticks lift a ginger slice from the squab, corn and shiitake soup beside a serving bowl.

kabocha-no-nimono.zh: 手在砧板上削去南瓜块的棱角和窄条瓜皮。
kabocha-no-nimono.en: Hands trim a corner and a narrow strip of skin from kabocha on a cutting board.

kabocha-no-nimono.zh: 手向排好南瓜块的浅锅里倒入高汤，旁边备有清酒和糖。
kabocha-no-nimono.en: Hands pour dashi over kabocha in a shallow pot, with sake and sugar nearby.

kabocha-no-nimono.zh: 手向锅边冒泡的南瓜煮汁中倒入一勺酱油。
kabocha-no-nimono.en: A hand pours a spoonful of soy sauce into bubbling broth around the kabocha.

kabocha-no-nimono.zh: 手将木落盖放在南瓜块上，锅中煮汁微微冒泡。
kabocha-no-nimono.en: A hand places a wooden drop lid over kabocha in gently bubbling broth.

kabocha-no-nimono.zh: 手用竹签扎入南瓜块中心，锅中煮汁微微冒泡。
kabocha-no-nimono.en: A hand inserts a bamboo skewer into a kabocha piece in gently bubbling broth.

kabocha-no-nimono.zh: 手用宽勺托起带皮南瓜块，盛入有少量煮汁的盘中。
kabocha-no-nimono.en: A hand lifts a skin-on kabocha piece with a wide spoon onto a plate with a little broth.

kai-jeow.zh: 用叉子搅打碗中均匀起细泡的蛋液。
kai-jeow.en: A fork beats the evenly mixed egg in a bowl until fine bubbles appear.

kai-jeow.zh: 将一滴蛋液滴入热油，蛋液立即起泡。
kai-jeow.en: A drop of beaten egg bubbles immediately in the hot oil.

kai-jeow.zh: 用铲子将蓬起凝固的蛋饼边缘推向中间。
kai-jeow.en: A spatula pushes the puffed, set edge of the omelet toward the center.

kai-jeow.zh: 倾斜锅子，让生蛋液流向露出的锅底。
kai-jeow.en: The pan tilts so uncooked egg flows onto the exposed bottom.

kai-jeow.zh: 用宽铲托起完整的金黄蛋饼翻面。
kai-jeow.en: A wide spatula lifts and flips the intact golden omelet.

kai-jeow.zh: 金黄蓬松的泰式煎蛋盛在餐盘中。
kai-jeow.en: The golden, puffy Thai omelet rests on a serving plate.

kalguksu.zh: 双手在碗中揉成团的面团，旁边放着水。
kalguksu.en: Hands knead cohesive dough in a bowl beside a cup of water.

kalguksu.zh: 手持漏勺撇去鸡汤表面的浮沫。
kalguksu.en: A hand skims foam from chicken broth with a slotted spoon.

kalguksu.zh: 双手挤出西葫芦丝的水分，旁边是调好的鸡丝。
kalguksu.en: Hands squeeze liquid from zucchini strips beside seasoned shredded chicken.

kalguksu.zh: 双手用擀面杖将面团擀成薄片。
kalguksu.en: Hands use a rolling pin to roll dough into a thin sheet.

kalguksu.zh: 双手将折叠的面片切成条，旁边放着散开的面条。
kalguksu.en: Hands cut folded dough into strips beside loosened noodles.

kalguksu.zh: 手用筷子拨散沸水中的面条，旁边的锅里煮着洋葱鸡汤。
kalguksu.en: A hand separates noodles in boiling water beside a pot of chicken broth and onion.

kalguksu.zh: 手在鸡丝西葫芦刀切面上撒葱绿。
kalguksu.en: A hand scatters green scallions over chicken and zucchini noodle soup.

kao-dan-ta.zh: 手轻搅碗中均匀的蛋奶液，旁边放着留好的蛋清。
kao-dan-ta.en: A hand gently stirs smooth custard in a bowl beside the reserved egg whites.

kao-dan-ta.zh: 手将蛋奶液倒入筛网，过滤到碗中。
kao-dan-ta.en: Hands pour custard through a sieve into a bowl.

kao-dan-ta.zh: 手将空挞皮间隔摆在烤盘上，旁边的烤箱已预热。
kao-dan-ta.en: A hand spaces empty tart shells on a tray beside the preheated oven.

kao-dan-ta.zh: 手将蛋奶液倒入挞皮，液面低于挞皮边缘。
kao-dan-ta.en: A hand pours custard into tart shells, leaving space below the rims.

kao-dan-ta.zh: 打开烤箱，盘中蛋挞酥皮金黄、馅面凝住。
kao-dan-ta.en: The open oven reveals tarts with golden pastry and set custard.

kao-dan-ta.zh: 手将烤好的蛋挞放在网架上稍凉。
kao-dan-ta.en: A hand places baked egg tarts on a wire rack to cool.

kao-qie-zi.zh: 手用勺搅拌湿润的蒜蓉辣椒酱。
kao-qie-zi.en: A hand stirs a moist garlic and chili sauce with a spoon.

kao-qie-zi.zh: 手用叉子在整根茄子表皮上扎孔。
kao-qie-zi.en: A hand pricks the skin of a whole eggplant with a fork.

kao-qie-zi.zh: 手将盛着整根茄子的烤盘送入烤箱中层。
kao-qie-zi.en: A hand slides a tray holding a whole eggplant onto the middle oven rack.

kao-qie-zi.zh: 手用夹子轻压表皮起皱的烤茄子。
kao-qie-zi.en: A hand gently presses a wrinkled roasted eggplant with tongs.

kao-qie-zi.zh: 手用叉子划松剖开的茄肉，热气升起。
kao-qie-zi.en: A hand loosens the flesh of the split eggplant with a fork as steam rises.

kao-qie-zi.zh: 手用勺将蒜蓉辣椒酱铺进剖开的茄肉。
kao-qie-zi.en: A hand spoons garlic and chili sauce into the opened eggplant.

kao-yu.zh: 双手将调料抹在划过刀的生鱼肉上。
kao-yu.en: Hands rub seasonings over the scored raw fish.

kao-yu.zh: 手将千张切丝，周围摆着备好的配菜和香料。
kao-yu.en: Hands cut tofu sheets into strips beside prepared vegetables and spices.

kao-yu.zh: 手向烤至金黄的鱼皮上撒孜然。
kao-yu.en: A hand sprinkles cumin over the golden roasted fish skin.

kao-yu.zh: 锅中炒散底料，红油里有葱蒜和香料。
kao-yu.en: A hand stirs the paste into red oil with leek, garlic, and spices.

kao-yu.zh: 手将烤鱼放到红汤和配菜上。
kao-yu.en: Hands lower the roasted fish onto vegetables in red broth.

kao-yu.zh: 手将热油浇在鱼身上的辣椒和青花椒上。
kao-yu.en: A hand pours hot oil over the chilies and green Sichuan peppercorns on the fish.

karaage.zh: 手将带皮鸡腿肉切成大小相近的鸡块。
karaage.en: Hands cut skin-on chicken thigh into evenly sized pieces.

karaage.zh: 手用筷子将带皮鸡块与葱末腌汁拌匀。
karaage.en: Hands mix skin-on chicken pieces with scallion marinade using chopsticks.

karaage.zh: 筛中的生鸡块沥着腌汁，手用纸轻吸表面。
karaage.en: A hand blots raw chicken in a strainer as marinade drains into a bowl.

karaage.zh: 手在面粉盘中滚动鸡块，裹上薄薄一层粉。
karaage.en: A hand rolls chicken in flour to coat it lightly.

karaage.zh: 手将薄裹面粉的鸡块放入热油，锅中鸡块周围冒泡。
karaage.en: A hand lowers a lightly floured chicken piece into bubbling oil beside other pieces.

karaage.zh: 手将温度计插入油锅中浅金褐色的鸡块。
karaage.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into a light golden brown chicken piece in the oil.

katsudon.zh: 在猪排肥瘦交界处划浅口，旁边备好面粉、蛋液和面包糠。
katsudon.en: Score the fat edge of seasoned pork cutlets beside plates of flour, egg, and panko.

katsudon.zh: 用手将面包糠轻压在猪排表面和侧边。
katsudon.en: Press panko onto the top and sides of a pork cutlet.

katsudon.zh: 用夹子翻动深锅中炸至金黄的猪排。
katsudon.en: Turn a golden pork cutlet in bubbling oil with tongs.

katsudon.zh: 揭开锅盖，出汁中的洋葱已煮软；切好的猪排和蛋液在旁。
katsudon.en: Lift the lid to reveal softened onions in dashi beside sliced cutlet and beaten egg.

katsudon.zh: 盖上锅盖，小火煮洋葱和浸在汤汁中的猪排。
katsudon.en: Cover the pan and gently simmer sliced cutlets and onions in broth.

katsudon.zh: 揭开锅盖，猪排和洋葱周围的蛋液已凝成软块。
katsudon.en: Lift the lid to reveal softly set egg around the cutlets and onions.

katsudon.zh: 用宽铲将猪排、蛋和洋葱盖到白饭上，撒有葱花。
katsudon.en: Use a broad spatula to place cutlet, egg, and onions with scallions over rice.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 用漏勺撇去鸡翅焯水锅里的浮沫。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: A hand skims foam from a pot of blanching chicken wings.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 用刀在焯过的鸡翅上划浅口，旁边放着生抽。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: Hands score a blanched chicken wing beside a bowl of light soy sauce.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 用筷子翻动锅中的鸡翅，露出煎至金黄的一面。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: Chopsticks turn a chicken wing to reveal its golden seared side.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 往鸡翅和葱结的锅中倒入可乐，旁边备着调料。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: A hand pours cola over chicken wings and a scallion knot, with seasonings nearby.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 把温度计插入焖煮中的鸡翅厚处。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the thick part of a simmering chicken wing.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 小火翻动鸡翅，锅里的酱汁减少并冒出密集气泡。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: Chopsticks turn chicken wings over low heat as the reduced sauce bubbles densely.

ke-le-ji-chi.zh: 将亮汁淋在盘中油亮的可乐鸡翅上。
ke-le-ji-chi.en: A spoon pours glossy sauce over plated cola chicken wings.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 手将碎棕榈糖倒入开始冒泡的猪肘卤汁。
khao-kha-moo.en: A hand adds chopped palm sugar to the pork hock as the braising liquid begins to bubble.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 手将香料倒入小火轻沸的猪肘锅中。
khao-kha-moo.en: A hand adds aromatics to the pork hock simmering gently over low heat.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 双手剥煮熟的鸡蛋，旁边放着沥干的酸芥菜。
khao-kha-moo.en: Hands peel a boiled egg beside a bowl of drained pickled mustard greens.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 手用叉子检查轻沸的猪肘，锅里还有卤蛋和酸芥菜。
