khao-kha-moo.en: A hand tests the gently simmering pork hock with a fork, alongside eggs and pickled mustard greens.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 手把芥兰叶放入煮着鲜绿菜茎的水中，旁边放着辣椒醋。
khao-kha-moo.en: A hand adds gai lan leaves to boiling water with bright green stems, beside a bowl of chili vinegar.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 双手将带皮猪肘切片，旁边是半切卤蛋和酸芥菜。
khao-kha-moo.en: Hands slice skin-on pork hock beside halved braised eggs and cut pickled mustard greens.

khao-kha-moo.zh: 手把卤汁淋在猪脚饭上，旁边放着辣椒醋。
khao-kha-moo.en: A hand spoons braising liquid over pork and rice, with chili vinegar served on the side.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手将去皮青芒果切成细丝，旁边摆着切好的配菜。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: Hands cut peeled green mango into fine strips beside the prepared accompaniments.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手翻炒猪肉，棕榈糖正在融入黏稠褐色酱汁。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: A hand stirs pork as palm sugar melts into the sticky brown sauce.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手用锅铲掀起锅中已经凝固的薄蛋皮。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: A hand lifts the edge of a set thin egg sheet with a spatula.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手用漏勺捞起炸脆的小虾干，沥去油。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: A hand lifts crisp dried shrimp from the oil with a slotted spoon.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手用锅铲翻煎锅中刚上色的腊肠段。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: A hand turns lightly browned Chinese sausage pieces in the pan.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手用锅铲翻拌均匀染色、颗粒松散的虾酱饭。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: A hand folds loose, evenly colored shrimp-paste rice with a spatula.

khao-kluk-kapi.zh: 手将青柠瓣摆在饭团及各色配菜旁。
khao-kluk-kapi.en: A hand places a lime wedge beside the rice dome and arranged accompaniments.

khao-man-gai.zh: 用漏勺撇去微微冒泡的鸡汤表面浮沫。
khao-man-gai.en: A hand skims foam from gently bubbling chicken broth.

khao-man-gai.zh: 用勺捞出金黄的鸡皮油渣，锅中留有鸡油。
khao-man-gai.en: A hand lifts golden chicken cracklings from rendered fat.

khao-man-gai.zh: 将沥干的香米倒入鸡油和淡金色蒜末中。
khao-man-gai.en: A hand pours drained jasmine rice into chicken fat and pale golden garlic.

khao-man-gai.zh: 搅拌冒泡的姜辣黄豆蘸酱。
khao-man-gai.en: A hand stirs bubbling ginger and chili soybean sauce.

khao-man-gai.zh: 将鸡肉片摆在鸡油饭上，配黄瓜、蘸酱和清汤。
khao-man-gai.en: Hands arrange sliced chicken over rice with cucumber, dipping sauce and broth.

khao-niao.zh: 往盛有糯米的大碗中倒入清水，水面没过米。
khao-niao.en: A hand pours clear water into a large bowl of glutinous rice, covering the grains.

khao-niao.zh: 手持筛子沥去泡发糯米的水，筛下只有一滴水。
khao-niao.en: A hand holds a sieve of soaked glutinous rice above a bowl, with one drop falling.

khao-niao.zh: 蒸锅水沸腾、蒸汽上升，手将湿布铺入蒸屉。
khao-niao.en: A hand lines the steamer basket with damp cloth as water boils and steam rises.

khao-niao.zh: 手将糯米铺在蒸布上，米层中央留有通气孔。
khao-niao.en: A hand spreads glutinous rice on the cloth, leaving a hole in the center.

khao-niao.zh: 揭开蒸锅，用勺从米层中央取出几粒米检查。
khao-niao.en: With the steamer open, a hand lifts a few grains from the center with a spoon.

khao-niao.zh: 用饭勺将蒸好的糯米饭盛入红纹带盖碗。
khao-niao.en: A hand spoons steamed glutinous rice into a red-patterned bowl with its lid beside it.

khao-niao-mamuang.zh: 双手在滤网中冲洗泡发的糯米。
khao-niao-mamuang.en: Hands rinse soaked sticky rice in a strainer.

khao-niao-mamuang.zh: 手在铺了湿纱布的蒸屉中摊平糯米。
khao-niao-mamuang.en: A hand spreads sticky rice in a steamer lined with damp cheesecloth.

khao-niao-mamuang.zh: 手将温椰浆倒在大碗里的熟糯米上。
khao-niao-mamuang.en: A hand pours warm coconut cream over cooked sticky rice in a large bowl.

khao-niao-mamuang.zh: 手搅拌微微冒泡的椰浆酱，旁边备着糖。
khao-niao-mamuang.en: A hand stirs gently bubbling coconut sauce with sugar ready beside it.

khao-niao-mamuang.zh: 双手将去皮芒果横切成片，旁边是糯米饭。
khao-niao-mamuang.en: Hands slice peeled mango crosswise beside a bowl of sticky rice.

khao-niao-mamuang.zh: 手将椰浆酱淋在糯米饭上，旁边摆着芒果和淋酱。
khao-niao-mamuang.en: A hand drizzles coconut sauce over sticky rice beside mango and extra sauce.

khao-pad.zh: 双手拨松米饭，旁边摆着分成两份的鸡肉、蔬菜和酱汁。
khao-pad.en: Hands loosen rice beside two portions of chicken, vegetables and sauce.

khao-pad.zh: 双手将辣椒圈拌入鱼露，旁边放着黄瓜片和青柠角。
khao-pad.en: Hands stir chili rings into fish sauce beside cucumber slices and lime wedges.

khao-pad.zh: 锅铲翻动微微上色的洋葱瓣，锅中还有蒜末。
khao-pad.en: A spatula turns lightly browned onion wedges in a wok with minced garlic.

khao-pad.zh: 锅铲翻炒鸡肉、番茄、洋葱和芥兰茎。
khao-pad.en: A spatula stir-fries chicken, tomato, onion and Chinese broccoli stalks.

khao-pad.zh: 锅铲从锅底翻起米饭、鸡肉和蔬菜，旁边放着三碗酱汁。
khao-pad.en: A spatula lifts rice, chicken and vegetables from the wok beside three bowls of sauce.

khao-pad.zh: 锅铲轻划饭中央正在凝固的鸡蛋，芥兰叶放在一旁。
khao-pad.en: A spatula gently stirs an egg setting in the center of the rice, with broccoli leaves on the side.

khao-pad.zh: 手向鸡肉蔬菜炒饭挤青柠汁，盘边有黄瓜，旁边有辣椒鱼露。
khao-pad.en: A hand squeezes lime over chicken and vegetable fried rice, served with cucumber and chili fish sauce.

khao-soi.zh: 手持木铲在干锅中翻炒草果籽和芫荽籽，旁边放着干辣椒碎。
khao-soi.en: A hand stirs tsaoko and coriander seeds in a dry pan beside chopped dried chilies.

khao-soi.zh: 手用石杵将烙香的姜、红葱头和香料捣成湿润的咖喱酱。
khao-soi.en: Hands pound roasted ginger, shallots and spices into a moist curry paste.

khao-soi.zh: 手在锅中翻炒椰奶咖喱酱，酱汁已变浓稠。
khao-soi.en: A hand stirs coconut curry paste in a pot until thick.

khao-soi.zh: 手掀开留缝的锅盖，鸡腿在冒着小泡的咖喱汤中慢煨。
khao-soi.en: A hand lifts the ajar lid over chicken drumsticks simmering gently in curry broth.

khao-soi.zh: 手用漏铲把金黄面条压进热油，油面只剩少量气泡。
khao-soi.en: A hand presses golden noodles into hot oil with a slotted spoon as a few bubbles remain.

khao-soi.zh: 手在小锅中搅炒油里的辣椒碎，辣椒颜色略深。
khao-soi.en: A hand stirs slightly darkened chili flakes in oil in a small saucepan.

khao-soi.zh: 手用筷子从沸水中夹起扁鸡蛋面，检查面条。
khao-soi.en: A hand lifts flat egg noodles from boiling water with chopsticks to check them.

khao-soi.zh: 手将炸面放到咖喱鸡腿面上，旁边摆着酸芥菜、红葱头、青柠和辣椒油。
khao-soi.en: A hand tops chicken curry noodles with crisp noodles beside pickled greens, shallots, lime and chili oil.

kimchi-bokkeumbap.zh: 手在案板上切碎泡菜，旁边放着熟饭和泡菜汁。
kimchi-bokkeumbap.en: Hands chop kimchi beside bowls of cooked rice and reserved kimchi juice.

kimchi-bokkeumbap.zh: 手搅拌碗中的红汁，直到酱汁均匀。
kimchi-bokkeumbap.en: Hands stir the red sauce in a bowl until smooth.

kimchi-bokkeumbap.zh: 手在火上翻炒泡菜，锅里只剩少量水分。
kimchi-bokkeumbap.en: Hands stir-fry kimchi over a flame with little liquid left in the pan.

kimchi-bokkeumbap.zh: 手将红汁倒入锅中，翻拌米饭和泡菜。
kimchi-bokkeumbap.en: Hands pour red sauce into the pan and turn the rice and kimchi.

kimchi-bokkeumbap.zh: 手拨开泡菜炒饭，露出干爽的锅底。
kimchi-bokkeumbap.en: A hand pushes the kimchi fried rice aside to reveal the dry pan.

kimchi-bokkeumbap.zh: 手往泡菜炒饭上撒紫菜丝，饭上已有葱花和芝麻。
kimchi-bokkeumbap.en: A hand scatters seaweed strips over kimchi fried rice topped with scallions and sesame.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 手在切泡菜，案板上放着葱花和泡菜汁。
kimchi-jeon.en: Hands chop kimchi beside chopped scallion and reserved kimchi juice.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 手提起勺子，泡菜葱花面糊从勺上流下。
kimchi-jeon.en: A hand lifts a spoon as kimchi and scallion batter flows back into the bowl.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 手用勺背把泡菜面糊摊成薄圆饼。
kimchi-jeon.en: A hand spreads kimchi batter into a thin round pancake with the back of a spoon.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 铲子轻抬泡菜饼边，露出金黄的底面。
kimchi-jeon.en: A spatula lifts the edge of the kimchi pancake to reveal its golden underside.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 铲子抬起饼边，让油流到泡菜饼底下。
kimchi-jeon.en: A spatula lifts the pancake edge so oil can flow underneath.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 手在盘中切开金黄酥脆的泡菜饼。
kimchi-jeon.en: A hand cuts the golden, crisp kimchi pancake on a plate.

kimchi-jeon.zh: 第二张泡菜饼从锅中滑入盘里，第一张另放一盘。
kimchi-jeon.en: The second kimchi pancake slides onto its own plate beside the first.

kimchi-jjigae.zh: 去头鳀鱼、萝卜片和昆布在锅中沸煮。
kimchi-jjigae.en: Headless anchovies, daikon slices, and kombu simmer in a pot.

kimchi-jjigae.zh: 双手切薄猪肉，旁边放着泡菜、泡菜汁和底汤。
kimchi-jjigae.en: Hands slice pork thinly beside kimchi, kimchi juice, and stock.

kimchi-jjigae.zh: 手将底汤倒入盛有泡菜、猪肉和调料的锅中。
kimchi-jjigae.en: A hand pours stock into a pot of kimchi, pork, and seasonings.

kimchi-jjigae.zh: 泡菜和猪肉在半盖的锅中沸腾。
kimchi-jjigae.en: Kimchi and pork boil in a partially covered pot.

kimchi-jjigae.zh: 手将豆腐片铺在泡菜猪肉汤表面。
kimchi-jjigae.en: A hand lays tofu slices over the kimchi and pork stew.

kimchi-jjigae.zh: 手往泡菜豆腐汤上撒葱花，旁边放着白饭。
kimchi-jjigae.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over kimchi tofu stew beside a bowl of rice.

kinpira-gobo.zh: 手持刀将牛蒡切成细丝，旁边放着牛蒡片。
kinpira-gobo.en: Hands cut burdock into fine matchsticks beside sliced burdock.

kinpira-gobo.zh: 手将牛蒡丝浸入略呈褐色的水中。
kinpira-gobo.en: A hand submerges burdock matchsticks in lightly browned water.

kinpira-gobo.zh: 手将胡萝卜切成细丝，旁边备有调味汁和辣椒圈。
kinpira-gobo.en: Hands cut carrot into matchsticks beside prepared sauce and chili rings.

kinpira-gobo.zh: 手用锅铲翻炒略透亮、能弯折的牛蒡丝。
kinpira-gobo.en: A hand stir-fries flexible, slightly translucent burdock matchsticks.

kinpira-gobo.zh: 手用锅铲翻炒锅中的牛蒡丝和胡萝卜丝。
kinpira-gobo.en: A hand stir-fries burdock and carrot matchsticks in a pan.

kinpira-gobo.zh: 手向装盘的牛蒡丝、胡萝卜丝和辣椒圈撒白芝麻。
kinpira-gobo.en: A hand sprinkles white sesame over plated burdock, carrot, and chili rings.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 手将泡软涨大的萝卜丝按入水中。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: A hand submerges softened, expanded daikon shreds in water.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 手将泡软的萝卜丝切段，旁边留着泡发水。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: Hands cut soaked daikon into lengths beside a bowl of reserved soaking water.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 手将油豆腐切条，旁边是胡萝卜丝。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: Hands slice aburaage into strips beside carrot matchsticks.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 手用筷子翻炒油亮的萝卜丝、胡萝卜和油豆腐。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: A hand stir-fries glossy daikon, carrot and aburaage with chopsticks.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 手向大火沸腾的萝卜丝、胡萝卜和油豆腐中倒入煮汁。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: A hand pours broth into vigorously boiling daikon, carrot and aburaage.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 手揭起落盖，萝卜丝、胡萝卜和油豆腐在少量汤汁中小火煮。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: A hand lifts the drop lid over daikon, carrot and aburaage simmering in a little broth.

kiriboshi-daikon.zh: 关火后的锅敞开着，萝卜丝、胡萝卜和油豆腐不再冒热气。
kiriboshi-daikon.en: The uncovered pan of daikon, carrot and aburaage rests off heat without steam.

kitsune-udon.zh: 用筷子轻压沸水中的四片油豆腐。
kitsune-udon.en: Chopsticks gently press four pieces of fried tofu in boiling water.

kitsune-udon.zh: 往微微冒泡的煮汁中倒酱油并搅拌。
kitsune-udon.en: Soy sauce is poured into the gently bubbling cooking liquid as it is stirred.

kitsune-udon.zh: 揭开落盖，夹起浅褐色油豆腐，煮汁滴回锅中。
kitsune-udon.en: A light brown piece of fried tofu is lifted from beneath the drop lid, dripping sauce into the pan.

kitsune-udon.zh: 关火后轻压浸在煮汁里的油豆腐，旁边盛着三片。
kitsune-udon.en: With the heat off, chopsticks gently press tofu in its cooking liquid beside a plate holding three pieces.

kitsune-udon.zh: 往锅边冒泡的浅色汤底里撒少许盐。
kitsune-udon.en: A pinch of salt is added to pale broth bubbling around the edge of the pan.

kitsune-udon.zh: 用筷子拨散滚水中的粗乌冬面。
kitsune-udon.en: Chopsticks loosen thick udon noodles in vigorously boiling water.

kitsune-udon.zh: 往两片油豆腐盖面的乌冬汤面上撒葱圈。
kitsune-udon.en: Scallion rings are sprinkled over udon soup topped with two pieces of fried tofu.

kkakdugi.zh: 手持刀把萝卜切成方块，旁边的大碗盛着萝卜块。
kkakdugi.en: Hands cut radish into cubes beside a large bowl of radish cubes.

kkakdugi.zh: 手翻拌撒了粗盐和糖的萝卜块，碗底积着汁水。
kkakdugi.en: A hand turns salted and sugared radish cubes in a bowl of extracted liquid.

kkakdugi.zh: 双手倾斜大碗，将萝卜析出的汁水倒入小碗。
kkakdugi.en: Hands tilt a large bowl to pour radish liquid into a small bowl.

kkakdugi.zh: 戴手套的手翻拌裹满红色调料的萝卜块和葱段。
kkakdugi.en: A gloved hand mixes radish cubes and scallions coated in red seasoning.

kkakdugi.zh: 戴手套的手将拌好的萝卜块轻压进发酵容器。
kkakdugi.en: A gloved hand gently presses seasoned radish cubes into a fermentation jar.

kkakdugi.zh: 手扶着发酵罐，红色萝卜块之间冒出小气泡。
kkakdugi.en: A hand holds a fermentation jar as small bubbles rise between red radish cubes.

kkakdugi.zh: 手用筷子夹起泡菜萝卜块，余下的泡菜放在冰箱里。
kkakdugi.en: A hand lifts a piece of radish kimchi with chopsticks while the rest remains in the refrigerator.

kluay-buat-chi.zh: 用刀横切纵向剖开的香蕉，案板上摆着香蕉块。
kluay-buat-chi.en: A knife cuts a lengthwise-halved banana crosswise beside banana pieces on a board.

kluay-buat-chi.zh: 锅中椰奶边缘冒出细泡，手持勺轻搅。
kluay-buat-chi.en: A hand gently stirs coconut milk as small bubbles appear around the edge of the pot.

kluay-buat-chi.zh: 小火下用勺沿锅边轻推椰奶中的香蕉，旁边放着糖和盐。
kluay-buat-chi.en: A spoon gently pushes bananas through coconut milk over low heat, with sugar and salt nearby.

kluay-buat-chi.zh: 离火后用勺边试切椰奶中最厚的香蕉块，锅盖放在一旁。
kluay-buat-chi.en: Off the heat, a spoon cuts into a thick banana piece in coconut milk, with the lid beside the pot.

kluay-buat-chi.zh: 用勺托着香蕉和椰奶盛入碗中，旁边还有一碗。
kluay-buat-chi.en: A spoon carries banana and coconut milk into a bowl beside a second serving.

kongnamul-bap.zh: 锅中的短粒米浸在清水里，手正盖上锅盖。
kongnamul-bap.en: A hand covers a pot of short-grain rice soaking in clear water.

kongnamul-bap.zh: 手用筷子拌散调味牛肉末，旁边的黄豆芽已沥干。
kongnamul-bap.en: A hand mixes seasoned ground beef beside drained soybean sprouts.

kongnamul-bap.zh: 手将牛肉末撒在铺有黄豆芽的泡米上。
kongnamul-bap.en: A hand scatters ground beef over soybean sprouts and soaked rice.

kongnamul-bap.zh: 锅中汁水沸腾，手用饭勺翻拌米、豆芽和牛肉。
kongnamul-bap.en: A hand folds rice, sprouts, and beef together as the liquid boils.

kongnamul-bap.zh: 小火上，手拨开熟牛肉，锅中米饭和豆芽已熟。
kongnamul-bap.en: Over low heat, a hand parts the cooked beef over rice and sprouts.

kongnamul-bap.zh: 手向豆芽牛肉饭舀入葱蒜酱油汁。
kongnamul-bap.en: A hand spoons scallion and garlic soy sauce over soybean sprout and beef rice.

kongnamul-guk.zh: 手从泡着黄豆芽的水盆里捞出浮起的豆皮。
kongnamul-guk.en: A hand removes floating soybean skins from a basin of soybean sprouts in water.

kongnamul-guk.zh: 鳀鱼和蒜片在锅中加热，清汤开始冒泡。
kongnamul-guk.en: Anchovies and garlic slices heat in a pot as the clear broth begins to bubble.

kongnamul-guk.zh: 手用细筛捞出鳀鱼和蒜片，锅里留下清汤。
kongnamul-guk.en: A hand lifts anchovies and garlic slices out of clear broth with a fine skimmer.

kongnamul-guk.zh: 盖着的锅里，黄豆芽汤沿锅边连续冒泡。
kongnamul-guk.en: Soybean sprout soup bubbles around the edge of the covered pot.

kongnamul-guk.zh: 手用筷子夹起一颗豆头，检查熟度。
kongnamul-guk.en: A hand lifts a soybean head with chopsticks to check its doneness.

kongnamul-guk.zh: 手将加了葱花的黄豆芽汤分入小碗。
kongnamul-guk.en: A hand ladles soybean sprout soup with scallions into small bowls.

kongnamul-muchim.zh: 双手在清水中轻洗黄豆芽，水面浮着豆皮。
kongnamul-muchim.en: Hands gently wash soybean sprouts in water, with loose skins floating on the surface.

kongnamul-muchim.zh: 往装有黄豆芽和少许盐的锅里倒水。
kongnamul-muchim.en: A hand pours water into a pot of soybean sprouts and a little salt.

kongnamul-muchim.zh: 盖严的锅在火上加热，锅边冒出蒸汽。
kongnamul-muchim.en: A covered pot heats over a flame, with steam escaping at the edges.

kongnamul-muchim.zh: 双手托着漏篮，让煮熟的黄豆芽沥水散热。
kongnamul-muchim.en: Hands hold a colander as cooked soybean sprouts drain and release steam.

kongnamul-muchim.zh: 双手用两把勺子翻拌黄豆芽、蒜末、葱花和芝麻。
kongnamul-muchim.en: Hands use two spoons to toss soybean sprouts with minced garlic, scallions and sesame.

kongnamul-muchim.zh: 用勺子把拌好的黄豆芽盛到盘中。
kongnamul-muchim.en: A spoon serves seasoned soybean sprouts onto a plate.

kor-moo-yang.zh: 手持勺子搅拌均匀的棕黄色腌料。
kor-moo-yang.en: A hand stirs smooth tan marinade with a spoon.

kor-moo-yang.zh: 手将生猪颈肉翻入腌料，肉表面裹满酱汁。
kor-moo-yang.en: A hand turns raw pork jowl in marinade, coating its surface.

kor-moo-yang.zh: 手用木铲翻炒干锅中已变褐的糯米。
kor-moo-yang.en: A hand stirs browned glutinous rice in a dry skillet.

kor-moo-yang.zh: 手搅拌含红葱头末和辣椒碎的棕色蘸汁。
kor-moo-yang.en: A hand stirs brown dipping sauce with minced shallot and chili flakes.

kor-moo-yang.zh: 手把温度探针插入烤至金褐的猪颈肉。
kor-moo-yang.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into golden grilled pork jowl.

kor-moo-yang.zh: 手将烤猪颈肉切成薄片，旁边放着香菜和蘸汁。
kor-moo-yang.en: Hands slice grilled pork jowl thinly beside cilantro and dipping sauce.

korokke.zh: 手在锅中将沥干的土豆压成带小块的泥。
korokke.en: A hand mashes drained potatoes in a pot, leaving a few small chunks.

korokke.zh: 手在锅中炒散熟牛肉末和切细的蔬菜。
korokke.en: A hand stirs cooked ground beef and finely chopped vegetables in a pan.

korokke.zh: 手将鸡蛋拌入土豆泥和熟肉菜馅中。
korokke.en: A hand mixes an egg into mashed potatoes and cooked meat and vegetables.

korokke.zh: 双手将土豆肉馅压成边缘平整的椭圆饼。
korokke.en: Hands shape potato and meat filling into a smooth-edged oval patty.

korokke.zh: 双手将面包糠轻压在饼上，旁边放着面粉和蛋液。
korokke.en: Hands press panko onto a patty beside dishes of flour and beaten egg.

korokke.zh: 手用夹子翻动油锅中炸至金黄的可乐饼。
korokke.en: A hand turns golden croquettes in bubbling oil with tongs.

korokke.zh: 可乐饼在网架上沥油，一只手拿起一块蘸酱。
korokke.en: Croquettes drain on a wire rack as a hand dips one in sauce.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 鸡肉与姜葱花椒煮沸，撇去表面浮沫。
kou-shui-ji.en: Skim foam from chicken boiling with ginger, scallion and Sichuan pepper.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 鸡肉在锅中轻煮，用探针检查厚处。
kou-shui-ji.en: Check the thickest part of the gently simmering chicken with a probe.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 将熟鸡肉斩成大小相近的带皮块。
kou-shui-ji.en: Chop the cooked skin-on chicken into similar-sized pieces.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 搅拌油润过的辣椒面，旁边备好花生、葱和蒜。
kou-shui-ji.en: Stir oil-moistened chili flakes beside chopped peanuts, scallion and garlic.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 小火搅炒油中的葱段、花椒和蒜末。
kou-shui-ji.en: Stir scallion, Sichuan pepper and minced garlic in oil over low heat.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 少量热油泼入辣椒面，边起泡边搅拌。
kou-shui-ji.en: Stir as a small spoonful of hot oil bubbles in the chili flakes.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 用一块鸡肉蘸红油汁尝味。
kou-shui-ji.en: Dip a piece of chicken into the red oil sauce to taste.

kou-shui-ji.zh: 将红油汁淋在鸡块上，撒有花生碎和香菜。
kou-shui-ji.en: Spoon red oil sauce over chicken topped with chopped peanuts and cilantro.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 在案板上将去瓤苦瓜切成均匀薄片。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Slice the deseeded bitter melon into even thin crescents on a cutting board.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 用漏勺从滚水中捞出翠绿的苦瓜片。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Lift bright green bitter melon slices from boiling water with a slotted spoon.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 双手轻甩漏篮，沥干焯过的苦瓜片。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Gently shake the colander to drain the blanched bitter melon slices.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 将蛋液打匀，旁边放着调好的酱汁。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Whisk the eggs until evenly blended, with the prepared sauce alongside.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 用铲子将表面湿润的鸡蛋推成大块。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Push the moist-topped eggs into large curds with a spatula.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 将调好的酱汁倒入炒锅里的苦瓜片中。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Pour the prepared sauce over the bitter melon slices in the wok.

ku-gua-chao-dan.zh: 用铲子将熟透的苦瓜和大块鸡蛋盛入盘中。
ku-gua-chao-dan.en: Transfer the cooked bitter melon and large egg curds onto a plate with a spatula.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手抓拌碗中上浆的鸡丁，鸡肉均匀裹浆。
kung-pao-chicken.en: A hand mixes evenly coated chicken cubes in a bowl.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手剪干辣椒段，案板上摆着葱白、姜蒜片和花生。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands snip dried chilies beside scallion whites, ginger, garlic and a bowl of peanuts.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手用勺搅匀碗中的深色料汁。
kung-pao-chicken.en: A hand stirs the dark sauce in a bowl.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手在锅中翻炒干辣椒段和花椒。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands stir-fry dried chili segments and Sichuan peppercorns in a wok.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手翻炒鸡丁与香料，铲上鸡丁的切面已熟透。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands stir-fry chicken and aromatics, showing a cooked chicken cube cut open on the spatula.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手翻炒鸡丁与香料，沸腾的亮芡裹住鸡丁。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands toss chicken and aromatics in a bubbling, glossy sauce.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手将花生倒入锅中，鸡丁已裹上亮芡。
kung-pao-chicken.en: A hand pours peanuts into a wok of glossy sauce-coated chicken and aromatics.

kyuri-no-sunomono.zh: 小火搅拌锅中微微冒热气的醋汁。
kyuri-no-sunomono.en: A hand stirs gently steaming dressing over low heat.

kyuri-no-sunomono.zh: 手从冷水中捞起完全泡发的裙带菜。
kyuri-no-sunomono.en: A hand lifts fully rehydrated wakame from cold water.

kyuri-no-sunomono.zh: 手用刀将黄瓜切成薄圆片。
kyuri-no-sunomono.en: Hands slice a cucumber into thin rounds.

kyuri-no-sunomono.zh: 手轻拌盐渍黄瓜片，碗底渗出水分。
kyuri-no-sunomono.en: A hand gently tosses salted cucumber slices above liquid in the bowl.

kyuri-no-sunomono.zh: 双手轻挤黄瓜片，旁边碗里放着黄瓜和裙带菜。
kyuri-no-sunomono.en: Hands gently squeeze cucumber slices beside a bowl of cucumber and wakame.

kyuri-no-sunomono.zh: 手端着装有黄瓜、裙带菜和白芝麻的小碗。
kyuri-no-sunomono.en: A hand holds a bowl of cucumber, wakame, and white sesame.

la-ba-zhou.zh: 双手倒去红豆浸泡水，绿豆和花生分别浸在水中。
la-ba-zhou.en: Hands drain the soaked red beans while mung beans and peanuts soak separately.

la-ba-zhou.zh: 手持滤网沥去三种米的浸泡水。
la-ba-zhou.en: A hand holds a sieve to drain the soaking water from the three kinds of rice.

la-ba-zhou.zh: 手掀开锅盖，红豆、绿豆和花生在锅中小火煮。
la-ba-zhou.en: A hand lifts the lid as red beans, mung beans and peanuts simmer gently.

la-ba-zhou.zh: 手将三种米倒入煮着豆子和花生的锅中。
la-ba-zhou.en: A hand pours three kinds of rice into the pot of simmering beans and peanuts.

la-ba-zhou.zh: 手将红枣片和桂圆肉倒入浓稠的米豆粥中。
la-ba-zhou.en: A hand adds sliced jujubes and dried longan to the thick rice and bean porridge.

la-ba-zhou.zh: 手舀起腊八粥，粥连续流回锅中，旁边盛好一碗。
la-ba-zhou.en: A hand lifts a ladle of porridge, which flows back into the pot beside a filled bowl.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 泡发的白米在漏筛中沥水，旁边摆着切好的食材。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: Soaked white rice drains in a sieve beside the prepared ingredients.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 锅铲翻动油中煎至浅金色的土豆块。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: A spatula turns lightly golden potato pieces in oil.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 土豆围在锅边，锅铲翻炒中间的腊肠、姜末和葱白。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: A spatula stirs sausage, minced ginger and scallion whites inside a ring of potatoes.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 手将水倒入铺有土豆和腊肠的酱色米中。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: A hand pours water into soy-colored rice topped with potatoes and sausage.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 锅里的米、土豆和腊肠在水中煮出小泡。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: Small bubbles rise through the rice, potatoes and sausage in the pot.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 手用筷子戳锅中的土豆，检查是否软熟。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: A hand tests a potato in the pot with chopsticks.

la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.zh: 手用饭勺轻轻翻松撒了葱花的腊肠土豆饭。
la-chang-tu-dou-men-fan.en: A hand gently fluffs the sausage and potato rice with scallions using a rice paddle.

la-galbi.zh: 手在深盆中轻轻冲洗横切牛仔骨。
la-galbi.en: A hand gently rinses flanken-cut short ribs in a deep bowl.

la-galbi.zh: 手搅拌散着葱花和果泥的深色腌汁。
la-galbi.en: A hand stirs dark marinade flecked with scallions and fruit purée.

la-galbi.zh: 手将牛仔骨平铺在盛有腌汁的容器中。
la-galbi.en: A hand lays short ribs flat in a container of marinade.

la-galbi.zh: 手用夹子将生牛仔骨间隔铺入热烤纹锅。
la-galbi.en: A hand uses tongs to space raw short ribs in a hot grill pan.

la-galbi.zh: 手用夹子翻动带褐色烤纹的牛仔骨。
la-galbi.en: A hand uses tongs to turn browned short ribs with grill marks.

la-galbi.zh: 手用夹子夹厨房纸擦去烤纹锅里的焦渣。
la-galbi.en: A hand uses tongs and paper towel to wipe burnt residue from the grill pan.

la-galbi.zh: 手用剪刀剪开烤牛仔骨，旁边有生菜和米饭。
la-galbi.en: Hands cut grilled short ribs with scissors beside lettuce and rice.

la-jiao-chao-rou.zh: 手正斜切青椒，旁边放着姜末和蒜片。
la-jiao-chao-rou.en: Hands cut green chilies diagonally beside minced ginger and garlic slices.

la-jiao-chao-rou.zh: 手在碗中抓拌调味后的猪肉薄片。
la-jiao-chao-rou.en: A hand mixes seasoned thin pork slices in a bowl.

la-jiao-chao-rou.zh: 手向锅中起皱、有焦斑的青椒撒盐。
la-jiao-chao-rou.en: A hand salts wrinkled, blistered green chilies in the wok.

la-jiao-chao-rou.zh: 手在锅中翻炒姜末和浅色蒜片。
la-jiao-chao-rou.en: A hand stirs minced ginger and pale garlic slices in oil in the wok.

la-jiao-chao-rou.zh: 手把煸好的青椒倒回盛有熟肉片的锅中。
la-jiao-chao-rou.en: A hand returns blistered green chilies to the wok of cooked pork slices.

la-jiao-chao-rou.zh: 手将青椒、肉片和豆豉盛入红边白盘。
la-jiao-chao-rou.en: Hands plate green chilies, pork slices and fermented black beans on a white plate with a red rim.

la-wei-bao-zai-fan.zh: 手向砂煲里的长粒米倒水，米粒浸在水中。
la-wei-bao-zai-fan.en: A hand pours water over long-grain rice in a clay pot.

la-wei-bao-zai-fan.zh: 手搅拌深色豉油，案板上摆着整根腊肠和腊肉片。
la-wei-bao-zai-fan.en: A hand stirs dark sauce beside whole sausages and sliced cured pork belly.

la-wei-bao-zai-fan.zh: 砂煲里的米饭在小火上煮，湿润的饭面出现小孔。
la-wei-bao-zai-fan.en: Rice cooks over a modest flame in a clay pot, with small holes on its moist surface.

la-wei-bao-zai-fan.zh: 手用筷子把腊肉片摆在饭面，旁边是整根腊肠。
la-wei-bao-zai-fan.en: A hand arranges cured pork belly on rice beside whole sausages.

la-wei-bao-zai-fan.zh: 手沿砂煲内壁淋油，饭面铺着整根腊肠和腊肉片。
la-wei-bao-zai-fan.en: A hand pours oil along the inside of the clay pot, over rice topped with whole sausages and cured pork belly.

la-wei-bao-zai-fan.zh: 手用饭勺从腊味饭边缘起出金黄锅巴。
la-wei-bao-zai-fan.en: A hand lifts golden crisp rice from the edge of the clay pot rice with a paddle.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 双手摸查腊鱼细刺，旁边摆着三种腊味。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: Hands check cured fish for small bones beside the three cured meats.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 用漏勺从锅中捞起预煮的三种腊味。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: A slotted spoon lifts the three parboiled cured meats from the pot.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 在案板上切腊肉，旁边摆着腊鸡和腊鱼。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: Cured pork is sliced on a board beside chicken and fish.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 往排好的三种腊味上撒豆豉和干椒。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: Fermented black beans and dried chilies are sprinkled over the arranged meats.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 蒸锅盖紧，锅底火焰升起，锅边冒出蒸汽。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: Steam escapes from a covered steamer over a flame.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 往蒸锅边沿倒水，碗里的腊味在蒸架上。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: Water is poured along the steamer edge beside the bowl of cured meats.

la-wei-he-zheng.zh: 往盛着腊肉、腊鸡和腊鱼的碗中淋香油。
la-wei-he-zheng.en: Sesame oil is drizzled over the bowl of cured pork, chicken, and fish.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 双手在案板上将四季豆切成小粒。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: Hands cut green beans into small pieces on a cutting board.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 双手剁五花肉，旁边摆着蒜末、小米辣和橄榄菜。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: Hands mince pork belly beside garlic, chili and preserved olive vegetable.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 小火拨炒肉末，肉末微微金黄并开始出油。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: Minced pork is stirred over low heat until lightly golden and releasing fat.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 锅中翻炒肉末、橄榄菜、蒜末和小米辣。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: Minced pork, preserved olive vegetable, garlic and chili are stirred in a wok.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 手正给锅盖盖，豆粒和肉末在水中沸煮。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: A hand lowers the lid over beans and minced pork simmering in water.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 锅中翻炒四季豆和肉末，收干水分。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: Green beans and minced pork are stirred in the wok as the liquid evaporates.

lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.zh: 手将炒匀的四季豆、肉末和橄榄菜盛入盘中。
lan-cai-rou-mo-si-ji-dou.en: Hands transfer the mixed green beans, minced pork and preserved olive vegetable onto a plate.

lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.zh: 用漏勺撇去牛肉和牛骨汤面的浮沫。
lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand skims foam from a pot of beef and marrow bones.

lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.zh: 牛肉、牛骨和香料袋在锅中小火轻煨。
lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.en: Beef, marrow bones and a spice bag simmer gently in a pot.

lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.zh: 将浸在原汤里的牛肉放入冷水浴降温。
lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand places beef immersed in broth in a cold water bath.

lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.zh: 用筷子将牛肉片放入萝卜清汤中加热。
lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand lowers beef slices into gently simmering daikon broth.

lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.zh: 用筷子从沸水中捞起伸展的细面。
lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand lifts long thin noodles from vigorously boiling water.

lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.zh: 往盛有牛肉、萝卜和香菜的面汤上淋红油。
lan-zhou-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand pours chili oil over noodle soup with beef, daikon and cilantro.

lao-bing.zh: 双手将面絮揉成软面团。
lao-bing.en: Hands knead the flour shreds into a soft dough.

lao-bing.zh: 双手搅拌油酥，碗中面糊顺滑。
lao-bing.en: Hands stir the oil-and-flour paste until smooth.

lao-bing.zh: 双手擀薄面片，旁边盖着其余面团。
lao-bing.en: Hands roll a thin dough sheet beside the covered remaining portions.

lao-bing.zh: 双手沿切口将涂了油酥的面片卷成圆锥。
lao-bing.en: Hands roll the paste-coated dough from the cut into a cone.

lao-bing.zh: 双手将压扁的面团从中心向外擀薄。
lao-bing.en: Hands roll the flattened dough thin from the center outward.

lao-bing.zh: 锅中饼底出现淡黄斑点，正用铲子翻面。
lao-bing.en: A spatula turns the pancake in the pan, revealing pale yellow spots.

lao-bing.zh: 金黄烙饼装在盘中，切面露出熟透的层次。
lao-bing.en: Golden flatbreads sit on a plate, with cooked layers visible in a cut wedge.

lao-ma-ti-hua.zh: 白芸豆在锅中大火滚煮，水面翻起大泡。
lao-ma-ti-hua.en: White kidney beans boil vigorously in a pot over high heat.

lao-ma-ti-hua.zh: 用漏勺撇去猪蹄焯水锅里的浮沫。
lao-ma-ti-hua.en: A hand skims foam from a pot of blanching pork trotters.

lao-ma-ti-hua.zh: 向装有猪蹄、姜片和香料的压力锅里倒水。
lao-ma-ti-hua.en: A hand pours water into a pressure cooker holding pork trotters, ginger and spices.

lao-ma-ti-hua.zh: 将预煮白芸豆倒入装有猪蹄和汤的压力锅。
lao-ma-ti-hua.en: A hand tips precooked white kidney beans into the pressure cooker with pork trotters and broth.

lao-ma-ti-hua.zh: 猪蹄和白芸豆在锅中滚煮，汤色乳白。
lao-ma-ti-hua.en: Pork trotters and white kidney beans boil in milky broth.

lao-ma-ti-hua.zh: 一勺猪蹄原汤倒入蘸汁，旁边摆着蹄花汤。
lao-ma-ti-hua.en: A spoonful of pork broth is poured into dipping sauce beside the trotter soup.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 双手倒去淀粉上层清水，留下底部湿淀粉。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: Hands pour off the clear water, leaving wet starch in the bowl.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 双手将通脊切成薄片，旁边备有料酒和盐。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: Hands slice pork loin thinly beside bowls of cooking wine and salt.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 双手切蒜片，案板上摆着切好的配菜和糖醋汁。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: Hands slice garlic beside prepared vegetables and sweet-and-sour sauce.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 手提起裹着湿淀粉糊的肉片，糊缓缓流下。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: A hand lifts a pork slice coated in wet starch batter that slowly drips down.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 筷子扒开首炸肉片，检查浅色肉心。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: Chopsticks open a pale first-fried pork slice to check its center.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 漏勺捞出浅金黄肉片，沥油架上摊着肉片。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: A skimmer lifts light golden pork slices beside a rack of separated pieces.

lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.zh: 双手往装盘的锅包肉上撒白芝麻。
lao-shi-guo-bao-rou.en: Hands sprinkle white sesame over a plate of guo bao rou.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 手从水中提起泡软、能弯曲的米粉。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: A hand lifts pliable soaked rice noodles from water.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 用筷子拌匀薄浆包裹的猪肉片，汤底生抽另放。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: Chopsticks mix thinly coated pork slices, with broth soy sauce set aside.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 中火翻炒酸笋丝，锅底没有积水，豆豉和蒜末放在一旁。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: Bamboo strips are stirred over medium heat with no pooled water, while black beans and garlic wait nearby.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 小火翻炒酸笋中间的蒜末、剁椒和豆豉。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: Garlic, chopped chili and black beans are stirred among bamboo strips over a low flame.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 向有猪肉片和酸笋的锅里倒水，汤汁冒泡。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: Water is poured into bubbling broth with pork slices and bamboo shoots.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 用筷子从沸腾的汤中夹起米粉，锅里还有肉片和酸笋。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: Chopsticks lift a noodle from bubbling broth with pork and bamboo shoots.

lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.zh: 用筷子从盛好的猪肉酸笋米粉汤中夹起米粉。
lao-you-zhu-rou-fen.en: Chopsticks lift noodles from a finished bowl of pork and bamboo shoot soup.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 小锅里的水煮沸，旁边备好醪糟、枸杞和小汤圆。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: Water boils in a small pot beside prepared fermented rice, goji berries, and small tangyuan.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 用勺轻推锅中小汤圆，让它们在水中分开。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: A spoon gently pushes the small tangyuan apart in simmering water.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 切开一颗小汤圆，查看均匀软糯的中心。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: A small tangyuan is cut open to reveal its evenly cooked center.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 往煮着小汤圆的锅中倒入热水。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: Hot water is poured into the pot of cooking tangyuan.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 轻推微沸的汤圆、醪糟米粒和枸杞。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: A spoon gently stirs tangyuan, fermented rice grains, and goji berries in barely simmering soup.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 往关火后的醪糟小汤圆里少量加入白糖。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: A small spoonful of sugar is added to the tangyuan and fermented rice soup off the heat.

lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.zh: 用勺把醪糟小汤圆分装进两只碗里。
lao-zao-xiao-tang-yuan.en: The tangyuan and fermented rice soup is ladled into two bowls.

larb-moo.zh: 手持木勺在小火上翻炒金黄的糯米。
larb-moo.en: A hand stirs golden glutinous rice in a dry pan over low heat.

larb-moo.zh: 手在小火上翻炒干辣椒，烟飘向抽油烟机。
larb-moo.en: A hand stirs dried chilies over low heat as smoke rises toward the hood.

larb-moo.zh: 手切红葱头，旁边摆着备好的香草和包菜。
larb-moo.en: Hands slice a shallot beside prepared herbs and cabbage.

larb-moo.zh: 手把温度计插入湿润、熟透的猪肉碎中。
larb-moo.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into moist, cooked pork crumbles.

larb-moo.zh: 手将红葱头和辣椒拌进湿润的猪肉碎。
larb-moo.en: A hand mixes shallot and chili into moist pork crumbles.

larb-moo.zh: 手翻拌装盘的猪肉碎和香草，旁边摆着包菜。
larb-moo.en: A hand mixes plated pork and herbs beside a dish of cabbage.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺炒散牛肉末，锅里还有细切的蔬菜。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon breaks up browned ground beef with finely diced vegetables in a pan.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 把碎番茄倒入炒熟的牛肉末和蔬菜中。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: Crushed tomatoes are poured into the cooked ground beef and vegetables.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 小火搅拌浓稠肉酱，酱面微微冒泡。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: A spoon stirs thick meat sauce over a very low flame as a small bubble rises.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 双手用压面机将绿色菠菜面团压成薄片。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: Hands guide green spinach dough through a pasta machine into a thin sheet.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 双手把绿色面片分开平铺在干净布上。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: Hands lay green pasta sheets separately on a clean cloth.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 打蛋器提起浓稠白酱，白酱缓缓流回锅中。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: Thick béchamel flows slowly from a whisk back into the saucepan.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺拌匀肉酱和白酱，烤盘底部抹有白酱。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon mixes meat sauce and béchamel beside a baking dish with béchamel on its base.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 用勺把混合酱薄抹在菠菜面片上。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: A spoon spreads a thin layer of mixed sauce over spinach pasta sheets.

lasagne-alla-bolognese.zh: 用铲子将金黄的千层面盛到红边盘中。
lasagne-alla-bolognese.en: A spatula serves a golden slice of lasagne onto a red-rimmed plate.

lei-jiao-pi-dan.zh: 用厨房纸擦干案板上剖开压平的青椒。
lei-jiao-pi-dan.en: Pat the split, flattened green peppers dry on a cutting board with kitchen paper.

lei-jiao-pi-dan.zh: 搅匀碗中的拌汁，旁边摆着皮蛋和切好的配料。
lei-jiao-pi-dan.en: Stir the dressing beside the cut century eggs and chopped aromatics.

lei-jiao-pi-dan.zh: 小火煎青椒，用铲子压住有褐斑的椒身。
lei-jiao-pi-dan.en: Press the softened, lightly browned peppers against the pan over low heat.

lei-jiao-pi-dan.zh: 用筷子把煎软的青椒从锅中夹入深碗。
lei-jiao-pi-dan.en: Transfer the softened peppers from the pan to a deep bowl with chopsticks.

lei-jiao-pi-dan.zh: 用叉子轻压碗中的皮蛋和青椒条。
lei-jiao-pi-dan.en: Gently press the century egg and green pepper strips together with a fork.

lei-jiao-pi-dan.zh: 用叉子翻拌青椒条、皮蛋和调味配料。
lei-jiao-pi-dan.en: Toss the pepper strips, century egg and seasonings together with a fork.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 用厨房纸吸干碗中带骨兔肉表面的水分。
leng-chi-tu.en: Pat the drained bone-in rabbit pieces dry with a paper towel.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 用剪刀剪干辣椒，旁边摆着姜蒜末和葱段。
leng-chi-tu.en: Snip dried chilies beside minced ginger, garlic and scallion sections.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 用漏勺从油锅中捞出边缘微黄的葱段。
leng-chi-tu.en: Lift scallion sections with lightly yellowed edges out of the oil.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 油锅中兔肉炸至微黄冒泡，用探针测量肉温。
leng-chi-tu.en: Probe a piece of pale golden rabbit as it bubbles in the oil.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 小火翻炒红亮的辣椒、青花椒和整粒香料。
leng-chi-tu.en: Stir bright red chilies, green Sichuan peppercorns and whole spices over low heat.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 关火后翻拌兔肉、辣椒、花椒和熟芝麻。
leng-chi-tu.en: With the heat off, fold toasted sesame into the rabbit, chilies and peppercorns.

leng-chi-tu.zh: 用铲子将拌好辣椒和花椒的兔肉摊在浅容器里。
leng-chi-tu.en: Spread the rabbit, chilies and peppercorns in a shallow container.

li-yu-dun-bai-cai.zh: 在整条鲤鱼身上斜划刀，旁边放着白菜叶。
li-yu-dun-bai-cai.en: Hands score a whole carp diagonally beside napa cabbage leaves.

li-yu-dun-bai-cai.zh: 用锅铲轻托煎鱼，鱼皮边缘开始上色。
li-yu-dun-bai-cai.en: A spatula lifts the frying fish, whose skin is beginning to brown at the edges.

li-yu-dun-bai-cai.zh: 小火翻炒豆瓣酱和香料，锅中油色发红。
li-yu-dun-bai-cai.en: A hand stirs chili bean paste and aromatics over low heat in red oil.

li-yu-dun-bai-cai.zh: 用勺子将红褐色汤汁浇在锅里的鱼背上。
li-yu-dun-bai-cai.en: A hand spoons reddish-brown broth over the fish in the pan.

li-yu-dun-bai-cai.zh: 鱼和白菜在汤中轻滚，用勺子压软白菜。
li-yu-dun-bai-cai.en: A hand presses softened cabbage into the gently simmering broth around the fish.

li-yu-dun-bai-cai.zh: 用锅铲托住整条鱼，盛在白菜和汤汁上。
li-yu-dun-bai-cai.en: Hands support the whole fish with a spatula over cabbage and sauce in the serving dish.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 手切猪肉块，旁边放着凤梨块和姜末。
li-zhi-rou.en: Hands cut pork into chunks beside pineapple and minced ginger.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 手在碗中拌匀裹着厚糊的肉块。
li-zhi-rou.en: Hands stir pork chunks coated in thick batter in a bowl.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 手搅拌冷汁淀粉糊，旁边放着酸甜汁。
li-zhi-rou.en: Hands stir starch into cold sauce beside a bowl of sweet-and-sour sauce.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 浅金黄肉块在油中炸，手用温度计测肉心。
li-zhi-rou.en: A hand probes the center of a pale golden pork piece frying in oil.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 手捞起复炸至金黄的肉块，旁边摊开放凉。
li-zhi-rou.en: A hand lifts golden twice-fried pork from oil beside pieces draining on a rack.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 手将水淀粉淋入冒泡的酸甜汁并搅拌。
li-zhi-rou.en: Hands pour starch slurry into bubbling sweet-and-sour sauce while stirring.

li-zhi-rou.zh: 手向装盘的凤梨酸甜肉块撒白芝麻。
li-zhi-rou.en: A hand sprinkles white sesame over plated sweet-and-sour pork and pineapple.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 双手轻轻分开案板上的豆腐块，碎屑放在一旁。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: Hands gently separate tofu cubes on a cutting board, with crumbs set aside.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 小火轻煮清水中的豆腐，漏勺托着一块豆腐。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: A slotted spoon holds a tofu cube over gently simmering water.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 用漏勺把豆腐放入滤篮，摊开沥水。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: A slotted spoon transfers tofu into a colander to drain.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 在案板上切蒜末，旁边放着切好的葱花。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: Hands mince garlic on a cutting board beside sliced scallions.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 用勺搅拌小碗里的酱油、香油和蒜末。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: A spoon stirs soy sauce, sesame oil and minced garlic in a small bowl.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 用勺从碗底托起豆腐，轻轻翻合酱汁和葱蒜。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: A spoon gently folds tofu with sauce, scallions and garlic.

liang-ban-dou-fu.zh: 用勺舀起一块带葱蒜和酱汁的豆腐尝味。
liang-ban-dou-fu.en: A spoon lifts a sauced tofu cube with scallions and garlic for tasting.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 手扶黄瓜，在案板上切去一端。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: A hand steadies the cucumber while a knife trims one end on a cutting board.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 用宽刀面轻拍黄瓜，瓜身沿长度裂开。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: The flat of a cleaver gently cracks the cucumber lengthwise.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 用勺向碗里的黄瓜块撒糖。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: A spoon sprinkles sugar over cucumber chunks in a bowl.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 完整的黄瓜块放在滤篮里沥水。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: Intact cucumber chunks drain in a colander.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 用勺搅拌碗中的蒜末和棕色调汁。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: A spoon stirs minced garlic into the brown dressing in a bowl.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 向拌有蒜汁的黄瓜里倒入香油。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: Sesame oil is poured over cucumber mixed with garlic dressing.

liang-ban-huang-gua.zh: 用筷子把黄瓜块放到盛好的凉拌黄瓜上。
liang-ban-huang-gua.en: Chopsticks place a cucumber piece on the plated cucumber salad.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 手在案板上切鸡胸，旁边放着姜片。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: Hands cut chicken breast on a board beside ginger slices.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 手将料酒倒入小火轻煮鸡胸和姜片的锅中。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: A hand pours cooking wine into a gently simmering pot of chicken and ginger.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 手用温度计探测锅中鸡胸最厚处。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: A hand probes the thickest part of the chicken breast with a thermometer.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 双手顺着纹理将熟鸡胸撕成细丝。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: Hands pull cooked chicken breast into thin shreds along the grain.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 手用筷子搅拌碗中的深色料汁。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: A hand stirs dark dressing in a bowl with chopsticks.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 手边倒料汁，边用筷子拨散碗里的鸡丝。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: Hands pour dressing and separate shredded chicken with chopsticks.

liang-ban-ji-si.zh: 椭圆盘中盛着拌好的鸡丝、香菜、葱花和辣椒油。
liang-ban-ji-si.en: An oval platter holds dressed shredded chicken with cilantro, scallions and chili oil.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 双手在流水下冲洗并拆散金针菇。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: Hands rinse and separate enoki mushrooms under running water.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 案板上放着葱花，双手正将蒜切末。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: Hands mince garlic beside chopped scallions on a cutting board.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 筷子在大火沸水中拨散金针菇。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: Chopsticks separate enoki mushrooms in vigorously boiling water.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 筷子从沸水中挑起一小束金针菇。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: Chopsticks lift a small bundle of enoki from boiling water.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 双手轻晃滤篮，沥去金针菇的水。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: Hands gently shake a colander to drain the enoki mushrooms.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 手将带蒜末的拌汁淋在金针菇上。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: A hand pours garlic dressing over the enoki mushrooms.

liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.zh: 筷子挑拌挂汁的金针菇、葱花和辣椒油。
liang-ban-jin-zhen-gu.en: Chopsticks toss dressed enoki mushrooms with scallions and chili oil.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 手提起泡在水中、已经展开的木耳。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: A hand lifts a fully expanded wood ear mushroom from the soaking water.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 双手将泡发的木耳撕成小片，硬根放在一旁。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: Hands tear soaked wood ears into small pieces, with tough roots set aside.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 大火煮沸的锅中，筷子拨散舒展的木耳。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: Chopsticks separate expanded wood ears in a vigorously boiling pot over high heat.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 双手抖动滤篮，沥去摊开的木耳上的水。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: Hands shake a colander to drain the spread-out wood ears.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 手用勺搅拌碗中的蒜末、辣椒和深色拌汁。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: A hand stirs minced garlic and chili into the dark dressing.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 手用筷子翻拌碗中的木耳、蒜辣和拌汁。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: A hand folds wood ears with garlic, chili and dressing using chopsticks.

liang-ban-mu-er.zh: 手用筷子在盘中摆放拌好的蒜辣木耳。
liang-ban-mu-er.en: A hand arranges dressed wood ears with garlic and chili on a plate.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 手将去皮莴笋切成粗细均匀的条。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: Hands cut peeled celtuce into evenly sized sticks.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 手拎起腌软的莴笋和萝卜条，碗底有少量水。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: A hand lifts softened celtuce and daikon sticks above a little liquid in the bowl.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 手扶漏盆，用清水冲洗莴笋和萝卜条。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: A hand holds a colander while rinsing celtuce and daikon sticks under running water.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 用漏勺将焯过的莴笋和萝卜条放入冷水。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: A slotted spoon transfers blanched celtuce and daikon sticks into cold water.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 手切辣椒圈，旁边备好姜丝、蒜片和沥干的菜条。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: Hands slice chili into rings beside ginger, garlic and drained vegetable sticks.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 小火下搅动油中的姜丝、蒜片和辣椒圈。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: A hand stirs ginger, garlic and chili rings in oil over a low flame.

liang-ban-wo-sun.zh: 手用筷子整理盘中拌好香料油的莴笋条。
liang-ban-wo-sun.en: A hand arranges dressed celtuce sticks on a plate with chopsticks.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 双手在流水下翻开清洗油麦菜叶。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: Hands open and rinse a lettuce leaf under running water.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 双手用厨房纸吸干盆里的油麦菜叶。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: Hands blot lettuce leaves dry with kitchen paper in a bowl.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 双手将油麦菜切成短段，切好的菜放在盆里。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: Hands cut lettuce into short pieces beside a bowl of cut leaves.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 双手切蒜末，旁边的勺里盛着麻酱。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: Hands mince garlic beside a spoonful of sesame paste.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 勺子舀起顺滑麻酱汁，酱汁流回碗里。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: Smooth sesame dressing flows from a spoon back into the bowl.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 手拿一段油麦菜蘸取碗中的蒜香麻酱汁。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: A hand dips a lettuce piece into garlic sesame dressing.

liang-ban-you-mai-cai.zh: 手用筷子将裹着麻酱的油麦菜装盘。
liang-ban-you-mai-cai.en: A hand plates sesame-dressed lettuce with chopsticks.

liang-fen.zh: 手将豌豆淀粉浆搅匀，旁边放着刷油的浅容器。
liang-fen.en: Hands stir smooth pea starch slurry beside a lightly oiled shallow mold.

liang-fen.zh: 小火上边搅锅里的水，边沿锅边倒入粉浆。
liang-fen.en: Hands pour starch slurry along the edge of a saucepan while stirring over low heat.

liang-fen.zh: 小火搅煮浓稠发亮的粉糊，锅里缓缓冒泡。
liang-fen.en: A hand stirs thick glossy starch paste as it bubbles gently over low heat.

liang-fen.zh: 手用刮铲抹平浅容器里冒着热气的粉糊。
liang-fen.en: A hand smooths steaming starch paste in a shallow mold with a spatula.

liang-fen.zh: 手将凝固的凉粉切成匀条，宽铲托住一条凉粉。
liang-fen.en: Hands cut set jelly into even strips while a broad spatula supports one strip.

liang-fen.zh: 热油泼在蒜末、辣椒和花生碎上，碗里冒起小泡。
liang-fen.en: Hot oil is poured over minced garlic, chilies and chopped peanuts, causing small bubbles.

liang-fen.zh: 手在拌好辣汁的凉粉上撒香菜。
liang-fen.en: A hand sprinkles cilantro over jelly strips dressed in chili sauce.

liang-pi.zh: 手将凉皮切成宽条，旁边放着熟面筋块。
liang-pi.en: Hands cut liangpi into wide strips beside a bowl of cooked gluten cubes.

liang-pi.zh: 手把豆芽倒入大火沸腾的水中。
liang-pi.en: A hand tips bean sprouts into vigorously boiling water over high heat.

liang-pi.zh: 手将黄瓜切成细丝，旁边盘中盛着黄瓜丝。
liang-pi.en: Hands cut cucumber into thin strips beside a plate of prepared strips.

liang-pi.zh: 手将拌汁搅匀，旁边放着蒜汁。
liang-pi.en: Hands stir the dressing until smooth beside a bowl of garlic water.

liang-pi.zh: 手举起勺子，顺滑芝麻酱缓缓流回碗中。
liang-pi.en: A hand lifts a spoon as smooth sesame sauce slowly flows back into the bowl.

liang-pi.zh: 手用筷子轻轻翻拌凉皮、面筋和蔬菜。
liang-pi.en: Hands gently toss liangpi, gluten and vegetables with chopsticks.

liang-pi.zh: 手将辣椒油淋在拌好的凉皮上。
liang-pi.en: A hand drizzles chili oil over the dressed liangpi.

lu-cai.zh: 手在剪干辣椒，旁边摆着泡水牛腱和备好的香料。
lu-cai.en: A hand snips dried chili beside soaking beef shank and prepared aromatics.

lu-cai.zh: 手向离火的琥珀色糖液中缓缓倒水。
lu-cai.en: A hand slowly pours water into amber caramel off the heat.

lu-cai.zh: 牛腱在大火沸水中焯煮，手用漏勺撇浮沫。
lu-cai.en: A hand skims scum from beef shank boiling over high heat.

lu-cai.zh: 手搅拌沸腾的卤汁，锅里有料袋和香料。
lu-cai.en: A hand stirs boiling braising liquid with a spice bag and aromatics.

lu-cai.zh: 手用夹子将整块牛腱放入压力锅的卤汁中。
lu-cai.en: A hand lowers a whole beef shank into braising liquid in a pressure cooker.

lu-cai.zh: 手用叉子试开盖压力锅中的牛腱是否软透。
lu-cai.en: A hand tests the tenderness of beef shank with a fork in an open pressure cooker.

lu-cai.zh: 手在案板上将卤牛腱横切成片。
lu-cai.en: Hands slice braised beef shank across the grain on a cutting board.

lu-cai.zh: 手把过滤后的卤汁倒入浅容器。
lu-cai.en: A hand pours strained braising liquid into a shallow container.

lu-ji-tui.zh: 用厨房纸吸干案板上的生鸡腿，旁边放着小锅。
lu-ji-tui.en: A hand pats raw drumsticks dry with kitchen paper beside a small pot.

lu-ji-tui.zh: 小火翻炒葱段、姜片、八角和香叶。
lu-ji-tui.en: A hand stirs scallions, ginger, star anise and a bay leaf over low heat.

lu-ji-tui.zh: 往不断冒泡的香料卤汁中倒入清水。
lu-ji-tui.en: A hand pours water into bubbling braising liquid with aromatics.

lu-ji-tui.zh: 用夹子将生鸡腿放入冒泡的卤汁，鸡腿紧凑地排成一层。
lu-ji-tui.en: A hand places a raw drumstick among a single layer in bubbling braising liquid.

lu-ji-tui.zh: 小火卤鸡腿，手持探针插入鸡腿厚肉测温。
lu-ji-tui.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the thick meat of a gently simmering drumstick.

lu-ji-tui.zh: 将少量卤汁浇在装盘的光亮鸡腿上，旁边放着一碗卤汁。
lu-ji-tui.en: A hand spoons braising liquid over glossy plated drumsticks beside a bowl of sauce.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手切白萝卜块，旁边备有羊排、葱段和姜片。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: Hands cut daikon into chunks beside lamb ribs, scallion segments and ginger slices.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手用漏勺捞出变色的羊排，锅中浮着灰褐色浮沫。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: A hand lifts blanched lamb ribs from water covered with gray-brown scum.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手从沸水中捞出萝卜块，锅里还有冰糖。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: A hand lifts a daikon chunk from boiling water with rock sugar.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手撇去羊排汤的浮沫，锅里有葱姜、花椒和冰糖。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: A hand skims foam from lamb rib broth with scallion, ginger, peppercorns and rock sugar.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手把焯好的萝卜块倒入轻煨的羊排汤。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: A hand tips blanched daikon into gently simmering lamb rib broth.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手用筷子试萝卜软度，羊排和萝卜在锅中轻煨。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: A hand tests a daikon chunk with chopsticks as lamb ribs and daikon simmer gently.

luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.zh: 手将羊排、萝卜和清汤盛入碗中。
luo-bo-dun-yang-pai.en: A hand ladles lamb ribs, daikon and clear broth into a bowl.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 双手将白萝卜擦成粗丝，旁边摆着香菇、虾米和腊肠。
luo-bo-gao.en: Hands grate daikon into coarse shreds beside mushrooms, dried shrimp, and sausage.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 锅中翻炒腊肠、虾米、香菇和葱花。
luo-bo-gao.en: A hand stir-fries sausage, dried shrimp, mushrooms, and scallions in a pan.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 萝卜丝在锅中煮软，一手舀出锅里的汁水。
luo-bo-gao.en: A hand ladles liquid from a pan of softened daikon shreds.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 锅铲舀起浓稠萝卜粉浆，配料均匀悬在浆中。
luo-bo-gao.en: A spatula lifts thick daikon batter with the ingredients suspended throughout.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 蒸锅中的圆模冒着蒸汽，一手用筷子检查糕的中心。
luo-bo-gao.en: A hand checks the center of the cake with chopsticks in a steaming round mold.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 双手用湿刀将放凉定形的萝卜糕切片。
luo-bo-gao.en: Hands slice the cooled, firm daikon cake with a wet knife.

luo-bo-gao.zh: 锅铲翻起一片金黄的萝卜糕，旁边放着蚝油。
luo-bo-gao.en: A spatula turns a golden slice of daikon cake beside a bowl of oyster sauce.

luo-song-tang.zh: 双手拌匀盐和黑胡椒牛肉，旁边摆着切好的配料。
luo-song-tang.en: Hands mix beef with salt and black pepper beside the prepared ingredients.

luo-song-tang.zh: 用夹子翻动平底锅里的牛肉，煎面呈褐色。
luo-song-tang.en: Tongs turn a beef cube in a frying pan, revealing its browned side.

luo-song-tang.zh: 用木勺压散番茄，锅里有洋葱、胡萝卜和欧芹茎。
luo-song-tang.en: A wooden spoon crushes tomatoes among onion, carrot and parsley stems in the pot.

luo-song-tang.zh: 掀开锅盖，牛肉和土豆在番茄汤中小火轻沸。
luo-song-tang.en: A lid is lifted over beef and potatoes gently simmering in tomato broth.

luo-song-tang.zh: 用叉子拨开牛肉，锅里还有包菜、红肠和土豆。
luo-song-tang.en: A fork pulls apart beef in a pot with cabbage, sausage and potatoes.

luo-song-tang.zh: 用木勺将欧芹叶拌入牛肉红肠蔬菜汤。
luo-song-tang.en: A wooden spoon stirs parsley leaves into beef, sausage and vegetable soup.

lv-da-gun.zh: 双手将均匀的糯米粉浆倒入浅蒸盘。
lv-da-gun.en: Hands pour smooth glutinous rice batter into a shallow steaming dish.

lv-da-gun.zh: 筷子挑开蒸锅里略透亮的熟米皮。
lv-da-gun.en: Chopsticks lift the slightly translucent cooked rice sheet in the steamer.

lv-da-gun.zh: 用刮刀在蒸盘里折压黏软的米团。
lv-da-gun.en: A spatula folds and presses sticky rice dough in the steaming dish.

lv-da-gun.zh: 双手隔着烘焙纸将米团擀成长方形薄片。
lv-da-gun.en: Hands roll the rice dough into a thin rectangle through parchment paper.

lv-da-gun.zh: 双手沿长边卷起抹有红豆沙的米皮。
lv-da-gun.en: Hands roll the bean-paste-covered rice sheet from its long edge.

lv-da-gun.zh: 刀竖直切开裹有黄豆粉的米卷，露出红白卷纹。
lv-da-gun.en: A knife cuts vertically through the soybean-dusted roll, revealing red and white spirals.

lv-dou-tang.zh: 手将泡胀沥干的绿豆从滤盆倒入碗中。
lv-dou-tang.en: A hand tips plump, drained mung beans from a colander into a bowl.

lv-dou-tang.zh: 锅中绿豆水沸腾，一只手用勺撇去浮沫。
lv-dou-tang.en: A hand skims foam from vigorously boiling mung beans.

lv-dou-tang.zh: 锅盖微开，裂皮绿豆小火轻煮，一只手用勺轻推。
lv-dou-tang.en: A hand gently stirs split mung beans simmering under an ajar lid.

lv-dou-tang.zh: 小火煮着绿豆汤，勺中是粉软豆芯，汤里散着豆沙。
lv-dou-tang.en: A spoon holds soft mung beans above gently simmering soup with dispersed bean pulp.

lv-dou-tang.zh: 一只手将白糖倒入小火煮着的绿豆汤，旁边放着一碗汤。
lv-dou-tang.en: A hand pours sugar into gently simmering mung bean soup beside a serving bowl.

ma-la-gao.zh: 双手给竹蒸笼衬纸，旁边放着鸡蛋和淡奶。
ma-la-gao.en: Hands line a bamboo steamer with parchment beside eggs and evaporated milk.

ma-la-gao.zh: 电动打蛋器打发蛋糊，表面布满细泡。
ma-la-gao.en: An electric mixer beats the batter until its surface is covered with fine bubbles.

ma-la-gao.zh: 用刮刀从盆底向上翻拌浅色糕糊。
ma-la-gao.en: A spatula folds the light-colored batter upward from the bottom of the bowl.

ma-la-gao.zh: 用刮刀轻翻略稠、冒着细泡的糕糊。
ma-la-gao.en: A spatula gently folds the slightly thickened batter dotted with tiny bubbles.

ma-la-gao.zh: 把糕糊倒进衬纸的蒸笼，旁边的水锅冒着蒸汽。
ma-la-gao.en: Batter is poured into the lined steamer beside a steaming pot of water.

ma-la-gao.zh: 用竹签检查蒸笼里膨起的马拉糕中心。
ma-la-gao.en: A bamboo skewer checks the center of the risen cake in the steamer.

ma-la-gao.zh: 在白盘上把金黄色马拉糕切成八块。
ma-la-gao.en: Golden steamed cake is cut into eight wedges on a white plate.

ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手将娃娃菜厚帮切窄，旁边摆着生菜和荞麦面。
ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands cut the thick cabbage stems into narrow strips beside lettuce and soba noodles.

ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 用筷子轻拨锅中沸腾的荞麦面和娃娃菜。
ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.en: Chopsticks gently separate soba noodles and napa cabbage in boiling water.

ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 手把花生酱搅成顺滑稀糊，旁边备有底料和辣椒油。
ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.en: Hands stir peanut butter into a smooth thin slurry beside hot-pot base and chili oil.

ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 将牛奶倒入小火轻煮的荞麦面汤，旁边备有生抽。
ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.en: Milk is poured into gently simmering soba soup with soy sauce nearby.

ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 用勺把仍翠绿的生菜推入微沸的面汤中。
ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.en: A spoon pushes still-green lettuce into gently simmering noodle soup.

ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.zh: 用勺把麻辣面汤盛入装有荞麦面和蔬菜的碗中。
ma-la-qiao-mai-mian.en: A ladle pours spicy broth into a bowl of soba noodles and vegetables.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 双手切小白菜，旁边分别放着猪肉片和千张宽条。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: Hands cut bok choy beside separate bowls of pork slices and wide tofu-sheet strips.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 漏勺从沸水中捞出焯软的小白菜梗和菜叶。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: A skimmer lifts softened bok choy stalks and leaves from boiling water.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 筷子在沸水中划散猪肉片，沥干的千张放在一旁。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: Chopsticks separate pork slices in boiling water beside drained tofu-sheet strips.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 筷子从沸水中提起已经散开的面条。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: Chopsticks lift loosened noodles from boiling water.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 锅铲在油中翻炒散开的香锅酱和干辣椒段。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: A spatula stirs loosened mala sauce and dried chili segments in oil.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 锅铲翻拌裹着红酱的猪肉片、千张和干辣椒。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: A spatula tosses pork slices, tofu-sheet strips, and dried chilies coated in red sauce.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 锅铲翻炒裹上红油的青菜、猪肉片和千张。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: A spatula tosses bok choy, pork slices, and tofu sheets coated in red oil.

ma-la-xiang-guo.zh: 筷子将拌匀的面条、青菜、肉片和千张盛入盘中。
ma-la-xiang-guo.en: Chopsticks transfer the mixed noodles, bok choy, pork, and tofu sheets onto a plate.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 双手轻轻拨开泡软、能够弯曲的粉丝。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: Hands gently separate pliable soaked glass noodles.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 双手剁细豆瓣，案板上放着蒜末、姜末和葱花。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: Hands mince doubanjiang beside minced garlic, ginger and scallion.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 锅铲压散粉红色猪肉末，锅里蒜姜颜色仍浅。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: A spatula breaks up pink ground pork with pale garlic and ginger.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 锅铲翻炒肉末和豆瓣，锅底油已变红。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: A spatula stirs cooked ground pork and doubanjiang in red oil.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 手往肉末和豆瓣的红褐色汤汁中倒水。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: A hand pours water into the reddish-brown broth with pork and doubanjiang.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 筷子在汤汁中挑散柔软粉丝，肉末均匀附着。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: Chopsticks separate soft glass noodles and pork in the simmering sauce.

ma-yi-shang-shu.zh: 筷子拨散盘中肉末粉丝，上面撒着葱花。
ma-yi-shang-shu.en: Chopsticks separate plated glass noodles with ground pork and scallion.

ma-you-ban-mian.zh: 手将白胡椒撒进盛有麻油和老抽的碗，旁边水已烧开。
ma-you-ban-mian.en: A hand sprinkles white pepper into a bowl of sesame oil and dark soy sauce beside a pot of boiling water.

ma-you-ban-mian.zh: 筷子轻拨沸水中面饼松开的边缘。
ma-you-ban-mian.en: Chopsticks gently loosen the edges of a noodle cake in boiling water.

ma-you-ban-mian.zh: 手用筷子从热水锅中夹起一根面条试熟度。
ma-you-ban-mian.en: A hand lifts a noodle from the pot of hot water with chopsticks to check doneness.

ma-you-ban-mian.zh: 手用筷子翻拌浅褐色面条，旁边留着一小碗煮面水。
ma-you-ban-mian.en: A hand tosses light brown noodles with chopsticks beside a small bowl of reserved cooking water.

ma-you-ban-mian.zh: 一手少量倒入煮面水，另一手用筷子拌开面条。
ma-you-ban-mian.en: One hand adds a little cooking water while the other mixes the noodles with chopsticks.

ma-you-ban-mian.zh: 筷子从红边碗中夹起一口拌好的浅褐色面条。
ma-you-ban-mian.en: Chopsticks lift a bite of mixed light brown noodles from a red-rimmed bowl.

madeleines.zh: 用木勺搅拌浓面糊，旁边留有蛋液。
madeleines.en: A wooden spoon stirs thick batter beside the reserved beaten egg.

madeleines.zh: 端起小锅，融化的黄油中有细泡和浅褐色颗粒。
madeleines.en: A hand lifts the saucepan of melted butter with fine bubbles and lightly browned milk solids.

madeleines.zh: 用木勺搅拌带柠檬皮屑的光泽面糊。
madeleines.en: A wooden spoon stirs glossy batter flecked with lemon zest.

madeleines.zh: 用刷子将黄油面粉糊薄涂在贝壳模具的沟纹中。
madeleines.en: A brush spreads a thin butter and flour paste into the grooves of a shell mold.

madeleines.zh: 用勺子将一团浓面糊放入贝壳模穴。
madeleines.en: A spoon places a mound of thick batter into a shell-shaped mold.

madeleines.zh: 将金黄隆起的玛德琳移到网架上。
madeleines.en: Golden madeleines with raised centers are transferred to a wire rack.

man-tou.zh: 用勺搅拌酵母水，水面浮着细泡。
man-tou.en: A hand stirs yeast water with fine bubbles on its surface.

man-tou.zh: 双手在盆中揉光滑的面团，旁边放着一小碗油。
man-tou.en: Hands knead smooth dough in a bowl beside a small bowl of oil.

man-tou.zh: 手指轻按盆中膨起的面团，表面留下小坑。
man-tou.en: A finger presses a small indentation into risen dough in a bowl.

man-tou.zh: 手持刮板将撒粉案板上的面团长条切成八段。
man-tou.en: A hand cuts a dough log into eight pieces on a lightly floured board.

man-tou.zh: 手指轻按蒸笼里垫着烘焙纸的鼓起面坯。
man-tou.en: A finger presses a puffy dough piece on parchment in a steamer.

man-tou.zh: 蒸笼持续冒出蒸汽，一只手调节灶火。
man-tou.en: Steam escapes from the covered steamer as a hand adjusts the burner.

man-tou.zh: 双手掰开盘中的馒头，露出松软细密的内里。
man-tou.en: Hands pull apart a steamed bun over a plate, revealing its soft interior.

mandu.zh: 双手挤出西葫芦丝和洋葱末里的水分。
mandu.en: Hands squeeze liquid from shredded zucchini and minced onion.

mandu.zh: 锅中翻炒已变色的猪肉末和调味料。
mandu.en: Cooked ground pork and seasonings are stirred in a pan.

mandu.zh: 把沥干的透明粉条切成短段。
mandu.en: Drained translucent noodles are cut into short pieces.

mandu.zh: 锅中翻炒西葫芦丝和洋葱，旁边放着豆芽。
mandu.en: Zucchini and onion are stir-fried beside a bowl of bean sprouts.

mandu.zh: 用手拌匀肉末、豆腐、粉条和蔬菜馅。
mandu.en: A hand mixes pork, tofu, noodles and vegetables into filling.

mandu.zh: 双手捏紧半月形饺子的边缘。
mandu.en: Hands pinch the edges of a crescent dumpling shut.

mandu.zh: 蒸屉里的饺子隔开摆放，蒸汽不断冒出。
mandu.en: Spaced dumplings steam in a lined steamer basket.

mandu.zh: 用筷子托起蒸饺，旁边放着蘸汁。
mandu.en: Chopsticks support a steamed dumpling beside dipping sauce.

mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.zh: 整块五花肉在沸水中焯煮，水面浮沫聚起。
mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.en: A whole slab of pork belly blanches in vigorously boiling water as foam collects.

mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.zh: 双手将焯过的五花肉切块，旁边摆着姜葱和香料。
mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.en: Hands cut blanched pork belly into cubes beside ginger, scallions and spices.

mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.zh: 手搅动冒细泡的红褐色糖液，肉块在一旁备好。
mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.en: A hand stirs bubbling reddish-brown caramel with pork cubes ready nearby.

mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.zh: 手沿锅边倒水，锅中有肉块、姜和香料。
mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.en: A hand pours water along the edge of a pot containing pork, ginger and spices.

mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.zh: 手翻动锅中的肉块，锅底还留有流动的汤汁。
mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.en: A hand turns pork cubes in the pot, where the braising liquid remains fluid.

mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.zh: 手将亮汁包裹的红烧肉和葱段盛入盘中。
mao-shi-hong-shao-rou.en: A hand plates glossy braised pork and scallion segments.

mapo-tofu.zh: 豆腐块在淡盐水中微微沸煮。
mapo-tofu.en: Tofu cubes simmer gently in lightly salted water.

mapo-tofu.zh: 用勺搅匀碗里的土豆淀粉和冷水。
mapo-tofu.en: A spoon mixes potato starch and cold water in a bowl.

mapo-tofu.zh: 牛肉末煸至褐色出油，料酒沿锅边淋入。
mapo-tofu.en: Cooking wine is poured around the wok's edge over browned, lightly oily ground beef.

mapo-tofu.zh: 豆瓣与肉末炒出红油，加入豆豉和香料。
mapo-tofu.en: Black beans and aromatics are added to beef and chili bean paste in red oil.

mapo-tofu.zh: 用锅铲背面轻推汤汁里的豆腐块。
mapo-tofu.en: The back of a spatula gently pushes tofu cubes through the sauce.

mapo-tofu.zh: 向豆腐和蒜苗的沸腾汤汁中分次淋入水淀粉。
mapo-tofu.en: A portion of starch slurry is poured into simmering tofu and green garlic.

mapo-tofu.zh: 在装盘的麻婆豆腐上撒花椒面。
mapo-tofu.en: Ground Sichuan pepper is sprinkled over the plated mapo tofu.

mayonnaise.zh: 提起打蛋器，浓稠蛋黄液拉出短带。
mayonnaise.en: A whisk lifts a short ribbon of thick beaten egg yolks.

mayonnaise.zh: 在湿布垫稳的碗中搅拌蛋黄和调味料。
mayonnaise.en: Egg yolks and seasonings are whisked in a bowl steadied on a damp cloth.

mayonnaise.zh: 一边搅打浅黄色浓酱，一边逐滴加油。
mayonnaise.en: Oil is added drop by drop while the pale, thick sauce is whisked.

mayonnaise.zh: 一边搅打浓稠蛋黄酱，一边细流加油。
mayonnaise.en: Oil is poured in a thin stream while the thick mayonnaise is whisked.

mayonnaise.zh: 勺子托起顺滑蛋黄酱，旁边放着热水。
mayonnaise.en: A spoon lifts smooth mayonnaise beside a cup of hot water.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 把泡软挤干的梅菜切碎。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Chop the softened, squeezed preserved mustard greens.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 用厨房纸擦干煮过的整块五花肉。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Pat the boiled slab of pork belly dry with kitchen paper.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 用刷子在五花肉表面薄薄抹上老抽。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Brush a thin layer of dark soy sauce over the pork belly.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 用长夹夹住五花肉炸至肉皮变深、起泡。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Hold the pork belly with long tongs as its skin darkens and blisters in oil.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 往蒜末、小米椒和梅菜中倒入生抽并翻炒。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Pour light soy sauce into the stir-fried garlic, chili and preserved greens.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 把梅菜铺在碗中皮朝下排列的肉片上。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Spoon preserved greens over pork slices arranged skin-side down in a bowl.

mei-cai-kou-rou.zh: 用干布揭起倒扣的碗，露出盘中的梅菜扣肉。
mei-cai-kou-rou.en: Lift the inverted bowl with a dry cloth to reveal the plated pork and greens.

mentsuyu.zh: 用勺轻压锅里的柴鱼片，让它浸湿在有昆布的汁液中。
mentsuyu.en: A hand gently presses bonito flakes into the liquid with kombu.

mentsuyu.zh: 昆布和柴鱼在锅中小火微沸，锅边冒出小泡。
mentsuyu.en: Kombu and bonito flakes simmer gently over a low flame, with small bubbles at the edge.

mentsuyu.zh: 提起勺子，稀薄的汁液流回盛有昆布和柴鱼的锅中。
mentsuyu.en: A hand lifts a spoon, letting thin broth flow back into the pan with kombu and bonito flakes.

mentsuyu.zh: 将汁液倒过细筛，昆布和柴鱼留在筛中。
mentsuyu.en: A hand pours the broth through a fine sieve, leaving kombu and bonito flakes in the sieve.

mentsuyu.zh: 将过滤后的浓缩面汁倒入干净的玻璃罐。
mentsuyu.en: A hand pours strained concentrated noodle sauce into a clean glass jar.

mentsuyu.zh: 往碗中的面汁倒入清水，调成冷面蘸汁。
mentsuyu.en: A hand pours water into noodle sauce in a bowl to make a cold dipping sauce.

mi-xao-bo.zh: 手在碗中拌牛肉，旁边放着调好的酱汁。
mi-xao-bo.en: A hand mixes beef in a bowl beside a bowl of prepared sauce.

mi-xao-bo.zh: 双手托着漏盆，用冷水冲洗煮好的蛋面。
mi-xao-bo.en: Hands hold a colander of cooked egg noodles under cold running water.

mi-xao-bo.zh: 锅中翻炒蒜末和牛肉，肉大部分变色但仍带粉红。
mi-xao-bo.en: A spatula stirs garlic and mostly browned beef with some pink remaining.

mi-xao-bo.zh: 锅中翻炒胡萝卜丝、洋葱片和蒜末。
mi-xao-bo.en: A spatula stir-fries carrot matchsticks, sliced onion, and minced garlic.

mi-xao-bo.zh: 大火翻炒白菜、小白菜、胡萝卜和洋葱。
mi-xao-bo.en: Napa cabbage, bok choy, carrot, and onion are tossed over high heat.

mi-xao-bo.zh: 手往装盘的牛肉蔬菜炒面上撒黑胡椒。
mi-xao-bo.en: A hand sprinkles black pepper over plated beef and vegetable noodles.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 双手将梅头肉与姜蒜腌料抓匀，旁边放着加盖的小碗。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: Hands mix pork shoulder with ginger, garlic and marinade beside a covered small bowl.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 手将容器中铺开的腌肉翻面。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: A hand turns a marinated pork strip in a container where the pieces lie spread out.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 手用夹子将腌肉间隔摆在水盘上方的烤网上。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: A hand uses tongs to space marinated pork on a rack above a pan of water.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 手在烤网上边缘上色的肉条上刷腌料。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: A hand brushes marinade onto pork strips with browned edges on a rack.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 手在烤肉条上薄刷蜜汁，肉的边缘呈深褐色。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: A hand brushes honey glaze onto roasted pork strips with dark brown edges.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 手从侧面将探针插入烤肉条的厚处。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: A hand inserts a thermometer probe into the thick side of a roasted pork strip.

mi-zhi-cha-shao.zh: 双手将叉烧切片，旁边的盘中盛着叉烧和少量肉汁。
mi-zhi-cha-shao.en: Hands slice char siu beside a platter of sliced pork and a little meat juice.

mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.zh: 双手揉捏袋中裹有葱姜蒜腌汁的生鸡翅。
mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.en: Hands massage raw chicken wings with scallion, ginger, garlic, and marinade in a bag.

mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.zh: 用夹子将腌好的鸡翅单层摆在烘焙纸上。
mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.en: Tongs arrange marinated chicken wings in a single layer on parchment.

mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.zh: 烤箱中层的鸡翅表面收紧、边缘微黄，盘中析出油汁。
mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.en: Chicken wings on the middle oven rack have firmed, with lightly browned edges and juices in the tray.

mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.zh: 用刷子在金褐色鸡翅上薄刷蜂蜜。
mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.en: A brush spreads a thin layer of honey over golden-brown chicken wings.

mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.zh: 温度计探针插入撒了芝麻的黏亮鸡翅。
mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.en: A thermometer probe is inserted into a glossy sesame-topped chicken wing.

mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.zh: 用夹子把黏亮的芝麻鸡翅从烤盘移到干净盘中。
mi-zhi-kao-ji-chi.en: Tongs transfer glossy sesame chicken wings from the baking tray to a clean plate.

mi-zhou.zh: 用勺将沥干的米和少量油拌匀。
mi-zhou.en: Stir a little oil into the drained rice with a spoon.

mi-zhou.zh: 中大火加热，勺子拨散清水中的米粒。
mi-zhou.en: Over medium-high heat, use a spoon to separate the rice grains in the water.

mi-zhou.zh: 锅盖留缝，小火煮至水面起白沫。
mi-zhou.en: Simmer over low heat with the lid ajar as white foam rises.

mi-zhou.zh: 小火煮粥，用勺轻推锅里的米粒。
mi-zhou.en: Gently stir the rice porridge over low heat.

mi-zhou.zh: 用勺压碎几粒熟米，检查软硬。
mi-zhou.en: Press a few cooked rice grains between spoons to check their softness.

mi-zhou.zh: 关火后将乳白米粥舀入碗中。
mi-zhou.en: After turning off the heat, ladle the milky rice porridge into a bowl.

mien-ga.zh: 用夹子翻烤盘上带褐斑的洋葱和香料。
mien-ga.en: A hand turns browned onion and aromatics on a roasting tray.

mien-ga.zh: 将温度探针插入微沸鸡汤中的鸡胸肉。
mien-ga.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into chicken breast in gently simmering broth.

mien-ga.zh: 双手沿纹理把熟鸡肉撕成粗丝。
mien-ga.en: Hands pull cooked chicken into coarse strips along the grain.

mien-ga.zh: 用漏勺从油中捞出浅金黄的红葱片。
mien-ga.en: A slotted spoon lifts pale golden shallot slices from the oil.

mien-ga.zh: 用筷子从沸水中夹起透明柔软的粉丝。
mien-ga.en: Chopsticks lift soft, translucent glass noodles from boiling water.

mien-ga.zh: 把鸡丝倒回微沸的清鸡汤中温热。
mien-ga.en: Chicken strips are returned to gently simmering clear broth to warm through.

mien-ga.zh: 在鸡肉粉丝汤上撒红葱酥，旁边配青柠和辣椒。
mien-ga.en: A hand scatters crispy shallots over chicken glass noodle soup, with lime and chilies alongside.

minestrone.zh: 用叉子压熟白芸豆，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜。
minestrone.en: A fork mashes a cooked cannellini bean beside prepared vegetables.

minestrone.zh: 锅里用油和黄油翻炒软化的洋葱片。
minestrone.en: Onion slices soften in oil and butter as they are stirred in a pot.

minestrone.zh: 将四季豆段倒入盛有洋葱和蔬菜丁的锅中。
minestrone.en: Green bean pieces are tipped into a pot of onions and diced vegetables.

minestrone.zh: 锅中翻炒塌软的包菜丝、西葫芦和其他蔬菜。
minestrone.en: Wilted shredded cabbage, zucchini and other vegetables are stirred in a pot.

minestrone.zh: 蔬菜和干酪外皮在留缝盖锅中小火慢煮。
minestrone.en: Vegetables and cheese rind simmer gently in a partially covered pot.

minestrone.zh: 用汤勺把浓稠的白芸豆蔬菜汤盛入碗中。
minestrone.en: A ladle pours thick vegetable and cannellini bean soup into a bowl.

miso-shiru.zh: 手把裙带菜放入冷水中浸泡，旁边备好豆腐和葱花。
miso-shiru.en: A hand places wakame in cold water, with tofu and scallions prepared nearby.

miso-shiru.zh: 手轻推高汤中的豆腐，锅边冒出细泡。
miso-shiru.en: A hand gently pushes tofu in dashi as small bubbles form around the pot’s edge.

miso-shiru.zh: 手将泡软的裙带菜倒入盛有豆腐和高汤的锅中。
miso-shiru.en: A hand adds soaked wakame to a pot of dashi and tofu.

miso-shiru.zh: 手在小碗里搅散红味噌，旁边是豆腐裙带菜汤。
miso-shiru.en: A hand stirs red miso smooth in a small bowl beside a pot of tofu and wakame soup.

miso-shiru.zh: 手往四碗豆腐裙带菜味噌汤上撒葱花。
miso-shiru.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over four bowls of miso soup with tofu and wakame.

miyeok-guk.zh: 双手用剪刀将泡开的裙带菜剪入碗中。
miyeok-guk.en: Hands use scissors to cut soaked wakame into a bowl.

miyeok-guk.zh: 双手将牛肉薄片与蒜末、酱油和黑胡椒拌匀。
miyeok-guk.en: Hands mix thin beef slices with minced garlic, soy sauce and black pepper.

miyeok-guk.zh: 用铲子拨开锅中表面已变色的牛肉薄片。
miyeok-guk.en: A spatula separates beef slices whose surfaces have lost their red color.

miyeok-guk.zh: 锅中翻炒深绿色裙带菜和牛肉，同时淋入酱油。
miyeok-guk.en: A spatula stirs dark green wakame and beef while soy sauce is poured in.

miyeok-guk.zh: 锅中微微冒泡，裙带菜和牛肉在浅乳白色汤中煮软。
miyeok-guk.en: Wakame and beef simmer gently in a pale, slightly milky broth.

miyeok-guk.zh: 将裙带菜牛肉汤舀入碗中，旁边配着白饭。
miyeok-guk.en: Beef and wakame soup is ladled into a bowl beside white rice.

mo-hanh.zh: 双手用厨房纸擦干案板上的青葱。
mo-hanh.en: Hands dry scallions on a cutting board with a paper towel.

mo-hanh.zh: 双手将青葱切成短段，旁边放着细盐。
mo-hanh.en: Hands cut scallions into short pieces beside a bowl of fine salt.

mo-hanh.zh: 一小段葱在热油中冒出细泡。
mo-hanh.en: A small piece of scallion bubbles gently in hot oil.

mo-hanh.zh: 手在锅中翻拌鲜绿的葱花，油里冒着细泡。
mo-hanh.en: A hand stirs bright green scallions in gently bubbling oil.

mo-hanh.zh: 手在碗中搅拌均匀散在油里的葱花。
mo-hanh.en: A hand stirs scallions evenly distributed in a bowl of oil.

moo-palo.zh: 用夹子翻煎锅中间隔摆放的五花肉块。
moo-palo.en: A hand turns spaced pork belly pieces as they brown in the pot.

moo-palo.zh: 双手将芫荽籽、花椒和其他香料拢入纱布。
moo-palo.en: Hands gather coriander seeds, Sichuan peppercorns and other spices into cheesecloth.

moo-palo.zh: 鸡汤倒入深褐色糖液，锅中剧烈冒泡。
moo-palo.en: Chicken stock is poured into dark caramel, bubbling vigorously.

moo-palo.zh: 手把香料袋放入盛有猪肉、蒜和香菜根的卤汤。
moo-palo.en: A hand adds a spice bag to broth with pork, garlic and cilantro roots.

moo-palo.zh: 揭开锅盖，用叉子检查微滚汤里的五花肉。
moo-palo.en: A hand tests pork belly with a fork in gently simmering broth.

moo-palo.zh: 六个鸡蛋浸在大火滚开的水中。
moo-palo.en: Six eggs are submerged in vigorously boiling water.

moo-palo.zh: 手把豆泡倒入微滚的猪肉蛋卤汤。
moo-palo.en: A hand adds tofu puffs to gently simmering pork and egg broth.

moo-ping.zh: 手持刀将带脂肪的猪肩肉切成均匀薄片。
moo-ping.en: Hands cut marbled pork shoulder into even thin slices.

moo-ping.zh: 一边倒入椰奶，一边搅拌棕色腌汁。
moo-ping.en: A hand pours coconut milk while another stirs brown marinade.

moo-ping.zh: 手在棕色腌汁中拨开并抓匀猪肉薄片。
moo-ping.en: A hand separates and mixes thin pork slices in brown marinade.

moo-ping.zh: 手将竹签放入水中，旁边是撒了淀粉的腌猪肉。
moo-ping.en: A hand places bamboo skewers in water beside marinated pork topped with cornstarch.

moo-ping.zh: 手将腌猪肉片穿上竹签，托盘里摆着扁平肉串。
moo-ping.en: Hands thread marinated pork onto a skewer beside flat skewers on a tray.

moo-ping.zh: 烤架上肉串出现褐色烤痕，手用夹子翻动。
moo-ping.en: A hand turns pork skewers with brown grill marks on the grill.

moo-ping.zh: 手从侧面将探针插入烤肉串，旁边摆着肉串和糯米饭。
moo-ping.en: A hand inserts a probe into a grilled skewer beside plated skewers and sticky rice.

moo-tod-kratiem.zh: 双手将蒜和香料捣成糊，旁边放着猪肉片与粗切蒜。
moo-tod-kratiem.en: Hands grind garlic and spices into a paste beside sliced pork and chopped garlic.

moo-tod-kratiem.zh: 双手将猪肉片和腌料抓匀，旁边摆着调味料。
moo-tod-kratiem.en: Hands mix pork slices with marinade, with seasonings alongside.

moo-tod-kratiem.zh: 锅中猪肉片煎至金黄，一只手正用锅铲翻面。
moo-tod-kratiem.en: A hand flips golden pork slices frying in a pan.

moo-tod-kratiem.zh: 漏勺将金黄的炸蒜盛到厨房纸上沥油。
moo-tod-kratiem.en: A slotted spoon transfers golden fried garlic to kitchen paper to drain.

moo-tod-kratiem.zh: 手将炸蒜撒在猪肉和香菜上，旁边是一碗白饭。
moo-tod-kratiem.en: A hand scatters fried garlic over pork and cilantro beside a bowl of rice.

moules-marinieres.zh: 双手在流水下刷洗青口，沥水篮里放着闭合的青口。
moules-marinieres.en: Hands scrub a mussel under running water above a colander of closed mussels.

moules-marinieres.zh: 锅里的白酒、黄油、红葱头和香草正沸腾，锅底留有酒汁。
moules-marinieres.en: Wine, butter, shallots and herbs boil in a pot with liquid remaining.

moules-marinieres.zh: 手持长勺向上翻动大火蒸煮的青口，锅中蒸汽充足。
moules-marinieres.en: A hand turns mussels upward with a long spoon over high heat as steam rises.

moules-marinieres.zh: 手揭开锅盖，锅中青口大多张开，贝肉饱满不透明。
moules-marinieres.en: A hand lifts the lid to reveal mostly open mussels with plump, opaque meat.

moules-marinieres.zh: 手轻舀锅中上层清汁，沙粒留在锅底，熟青口盛在一旁。
moules-marinieres.en: A hand ladles clear broth above sediment in the pot beside a bowl of cooked mussels.

moules-marinieres.zh: 手向盛有青口和清汤的深盘撒上粗切欧芹。
moules-marinieres.en: A hand sprinkles roughly chopped parsley over mussels in clear broth.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 提起打蛋器，浅黄色蛋黄糊落成带状，旁边放着橙味利口酒。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: A whisk lifts a ribbon of pale yolk mixture beside a cup of orange liqueur.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 隔热水搅打蛋黄糊，温度计插在糊中，锅底燃着小火。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: A whisk stirs yolk mixture over gently heated water while a thermometer probes it.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 用刮刀将软黄油拌入顺滑的巧克力咖啡糊。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: A spatula stirs softened butter into smooth chocolate and coffee mixture.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 将巧克力糊倒入蛋黄糊，同时用打蛋器搅拌。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: Chocolate mixture is poured into the yolk mixture as it is whisked.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 提起打蛋器，白色蛋白泡沫形成直立的尖角，旁边放着糖。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: A whisk lifts glossy egg white foam into a firm peak beside a spoonful of sugar.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 用刮刀从碗底向上翻拌蛋白泡沫和巧克力糊。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: A spatula folds egg white foam upward into the chocolate mixture.

mousse-au-chocolat.zh: 六杯巧克力慕斯已经定形，一只手轻轻倾斜其中一杯。
mousse-au-chocolat.en: Six cups of chocolate mousse are set, and a hand gently tilts one cup.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 双手将泡发的木耳撕成小片，放在沥水篮中。
mu-xu-rou.en: Hands tear hydrated wood ear mushrooms into pieces over a colander.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 双手抓拌猪肉片与姜末，肉片表面裹着薄浆。
mu-xu-rou.en: Hands mix pork slices and minced ginger until thinly coated.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 双手将去瓤黄瓜切成薄片，旁边放着蛋液和调味汁。
mu-xu-rou.en: Hands slice a seeded cucumber beside bowls of beaten egg and sauce.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 锅铲推炒鸡蛋，锅中蛋液已凝成松软的大块。
mu-xu-rou.en: A spatula pushes soft, set egg curds in the wok.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 葱段倒入锅中，与散开的微微上色的肉片一起炒。
mu-xu-rou.en: Scallion segments are added to separated, lightly browned pork slices.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 调味汁倒入锅中，裹住肉片、木耳、黄瓜和葱段。
mu-xu-rou.en: Sauce is poured over pork, wood ear mushrooms, cucumber, and scallions in the wok.

mu-xu-rou.zh: 锅铲将鸡蛋、肉片、木耳、黄瓜和葱段盛入盘中。
mu-xu-rou.en: A spatula transfers egg, pork, wood ear mushrooms, cucumber, and scallions onto a plate.

myeolchi-bokkeum.zh: 双手轻颠干筛篮，筛出小银鱼的碎屑。
myeolchi-bokkeum.en: Hands gently shake dried anchovies in a dry sieve, letting crumbs fall through.

myeolchi-bokkeum.zh: 用勺搅拌酱汁，刮起碗底的糖。
myeolchi-bokkeum.en: A spoon stirs the sauce and scrapes up sugar from the bottom of the bowl.

myeolchi-bokkeum.zh: 中火翻炒油中的蒜末，蒜仍呈浅色。
myeolchi-bokkeum.en: Minced garlic remains pale as it is stirred in oil over medium heat.

myeolchi-bokkeum.zh: 中火用锅铲翻炒小鱼，鱼身略呈浅金色。
myeolchi-bokkeum.en: A spatula turns the anchovies over medium heat until lightly golden.

myeolchi-bokkeum.zh: 离火后将酱汁倒入锅中央，鱼围在锅边，汁冒细泡。
myeolchi-bokkeum.en: Sauce is poured into the center of the pan off the heat, bubbling inside a ring of anchovies.

myeolchi-bokkeum.zh: 用锅铲将发亮的小鱼和芝麻摊在盘中。
myeolchi-bokkeum.en: A spatula spreads glossy anchovies and sesame seeds over a plate.

nam-jim-jaew.zh: 手持木铲翻炒干锅里浅褐色的糯米。
nam-jim-jaew.en: A hand stirs light brown glutinous rice in a dry pan.

nam-jim-jaew.zh: 手持木铲在小火上翻焙去蒂干辣椒。
nam-jim-jaew.en: A hand turns stemmed dried chilies in a dry pan over low heat.

nam-jim-jaew.zh: 手将红葱头薄片和辣椒碎拌入棕色酱汁。
nam-jim-jaew.en: A hand stirs sliced shallots and chili flakes into brown sauce.

nam-jim-jaew.zh: 手搅拌加入香菜和烤米粉的蘸酱，旁边放着烤鸡。
nam-jim-jaew.en: A hand stirs cilantro and toasted rice powder into dipping sauce beside grilled chicken.

nam-jim-seafood.zh: 手切香菜梗，旁边摆着切好的青椒、蒜和青柠汁。
nam-jim-seafood.en: Hands chop cilantro stems beside chopped green chilies, garlic, and lime juice.

nam-jim-seafood.zh: 手用杵沿研钵内壁研磨绿色香料湿糊。
nam-jim-seafood.en: Hands grind a moist green aromatic paste against the mortar wall.

nam-jim-seafood.zh: 手用杵将棕榈糖碎压入绿色香料糊。
nam-jim-seafood.en: Hands press shaved palm sugar into the green aromatic paste with a pestle.

nam-jim-seafood.zh: 手用杵搅拌研钵里能流动的绿色酱汁。
nam-jim-seafood.en: Hands stir the fluid green sauce in a mortar with a pestle.

nam-jim-seafood.zh: 手拿熟虾蘸绿色海鲜酱，碗旁还有一只虾。
nam-jim-seafood.en: A hand dips a cooked shrimp into green seafood sauce, with another shrimp beside the bowl.

nam-prik-pao.zh: 双手剪开干辣椒去籽，旁边放着蒜瓣和红葱头块。
nam-prik-pao.en: Hands cut open a dried chili and remove its seeds beside garlic cloves and shallot chunks.

nam-prik-pao.zh: 木铲在干锅中翻动带少量深色斑点的辣椒。
nam-prik-pao.en: A wooden spatula turns chilies with a few dark spots in a dry pan.

nam-prik-pao.zh: 木铲在干锅中翻烘表面有褐色斑点的蒜和红葱头。
nam-prik-pao.en: A wooden spatula turns garlic and shallots with brown spots in a dry pan.

nam-prik-pao.zh: 手向料理机中的辣椒厚糊倒油，旁边摆着配料。
nam-prik-pao.en: A hand pours oil into thick chili paste in a food processor, with ingredients alongside.

nam-prik-pao.zh: 手用木铲刮炒浓稠辣椒膏，锅边渗出油。
nam-prik-pao.en: A hand scrapes thick chili paste with a wooden spatula as oil gathers around the edge.

nam-prik-pao.zh: 手用勺将深红褐色辣椒膏从锅中盛入小碗。
nam-prik-pao.en: A hand spoons deep reddish-brown chili paste from the pan into a small bowl.

nam-prik-pla.zh: 双手将辣椒横切成圈，切好的辣椒圈放在碗里。
nam-prik-pla.en: Hands slice a chili into rings beside a bowl of sliced chilies.

nam-prik-pla.zh: 手将蒜薄片放入盛有红绿辣椒圈的碗中。
nam-prik-pla.en: A hand adds thin garlic slices to a bowl of red and green chili rings.

nam-prik-pla.zh: 手将鱼露倒入盛有辣椒圈和蒜片的碗中。
nam-prik-pla.en: A hand pours fish sauce into a bowl of chili rings and garlic slices.

nam-prik-pla.zh: 手用小匙舀取鱼露辣椒汁，旁边放着米饭。
nam-prik-pla.en: A hand spoons chili fish sauce from a bowl beside a serving of rice.

nam-tok-neua.zh: 用夹子将生牛排裹上带黑胡椒的腌汁。
nam-tok-neua.en: Tongs coat a raw steak in black pepper marinade.

nam-tok-neua.zh: 用木铲在大火上翻炒至金褐的糯米。
nam-tok-neua.en: A wooden spatula stirs golden toasted glutinous rice over high heat.

nam-tok-neua.zh: 将温度计从侧面插入烤架上的牛排。
nam-tok-neua.en: A thermometer is inserted into the side of a steak on the grill.

nam-tok-neua.zh: 在案板上将烤牛排切成薄片，旁边留有肉汁。
nam-tok-neua.en: A grilled steak is cut into thin slices on a board, with its juices nearby.

nam-tok-neua.zh: 用勺翻拌肉片和带辣椒、烤米粉的拌汁。
nam-tok-neua.en: A spoon folds beef slices into dressing flecked with chili and toasted rice powder.

nam-tok-neua.zh: 将牛肉与香茅、红葱头和翠绿香草轻轻拌匀。
nam-tok-neua.en: Beef is gently tossed with lemongrass, shallots, and green herbs.

nasu-dengaku.zh: 手将铝箔铺平在烤盘上，烤箱预热灯亮起。
nasu-dengaku.en: A hand smooths foil onto a baking tray as the oven preheat light glows.

nasu-dengaku.zh: 手在划格的茄子切面薄刷一层油。
nasu-dengaku.en: A hand brushes a thin layer of oil onto scored eggplant halves.

nasu-dengaku.zh: 手用竹签检查烤盘上茄子的中心。
nasu-dengaku.en: A hand checks the center of a baked eggplant half with a bamboo skewer.

nasu-dengaku.zh: 手在小火上搅拌冒小泡的味噌酱。
nasu-dengaku.en: A hand stirs gently bubbling miso sauce over low heat.

nasu-dengaku.zh: 手用勺子将味噌酱薄薄抹在烤软的茄子上。
nasu-dengaku.en: A hand spreads a thin layer of miso sauce over softened eggplant.

nasu-dengaku.zh: 手在带焦斑的味噌烤茄子上撒白芝麻。
nasu-dengaku.en: A hand sprinkles white sesame over miso-glazed eggplant with browned spots.

ngheu-hap-sa.zh: 双手用刷子清洁沥水篮里的蛤蜊壳。
ngheu-hap-sa.en: Hands brush the shells of clams in a colander.

ngheu-hap-sa.zh: 双手斜切香茅，旁边摆着蒜、辣椒圈和罗勒。
ngheu-hap-sa.en: Hands slice lemongrass diagonally beside garlic, chili rings, and basil.

ngheu-hap-sa.zh: 中火翻炒香茅和浅色蒜瓣。
ngheu-hap-sa.en: A hand stir-fries lemongrass and pale garlic over medium heat.

ngheu-hap-sa.zh: 揭开锅盖，锅里蛤蜊已张开并冒着蒸汽。
ngheu-hap-sa.en: A hand lifts the lid to reveal steaming, open clams.

ngheu-hap-sa.zh: 用勺把蛤蜊、香茅、罗勒和汤汁盛入盘中。
ngheu-hap-sa.en: A hand serves clams, lemongrass, basil, and broth into a bowl.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 双手用棉线扎紧露出肥瘦螺旋的生五花肉卷。
nibuta-chashu.en: Hands tie a raw pork belly roll with cotton string, revealing its spiral of meat and fat.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 用夹子在平底锅中转动煎至金褐色的肉卷。
nibuta-chashu.en: Tongs turn a golden-brown pork roll in an oiled frying pan.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 肉卷与葱姜在煮汁中沸腾，勺子撇去浮沫。
nibuta-chashu.en: A spoon skims foam from boiling braising liquid around the pork roll, scallions and ginger.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 双手将中央开孔的烘焙纸落盖贴在肉卷上。
nibuta-chashu.en: Hands place a parchment drop lid with a central hole over the gently simmering pork roll.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 用竹签插入煮汁中的肉卷，检查软硬。
nibuta-chashu.en: A hand inserts a bamboo skewer into the pork roll in its braising liquid to check tenderness.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 盛着肉卷和煮汁的浅容器放在冰水盆中冷却。
nibuta-chashu.en: A shallow container of pork roll and cooking liquid cools in a basin of ice water.

nibuta-chashu.zh: 叉烧片在小锅的煮汁中加热，一只手盖上锅盖。
nibuta-chashu.en: A hand covers a small saucepan of chashu slices warming in cooking liquid.

niku-maki.zh: 手在案板上切芦笋段，旁边放着猪肉片和调好的酱汁。
niku-maki.en: A hand cuts asparagus into sections beside pork slices and mixed sauce.

niku-maki.zh: 手用夹子从沸水锅中夹起鲜绿的芦笋段。
niku-maki.en: A hand lifts a bright green asparagus piece from a pot of boiling water.

niku-maki.zh: 双手将撒了黑胡椒的猪肉片紧紧卷在芦笋束上。
niku-maki.en: Hands roll peppered pork tightly around a bundle of asparagus.

niku-maki.zh: 手给生芦笋肉卷薄撒淀粉，旁边的锅里有油。
niku-maki.en: A hand dusts raw asparagus pork rolls with starch beside an oiled pan.

niku-maki.zh: 手用夹子翻动锅中煎至浅金黄的芦笋肉卷。
niku-maki.en: A hand turns lightly golden asparagus pork rolls in a frying pan.

niku-maki.zh: 手用锅铲滚动肉卷，锅中酱汁起细泡并留下划痕。
niku-maki.en: A hand rolls pork bundles through bubbling sauce, leaving a trail with the spatula.

niku-maki.zh: 手用夹子将亮泽的芦笋肉卷盛到盘中，切面露出菜芯。
niku-maki.en: A hand plates glazed asparagus pork rolls, with asparagus visible in the cut ends.

nikujaga.zh: 削去土豆块的棱角，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜和牛肉。
nikujaga.en: A hand rounds a potato chunk beside prepared vegetables and sliced beef.

nikujaga.zh: 锅里翻炒土豆、胡萝卜、洋葱和变色的牛肉。
nikujaga.en: Potatoes, carrots, onions and browned beef are gently turned in a pan.

nikujaga.zh: 在微沸的土豆炖肉上放入中间开孔的纸落盖。
nikujaga.en: A hand places a perforated parchment drop lid over gently simmering beef and vegetables.
