nikujaga.zh: 用竹签检查锅中土豆的中心，糖和味醂备在一旁。
nikujaga.en: A bamboo skewer tests the center of a potato, with sugar and mirin nearby.

nikujaga.zh: 用勺把锅里的煮汁淋在完整的土豆块上。
nikujaga.en: A ladle pours simmering broth over an intact potato chunk.

nikujaga.zh: 把带少量煮汁的土豆炖肉和鲜绿荷兰豆盛入碗中。
nikujaga.en: A ladle serves nikujaga with bright green snow peas and a little broth into a bowl.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 用刀拍裂干香料，旁边摆着切好的葱姜蒜和洋葱。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: A hand cracks a dry spice pod beside sliced aromatics and spices.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 从微微冒泡的牛油中捞出炸至金黄的葱姜蒜和洋葱。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: A skimmer lifts golden aromatics from gently bubbling beef tallow.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 离火后用长铲将糍粑辣椒翻入融化的油脂中。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: A hand folds pounded chili into melted fats in a pot away from the heat.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 小火铲炒豆瓣和辣椒，锅中料渣松散、红油明亮。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: A spatula stirs loose chili and doubanjiang in bright red oil over a low flame.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 小火翻炒姜蒜、豆豉、花椒和干香料，拌入红油料渣。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: Ginger, garlic, fermented beans, Sichuan pepper and spices are stirred into the chili mixture over low heat.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 锅离火后，一手倒入白酒，一手搅拌红油香料。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: A hand pours baijiu into the chili and spice mixture while another stirs the pot away from the heat.

niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.zh: 用勺将红油底料分装进浅容器，旁边一盒已装满。
niu-you-huo-guo-di-liao.en: A ladle portions the red chili base into shallow containers beside a filled one.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 用厨房纸吸干肉片，旁边摆着椒段、蒜末和姜丝。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: A hand blots sliced pork beside chopped peppers, minced garlic and ginger strips.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 小火下用锅铲划动刚凝固的大块鸡蛋。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: A spatula moves large, just-set egg curds over low heat.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 小火翻煸肥肉片，肉片边缘呈浅金黄色。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: Fatty pork slices turn pale golden at the edges over low heat.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 锅铲翻动已变色的五花肉片。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: A spatula turns opaque cooked pork slices in the wok.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 锅铲把豆瓣、姜丝和蒜末拨散在肉片和红油中。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: A spatula spreads doubanjiang, ginger and garlic among pork slices in reddish oil.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 锅中肉片、椒段和蛋块翻拌，勺子淋入生抽。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: Soy sauce is poured over pork, peppers and egg curds in the wok.

nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.zh: 锅铲将肉片、椒段和蛋块盛入盘中。
nong-jia-yi-wan-xiang.en: A spatula transfers pork, peppers and egg curds onto a serving plate.

nuoc-cham.en: A hand squeezes lime juice into a measuring cup.

nuoc-cham.zh: 手搅拌碗中的青柠糖水，至糖溶解。
nuoc-cham.en: A hand stirs the lime and sugar water until the sugar dissolves.

nuoc-cham.zh: 手将鱼露倒入青柠糖水，旁边放着生菜。
nuoc-cham.en: A hand pours fish sauce into lime and sugar water, with lettuce alongside.

nuoc-cham.zh: 手将蒜末和辣椒圈倒入鱼露汁。
nuoc-cham.en: A hand adds minced garlic and chili rings to the fish sauce mixture.

nuoc-cham.zh: 手将蒜末辣椒鱼露汁倒入宽碗，旁边是青柠和生菜。
nuoc-cham.en: A hand pours garlic and chili fish sauce into a wide bowl beside lime and lettuce.

oden.zh: 用竹签试探清水中小火煮着的十字萝卜。
oden.en: A hand tests cross-scored daikon simmering in water with a bamboo skewer.

oden.zh: 用勺子把鸡蛋放入轻沸的水中。
oden.en: A hand lowers an egg into gently boiling water with a spoon.

oden.zh: 捞出焯过的鱼糕和厚油豆腐，水面浮着油滴。
oden.en: A strainer lifts blanched fish cakes and fried tofu above water dotted with oil.

oden.zh: 用竹签试探出汁里轻煨的萝卜，锅中还有蛋和蒟蒻。
oden.en: A hand tests daikon simmering in dashi with eggs and konnyaku.

oden.zh: 用勺子轻压鱼糕，锅里食材在小泡汤中轻煨。
oden.en: A hand gently presses a fish cake into the simmering broth with a spoon.

oden.zh: 将汤舀入盛好的关东煮，旁边另放一碟黄芥末。
oden.en: A hand ladles broth over the served oden beside a dish of yellow mustard.

oi-muchim.zh: 手持刀将带皮黄瓜斜切成薄片。
oi-muchim.en: Hands slice a skin-on cucumber diagonally into thin pieces.

oi-muchim.zh: 双手在碗上拨散洋葱丝，旁边放着葱花和蒜末。
oi-muchim.en: Hands separate onion slivers over a bowl beside chopped scallion and garlic.

oi-muchim.zh: 手用勺搅拌含辣椒碎和蒜末的酱汁。
oi-muchim.en: A hand stirs sauce with chili flakes and minced garlic.

oi-muchim.zh: 双手用两把勺翻拌沾有辣椒碎的黄瓜、洋葱和葱花。
oi-muchim.en: Hands use two spoons to toss cucumbers, onion and scallions coated in chili flakes.

oi-muchim.zh: 手将拌有芝麻的辣黄瓜盛入盘中。
oi-muchim.en: A hand serves spicy cucumber salad with sesame seeds onto a plate.

ojingeo-bokkeum.zh: 手将生鱿鱼筒切成圈，旁边摆着触腕。
ojingeo-bokkeum.en: Hands slice a raw squid tube into rings beside the tentacles.

ojingeo-bokkeum.zh: 手在碗中拌匀鱿鱼，表面裹满红酱。
ojingeo-bokkeum.en: A hand mixes squid in a bowl until coated in red sauce.

ojingeo-bokkeum.zh: 手切胡萝卜，案板上摆着切好的蔬菜。
ojingeo-bokkeum.en: Hands slice carrot beside the prepared vegetables on a cutting board.

ojingeo-bokkeum.zh: 手在大火上翻炒蔬菜，洋葱边缘变透明。
ojingeo-bokkeum.en: A hand stir-fries vegetables over high heat until the onion edges turn translucent.

ojingeo-bokkeum.zh: 手在大火上翻炒锅中央卷起的鱿鱼，蔬菜围在锅边。
ojingeo-bokkeum.en: A hand stir-fries curling squid in the center of the pan with vegetables around the edge.

ojingeo-bokkeum.zh: 手将裹着红酱的鱿鱼和蔬菜盛入白盘。
ojingeo-bokkeum.en: Hands transfer red-sauced squid and vegetables onto a white plate.

okonomiyaki.zh: 双手切碎卷心菜，旁边备好山药泥、红腌姜和猪五花。
okonomiyaki.en: Hands chop cabbage beside prepared grated yam, pickled ginger and pork belly.

okonomiyaki.zh: 勺子舀起顺滑面糊，面糊缓缓落回碗中。
okonomiyaki.en: A spoon lifts smooth batter that falls slowly back into the bowl.

okonomiyaki.zh: 用勺轻轻翻拌卷心菜和配料，使菜末均匀挂糊。
okonomiyaki.en: A spoon gently folds cabbage and toppings until evenly coated with batter.

okonomiyaki.zh: 平底锅中煎着定形的菜饼，双手在饼上铺猪五花。
okonomiyaki.en: Hands lay pork belly on a set cabbage pancake in a frying pan.

okonomiyaki.zh: 双手用两把铲子托起菜饼，准备翻面。
okonomiyaki.en: Two spatulas support the pancake as hands turn it over.

okonomiyaki.zh: 手持温度计从侧面插入锅中的饼心。
okonomiyaki.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the side of the pancake in the pan.

okonomiyaki.zh: 手在装盘的大阪烧上撒柴鱼片。
okonomiyaki.en: A hand sprinkles bonito flakes over the plated okonomiyaki.

omurice.zh: 双手将洋葱切成细丁，旁边放着鸡肉丁和熟饭。
omurice.en: Hands finely dice an onion beside prepared chicken and cooked rice.

omurice.zh: 用铲翻炒黄油中软透的洋葱丁。
omurice.en: A spatula stirs softened diced onion in foaming butter.

omurice.zh: 用铲划开浓稠的鸡肉番茄酱，露出锅底。
omurice.en: A spatula draws a track through thick tomato sauce and chicken, exposing the pan.

omurice.zh: 将熟豌豆倒入橙红色的鸡肉炒饭中。
omurice.en: Cooked peas are poured into orange-red chicken fried rice.

omurice.zh: 一手晃锅，一手用筷子搅动形成细软块的蛋液。
omurice.en: One hand holds the pan while the other stirs eggs into small soft curds with chopsticks.

omurice.zh: 用软铲将蛋皮的一边折向中央的炒饭。
omurice.en: A spatula folds one side of the egg sheet over the fried rice.

omurice.zh: 在盘中的椭圆形蛋包饭上挤番茄酱。
omurice.en: Ketchup is squeezed over the oval omurice on a plate.

onigiri.zh: 用饭勺轻轻翻松碗里的熟短粒米饭。
onigiri.en: A hand gently fluffs cooked short-grain rice in a bowl with a rice paddle.

onigiri.zh: 用小匙拌匀柴鱼馅，旁边摆着海苔条。
onigiri.en: A hand mixes bonito filling with a spoon beside strips of nori.

onigiri.zh: 将布松松盖在十份米饭上。
onigiri.en: A hand loosely covers ten portions of rice with a cloth.

onigiri.zh: 在掌心铺开的米饭中央放入柴鱼馅。
onigiri.en: A hand spoons bonito filling into the center of rice spread on a palm.

onigiri.zh: 双手轻轻将米饭握成三角形。
onigiri.en: Two hands gently shape rice into a triangle.

onigiri.zh: 双手把海苔裹在饭团底部，盘中还有两个饭团。
onigiri.en: Two hands wrap nori around the base of a rice ball beside two others on a plate.

orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.zh: 双手将西兰花苔嫩茎切短，旁边放着老梗和黄叶。
orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.en: Hands cut tender rapini stems short, with woody stems and yellow leaves set aside.

orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.zh: 鲜猫耳朵面倒入煮着西兰花苔的沸水中。
orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.en: Fresh orecchiette is poured into boiling water with rapini.

orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.zh: 小火下用铲子压散鳀鱼，油中有蒜和干辣椒。
orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.en: A spatula breaks up anchovies in oil with garlic and dried chili over low heat.

orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.zh: 用漏勺将带水的猫耳朵面和西兰花苔捞入香油锅。
orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.en: A slotted spoon transfers wet orecchiette and rapini into the seasoned oil.

orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.zh: 用勺将猫耳朵面和西兰花苔盛入红边盘中。
orecchiette-con-cime-di-rapa.en: A spoon serves orecchiette and rapini onto a red-rimmed platter.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 用厨房剪刀在带骨小牛膝的边缘筋膜上剪浅口。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: Kitchen shears snip the membrane around a raw bone-in veal shank.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 锅中翻炒软化的洋葱、胡萝卜、西芹、蒜末和柠檬皮。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: A spoon stirs softened onion, carrot, celery, garlic and lemon peel in the pot.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 用夹子翻动煎至金褐色的带骨小牛膝。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: Tongs turn a bone-in veal shank seared golden brown in a frying pan.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 用木铲刮起白葡萄酒中煮开的褐色锅底。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: A wooden spatula scrapes browned bits into simmering white wine.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 向盛有肉片、番茄和香草的炖锅倒入高汤。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: Stock is poured into a pot of veal shanks, tomatoes and herbs.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 用叉子扎入微沸炖汁中软嫩的小牛膝。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: A fork pierces a tender veal shank in gently simmering sauce.

ossobuco-alla-milanese.zh: 将欧芹、柠檬皮屑和蒜末撒在炖好的小牛膝上。
ossobuco-alla-milanese.en: Parsley, lemon zest and minced garlic are sprinkled over braised veal shanks.

oyakodon.zh: 用筷子轻轻划散蛋液，旁边备好白饭、鸡肉和葱段。
oyakodon.en: Chopsticks gently break up the eggs beside bowls of rice, sliced chicken and scallions.

oyakodon.zh: 用勺搅动锅中轻沸的酱油出汁。
oyakodon.en: A spoon stirs gently simmering soy-seasoned dashi in a pan.

oyakodon.zh: 将温度计插入煮汁中的鸡肉片。
oyakodon.en: A thermometer probes a piece of chicken simmering in broth.

oyakodon.zh: 将蛋液淋入轻沸的鸡肉和葱段中。
oyakodon.en: Beaten egg is poured over chicken and scallions in gently simmering broth.

oyakodon.zh: 用宽勺将锅边凝起的蛋层轻轻拨向中央。
oyakodon.en: A wide spoon gently pushes the set edge of the egg toward the center of the pan.

oyakodon.zh: 用宽勺将鸡肉、葱和蛋层托到白饭上。
oyakodon.en: A wide spoon transfers chicken, scallions and a soft layer of egg onto rice.

pad-kana-moo.zh: 手持研杵粗捣蒜和辣椒，旁边是切好的芥兰。
pad-kana-moo.en: Hands pound garlic and chili coarsely beside cut Chinese broccoli.

pad-kana-moo.zh: 手将生猪肉片倒入有蒜和辣椒的热油锅中。
pad-kana-moo.en: A hand tips raw pork slices into hot oil with garlic and chili.

pad-kana-moo.zh: 锅铲翻炒已变白的猪肉片、蒜和辣椒。
pad-kana-moo.en: A spatula tosses opaque pork slices with garlic and chili in the wok.

pad-kana-moo.zh: 锅铲翻拌猪肉和蒜辣椒，锅中酱汁略微收浓。
pad-kana-moo.en: A spatula stirs pork, garlic and chili in slightly reduced sauce.

pad-kana-moo.zh: 芥兰炒猪肉盛在盘中，旁边配一碗米饭。
pad-kana-moo.en: Stir-fried Chinese broccoli and pork is plated beside a bowl of rice.

pad-kee-mao.zh: 双手轻轻揭开柔软的宽河粉，旁边另有一碗河粉。
pad-kee-mao.en: Hands gently separate soft wide rice noodles, with another bowl of noodles beside them.

pad-kee-mao.zh: 双手用石臼将辣椒、蒜和红椒捣成粗泥。
pad-kee-mao.en: Hands pound chilies, garlic and red pepper into a coarse paste in a mortar.

pad-kee-mao.zh: 锅铲翻动锅中煎至不透明的虾仁。
pad-kee-mao.en: A spatula turns opaque shrimp frying in a wok.

pad-kee-mao.zh: 大火翻炒芥兰茎、胡萝卜丝和椒蒜粒。
pad-kee-mao.en: A spatula stir-fries gai lan stems, carrot strips and chili-garlic over high heat.

pad-kee-mao.zh: 锅铲翻动着色的河粉、虾仁和蔬菜，粉上有少量焦斑。
pad-kee-mao.en: A spatula turns browned rice noodles, shrimp and vegetables, with a few charred spots on the noodles.

pad-kee-mao.zh: 锅铲将炒好的虾仁河粉和绿叶盛入盘中。
pad-kee-mao.en: A spatula serves the cooked shrimp noodles and greens onto a plate.

pad-kra-pao.zh: 手用杵将蒜、辣椒和红葱头捣成粗泥。
pad-kra-pao.en: A hand pounds garlic, chilies and shallot into a coarse paste.

pad-kra-pao.zh: 手舀热油浇在边缘金黄酥脆的煎蛋上。
pad-kra-pao.en: A hand spoons hot oil over a fried egg with crisp golden edges.

pad-kra-pao.zh: 锅铲在中大火上翻炒松散、无积水的猪肉末。
pad-kra-pao.en: A spatula stirs loose ground pork over medium-high heat with no water pooled in the pan.

pad-kra-pao.zh: 锅铲翻炒挂着薄亮酱汁的肉末，锅底没有积水。
pad-kra-pao.en: A spatula stirs minced pork coated in a thin glossy sauce, with no liquid pooling in the pan.

pad-kra-pao.zh: 手将酥边煎蛋放在罗勒猪肉饭上。
pad-kra-pao.en: A hand places a crisp-edged fried egg on basil pork and rice.

pad-pak-boong.zh: 双手纵剖空心菜粗嫩茎，旁边放着切段的菜。
pad-pak-boong.en: Hands split a tender water spinach stem lengthwise beside cut greens.

pad-pak-boong.zh: 双手用刀拍蒜，旁边备好辣椒、豆粒和调味料。
pad-pak-boong.en: Hands crush garlic with a knife beside chili, soybeans, and seasonings.

pad-pak-boong.zh: 手往盛有空心菜、蒜、豆粒和辣椒的碗里撒糖。
pad-pak-boong.en: A hand sprinkles sugar over water spinach, garlic, soybeans, and chili in a bowl.

pad-pak-boong.zh: 双手将空心菜和配料倒进大火上的热油锅。
pad-pak-boong.en: Hands tip water spinach and seasonings into hot oil in a wok over high heat.

pad-pak-boong.zh: 双手将炒好的空心菜、蒜、豆粒和辣椒盛入盘中。
pad-pak-boong.en: Hands serve stir-fried water spinach, garlic, soybeans, and chili onto a plate.

pad-pak-ruam.zh: 手在粗切蒜粒，三碗蔬菜分别备好。
pad-pak-ruam.en: Hands coarsely chop garlic beside three bowls of prepared vegetables.

pad-pak-ruam.zh: 手将碗中的深色酱汁搅匀，旁边另放一碗水。
pad-pak-ruam.en: A hand stirs dark sauce until smooth beside a separate bowl of water.

pad-pak-ruam.zh: 手在中大火的锅中翻炒浅金黄蒜粒。
pad-pak-ruam.en: A hand stirs pale golden garlic in oil over a medium-high flame.

pad-pak-ruam.zh: 手翻炒胡萝卜和花菜，锅底的水冒着蒸汽。
pad-pak-ruam.en: A hand stir-fries carrots and cauliflower as water steams in the wok.

pad-pak-ruam.zh: 手把酱汁倒入盛有杂菜的热锅。
pad-pak-ruam.en: A hand pours sauce into the hot wok of mixed vegetables.

pad-pak-ruam.zh: 手将炒好的杂菜和少量汁从锅中盛入盘里。
pad-pak-ruam.en: Hands tip the cooked vegetables and a little sauce from the wok onto a plate.

pad-prik-king.zh: 双手将鱼露抓匀猪肉，旁边备好豆段、橙叶和调料。
pad-prik-king.en: Hands mix fish sauce into pork beside prepared beans, lime leaves and seasonings.

pad-prik-king.zh: 双手将煮熟沥干的四季豆段摊开晾干。
pad-prik-king.en: Hands spread the drained, cooked green beans out to dry.

pad-prik-king.zh: 锅铲翻动单层猪肉片，肉面出现褐色斑点。
pad-prik-king.en: A spatula turns a single layer of pork slices with browned spots.

pad-prik-king.zh: 锅铲在中火上将红咖喱酱与油炒匀。
pad-prik-king.en: A spatula stirs red curry paste and oil over medium heat.

pad-prik-king.zh: 手将撕碎的马蜂橙叶撒入锅中的红咖喱酱。
pad-prik-king.en: A hand drops torn makrut lime leaves into red curry sauce in the pan.

pad-prik-king.zh: 锅铲翻炒挂满红酱的猪肉和四季豆，划出一道锅底。
pad-prik-king.en: A spatula stirs sauce-coated pork and green beans, leaving a clear track in the pan.

pad-prik-king.zh: 双手将红咖喱猪肉和四季豆盛盘，旁边配香米饭。
pad-prik-king.en: Hands plate the red curry pork and green beans beside jasmine rice.

pad-see-ew.zh: 双手在碗上轻轻分开宽河粉。
pad-see-ew.en: Two hands gently separate wide rice noodles over a bowl.

pad-see-ew.zh: 手持刀斜切芥兰茎，旁边放着鸡肉和酱汁。
pad-see-ew.en: A hand slices gai lan stems diagonally beside chicken and sauce.

pad-see-ew.zh: 锅铲翻炒鸡肉、鸡蛋和斜切芥兰茎。
pad-see-ew.en: A spatula stir-fries chicken, egg and diagonally sliced gai lan stems.

pad-see-ew.zh: 一手倒入酱汁，一手从锅底翻起河粉。
pad-see-ew.en: One hand pours in sauce while the other lifts noodles from the wok.

pad-see-ew.zh: 锅铲翻起河粉，露出底面的褐色斑点。
pad-see-ew.en: A spatula turns the noodles to reveal brown spots underneath.

pad-see-ew.zh: 芥兰叶倒入锅中，与河粉、鸡肉和鸡蛋翻炒。
pad-see-ew.en: Gai lan leaves are added to the wok and tossed with noodles, chicken and egg.

pad-thai.zh: 双手将泡软的米粉绕在手指上弯曲。
pad-thai.en: Hands bend a soaked rice noodle around a finger.

pad-thai.zh: 双手搅拌棕色酱汁，周围摆着切好的配料。
pad-thai.en: Hands stir brown sauce surrounded by prepared ingredients.

pad-thai.zh: 手将棕色酱汁倒入盛有米粉的热锅中。
pad-thai.en: A hand pours brown sauce over rice noodles in a hot wok.

pad-thai.zh: 米粉拨在锅的一侧，铲子翻炒刚变色的虾和配料。
pad-thai.en: A spatula turns just-pink shrimp and aromatics beside noodles in the wok.

pad-thai.zh: 锅中央的蛋已凝固成碎块，米粉和虾分在两侧。
pad-thai.en: A spatula breaks up set egg between noodles and shrimp in the wok.

pad-thai.zh: 手在装盘的炒河粉上撒花生，旁边有青柠和辣椒粉。
pad-thai.en: A hand sprinkles peanuts over plated pad thai beside lime and chili flakes.

pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.zh: 用漏勺撇去排骨姜片焯水时的浮沫。
pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.en: A hand skims foam from boiling ribs and ginger.

pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.zh: 用勺挖去苦瓜籽瓤，旁边放着苦瓜条和虾皮。
pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.en: A hand scoops seeds and pith from bitter melon beside cut strips and dried shrimp.

pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.zh: 排骨、苦瓜和虾皮在小火上轻炖，手正盖锅盖。
pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.en: A hand covers ribs, bitter melon and dried shrimp simmering over low heat.

pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.zh: 用筷子夹起排骨，检查肉是否容易离骨。
pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.en: A hand lifts a rib with chopsticks to check whether the meat separates from the bone.

pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.zh: 打开电压力锅，用筷子夹起排骨检查肉是否离骨。
pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.en: A hand lifts a rib from the open electric pressure cooker to check whether the meat separates from the bone.

pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.zh: 用勺托着软苦瓜，盛入排骨虾皮汤中。
pai-gu-ku-gua-tang.en: A hand supports soft bitter melon with a ladle while serving the rib and dried shrimp soup.

pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.zh: 戴手套切山药，旁边放着胡萝卜块和玉米段。
pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.en: Gloved hands cut Chinese yam beside carrot chunks and corn rounds.

pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.zh: 用漏勺撇去排骨、姜片和葱白焯水时的浮沫。
pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.en: A skimmer removes foam from blanching ribs, ginger and scallion whites.

pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.zh: 用锅铲翻炒姜片和带浅金色煎痕的排骨。
pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.en: A spatula stirs ginger and ribs with light golden sear marks.

pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.zh: 手扶锅盖，排骨和蔬菜在锅中小火轻炖。
pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.en: A hand holds the lid over gently simmering ribs and vegetables.

pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.zh: 用筷子插排骨，检查轻炖后的软度。
pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.en: Chopsticks pierce a rib to check its tenderness in the simmering soup.

pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.zh: 在盛有排骨、山药、玉米和胡萝卜的汤上撒葱绿。
pai-gu-shan-yao-yu-mi-tang.en: A hand sprinkles scallion greens over the served rib and vegetable soup.

pain-perdu.zh: 双手在案板上将法棍斜切成片。
pain-perdu.en: Hands slice a baguette diagonally on a cutting board.

pain-perdu.zh: 一手搅匀浅盘里的蛋液，旁边放着牛奶。
pain-perdu.en: A hand whisks beaten egg in a shallow dish beside a dish of milk.

pain-perdu.zh: 一手从牛奶中拿起吸湿后仍完整的面包片。
pain-perdu.en: A hand lifts an intact, milk-soaked bread slice from the dish.

pain-perdu.zh: 一手举起裹匀蛋液的面包片，蛋液滴回浅盘。
pain-perdu.en: A hand lifts an egg-coated bread slice as excess egg drips into the dish.

pain-perdu.zh: 小火煎锅里的黄油起泡，宽铲翻起金黄的面包片。
pain-perdu.en: A spatula turns a golden bread slice in foaming butter over a low flame.

pain-perdu.zh: 锅中面包煎至金黄，一手用探针测量中心温度。
pain-perdu.en: A hand checks the center of golden bread in the pan with a probe thermometer.

pain-perdu.zh: 一手向盘中金黄的法式吐司撒糖，切面露出松软孔隙。
pain-perdu.en: A hand sprinkles sugar over golden French toast, with a soft porous interior exposed.

panang-neua.zh: 双手捏开煮软的花生，旁边摆着辣椒和切碎的香料。
panang-neua.en: Hands break open a soft boiled peanut beside chilies and chopped aromatics.

panang-neua.zh: 双手用石臼把花生捣入红色咖喱酱。
panang-neua.en: Hands pound peanuts into red curry paste in a stone mortar.

panang-neua.zh: 叉子插入小火椰奶中炖软的整块牛腩。
panang-neua.en: A fork pierces a whole piece of tender brisket simmering in coconut milk.

panang-neua.zh: 双手切熟牛腩，案板旁放着一碗炖汁。
panang-neua.en: Hands slice cooked brisket beside a bowl of braising liquid.

panang-neua.zh: 锅中翻炒咖喱酱和浓椰浆，表面浮出亮油珠。
panang-neua.en: Curry paste and coconut cream are stirred in a pan with oil droplets on the surface.

panang-neua.zh: 小火翻拌牛肉片和红辣椒，浓咖喱汁贴住肉片。
panang-neua.en: Beef slices and red chilies are stirred over low heat in thick curry sauce.

panang-neua.zh: 一勺带绿叶和红辣椒的浓咖喱牛肉盛入碗中。
panang-neua.en: A spoonful of thick beef curry with green leaves and red chilies is served into a bowl.

panna-cotta.zh: 手将柔软的片状明胶完全按入冷水中。
panna-cotta.en: A hand presses softened gelatin sheets completely into cold water.

panna-cotta.zh: 小火搅拌香草奶油，锅边冒出细小气泡。
panna-cotta.en: A hand stirs vanilla cream over low heat as small bubbles form around the edge.

panna-cotta.zh: 将顺滑的香草奶液通过细筛倒入带嘴容器。
panna-cotta.en: Smooth vanilla cream is poured through a fine sieve into a spouted jug.

panna-cotta.zh: 将香草奶液倒入四只小模具中的一只。
panna-cotta.en: Vanilla cream is poured into one of four small molds.

panna-cotta.zh: 手提起模具，露出盘中带香草籽的奶冻。
panna-cotta.en: A hand lifts the mold to reveal vanilla-speckled panna cotta on a plate.

panzanella.zh: 双手掰开浸泡的面包，查看湿润的中心。
panzanella.en: Hands break open soaked bread to check its moist center.

panzanella.zh: 双手揉散面包，碗里是大小不一的柔软颗粒。
panzanella.en: Hands crumble bread into a bowl of soft, uneven pieces.

panzanella.zh: 双手切番茄丁，旁边备有番茄汁、洋葱、黄瓜和罗勒。
panzanella.en: Hands dice a tomato beside its juice, onion, cucumber and basil.

panzanella.zh: 双手用两把勺子轻翻面包和蔬菜。
panzanella.en: Hands gently fold bread and vegetables with two spoons.

panzanella.zh: 双手在面包沙拉上磨黑胡椒，旁边放着醋和盐。
panzanella.en: Hands grind black pepper over bread salad beside vinegar and salt.

panzanella.zh: 一手扶碗，一手用勺子舀起面包沙拉。
panzanella.en: One hand steadies the bowl while the other lifts a spoonful of bread salad.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 双手用厨房纸擦干渗水的去皮茄片。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: Hands blot moisture from peeled eggplant slices with kitchen paper.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 铲子划过收浓的番茄酱，露出一道锅底。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: A spatula leaves a clear track in the thick tomato sauce.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 薄裹面粉的茄片下油锅，周围持续冒泡。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: A lightly floured eggplant slice is lowered into bubbling oil.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 炸至金黄的茄片被捞起沥油，旁边的茄片平放在架上。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: A golden eggplant slice drains above the oil while others rest flat on a rack.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 手在烤皿里的茄子和番茄酱上铺马苏里拉片。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: A hand places mozzarella slices over eggplant and tomato sauce in a baking dish.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 烤箱里的焗茄子边缘冒泡，表面出现金黄斑点。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: The eggplant bake bubbles at the edges and browns on top in the oven.

parmigiana-di-melanzane.zh: 双手切开盘中定形的焗茄子，露出茄子、番茄酱和融化的奶酪。
parmigiana-di-melanzane.en: Hands cut the rested eggplant bake, revealing layers of eggplant, tomato sauce, and melted cheese.

pasta-al-tonno.zh: 手在切碎欧芹，旁边备好鳀鱼碎和金枪鱼片。
pasta-al-tonno.en: Hands finely chop parsley beside minced anchovies and flaked tuna.

pasta-al-tonno.zh: 手在小火油锅中搅拌鳀鱼碎，蒜已变金黄。
pasta-al-tonno.en: A hand stirs minced anchovies into oil over low heat beside golden garlic.

pasta-al-tonno.zh: 锅铲划过浓稠番茄酱，露出一道锅底。
pasta-al-tonno.en: A spatula leaves a trail of exposed pan through thick tomato sauce.

pasta-al-tonno.zh: 手将欧芹拌入浓稠的金枪鱼番茄酱。
pasta-al-tonno.en: A hand folds parsley into thick tomato sauce with tuna.

pasta-al-tonno.zh: 手用面叉将裹着番茄酱和金枪鱼的意面盛盘。
pasta-al-tonno.en: A hand uses a pasta server to plate spaghetti coated with tomato sauce and tuna.

pasta-alla-gricia.zh: 手将猪颊肉切成条，旁边放着羊奶酪细屑。
pasta-alla-gricia.en: Hands cut guanciale into strips beside a bowl of finely grated pecorino.

pasta-alla-gricia.zh: 手翻动锅中边缘金黄的猪颊肉，锅底积有融出的油。
pasta-alla-gricia.en: A hand turns golden-edged guanciale in a pan of rendered fat.

pasta-alla-gricia.zh: 手搅动沸水中的意面，旁边放着一碗煮面水。
pasta-alla-gricia.en: A hand stirs spaghetti in boiling water beside a bowl of reserved pasta water.

pasta-alla-gricia.zh: 手翻拌锅中的意面和猪颊肉，锅底有一层汁。
pasta-alla-gricia.en: A hand tosses spaghetti and guanciale in a shallow layer of sauce.

pasta-alla-gricia.zh: 手在离火的肉面锅中撒入羊奶酪，同时翻拌面条。
pasta-alla-gricia.en: Hands sprinkle pecorino into the off-heat pan and toss the pasta.

pasta-alla-gricia.zh: 手向两盘猪颊肉意面磨入黑胡椒。
pasta-alla-gricia.en: Hands grind black pepper over two plates of guanciale pasta.

pasta-alla-norma.zh: 用厨房纸压干案板上的去皮茄子片。
pasta-alla-norma.en: Hands pat peeled eggplant slices dry on a cutting board.

pasta-alla-norma.zh: 小火上搅拌浓稠的番茄洋葱酱。
pasta-alla-norma.en: Hands stir thick tomato and onion sauce over a low flame.

pasta-alla-norma.zh: 用夹子翻动油锅中分开的金黄茄子片。
pasta-alla-norma.en: A hand turns spaced golden eggplant slices in bubbling oil.

pasta-alla-norma.zh: 用厨房纸轻压架上摊开的炸茄子片。
pasta-alla-norma.en: A hand blots fried eggplant slices spread on a rack.

pasta-alla-norma.zh: 用夹子翻拌裹着番茄酱的意面，旁边放着面水。
pasta-alla-norma.en: Hands toss spaghetti in tomato sauce beside a cup of pasta water.

pasta-alla-norma.zh: 往铺有炸茄子和罗勒的番茄意面上撒奶酪。
pasta-alla-norma.en: Hands scatter cheese over tomato pasta topped with fried eggplant and basil.

pasta-e-ceci.zh: 用勺压软熟鹰嘴豆，旁边的豆子已经沥干。
pasta-e-ceci.en: A spoon mashes soft cooked chickpeas beside a colander of drained chickpeas.

pasta-e-ceci.zh: 用勺翻动油中浅金色的整瓣蒜，旁边备着迷迭香和番茄。
pasta-e-ceci.en: A spoon turns lightly golden whole garlic cloves in oil beside rosemary and tomatoes.

pasta-e-ceci.zh: 小火翻拌鹰嘴豆，让软烂番茄汁裹住豆子。
pasta-e-ceci.en: Chickpeas are stirred over low heat until coated in softened tomato sauce.

pasta-e-ceci.zh: 将部分鹰嘴豆和汤压成细泥，旁边锅里留着整颗豆子。
pasta-e-ceci.en: Some chickpeas and broth are mashed smooth beside a pot of whole chickpeas.

pasta-e-ceci.zh: 小火轻搅浓汤里的短管面和鹰嘴豆。
pasta-e-ceci.en: Short pasta and chickpeas are gently stirred in thick soup over low heat.

pasta-e-ceci.zh: 将鹰嘴豆短面汤舀入红边碗中，汤面有奶酪和黑胡椒。
pasta-e-ceci.en: Chickpea and pasta soup is ladled into a red-rimmed bowl with cheese and black pepper.

pasta-e-fagioli.zh: 用勺压软锅中小火煮着的花芸豆。
pasta-e-fagioli.en: A spoon presses a soft cranberry bean as the beans simmer.

pasta-e-fagioli.zh: 用勺翻炒排骨、细丁蔬菜和淡金色洋葱。
pasta-e-fagioli.en: A spoon turns pork ribs with diced vegetables and pale golden onion.

pasta-e-fagioli.zh: 搅拌排骨和蔬菜，锅里的番茄汁略微收浓。
pasta-e-fagioli.en: A spoon stirs ribs and vegetables in slightly thickened tomato sauce.

pasta-e-fagioli.zh: 将压碎的熟豆倒回有排骨和蔬菜的汤锅。
pasta-e-fagioli.en: Mashed cooked beans are returned to the pot with ribs and vegetables.

pasta-e-fagioli.zh: 用勺搅拌锅中浓稠但仍能流动的豆子面汤。
pasta-e-fagioli.en: A spoon stirs the thick but flowing bean and pasta soup.

pasta-e-fagioli.zh: 将豆子、短面和肉块组成的浓汤舀入碗中。
pasta-e-fagioli.en: Bean and short pasta soup with pieces of pork is ladled into a bowl.

peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.zh: 双手在大碗中拌鸡翅，表面裹匀薄糊。
peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.en: Hands mix chicken wings in a large bowl until evenly coated in a thin batter.

peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.zh: 深锅中的油正在加热，温度计探头悬在油里。
peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.en: Oil heats in a deep pot with a thermometer probe suspended in it.

peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.zh: 金黄鸡翅在油中冒泡，手持温度计探入鸡翅测温。
peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.en: Golden wings bubble in the oil as a hand inserts a thermometer into one piece.

peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.zh: 手用漏勺捞出金黄鸡翅，旁边的网架上放着鸡翅沥油。
peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.en: A hand lifts golden wings with a skimmer beside wings draining on a rack.

peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.zh: 手用夹子把金黄鸡翅摆在盘里，鸡翅之间留有空隙。
peek-gai-tod-nam-pla.en: A hand uses tongs to arrange golden wings with spaces between them on a plate.

penne-allarrabbiata.zh: 用叉捣碎番茄，旁边备好拍裂的蒜、辣椒圈和欧芹碎。
penne-allarrabbiata.en: A fork crushes tomatoes beside cracked garlic, chili rings, and chopped parsley.

penne-allarrabbiata.zh: 小火用橄榄油加热蒜和辣椒圈，蒜刚泛浅金色。
penne-allarrabbiata.en: Garlic and chili rings warm gently in olive oil until the garlic is pale golden.

penne-allarrabbiata.zh: 木勺划过浓稠的番茄辣椒酱，锅底留下一道痕迹。
penne-allarrabbiata.en: A wooden spoon leaves a trail through thick tomato and chili sauce.

penne-allarrabbiata.zh: 从沸水中叉起一根笔管面，旁边放着留出的煮面水。
penne-allarrabbiata.en: A fork lifts one penne from boiling water beside a cup of reserved pasta water.

penne-allarrabbiata.zh: 用木勺在锅中翻拌笔管面和番茄辣椒酱。
penne-allarrabbiata.en: A wooden spoon tosses penne with tomato and chili sauce in the pan.

penne-allarrabbiata.zh: 将拌有欧芹的香辣番茄笔管面从锅中盛入盘里。
penne-allarrabbiata.en: Penne with spicy tomato sauce and parsley is spooned from the pan onto a plate.

peperonata.zh: 用夹子翻烤盘上的红黄甜椒，外皮起泡变黑。
peperonata.en: A hand turns red and yellow peppers with tongs under the broiler, their skins blistered and blackened.

peperonata.zh: 用漏勺捞出番茄，底部十字切口的皮已经翘起。
peperonata.en: A hand lifts a tomato from boiling water, its skin curling back at the cross cut.

peperonata.zh: 向小火锅中的洋葱香草底料倒入白葡萄酒。
peperonata.en: A hand pours white wine into the onion and herb base over low heat.

peperonata.zh: 小火翻拌椒条和番茄，椒肉保持形状，番茄化成汁。
peperonata.en: A hand stirs pepper strips and tomatoes over low heat as the tomatoes break down into sauce.

peperonata.zh: 将带汁的红黄椒条和番茄盛入碗中。
peperonata.en: A hand spoons red and yellow peppers, tomatoes, and their juices into a serving bowl.

pesto-alla-genovese.zh: 双手用布轻吸罗勒叶，旁边放着奶酪末和松子。
pesto-alla-genovese.en: Hands gently blot basil leaves beside grated cheeses and pine nuts.

pesto-alla-genovese.zh: 手持杵在研钵中压磨蒜和松子，混合物呈细糊状。
pesto-alla-genovese.en: A hand grinds garlic and pine nuts into a fine paste in a mortar.

pesto-alla-genovese.zh: 手持杵沿研钵转动，将罗勒磨成湿润绿糊。
pesto-alla-genovese.en: A hand turns a pestle in the mortar, grinding basil into a moist green paste.

pesto-alla-genovese.zh: 一边向青酱缓缓倒入橄榄油，一边用勺搅拌。
pesto-alla-genovese.en: Olive oil is slowly poured into the pesto while a spoon stirs it.

pesto-alla-genovese.zh: 手在大碗中翻拌青酱面，旁边放着一小碗青酱。
pesto-alla-genovese.en: Hands toss pesto pasta in a large bowl beside a small bowl of pesto.

petits-pois-a-la-francaise.zh: 双手用棉线扎香草束，旁边备好豌豆、生菜心和小洋葱。
petits-pois-a-la-francaise.en: Hands tie herbs with cotton string beside prepared peas, lettuce heart and pearl onions.

petits-pois-a-la-francaise.zh: 手向装有蔬菜、香草、黄油和调料的锅中倒水。
petits-pois-a-la-francaise.en: A hand pours water into a pot of vegetables, herbs, butter and seasonings.

petits-pois-a-la-francaise.zh: 双手晃动盖好的锅，锅底有一圈小火。
petits-pois-a-la-francaise.en: Hands shake the covered pot over a small ring of flame.

petits-pois-a-la-francaise.zh: 手用细刀试探锅中小洋葱的中心，周围是豌豆和生菜。
petits-pois-a-la-francaise.en: A hand tests the center of a pearl onion with a slender knife among peas and lettuce.

petits-pois-a-la-francaise.zh: 手在案板上将熟生菜切成细条，旁边锅里有豌豆和小洋葱。
petits-pois-a-la-francaise.en: Hands slice cooked lettuce into thin strips beside a pot of peas and pearl onions.

petits-pois-a-la-francaise.zh: 双手将亮润的豌豆、小洋葱和生菜从锅中倒入盘里。
petits-pois-a-la-francaise.en: Hands tip glossy peas, pearl onions and lettuce from the pot onto a plate.

pho-bo.zh: 夹子翻动烤架上局部焦黑的洋葱和姜。
pho-bo.en: Tongs turn locally charred onion and ginger on a broiler rack.

pho-bo.zh: 双手在流水下冲洗焯过的牛髓骨。
pho-bo.en: Hands rinse blanched beef marrow bones under running water.

pho-bo.zh: 往微沸的牛骨牛腩香料汤中倒入鱼露。
pho-bo.en: Fish sauce is poured into gently simmering broth with beef bones, brisket and spices.

pho-bo.zh: 用夹子从微沸的牛骨汤中捞出整块牛腩。
pho-bo.en: Tongs lift a whole piece of brisket from gently simmering beef bone broth.

pho-bo.zh: 将牛骨汤倒过滤网，滤出骨头和香料。
pho-bo.en: Beef broth is poured through a strainer to catch the bones and spices.

pho-bo.zh: 用筷子从沸水中夹起烫软的河粉。
pho-bo.en: Chopsticks lift softened rice noodles from boiling water.

pho-bo.zh: 将热汤浇入牛肉河粉碗，旁边摆着配菜。
pho-bo.en: Hot broth is ladled over beef rice noodles beside a plate of garnishes.

pho-ga.zh: 手剥去烤洋葱的焦皮，旁边放着烤姜和整粒芫荽籽。
pho-ga.en: A hand peels charred skin from a roasted onion beside ginger and whole coriander seeds.

pho-ga.zh: 鸡翅在沸水中翻滚，手正撇去聚起的灰白浮沫。
pho-ga.en: Chicken wings boil vigorously as a hand skims the gathered grayish foam.

pho-ga.zh: 鸡肉和香料在汤中微沸，手将温度探针插入鸡胸。
pho-ga.en: Chicken and aromatics simmer while a hand inserts a temperature probe into the breast.

pho-ga.zh: 手将鸡骨放回微沸的汤锅，骨架周围的软组织已松散。
pho-ga.en: A hand returns a chicken bone to gently simmering broth around a loosened carcass.

pho-ga.zh: 手将鸡汤倒过滤网，旁边是冷水泡洋葱和鸡肉片。
pho-ga.en: A hand strains chicken broth beside sliced chicken and onions soaking in cold water.

pho-ga.zh: 手用漏勺从沸水中捞起柔软河粉，旁边放着豆芽。
pho-ga.en: A hand lifts soft flat rice noodles from boiling water beside a bowl of bean sprouts.

pho-ga.zh: 手将鸡汤浇入鸡肉河粉，旁边配豆芽、薄荷、辣椒和青柠。
pho-ga.en: A hand ladles broth over chicken pho with bean sprouts, mint, chili and lime alongside.

pi-dan-dou-fu.zh: 用刀切皮蛋，案板上摆着切好的皮蛋瓣。
pi-dan-dou-fu.en: A knife cuts a century egg beside the prepared wedges.

pi-dan-dou-fu.zh: 将皮蛋瓣摆在豆腐块四周。
pi-dan-dou-fu.en: A hand arranges century egg wedges around blocks of tofu.

pi-dan-dou-fu.zh: 用勺子搅拌碗中的酱醋料汁和油。
pi-dan-dou-fu.en: A spoon stirs the soy-vinegar dressing and oil in a bowl.

pi-dan-dou-fu.zh: 用勺子将料汁淋在豆腐和皮蛋上。
pi-dan-dou-fu.en: A spoon drizzles dressing over tofu and century eggs.

pi-dan-dou-fu.zh: 在淋汁的皮蛋豆腐上撒花生碎、葱花和香菜。
pi-dan-dou-fu.en: A hand sprinkles peanuts, scallions and cilantro over the dressed tofu and century eggs.

pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.zh: 往电饭锅里的米和水中倒入姜丝。
pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.en: Ginger matchsticks are tipped into rice and water in a rice cooker.

pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.zh: 用手拌匀肉丝，旁边摆着切好的配料。
pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.en: Hands mix pork strips beside the prepared ingredients.

pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.zh: 舀起煮好的粥，米粒和粥水连在一起。
pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.en: A spoon lifts cooked congee with rice and liquid flowing together.

pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.zh: 小火轻推粥中分散的熟肉丝。
pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.en: A spoon gently moves separated cooked pork strips through simmering congee.

pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.zh: 小火拌匀粥中的皮蛋、肉丝和生菜。
pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.en: Century egg, pork and softened lettuce are gently stirred into congee over low heat.

pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.zh: 将皮蛋瘦肉粥舀入碗中。
pi-dan-shou-rou-zhou.en: Finished century egg and pork congee is ladled into a bowl.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 用漏勺撇去鸭块和姜片焯水时浮起的沫。
pi-jiu-ya.en: A skimmer removes foam from duck and ginger simmering in water.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 锅铲摊开鸭块，鸭皮微黄，锅底积起鸭油。
pi-jiu-ya.en: A spatula spreads the duck as its skin turns golden and fat collects in the wok.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 鸭块拨在一边，锅铲在红油中翻炒豆瓣酱和冰糖。
pi-jiu-ya.en: Duck rests to one side while a spatula fries bean paste and rock sugar in red oil.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 向鸭块、蒜瓣和香料中倒入酱油。
pi-jiu-ya.en: Soy sauce is poured over duck, garlic and whole spices.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 向鸭块和香料中倒入啤酒，液面接近鸭肉顶部。
pi-jiu-ya.en: Beer is poured over duck and aromatics until the liquid nearly covers them.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 夹起一块鸭肉，用叉子检查是否软透。
pi-jiu-ya.en: A piece of duck is held with tongs and checked for tenderness with a fork.

pi-jiu-ya.zh: 锅铲轻翻鸭块，酱汁挂在肉上，锅底留有少量汁水。
pi-jiu-ya.en: A spatula turns duck coated in sauce, with a little liquid remaining in the wok.

piadina.zh: 手在碗中抓拌面粉和液体，面团仍有干碎屑。
piadina.en: A hand mixes flour and liquids in a bowl, leaving a few dry crumbs.

piadina.zh: 双手轻轻拉开光滑面团的一小片。
piadina.en: Hands gently stretch a small section of smooth dough.

piadina.zh: 双手将面团擀成薄圆饼，其余面团盖在布下。
piadina.en: Hands roll dough into a thin round while the remaining portions rest under a cloth.

piadina.zh: 手用锅铲翻动铸铁锅里的薄饼，表面有零星斑点。
piadina.en: A hand flips a lightly spotted flatbread in a cast iron skillet.

piadina.zh: 手用叉子扎破锅中薄饼鼓起的大泡。
piadina.en: A hand pierces a large bubble in the spotted flatbread with a fork.

piadina.zh: 双手在红边盘中将带焦斑的薄饼切成块。
piadina.en: Hands cut spotted flatbread into wedges on a red-rimmed plate.

pizza-margherita.zh: 用木勺把碗里的面粉拌成柔软面团。
pizza-margherita.en: A hand mixes flour into a soft dough with a wooden spoon.

pizza-margherita.zh: 揭开盖布，碗里的面团已经膨起。
pizza-margherita.en: A hand lifts the cloth to reveal risen dough in a bowl.

pizza-margherita.zh: 番茄条和鲜奶酪条分别在筛中沥水。
pizza-margherita.en: Tomato strips and fresh mozzarella strips drain in separate strainers.

pizza-margherita.zh: 双手将烤石放进尚未加热的烤箱。
pizza-margherita.en: Two hands place a baking stone in an unheated oven.

pizza-margherita.zh: 双手向外按开生面饼，留出较厚的边缘。
pizza-margherita.en: Two hands press raw dough outward, leaving a thicker rim.

pizza-margherita.zh: 在披萨铲上的番茄、奶酪和罗勒生饼上淋油。
pizza-margherita.en: A hand drizzles oil over the tomato, mozzarella and basil on a raw pizza on a peel.

pizza-margherita.zh: 双手用披萨铲托起烤至金黄的玛格丽特披萨。
pizza-margherita.en: Two hands hold a peel carrying a golden baked Margherita pizza.

pla-neung-manao.zh: 手将拍裂的香茅塞入划好刀的鱼腹。
pla-neung-manao.en: Hands tuck bruised lemongrass into the cavity of a scored fish.

pla-neung-manao.zh: 蒸锅水沸腾，手用叉子检查鱼肉是否能分片。
pla-neung-manao.en: A hand checks whether the fish flakes in the steaming pot of boiling water.

pla-neung-manao.zh: 手在碗中搅拌蒜末、辣椒和青柠汁。
pla-neung-manao.en: Hands stir minced garlic and chili into the lime sauce in a bowl.

pla-neung-manao.zh: 手用夹子取出鱼腹中的香茅，蒸鱼汁另放。
pla-neung-manao.en: A hand removes lemongrass from the cooked fish, with steaming juices in a separate bowl.

pla-neung-manao.zh: 手将香菜青柠蒜汁浇在鱼身和划口上。
pla-neung-manao.en: A hand pours cilantro lime garlic sauce over the fish and its cuts.

pla-rad-prik.zh: 用厨房纸按干划过刀的鱼，旁边放着辣椒蒜泥。
pla-rad-prik.en: A hand pats the scored fish dry beside a mortar of chili and garlic paste.

pla-rad-prik.zh: 锅中搅炒辣椒蒜泥，棕榈糖开始融化。
pla-rad-prik.en: A hand stirs chili and garlic paste as palm sugar begins to melt.

pla-rad-prik.zh: 勺上挂着薄糖浆般的辣椒酱，锅底是小火。
pla-rad-prik.en: Thin syrupy chili sauce coats a spoon above the saucepan on low heat.

pla-rad-prik.zh: 整鱼在深锅中炸至下侧金黄，油面冒泡。
pla-rad-prik.en: A whole fish fries in bubbling oil until golden underneath.

pla-rad-prik.zh: 双铲托着金黄的炸鱼，在网架上沥油。
pla-rad-prik.en: Two spatulas support the golden fried fish over a wire rack to drain.

pla-rad-prik.zh: 手将辣椒香菜酱浇在炸鱼上，旁边配白米饭。
pla-rad-prik.en: A hand spoons chili and cilantro sauce over fried fish beside a bowl of rice.

polenta.zh: 往深锅里的沸水中撒盐，水面离锅沿有余量。
polenta.en: Salt is sprinkled into boiling water in a deep pot with room below the rim.

polenta.zh: 一手细撒玉米粗粉，另一手用打蛋器搅动沸水。
polenta.en: One hand sprinkles cornmeal into boiling water while the other whisks.

polenta.zh: 小火慢煮浓稠玉米粥，用木勺沿锅边翻搅。
polenta.en: A wooden spoon folds thick, gently bubbling polenta over low heat.

polenta.zh: 往小火煮着的浓稠玉米粥里倒入少量沸水。
polenta.en: A little boiling water is poured into thick polenta over low heat.

polenta.zh: 木勺划过软稠的玉米粥，留下短暂的沟。
polenta.en: A wooden spoon leaves a groove in the soft, thick polenta.

polenta.zh: 将热玉米粥舀入浅盘，旁边配一碗带汁炖肉。
polenta.en: Hot polenta is ladled onto a shallow plate beside a bowl of saucy braised meat.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手在案板上的八块生鸡肉上撒盐和黑胡椒。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand seasons eight raw chicken pieces on a cutting board with salt and black pepper.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手用木勺翻炒软化、边缘浅金黄的洋葱和蒜。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand stirs softened onions with pale golden edges and garlic with a wooden spoon.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手用夹子翻动分开煎至金褐色的鸡块。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand turns separated chicken pieces browned to golden with tongs.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手用木勺刮起鸡块、洋葱和酒液下的锅底焦香。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand scrapes browned bits from the pot beneath chicken, onions and wine.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手掀起锅盖，鸡块在番茄洋葱酱中小火微炖。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand lifts the lid over chicken gently simmering in tomato and onion sauce.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手将温度探针插入番茄酱中鸡块的厚处。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the thick part of a chicken piece in tomato sauce.

pollo-alla-cacciatora.zh: 手用木勺划过浓稠的番茄洋葱酱，锅底露出一道痕。
pollo-alla-cacciatora.en: A hand draws a wooden spoon through thick tomato and onion sauce, leaving a trail across the pot bottom.

polpette-al-sugo.zh: 用叉子将小锅里的牛奶面包压成糊。
polpette-al-sugo.en: Mash the milk-soaked bread in a small saucepan with a fork.

polpette-al-sugo.zh: 用木勺轻轻拌匀牛肉末和配料。
polpette-al-sugo.en: Gently mix the ground beef and seasonings with a wooden spoon.

polpette-al-sugo.zh: 用手将生肉丸薄薄裹上面包糠。
polpette-al-sugo.en: Roll a raw meatball in a thin coating of breadcrumbs.

polpette-al-sugo.zh: 用铲子翻动油中煎出棕色薄壳的肉丸。
polpette-al-sugo.en: Turn a meatball with a browned crust in shallow oil.

polpette-al-sugo.zh: 用温度计测量浓番茄汁中肉丸的中心。
polpette-al-sugo.en: Check the center of a meatball in thick tomato sauce with a thermometer.

polpettone.zh: 手持木铲翻炒锅中熟蘑菇、红葱头和蒜。
polpettone.en: A hand stirs cooked mushrooms, shallot and garlic in a pan.

polpettone.zh: 双手在大碗里拌合肉末、蘑菇、鸡蛋和调料。
polpettone.en: Hands mix ground meat, mushrooms, egg and seasonings in a large bowl.

polpettone.zh: 双手在烤模中的生肉卷上铺培根片。
polpettone.en: Hands lay bacon strips over a raw meatloaf in a loaf pan.

polpettone.zh: 手将温度探针插入表面上色的培根肉卷中心。
polpettone.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the center of the browned bacon-wrapped meatloaf.

polpettone.zh: 双手将盘中烤好的培根肉卷切片。
polpettone.en: Hands slice the baked bacon-wrapped meatloaf on a platter.

ponzu.zh: 小锅中的味醂在小火上轻轻冒泡。
ponzu.en: Mirin bubbles gently in a small saucepan over low heat.

ponzu.zh: 手将酱油倒入装有昆布和柴鱼的玻璃罐。
ponzu.en: A hand pours soy sauce into a glass jar containing kombu and bonito flakes.

ponzu.zh: 双手轻摇玻璃罐，昆布和柴鱼浸在汁中。
ponzu.en: Two hands gently shake a jar with kombu and bonito flakes submerged in the liquid.

ponzu.zh: 昆布和柴鱼留在细筛中，深褐色的汁滴入容器。
ponzu.en: Kombu and bonito flakes rest in a fine sieve as deep brown liquid drips into a container.

ponzu.zh: 手将柚子醋从玻璃罐倒入小碟，旁边放着豆腐和柚子。
ponzu.en: A hand pours ponzu from a glass jar into a small dish beside tofu and yuzu.

pot-au-feu.zh: 往装有扎好的牛肩、短肋和骨髓骨的锅里倒冷水。
pot-au-feu.en: Cold water is poured into a pot containing tied beef chuck, short ribs and marrow bone.

pot-au-feu.zh: 用勺撇去牛肉汤表面的灰色浮沫。
pot-au-feu.en: A spoon skims gray scum from the surface of the beef broth.

pot-au-feu.zh: 牛肉和骨头在留缝盖锅的小火中微沸。
pot-au-feu.en: Beef and bones gently simmer over low heat with the lid ajar.

pot-au-feu.zh: 把香料束放入盛有牛肉和蔬菜的汤锅。
pot-au-feu.en: A herb bundle is lowered into a pot of beef and vegetables.

pot-au-feu.zh: 用叉子检查汤锅里的牛肉是否软到能沿纤维分开。
pot-au-feu.en: A fork tests whether the beef in the simmering pot separates along its fibers.

pot-au-feu.zh: 向盘中的牛肉和蔬菜浇清汤，旁边另盛一碗汤。
pot-au-feu.en: Broth is ladled over plated beef and vegetables beside a separate bowl of soup.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 用夹子将鸡块皮朝下放入融化的黄油中。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Using tongs, place chicken skin-side down in melted butter.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 用夹子将煎至金黄的鸡块盛出。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Use tongs to transfer golden-brown chicken pieces to a plate.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 用木铲小火翻炒红葱头末至软透。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Stir the minced shallots over low heat until soft.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 用木铲刮起锅底沉积，醋汁收至少量。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Scrape the browned bits from the pan as the vinegar reduces to a small amount.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 将温度计插入奶油汁中鸡块的厚肉处。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Insert a thermometer into the thickest part of a chicken piece simmering in cream sauce.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 舀起收浓的红葱头奶油汁，鸡块在旁保温。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Lift a spoonful of reduced shallot cream sauce while the chicken rests covered nearby.

poulet-au-vinaigre.zh: 将醋汁浇在鸡块上，盘中撒有欧芹。
poulet-au-vinaigre.en: Spoon vinegar sauce over the chicken, garnished with parsley.

poulet-basquaise.zh: 双手切番茄，案板上摆着洋葱、甜椒、蒜末和火腿条。
poulet-basquaise.en: Hands cut tomatoes beside prepared onion, peppers, garlic and ham.

poulet-basquaise.zh: 用夹子翻动鸡块，鸡皮煎至金棕色。
poulet-basquaise.en: Tongs turn chicken pieces with golden-brown skin in the pan.

poulet-basquaise.zh: 锅中翻炒软洋葱、红青椒、蒜末和火腿条。
poulet-basquaise.en: A spoon stirs softened onion, red and green peppers, garlic and ham.

poulet-basquaise.zh: 锅中倒入白葡萄酒，木勺刮动番茄蔬菜酱汁。
poulet-basquaise.en: White wine is poured into the tomato and vegetable mixture as a spoon scrapes the pan.

poulet-basquaise.zh: 小火下用木勺将煎好的鸡块压入番茄甜椒酱汁。
poulet-basquaise.en: A wooden spoon presses browned chicken into tomato and pepper sauce over low heat.

poulet-basquaise.zh: 从浓稠的巴斯克炖鸡中夹出月桂叶。
poulet-basquaise.en: Tongs lift a bay leaf from the thick sauce of the finished Basque chicken.

poulet-roti.zh: 手将黄油抹在撒盐、绑腿的生鸡上。
poulet-roti.en: A hand rubs butter over a salted raw chicken with tied legs.

poulet-roti.zh: 手将胡萝卜片放在烤盘中的生鸡周围。
poulet-roti.en: A hand arranges carrot slices around a raw chicken in a roasting pan.

poulet-roti.zh: 手用勺将黄油混合油淋在浅金色的鸡身上。
poulet-roti.en: A hand spoons butter and oil over a lightly golden chicken.

poulet-roti.zh: 手用勺将油脂淋在金黄的烤鸡上。
poulet-roti.en: A hand spoons fat over a golden roast chicken.

poulet-roti.zh: 手将温度探针插入烤鸡腿根的厚肉。
poulet-roti.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the thick meat at the base of a roasted chicken leg.

poulet-roti.zh: 手倒入鸡汤，并用木勺刮起锅底的褐色肉汁渣。
poulet-roti.en: Hands pour in chicken stock and scrape browned drippings from the pan with a wooden spoon.

profiteroles.zh: 手提起小锅，锅里的黄油水正沸腾。
profiteroles.en: A hand lifts a saucepan of boiling butter and water.

profiteroles.zh: 手用木勺压拌锅中成团、离壁的面团。
profiteroles.en: A hand presses the cohesive dough away from the pan with a wooden spoon.

profiteroles.zh: 手抬起刮刀，光亮面糊垂成宽厚倒三角。
profiteroles.en: A hand lifts a spatula with glossy batter hanging in a thick inverted triangle.

profiteroles.zh: 手指蘸水压平烤盘上生面糊团的尖顶。
profiteroles.en: A wet fingertip flattens the peak of a raw pastry mound on a baking tray.

profiteroles.zh: 手切开金黄泡芙壳，露出干燥空腔。
profiteroles.en: Hands cut open a golden choux shell to reveal its dry hollow interior.

profiteroles.zh: 手提起勺子，巧克力酱薄薄挂在勺上。
profiteroles.en: A hand lifts a spoon coated with chocolate sauce above the saucepan.

profiteroles.zh: 手将巧克力酱淋在夹冰淇淋的泡芙上。
profiteroles.en: A hand pours chocolate sauce over ice cream-filled choux puffs.

puree-de-pommes-de-terre.zh: 手持勺子向沸水中的土豆块加盐。
puree-de-pommes-de-terre.en: A hand adds salt to potato chunks boiling in a saucepan.

puree-de-pommes-de-terre.zh: 手用刀尖检查土豆块，土豆中心裂开。
puree-de-pommes-de-terre.en: A hand tests a potato chunk with a knife, splitting its soft center.

puree-de-pommes-de-terre.zh: 双手用压泥器将热土豆压入干锅。
puree-de-pommes-de-terre.en: Hands press hot potatoes through a ricer into a dry saucepan.

puree-de-pommes-de-terre.zh: 手用木勺翻拌锅中的土豆泥，水汽升起。
puree-de-pommes-de-terre.en: A hand folds the mashed potatoes with a wooden spoon as steam rises.

puree-de-pommes-de-terre.zh: 手将少量牛奶倒入土豆泥，旁边放着黄油块。
puree-de-pommes-de-terre.en: A hand pours a little milk into mashed potatoes beside a bowl of butter cubes.

puree-de-pommes-de-terre.zh: 手用木勺将柔软的土豆泥盛入红边盘中。
puree-de-pommes-de-terre.en: A hand spoons soft mashed potatoes onto a red-rimmed plate.

purin.zh: 壶中的水沸腾，六只模具摆在一旁。
purin.en: Water boils in a kettle beside six molds.

purin.zh: 手轻转小锅，锅中的焦糖呈深琥珀色。
purin.en: A hand swirls a saucepan of deep amber caramel.

purin.zh: 手将焦糖倒入模具，其他模具底部已有薄层焦糖。
purin.en: A hand pours caramel into a mold beside five lined molds.

purin.zh: 手将牛奶缓缓倒入蛋液，同时轻轻搅拌。
purin.en: Hands slowly pour milk into the egg mixture while stirring gently.

purin.zh: 手向烤盘倒热水，六只模具中的蛋奶液没有溅水。
purin.en: A hand pours hot water around six custard-filled molds in a baking pan.

purin.zh: 烤箱内的模具浸在水浴中，手轻碰模具查看凝固状态。
purin.en: A hand nudges a mold in the oven water bath to check the custard.

purin.zh: 六只布丁模具放在网架上，手正给其中一只盖盖。
purin.en: A hand covers one of six custard molds on a cooling rack.

purin.zh: 手提起模具，焦糖布丁脱模落在盘上。
purin.en: A hand lifts the mold from a caramel custard on a plate.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 案板上切泡发的木耳，旁边是黄花菜短段。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Cut rehydrated wood ear mushrooms on a board beside short pieces of daylily.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 锅中翻炒肉片和姜末，肥肉出油，瘦肉变色。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Stir-fry pork slices and minced ginger until the fat renders and the lean meat changes color.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 小火翻炒肉片，撒入辣椒面，锅中油汁变红。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Stir the pork over low heat while adding chili flakes to the red oil.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 用锅铲翻起表面凝固的薄蛋皮。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Lift the edge of the set thin egg sheet with a spatula.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 将豆腐、木耳和黄花菜倒入胡萝卜土豆丁中。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Add tofu, wood ear mushrooms, and daylily to the diced carrots and potatoes.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 向小火煨着的酸汤中撒入蛋皮和韭菜。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Scatter egg sheet pieces and chives into the gently simmering sour soup.

qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.zh: 用勺将红汤和配菜浇在碗中的细面上。
qi-shan-sao-zi-mian.en: Ladle red broth and toppings over thin noodles in a bowl.

qian-long-bai-cai.zh: 用厨房纸吸去白菜嫩叶上的水珠。
qian-long-bai-cai.en: A hand blots water from tender napa cabbage leaves with kitchen paper.

qian-long-bai-cai.zh: 双手将白菜嫩叶撕成片放入宽盆。
qian-long-bai-cai.en: Hands tear tender napa cabbage leaves into pieces over a wide bowl.

qian-long-bai-cai.zh: 一边向麻酱倒醋，一边用勺搅匀。
qian-long-bai-cai.en: A hand pours vinegar into sesame paste while another stirs it.

qian-long-bai-cai.zh: 提起勺子，顺滑麻酱汁连续落回碗中。
qian-long-bai-cai.en: Smooth sesame dressing flows continuously from a raised spoon into the bowl.

qian-long-bai-cai.zh: 用两把勺子从盆底向上翻拌裹酱的白菜。
qian-long-bai-cai.en: Two spoons gently lift and fold dressed cabbage leaves from the bottom of the bowl.

qian-long-bai-cai.zh: 在装盘的麻酱白菜上撒熟白芝麻。
qian-long-bai-cai.en: A hand sprinkles toasted white sesame seeds over plated cabbage with sesame dressing.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 双手查看腊肠包装，冰箱里放着另一根腊肠。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Hands inspect a sausage package beside another sausage in the refrigerator.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 双手纵向切开娃娃菜，案板上摆着切好的菜瓣。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Hands cut baby napa cabbage lengthwise beside prepared wedges.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 小锅里的水正在沸腾，锅底燃着火。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Water boils in a small saucepan over a flame.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 筷子翻动完全浸在冒泡热水里的整根腊肠。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Chopsticks turn a whole sausage fully submerged in bubbling water.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 双手将温度计从整根腊肠末端插入。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Hands insert a thermometer into the end of a whole sausage.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 筷子将娃娃菜压入汤中，与整根腊肠一起煮。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Chopsticks press baby napa cabbage beneath the broth alongside a whole sausage.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 双手将腊肠切片，盘中摆着沥好的娃娃菜。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Hands slice sausage beside a plate of drained baby napa cabbage.

qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 筷子夹起一片腊肠和一口娃娃菜。
qian-shi-la-chang-wa-wa-cai.en: Chopsticks lift a slice of sausage and a bite of baby napa cabbage.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 手在砧板上切猪肉条，旁边备好蔬菜和蒜。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: Hands slice pork into strips on a board beside prepared vegetables and garlic.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 手把土豆切成小块，旁边摆着茄子和青椒块。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: Hands cut potato into small pieces beside cut eggplant and green chili.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 铲子拨散锅中的肉丝和青椒，肉丝表面开始变色。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: A spatula separates pork strips and green chili as the pork begins to change color.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 铲子从锅底翻起土豆、茄子、肉丝和青椒。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: A spatula lifts potato, eggplant, pork strips, and green chili from the bottom of the wok.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 手将酱油倒入盛有土豆、茄子、肉丝和青椒的锅中。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: A hand pours soy sauce into a wok of potato, eggplant, pork, and green chili.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 盖着锅盖的土豆、茄子、肉丝和青椒在汤中轻沸。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: Potato, eggplant, pork, and green chili simmer gently in broth under a lid.

qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.zh: 手把裹着浓汁的茄子、土豆和肉丝盛入碗中。
qie-zi-dun-tu-dou.en: Hands transfer sauced eggplant, potato, and pork into a serving bowl.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 双手将去皮茄子切成薄片，旁边放着熟腊肉片。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: Hands slice peeled eggplant beside sliced cooked cured pork.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 一手倒水，一手提起勺子，稠面糊缓缓流回盆中。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: One hand pours water while the other lifts a spoon, letting thick batter slowly flow into the bowl.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 用勺拌匀盆中的茄片、熟腊肉和面糊。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: A spoon mixes eggplant slices and cooked cured pork into the batter.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 用勺将茄子腊肉面糊分块放入小火油锅。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: A spoon places separate portions of eggplant and pork batter into a lightly oiled pan over low heat.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 用锅铲翻起边缘定形的煎饼，露出金黄底面。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: A spatula flips a pancake with set edges to reveal its golden underside.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 小火继续煎金黄的饼，切面露出茄子和腊肉。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: Golden pancakes continue cooking over low heat, with eggplant and cured pork visible in a cut piece.

qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.zh: 用锅铲将金黄的茄子肉煎饼盛入红边盘。
qie-zi-rou-jian-bing.en: A spatula transfers golden eggplant and pork pancakes onto a red-rimmed plate.

qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.zh: 双手在水流下清洗芹菜，嫩叶单独放在碗中。
qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.en: Hands rinse a celery stalk under running water, with tender leaves set aside in a bowl.

qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.zh: 双手将芹菜细条切成段，茎和叶分开放置。
qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.en: Hands cut thin celery strips into short lengths, with stems and leaves kept apart.

qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.zh: 用筷子拨散沸水中翠绿的芹菜茎。
qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.en: Chopsticks separate bright green celery stems in boiling water.

qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.zh: 手从筛中抓起沥干的芹菜茎叶，检查水分。
qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.en: A hand lifts drained celery stems and leaves from a strainer to check for dripping water.

qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.zh: 用筷子轻拌盆中的芹菜，旁边放着三种调味料。
qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.en: Chopsticks gently toss celery in a bowl beside three seasonings.

qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.zh: 用勺将拌好的芹菜和茶树菇盛入盘中。
qin-cai-ban-cha-shu-gu.en: A spoon transfers mixed celery and tea tree mushrooms onto a plate.

qing-chao-hua-cai.zh: 切薄花菜粗茎，旁边摆着花菜小朵和蒜片。
qing-chao-hua-cai.en: A cook thinly slices cauliflower stem beside florets and sliced garlic.

qing-chao-hua-cai.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞出完整的花菜小朵。
qing-chao-hua-cai.en: A cook lifts intact cauliflower florets from boiling water with a slotted spoon.

qing-chao-hua-cai.zh: 轻晃漏盆，沥干花菜小朵和茎片。
qing-chao-hua-cai.en: A cook gently shakes a colander to drain cauliflower florets and stem slices.

qing-chao-hua-cai.zh: 用锅铲翻炒花菜和蒜片，锅下燃着火。
qing-chao-hua-cai.en: A cook tosses cauliflower and garlic slices in a wok over a flame.

qing-chao-hua-cai.zh: 沿锅边倒入清水，锅中是花菜和蒜片。
qing-chao-hua-cai.en: A cook pours water down the side of a wok containing cauliflower and garlic.

qing-chao-hua-cai.zh: 将收干水分的花菜和蒜片从锅中盛入盘里。
qing-chao-hua-cai.en: A cook transfers drained cauliflower and garlic from the wok onto a plate.

qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.zh: 用刀略斩五花肉，肥瘦肉粒清晰可见。
qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.en: A cleaver chops pork belly into distinct lean and fatty pieces.

qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.zh: 用筷子搅拌肉馅，肉粒黏合成柔软的一团。
qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.en: Chopsticks stir the chopped pork into a soft, sticky mixture.

qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.zh: 将清鸡汤倒入铺有白菜和葱姜的锅中。
qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.en: Clear chicken stock is poured into a pot lined with cabbage, scallion and ginger.

qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.zh: 用大勺将生肉圆托入白菜清汤中。
qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.en: A large spoon lowers a raw meatball into clear broth with cabbage.

qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.zh: 白菜盖住肉圆，锅里的清汤在小火上微微冒泡。
qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.en: Cabbage covers the meatballs as clear broth gently bubbles over low heat.

qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.zh: 将清汤浇入盛有肉圆和白菜的深碗。
qing-dun-shi-zi-tou.en: Clear broth is ladled into a deep bowl containing a meatball and cabbage.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手用筷子搅拌葱姜肉馅，肉馅黏成团。
qing-jiao-niang.en: Hands stir sticky ground pork with scallion and ginger using chopsticks.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手从完整青椒的开口取出籽和白筋。
qing-jiao-niang.en: Hands remove seeds and white pith through the opening of a whole green pepper.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手用勺从青椒开口填入肉馅，馅与开口齐平。
qing-jiao-niang.en: A hand spoons pork filling into a green pepper, level with its opening.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手把老抽倒入酱汁碗，淀粉浆另放一旁。
qing-jiao-niang.en: A hand pours dark soy sauce into the sauce while starch slurry sits separately.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手用夹子翻煎青椒，椒皮起皱并有褐斑。
qing-jiao-niang.en: A hand turns stuffed peppers with tongs as their skins wrinkle and brown.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手将温度探针插入锅中最粗青椒的肉馅。
qing-jiao-niang.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the filling of the thickest pepper in the pan.

qing-jiao-niang.zh: 手用夹子将裹着亮汁的青椒酿夹到盘中。
qing-jiao-niang.en: A hand transfers glossy stuffed peppers from the pan to a plate with tongs.

qing-jiao-rou-si.zh: 双手将里脊薄片切成均匀细丝。
qing-jiao-rou-si.en: Hands cut stacked pork tenderloin slices into even thin strips.

qing-jiao-rou-si.zh: 双手用筷子顺一个方向搅拌湿润的肉丝。
qing-jiao-rou-si.en: Hands stir moist pork strips in one direction with chopsticks.

qing-jiao-rou-si.zh: 双手将去籽青椒切成细丝，旁边备有蒜末和生抽。
qing-jiao-rou-si.en: Hands slice deseeded green pepper into thin strips beside minced garlic and soy sauce.

qing-jiao-rou-si.zh: 锅铲在中火油锅中拨散表面转白的肉丝。
qing-jiao-rou-si.en: A spatula separates pork strips whose surfaces have turned white in oil over medium heat.

qing-jiao-rou-si.zh: 双手在火上翻炒鲜绿的青椒丝和蒜末。
qing-jiao-rou-si.en: Hands stir-fry bright green pepper strips and minced garlic over the flame.

qing-jiao-rou-si.zh: 双手将炒好的青椒肉丝从锅中盛入白盘。
qing-jiao-rou-si.en: Hands tip the cooked pork and green pepper strips from the wok onto a white plate.

qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.zh: 双手切土豆薄片，旁边备好青椒、五花肉、葱姜蒜和水淀粉。
qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.en: Hands slice potato beside prepared pepper, pork belly, aromatics and starch slurry.

qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.zh: 锅中五花肉析出油脂，手正倒入酱油。
qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.en: A hand pours soy sauce over pork belly with rendered fat in the wok.

qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.zh: 用铲子铺开锅中的土豆片，旁边是肉片和葱姜蒜。
qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.en: A spatula spreads potato slices in the wok with pork and aromatics.

qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.zh: 用铲子压开带浅金色焦斑的土豆片。
qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.en: A spatula cuts through a potato slice with light golden sear marks.

qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.zh: 用铲子翻炒鲜绿青椒、土豆片和熟五花肉。
qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.en: A spatula stirs bright green pepper, potato slices and cooked pork belly.

qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.zh: 双手将薄汁裹着的青椒土豆炒肉盛入盘中。
qing-jiao-tu-dou-chao-rou.en: Hands serve glossy pepper, potato and pork belly onto a plate.

qing-zheng-nan-gua.zh: 手用勺子挖去带皮南瓜里的瓤和籽。
qing-zheng-nan-gua.en: Hands scoop the pulp and seeds from a skin-on pumpkin wedge.

qing-zheng-nan-gua.zh: 手将南瓜切成均匀厚片，薄边角另放。
qing-zheng-nan-gua.en: Hands cut the pumpkin into even thick slices, with thin trimmings set aside.

qing-zheng-nan-gua.zh: 蒸锅在大火上冒出蒸汽，沸水低于蒸架。
qing-zheng-nan-gua.en: Steam rises from a steamer over high heat, with boiling water below the rack.

qing-zheng-nan-gua.zh: 手将单层摆放南瓜片的盘子放入冒汽的蒸锅。
qing-zheng-nan-gua.en: Hands lower a plate of pumpkin slices in a single layer into the steaming pot.

qing-zheng-nan-gua.zh: 手用筷子检查蒸锅中最厚南瓜片的中心。
qing-zheng-nan-gua.en: A hand checks the center of the thickest pumpkin slice with a chopstick in the steamer.

qing-zheng-nan-gua.zh: 戴隔热手套的手从蒸锅中取出一盘南瓜。
qing-zheng-nan-gua.en: An oven-mitted hand lifts a plate of pumpkin from the steamer.

qing-zheng-sheng-hao.zh: 在流水下用刷子刷洗蚝壳，旁边的蚝在沥水。
qing-zheng-sheng-hao.en: Hands scrub an oyster shell under running water while other oysters drain.

qing-zheng-sheng-hao.zh: 将整只生蚝间隔摆入冒汽的蒸屉。
qing-zheng-sheng-hao.en: A hand spaces whole oysters in a steaming basket over boiling water.

qing-zheng-sheng-hao.zh: 蒸锅中带壳生蚝张开，蒸汽升起。
qing-zheng-sheng-hao.en: Whole oyster shells open in a steaming pot as steam rises.

qing-zheng-sheng-hao.zh: 戴隔热手套固定下壳，取去上壳，留下蚝肉和汁。
qing-zheng-sheng-hao.en: An insulated mitt steadies the bottom shell while a hand removes the top, leaving the oyster and its liquor.

qing-zheng-sheng-hao.zh: 往蒸屉里的蚝肉上撒蒜末和姜丝。
qing-zheng-sheng-hao.en: A hand sprinkles minced garlic over oysters topped with thin ginger strips in a steamer.

qing-zheng-sheng-hao.zh: 将葱花撒在装盘的蒜姜生蚝上。
qing-zheng-sheng-hao.en: A hand scatters chopped scallions over plated oysters with garlic and ginger.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 双手将黄油和面粉搓成带黄油片的粗砂。
quiche-lorraine.en: Hands rub butter into flour until coarse crumbs with small flakes remain.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 双手将面皮轻贴在派模底部和侧壁。
quiche-lorraine.en: Hands gently press pastry against the bottom and sides of a tart pan.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 手提起烘焙纸和重石，露出干燥的派底。
quiche-lorraine.en: A hand lifts parchment and baking weights to reveal the dry tart base.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 手用木勺翻动微微上色的柔软培根短条。
quiche-lorraine.en: A hand stirs lightly browned, soft bacon lardons with a wooden spoon.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 手将蛋奶液倒入铺有培根和黄油丁的派壳。
quiche-lorraine.en: A hand pours custard into a tart shell with bacon and butter cubes.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 手将温度探针插入已凝固的咸派中心。
quiche-lorraine.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the center of the set quiche.

quiche-lorraine.zh: 手用派铲盛起一块咸派，旁边放着沙拉。
quiche-lorraine.en: A hand serves a slice of quiche beside a bowl of salad.

rad-na.zh: 手抓匀裹着蛋清淀粉的猪肉片，旁边放着辣椒醋。
rad-na.en: A hand mixes pork slices coated in egg white and starch beside a bowl of chili vinegar.

rad-na.zh: 双手轻轻分开拌了黑酱油的宽河粉。
rad-na.en: Hands gently separate wide rice noodles coated with dark soy sauce.

rad-na.zh: 锅铲翻起河粉，露出煎出的褐色斑点。
rad-na.en: A spatula lifts wide rice noodles to reveal browned sear marks.

rad-na.zh: 高汤倒入锅中，蒜末和黄豆酱在汤里翻滚。
rad-na.en: Stock is poured into a wok of bubbling broth with minced garlic and fermented soybean paste.

rad-na.zh: 勺子轻推汤中的熟猪肉片和芥兰。
rad-na.en: A spoon gently moves cooked pork slices and gai lan in the broth.

rad-na.zh: 勺上的透亮芡汁流回锅中，锅里有猪肉和芥兰。
rad-na.en: Glossy gravy flows from a spoon back into the wok with pork and gai lan.

rad-na.zh: 猪肉、芥兰和芡汁浇在河粉上，辣椒醋另放。
rad-na.en: Pork, gai lan and gravy are poured over rice noodles with chili vinegar on the side.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺翻炒五花肉末，锅底释出金黄油脂。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon stirs minced pork belly in a pool of rendered fat and olive oil.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 小火翻炒五花肉末和切细的洋葱、胡萝卜、西芹。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon stirs pork with finely diced onion, carrot and celery over low heat.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺翻炒牛肉和蔬菜，肉粒已变褐色。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon stirs browned ground beef and vegetables in the pot.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 往炒褐的肉末和蔬菜中倒入白葡萄酒。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: White wine is poured into the browned meat and vegetables.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 往番茄肉酱里倒入高汤，锅盖放在旁边。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: Stock is poured into the tomato and meat mixture, with the lid nearby.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 往小火炖煮的肉酱里倒入牛奶。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: Milk is poured into the meat sauce simmering over low heat.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺将浓稠肉酱和煮熟的宽面拌在一起。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon tosses cooked broad pasta ribbons with thick meat sauce.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 小火锅中有大块肉和洋葱，手正倒入红酒。
ragu-napoletano.en: A hand pours red wine over large pieces of meat and onion in a pot over low heat.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 手翻动上色的肉，锅中洋葱已煨成金黄色软糊。
ragu-napoletano.en: A hand turns browned meat over softened golden onion in the pot.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 手在火上翻拌肉块与深红色番茄酱。
ragu-napoletano.en: A hand stirs meat into deep red tomato sauce over the flame.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 锅盖半掩，肉在红酱中以小火轻轻冒泡。
ragu-napoletano.en: Meat gently bubbles in red sauce over a low flame beneath a partly covered lid.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 手用叉子轻扭肉块，肉纤维分开。
ragu-napoletano.en: A hand twists a fork in a piece of meat, separating its fibers.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 手舀起浓稠红酱，锅旁放着一小碗盐。
ragu-napoletano.en: A hand lifts a spoonful of thick red sauce beside a small bowl of salt.

ragu-napoletano.zh: 肉和酱分开盛放，手向酱上撒奶酪。
ragu-napoletano.en: Meat and sauce are served separately as a hand sprinkles cheese over the sauce.

ratatouille.zh: 用厨房纸吸干茄子和西葫芦片。
ratatouille.en: A hand pats eggplant and zucchini slices dry with kitchen paper.

ratatouille.zh: 将去皮去籽的番茄果肉切成条。
ratatouille.en: A hand cuts peeled, deseeded tomato flesh into strips.

ratatouille.zh: 锅中单层煎茄子片，用铲子翻面。
ratatouille.en: A hand turns eggplant slices frying in a single layer.

ratatouille.zh: 小火搅拌收浓的番茄、洋葱和青椒。
ratatouille.en: A hand stirs reduced tomato, onion, and green pepper over low heat.

ratatouille.zh: 在番茄混合物上铺茄子和西葫芦片。
ratatouille.en: A hand layers eggplant and zucchini over the tomato mixture.

ratatouille.zh: 倾斜锅身，把浓汁舀回软熟的蔬菜上。
ratatouille.en: A hand tilts the pan and spoons thick sauce over the tender vegetables.

rau-muong-xao-toi.zh: 双手掰断空心菜嫩梗，案板上摆着菜段和蒜片。
rau-muong-xao-toi.en: Hands snap a tender water spinach stem beside cut greens and garlic slices.

rau-muong-xao-toi.zh: 大火烧着深锅，锅里的水持续翻滚。
rau-muong-xao-toi.en: Water boils vigorously in a deep pot over high heat.

rau-muong-xao-toi.zh: 手从滤篮中提起沥干的空心菜，菜叶柔软且不再滴水。
rau-muong-xao-toi.en: A hand lifts drained water spinach with softened leaves from a colander, with no water dripping.

rau-muong-xao-toi.zh: 锅铲翻动油中的蒜片，蒜片边缘刚泛浅黄。
rau-muong-xao-toi.en: A spatula stirs garlic slices in oil until their edges are pale golden.

rau-muong-xao-toi.zh: 锅铲在炒锅里抖散空心菜和蒜片。
rau-muong-xao-toi.en: A spatula spreads water spinach and garlic slices across the wok.

rau-muong-xao-toi.zh: 手将油亮的蒜炒空心菜盛入红边白盘。
rau-muong-xao-toi.en: A hand serves glossy garlic water spinach onto a white plate with a red rim.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 双手揉搓表面较光滑的黄色面团，案板上撒着少许面粉。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: Hands knead smooth yellow dough on a lightly floured board.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 双手将煮软的菠菜挤干，旁边放着沥干的乳清奶酪。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: Hands squeeze wilted spinach dry beside a bowl of drained ricotta.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 用勺搅拌菠菜奶酪馅，馅料稠厚，能在勺中成团。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: A spoon mixes thick spinach and cheese filling that holds together.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 面片从压面机伸出，薄得透出手影，旁边的面团盖着布。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: A thin pasta sheet passes through a roller, showing the shadow of a hand, beside covered dough.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 双手从馅团旁向外按压面片，排出空气并压紧接缝。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: Hands press outward around filling mounds to expel air and seal the pasta.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 饺子在微沸的水中煮着，一只饺子被漏勺捞起。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: Ravioli simmer gently in water as one is lifted with a slotted spoon.

ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.zh: 手将鼠尾草放在黄油拌好的方饺上，一只饺子露出菠菜奶酪馅。
ravioli-ricotta-spinaci.en: A hand places sage on butter-coated ravioli, one cut open to reveal spinach and ricotta.

re-gan-mian.zh: 手正在切酸豆角，旁边备有萝卜干丁、葱花和蒜水。
re-gan-mian.en: A hand dices pickled long beans beside diced radish, scallions, and garlic water.

re-gan-mian.zh: 锅铲拨散锅中炒熟、收干的猪肉末。
re-gan-mian.en: A spatula breaks up cooked, dry ground pork in a pan.

re-gan-mian.zh: 一边向芝麻酱中倒少量水，一边搅拌浓稠的酱。
re-gan-mian.en: Hands add a little water and stir the thick sesame paste.

re-gan-mian.zh: 勺子提起拌匀的芝麻酱，浓酱连续流回碗中。
re-gan-mian.en: A spoon lifts the smooth sesame sauce, which falls back in a thick ribbon.

re-gan-mian.zh: 筷子在沸水锅中拨散黄色面条。
re-gan-mian.en: Chopsticks loosen yellow noodles in a pot of boiling water.

re-gan-mian.zh: 筷子挑拌裹酱的面条，碗中有肉末、腌菜和葱花。
re-gan-mian.en: Chopsticks toss sauce-coated noodles with pork, pickles, and scallions.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 手切碎蒜，旁边摆着切好的配菜和泡发木耳。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: Hands mince garlic beside sliced vegetables, ham and soaked wood ear mushrooms.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 手将日本豆腐切成圆片，用锅铲从底部托起。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: Hands slice egg tofu into rounds and support one from below with a spatula.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 手在平盘中给豆腐圆片轻裹生粉。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: A hand lightly coats egg tofu rounds with starch on a plate.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 锅中豆腐周围起泡，锅铲翻起金黄的一片。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: Oil bubbles around tofu rounds as a spatula turns a golden piece.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 锅铲翻炒胡萝卜、青椒、木耳、火腿和洋葱。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: A spatula stirs carrots, green pepper, wood ear mushrooms, ham and onion.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 手将深色酱汁倒入盛有炒熟配菜的锅中。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: A hand pours dark sauce into a wok of cooked vegetables and ham.

ri-ben-dou-fu.zh: 锅铲从底部托起裹汁豆腐，旁边放着装好的菜。
ri-ben-dou-fu.en: A spatula lifts sauced tofu from below beside a plate of the finished dish.

ribollita.zh: 用叉子压碎煮软的白芸豆，锅里留着豆汤。
ribollita.en: A fork crushes a tender white bean above a pot of beans and their broth.

ribollita.zh: 用木勺翻拌锅中炒软的叶菜、土豆和其他蔬菜。
ribollita.en: A wooden spoon folds wilted greens, potatoes and other vegetables in the pot.

ribollita.zh: 将豆泥和豆汤倒入盛有蔬菜的锅中。
ribollita.en: Bean purée and broth are poured into the pot of vegetables.

ribollita.zh: 将整粒白芸豆倒入小火煮着的蔬菜豆汤。
ribollita.en: Whole white beans are added to the vegetable and bean soup over low heat.

ribollita.zh: 用勺将蔬菜豆汤浇在浅容器中的面包片上。
ribollita.en: Vegetable and bean soup is ladled over bread slices in a shallow dish.

ribollita.zh: 往碗里的面包蔬菜豆汤上淋橄榄油。
ribollita.en: Olive oil is drizzled over a bowl of bread, vegetable and bean soup.

ricotta.zh: 手持温度计测锅中牛奶，刮刀靠在锅底。
ricotta.en: A hand checks the milk with a thermometer while a spatula rests in the pot.

ricotta.zh: 手将柠檬汁倒入锅中，白色凝乳与乳清分开。
ricotta.en: A hand pours lemon juice into the pot as white curds separate from the whey.

ricotta.zh: 关火后，大块白色凝乳浮在黄绿色乳清上。
ricotta.en: With the heat off, large white curds float in yellow-green whey.

ricotta.zh: 手用漏勺将凝乳舀入架在碗上的纱布筛网。
ricotta.en: A hand spoons curds into a cheesecloth-lined sieve set over a bowl.

ricotta.zh: 手用勺舀起碗中湿软的乳清奶酪，旁边放着柠檬。
ricotta.en: A hand lifts soft ricotta from a bowl with a spoon, beside a lemon wedge.

risi-e-bisi.zh: 双手拉去豌豆荚的筋，案板上放着豆粒和嫩荚。
risi-e-bisi.en: Hands pull the string from a pea pod beside shelled peas and tender pods.

risi-e-bisi.zh: 双手沥干豌豆和嫩荚，旁边的高汤正在加热。
risi-e-bisi.en: Hands drain peas and tender pods while stock warms nearby.

risi-e-bisi.zh: 用勺翻拌黄油中的豌豆、嫩荚和浅金色洋葱。
risi-e-bisi.en: A spoon stirs peas, tender pods and pale golden onion in butter.

risi-e-bisi.zh: 豌豆和嫩荚在高汤中温和沸煮，锅盖放在一旁。
risi-e-bisi.en: Peas and tender pods simmer gently in stock with the lid nearby.

risi-e-bisi.zh: 用勺搅动锅中的米、豌豆和流动的浓汤。
risi-e-bisi.en: A spoon stirs rice and peas in flowing thick broth.

risi-e-bisi.zh: 用勺将带有欧芹的豌豆饭和浓汤盛入浅盘。
risi-e-bisi.en: A ladle serves soupy rice and peas with parsley into a shallow bowl.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 双手将泡软的牛肝菌切成小块，旁边放着泡菌水。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: Hands chop softened porcini into small pieces beside a bowl of soaking liquid.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 双手将泡菌水倒入铺纸的细筛，旁边的高汤微沸。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: Hands pour mushroom soaking liquid through a paper-lined sieve as stock simmers nearby.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 手持木勺翻炒米粒和洋葱，锅中米粒裹油发亮。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: A hand stirs rice and onion in a pan until the grains glisten with oil.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 手用木勺搅动微沸的米饭，勺子划过处露出锅底。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: A hand stirs gently simmering rice, briefly revealing the bottom of the pan.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 手将牛肝菌块和菌汁倒入锅中的米饭。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: A hand pours porcini pieces and mushroom liquid into the rice.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 手舀起一勺米饭准备试吃，锅中米粒裹着浓汁和菌菇。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: A hand lifts a spoonful to taste while the rice and mushrooms sit in a thick sauce.

risotto-ai-funghi.zh: 双手将蘑菇烩饭从锅中盛到白色盘子里。
risotto-ai-funghi.en: Hands spoon mushroom risotto from the pan onto a white plate.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 用木勺翻炒油脂中软透微黄的洋葱末。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Stir softened, lightly golden minced onion in melted fat.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 用木勺翻炒裹油发亮的米粒和洋葱末。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Stir glossy, fat-coated rice grains with minced onion.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 往米和洋葱中倒入白葡萄酒并轻轻翻动。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Pour white wine into the rice and onion while stirring gently.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 用木勺轻推高汤中微沸的米粒，旁边备着热汤。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Gently push simmering rice through stock with a wooden spoon, with hot stock ready nearby.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 将浸泡藏红花的金色汤汁倒入微沸的米饭。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Pour golden saffron-infused stock into the simmering rice.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 离火将黄油和奶酪拌入金黄色烩饭。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Stir butter and cheese into golden risotto off the heat.

rou-bing-dun-dan.zh: 用筷子搅拌湿润的猪肉馅，碗边摆着调料。
rou-bing-dun-dan.en: Chopsticks mix moist ground pork in a bowl, with seasonings alongside.

rou-bing-dun-dan.zh: 用勺背在铺平的生肉馅中央压出浅窝。
rou-bing-dun-dan.en: The back of a spoon presses a shallow well into the flattened raw pork.

rou-bing-dun-dan.zh: 将鸡蛋打入肉馅中央的浅窝，蛋黄保持完整。
rou-bing-dun-dan.en: An egg is cracked into the well in the pork, keeping the yolk intact.

rou-bing-dun-dan.zh: 盖好的蒸锅持续冒汽，浅盘架在沸水上方。
rou-bing-dun-dan.en: Steam escapes the covered steamer as the shallow dish sits on a rack above boiling water.

rou-bing-dun-dan.zh: 将温度计探头插入蛋旁的熟肉饼测温。
rou-bing-dun-dan.en: A thermometer probe is inserted into the cooked pork patty beside the egg.

rou-bing-dun-dan.zh: 用勺从边缘舀起熟肉饼，盘底留着鲜汁。
rou-bing-dun-dan.en: A spoon lifts cooked pork from the edge of the patty, with juices remaining in the dish.

rou-dan-gai-fan.zh: 手搅匀碗汁，旁边备着两碗米饭。
rou-dan-gai-fan.en: A hand stirs smooth sauce beside two bowls of rice.

rou-dan-gai-fan.zh: 手用锅铲将猪肉末摊成薄层。
rou-dan-gai-fan.en: A hand spreads ground pork into a thin layer in the pan.

rou-dan-gai-fan.zh: 锅铲翻起肉块，露出浅褐色底面。
rou-dan-gai-fan.en: A spatula turns a piece of pork, exposing its lightly browned underside.

rou-dan-gai-fan.zh: 手揭开锅盖，肉块间四颗蛋的蛋白已凝固。
rou-dan-gai-fan.en: A hand lifts the lid to reveal four eggs with set whites among the pork.

rou-dan-gai-fan.zh: 手将碗汁倒入肉块间，避开四颗蛋黄。
rou-dan-gai-fan.en: A hand pours sauce between the pork pieces, away from the four yolks.

rou-dan-gai-fan.zh: 手向肉蛋盖饭撒葱花，旁边还有一碗。
rou-dan-gai-fan.en: A hand sprinkles scallions onto a bowl of pork and egg rice beside another bowl.

rou-jia-mo.zh: 锅中两块五花肉煮沸，手持勺撇去浮沫。
rou-jia-mo.en: A hand skims scum from two pieces of pork belly boiling in a pot.

rou-jia-mo.zh: 筷子插入香料卤汁中轻煨的整块五花肉。
rou-jia-mo.en: Chopsticks pierce a whole piece of pork belly gently simmering in spiced broth.

rou-jia-mo.zh: 双手掰开发好的面团，露出细小气孔。
rou-jia-mo.en: Two hands pull open risen dough to reveal small air pockets.

rou-jia-mo.zh: 双手将长椭圆面片从短端卷起，旁边的面团盖着布。
rou-jia-mo.en: Two hands roll an oval sheet of dough from its short end beside covered dough portions.

rou-jia-mo.zh: 手持铲子翻动锅中带金黄斑点的面饼。
rou-jia-mo.en: A hand turns a flatbread with golden spots in a pan using a spatula.

rou-jia-mo.zh: 手用勺子把卤肉馅装进剖开的馍，盘中另有一个肉夹馍。
rou-jia-mo.en: A hand spoons braised pork into a split flatbread beside a finished rou jia mo.

rou-mo-qie-zi.zh: 手用小盘把茄块压在水中。
rou-mo-qie-zi.en: A hand presses eggplant pieces beneath water with a small plate.

rou-mo-qie-zi.zh: 手拌匀湿润的猪肉末，旁边摆着切好的配料。
rou-mo-qie-zi.en: Hands mix moist ground pork beside the prepared aromatics.

rou-mo-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲压开锅里已经塌软的茄块。
rou-mo-qie-zi.en: A spatula presses a softened piece of eggplant in the wok.

rou-mo-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲把炒熟的肉末推向锅边，中央留出油。
rou-mo-qie-zi.en: A spatula pushes cooked pork to the edge, leaving oil in the center.

rou-mo-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲在红油中炒豆瓣和姜蒜葱白，肉末留在锅边。
rou-mo-qie-zi.en: A spatula stirs douban and aromatics in red oil beside cooked pork.

rou-mo-qie-zi.zh: 手向锅中油亮的茄子肉末淋入香油。
rou-mo-qie-zi.en: A hand drizzles sesame oil over glossy eggplant and pork in the wok.

rou-xie-bao.zh: 擦干切好的生蟹，旁边备好土豆、洋葱、青红椒和年糕。
rou-xie-bao.en: Pat the raw crab pieces dry beside prepared potatoes, onion, peppers and rice cakes.

rou-xie-bao.zh: 用漏勺捞起薄裹淀粉、炸至外层定形的蟹块。
rou-xie-bao.en: Lift the lightly coated crab pieces from the oil once their exterior has set.

rou-xie-bao.zh: 小火拌匀酱汁、洋葱和香料，冰糖开始溶化。
rou-xie-bao.en: Stir the sauce, onion and aromatics over low heat as the rock sugar begins to dissolve.

rou-xie-bao.zh: 蟹块和土豆在锅中小火炖煮，用筷子试土豆。
rou-xie-bao.en: Test a potato with chopsticks while the crab and potatoes simmer over low heat.

rou-xie-bao.zh: 大火收汁，轻推锅底的蟹块、土豆、年糕和青红椒。
rou-xie-bao.en: Gently push the crab, potatoes, rice cakes and peppers along the pot bottom as the sauce reduces over high heat.

rou-xie-bao.zh: 在酱汁包裹的蟹块、土豆和年糕上撒白胡椒。
rou-xie-bao.en: Sprinkle white pepper over the sauced crab, potatoes and rice cakes.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 双手在青花鱼皮上划浅十字，姜片和姜丝分放。
saba-no-misoni.en: Hands score a shallow cross in mackerel skin beside separate bowls of sliced and shredded ginger.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞起表面发白的鱼，旁边放着冷水。
saba-no-misoni.en: A slotted spoon lifts pale blanched mackerel from boiling water beside a bowl of cold water.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 搅拌沸腾的味噌煮汁，锅中可见姜。
saba-no-misoni.en: A hand stirs bubbling miso broth with ginger in a shallow pan.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 将落盖放在鱼面上，锅边的味噌汁轻轻冒泡。
saba-no-misoni.en: A hand lowers a drop lid onto the fish while miso broth bubbles gently at the edge.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 将调开的味噌倒入鱼锅，旁边放着酱油。
saba-no-misoni.en: A hand pours dissolved miso into the pan of fish beside a dish of soy sauce.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 回热时用勺把微沸的味噌汁浇在鱼块上。
saba-no-misoni.en: A hand spoons gently simmering miso sauce over the fish as it reheats.

saba-no-misoni.zh: 用宽铲将鱼皮朝上的鱼块装盘，盘中有酱汁和姜丝。
saba-no-misoni.en: A wide spatula places a skin-up fish portion on a plate with sauce and shredded ginger.

sake-no-shioyaki.zh: 手把盐撒在浅盘里的两片带皮三文鱼上，盘底有汁水。
sake-no-shioyaki.en: A hand sprinkles salt over two skin-on salmon fillets in a shallow dish with liquid.

sake-no-shioyaki.zh: 手用厨房纸轻轻吸干三文鱼的鱼皮边缘。
sake-no-shioyaki.en: A hand gently blots the edge of salmon skin with a paper towel.

sake-no-shioyaki.zh: 烤箱上发热管烧热，烤架上放着铺铝箔的空烤盘。
sake-no-shioyaki.en: The upper oven element glows above an empty foil-lined tray on the rack.

sake-no-shioyaki.zh: 手用叉子轻拨烤盘里的三文鱼，鱼皮已有褐斑。
sake-no-shioyaki.en: A hand tests the salmon with a fork on the tray, its skin browned in spots.

sake-no-shioyaki.zh: 手把烤三文鱼放上盘，旁边有萝卜泥和柠檬。
sake-no-shioyaki.en: A hand plates broiled salmon beside grated daikon and lemon.

salade-de-lentilles.zh: 扁豆、洋葱和香草在锅中小火微煮。
salade-de-lentilles.en: Lentils, onion and herbs simmer gently in a saucepan.

salade-de-lentilles.zh: 手将胡萝卜丁倒入微沸的扁豆锅中。
salade-de-lentilles.en: A hand adds diced carrot to the gently simmering lentils.

salade-de-lentilles.zh: 一手搅拌芥末醋汁，一手倒入橄榄油。
salade-de-lentilles.en: One hand whisks mustard vinaigrette while the other pours in olive oil.

salade-de-lentilles.zh: 手将西芹丁和醋汁轻轻拌入温热扁豆。
salade-de-lentilles.en: A hand gently folds celery and vinaigrette into warm lentils.

salade-de-lentilles.zh: 手将欧芹碎撒在装盘的扁豆沙拉上。
salade-de-lentilles.en: A hand sprinkles chopped parsley over the plated lentil salad.

salade-lyonnaise.zh: 戴烤箱手套的手取出金黄面包丁，旁边放着菊苣。
salade-lyonnaise.en: An oven-mitted hand removes golden croutons beside a bowl of frisée.

salade-lyonnaise.zh: 手用木铲翻动锅中煎至金黄出油的培根丁。
salade-lyonnaise.en: A hand turns golden bacon cubes in their rendered fat.

salade-lyonnaise.zh: 一手缓缓倒入橄榄油，一手搅拌均匀的油醋汁。
salade-lyonnaise.en: One hand slowly pours olive oil while the other whisks the vinaigrette.

salade-lyonnaise.zh: 手从小碗将鸡蛋滑入小火微沸的水中。
salade-lyonnaise.en: A hand slides an egg from a small bowl into gently simmering water.

salade-lyonnaise.zh: 手用漏勺捞起蛋白凝固的水波蛋，旁边备有厨房纸。
salade-lyonnaise.en: A hand lifts a poached egg with set white on a slotted spoon beside a paper towel.

salade-lyonnaise.zh: 手把水波蛋放在铺有培根丁和面包丁的菊苣沙拉上。
salade-lyonnaise.en: A hand places a poached egg on frisée salad with bacon and croutons.

salade-nicoise.zh: 双手将蛋黄完全凝固的熟鸡蛋切成瓣。
salade-nicoise.en: Hands cut hard-boiled eggs with fully set yolks into wedges.

salade-nicoise.zh: 手在案板上切薄西芹，旁边摆着备好的蔬菜。
salade-nicoise.en: A hand slices celery thinly beside the prepared vegetables.

salade-nicoise.zh: 双手把嫩洋蓟心切成薄片，旁边放着蚕豆。
salade-nicoise.en: Hands thinly slice a tender artichoke heart beside shelled fava beans.

salade-nicoise.zh: 手在铺有生菜的番茄瓣上撒少许盐。
salade-nicoise.en: A hand sprinkles a little salt over tomato wedges on lettuce.

salade-nicoise.zh: 双手将罗勒撕碎，撒在鱼蛋蔬菜上。
salade-nicoise.en: Hands tear basil over the fish, eggs, and vegetables.

salade-nicoise.zh: 手将橄榄油淋在摆好的尼斯沙拉上。
salade-nicoise.en: A hand pours olive oil over the assembled Niçoise salad.

salsa-verde.zh: 双手用刀在案板上将欧芹切成细末。
salsa-verde.en: Hands finely chop parsley on a cutting board.

salsa-verde.zh: 用勺背将凤尾鱼压成糊，旁边放着切碎的酸豆。
salsa-verde.en: A spoon mashes anchovies into a paste beside chopped capers.

salsa-verde.zh: 将柠檬汁倒入欧芹和酸豆等拌成的湿润底料。
salsa-verde.en: Lemon juice is poured into the moist parsley and caper mixture.

salsa-verde.zh: 边倒入橄榄油，边用叉子搅拌绿色底料。
salsa-verde.en: Olive oil is poured into the green mixture as it is stirred with a fork.

salsa-verde.zh: 将一勺青酱汁放在熟鱼上，旁边是盛好的酱汁。
salsa-verde.en: A spoonful of salsa verde is placed on cooked fish beside the serving bowl.

salsiccia-e-fagioli.zh: 用木铲翻煎香肠，锅底有金黄红葱头和褐渣。
salsiccia-e-fagioli.en: A hand turns browned sausage with a wooden spatula over golden shallots and browned bits.

salsiccia-e-fagioli.zh: 往煎过的香肠和冒泡的酒汁中倒入番茄泥。
salsiccia-e-fagioli.en: A hand pours tomato purée into bubbling wine sauce around browned sausages.

salsiccia-e-fagioli.zh: 把白豆倒入小火上的香肠番茄汁中。
salsiccia-e-fagioli.en: A hand pours white beans into sausage and tomato sauce over low heat.

salsiccia-e-fagioli.zh: 用温度计测浓稠番茄白豆汁中香肠的中心。
salsiccia-e-fagioli.en: A hand checks the center of a sausage in thick tomato and white bean sauce with a thermometer.

saltimbocca-alla-romana.zh: 双手隔着烘焙纸轻拍小牛肉。
saltimbocca-alla-romana.en: Hands gently pound veal between sheets of parchment.

saltimbocca-alla-romana.zh: 双手用牙签固定小牛肉上的鼠尾草和生火腿。
saltimbocca-alla-romana.en: Hands secure sage and prosciutto to raw veal with a toothpick.

saltimbocca-alla-romana.zh: 手将小牛肉肉面朝下放入浅黄起泡的黄油中。
saltimbocca-alla-romana.en: A hand places veal meat-side down in lightly foaming yellow butter.

saltimbocca-alla-romana.zh: 手从侧面将探针插入锅中浅金色的小牛肉。
saltimbocca-alla-romana.en: A hand inserts a probe into the side of a lightly golden veal cutlet in the pan.

saltimbocca-alla-romana.zh: 手将煎好的小牛肉平放到盘中。
saltimbocca-alla-romana.en: Hands transfer a cooked veal cutlet to a plate in a single layer.

saltimbocca-alla-romana.zh: 手将黄油肉汁淋在盘中的四片小牛排上。
saltimbocca-alla-romana.en: A hand spoons buttery pan juices over four veal cutlets on a plate.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 双手将生五花肉切片，旁边备有洋葱、蒜和菜叶。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: Hands slice raw pork belly beside prepared onion, garlic and leaves.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 手将包饭酱舀入小碟，生熟肉盘和夹子分开放。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: A hand spoons ssamjang into a dish beside separate raw and cooked meat plates and tongs.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 手用夹子将生五花肉片间隔铺入热油锅中。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: A hand uses tongs to space raw pork belly slices in the hot oiled pan.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 手将温度计插入锅中金褐色五花肉的侧面。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the side of browned pork belly in the pan.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 手在锅中翻动边缘褐色的洋葱和金黄蒜片。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: A hand turns browned onion and golden garlic in the pan.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 手将锅中多余的猪油舀入耐热碗，锅底留薄油。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: A hand ladles excess pork fat into a heatproof bowl, leaving a thin film in the pan.

samgyeopsal-gui.zh: 双手将肉、洋葱、蒜和酱包入生菜与苏子叶。
samgyeopsal-gui.en: Hands fold lettuce and perilla around pork, onion, garlic and sauce.

samgyetang.zh: 手持滤网沥干泡胀的糯米，旁边放着人参和红枣。
