samgyetang.en: A hand drains plump soaked glutinous rice beside ginseng and jujubes.

samgyetang.zh: 手把糯米舀入鸡腹腔，里面放着蒜瓣并留有空隙。
samgyetang.en: A hand spoons rice into a chicken cavity with garlic cloves, leaving room inside.

samgyetang.zh: 水倒入装有绑腿小鸡、人参和香料的深锅。
samgyetang.en: Water is poured into a deep pot with tied chickens, ginseng, and aromatics.

samgyetang.zh: 鸡汤持续沸腾，手用勺子撇去汤面浮沫。
samgyetang.en: A hand skims foam from the steadily boiling chicken soup.

samgyetang.zh: 手将温度计插入锅中鸡肉，汤正加热。
samgyetang.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into a chicken as the soup heats.

samgyetang.zh: 手用筷子拨开鸡腹腔里的软糯米饭。
samgyetang.en: A hand uses chopsticks to part the soft sticky rice inside the chicken.

samgyetang.zh: 手向参鸡汤撒葱绿，碗旁另放盐和黑胡椒。
samgyetang.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over ginseng chicken soup beside dishes of salt and black pepper.

san-bei-ji.zh: 用纸巾擦干带皮鸡块，旁边放着调好的焖汁。
san-bei-ji.en: Pat the skin-on chicken pieces dry with a paper towel beside a bowl of mixed braising sauce.

san-bei-ji.zh: 小火翻煸姜片、蒜和葱白，蒜表面略带金色。
san-bei-ji.en: Stir ginger, garlic and scallion whites over low heat until the garlic is lightly golden.

san-bei-ji.zh: 中火翻煎鸡块，鸡皮微黄，外层肉变白。
san-bei-ji.en: Turn the chicken over medium heat until the skin is lightly yellow and the outside is white.

san-bei-ji.zh: 焖汁在锅边冒泡，用铲子刮起锅底的附着物。
san-bei-ji.en: Scrape the browned bits from the bottom as the braising sauce bubbles around the edge.

san-bei-ji.zh: 盖上锅盖，用小火焖煮鸡块。
san-bei-ji.en: Cover the pot and braise the chicken over low heat.

san-bei-ji.zh: 将亮汁鸡块、姜蒜和葱绿盛入碗中。
san-bei-ji.en: Transfer the glossy chicken, ginger, garlic and green scallions to a bowl.

sanshoku-soboro-don.zh: 锅中乳白色的米粒浸在水里，一只手拿着锅盖。
sanshoku-soboro-don.en: Milky white rice grains soak in water in a pot as a hand holds the lid.

sanshoku-soboro-don.zh: 一只手用饭勺翻松锅里煮熟的米饭。
sanshoku-soboro-don.en: A hand fluffs cooked rice in a pot with a rice paddle.

sanshoku-soboro-don.zh: 一只手用筷子在冷锅里拨散拌有调味液的生鸡肉末。
sanshoku-soboro-don.en: A hand uses chopsticks to separate raw ground chicken mixed with seasonings in a cold pot.

sanshoku-soboro-don.zh: 一只手用筷子在小火上拨散湿润的棕色鸡肉末。
sanshoku-soboro-don.en: A hand uses chopsticks to stir moist brown ground chicken over a low flame.

sanshoku-soboro-don.zh: 一只手用筷子在火上搅散已凝固的黄色蛋粒。
sanshoku-soboro-don.en: A hand uses chopsticks to stir set yellow egg crumbles over a flame.

sanshoku-soboro-don.zh: 一只手把豌豆铺在米饭上，位于鸡肉末和蛋松之间。
sanshoku-soboro-don.en: A hand spoons peas onto rice between ground chicken and scrambled egg.

satay-gai.zh: 手把鸡肉条拌入黄色腌料，旁边泡着竹签。
satay-gai.en: Hands stir chicken strips into a yellow marinade beside soaking bamboo skewers.

satay-gai.zh: 手搅动清澈的糖醋汁，黄瓜、红葱头和辣椒另放一碗。
satay-gai.en: A hand stirs clear sweet-and-sour brine beside a separate bowl of cucumber, shallot and chili.

satay-gai.zh: 手在小火上搅煮浓滑的花生咖喱酱。
satay-gai.en: A hand stirs thick, smooth peanut curry sauce over low heat.

satay-gai.zh: 双手把腌好的鸡肉平摊穿在竹签上。
satay-gai.en: Hands thread marinated chicken flat onto bamboo skewers.

satay-gai.zh: 手用探针测量炭火上带褐斑的鸡串。
satay-gai.en: A hand probes browned chicken skewers on a charcoal grill.

satay-gai.zh: 手把鸡串放上盘，旁边是花生酱和黄瓜配菜。
satay-gai.en: A hand places a chicken skewer on a plate beside peanut sauce and cucumber relish.

saucisses-aux-lentilles.zh: 锅中翻炒微黄出油的培根丁，旁边放着沥干的扁豆。
saucisses-aux-lentilles.en: Bacon cubes turn lightly golden and release fat in the pot, with drained lentils alongside.

saucisses-aux-lentilles.zh: 锅中翻炒培根丁、软洋葱、胡萝卜片和蒜。
saucisses-aux-lentilles.en: Bacon, softened onions, carrot rounds and garlic are stirred in the pot.

saucisses-aux-lentilles.zh: 手把整根香肠放在加了香草和蔬菜的扁豆上。
saucisses-aux-lentilles.en: A hand places a whole sausage on lentils with herbs and vegetables.

saucisses-aux-lentilles.zh: 锅盖留缝，整根香肠和扁豆在小火上微微冒泡。
saucisses-aux-lentilles.en: A whole sausage and lentils simmer gently over low heat under a slightly ajar lid.

saucisses-aux-lentilles.zh: 手在案板上切香肠，旁边锅里是炖好的扁豆和蔬菜。
saucisses-aux-lentilles.en: Hands slice the sausage on a board beside the pot of cooked lentils and vegetables.

saucisses-aux-lentilles.zh: 手将欧芹撒在香肠片、扁豆和蔬菜上。
saucisses-aux-lentilles.en: A hand sprinkles parsley over sliced sausage, lentils and vegetables.

saumon-en-papillote.zh: 手将西葫芦切成薄片，旁边摆着柠檬片和小番茄。
saumon-en-papillote.en: Hands slice zucchini beside lemon slices and halved cherry tomatoes.

saumon-en-papillote.zh: 手在两份烘焙纸上的西葫芦和小番茄上撒盐和黑胡椒。
saumon-en-papillote.en: A hand sprinkles salt and black pepper over zucchini and tomatoes on two sheets of parchment.

saumon-en-papillote.zh: 手用勺向铺有柠檬和百里香的三文鱼上淋橄榄油。
saumon-en-papillote.en: A hand spoons olive oil over salmon topped with lemon and thyme.

saumon-en-papillote.zh: 双手折紧烤盘上纸包的边缘，旁边放着另一个纸包。
saumon-en-papillote.en: Hands fold the edge of a parchment packet closed beside another packet on a baking tray.

saumon-en-papillote.zh: 手用叉子轻压纸包里的熟三文鱼，鱼肉分成片。
saumon-en-papillote.en: A hand presses cooked salmon in its parchment with a fork, separating it into flakes.

scaloppine-al-limone.zh: 用肉锤隔着烘焙纸轻拍小牛肉片。
scaloppine-al-limone.en: A hand gently pounds a veal cutlet between sheets of parchment.

scaloppine-al-limone.zh: 手抖去肉片上多余的面粉，锅中黄油正在起泡。
scaloppine-al-limone.en: A hand shakes excess flour off a cutlet beside a pan of foaming butter.

scaloppine-al-limone.zh: 锅中肉片煎出浅金色斑点，手用铲子翻面。
scaloppine-al-limone.en: A hand turns cutlets with pale golden spots in a frying pan.

scaloppine-al-limone.zh: 用木铲刮起锅底的褐色附着物，锅中汁液正在冒泡。
scaloppine-al-limone.en: A hand scrapes browned bits into the bubbling pan juices.

scaloppine-al-limone.zh: 手晃动锅子，让黄油和细欧芹融入发亮的酱汁。
scaloppine-al-limone.en: A hand swirls the pan as butter and chopped parsley blend into the glossy sauce.

scaloppine-al-limone.zh: 手把锅里的酱汁浇在肉片上，盘边放着柠檬薄片。
scaloppine-al-limone.en: A hand pours pan sauce over the cutlets beside thin lemon slices.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 双手挤干酸菜丝，旁边摆着蒜瓣和干辣椒段。
sha-zhu-cai.en: Hands squeeze shredded pickled cabbage dry beside garlic cloves and dried chili pieces.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 排骨煮开后，用漏勺撇去水面的浮沫。
sha-zhu-cai.en: A slotted spoon skims foam from boiling pork ribs.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 大火翻炒排骨、酸菜丝、蒜瓣和干辣椒。
sha-zhu-cai.en: Pork ribs, shredded pickled cabbage, garlic and dried chilies are tossed over high heat.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 排骨和酸菜放入电压力锅，准备加入香料和葱结。
sha-zhu-cai.en: Bay leaves, star anise and a scallion knot are held above ribs and pickled cabbage in an electric pressure cooker.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 打开压力锅，用筷子拨开骨边的排骨肉。
sha-zhu-cai.en: Chopsticks pull tender rib meat from the bone in an open pressure cooker.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 整段血肠在小火热水中温和加热。
sha-zhu-cai.en: A whole blood sausage warms gently in water over low heat.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 向小火炖煮的排骨酸菜锅中放入血肠厚片。
sha-zhu-cai.en: Thick blood sausage slices are added to gently simmering ribs and pickled cabbage.

sha-zhu-cai.zh: 酸菜排骨血肠盛在深盆中，旁边搅拌蒜辣蘸汁。
sha-zhu-cai.en: A hand stirs garlic chili dipping sauce beside a bowl of ribs, blood sausage and pickled cabbage.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 手切土豆块，旁边摆着豆角、番茄和葱姜蒜。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: Hands dice potato beside prepared beans, tomato, scallion, ginger and garlic.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 手将去籽青椒切成细条，椒蒂和籽放在一旁。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: Hands slice deseeded green chilies into thin strips beside the stems and seeds.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 手在锅中翻炒油里的葱花、姜丝和蒜末。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: A hand stirs scallion, ginger and garlic in oil in a wok.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 手在锅中翻炒鲜绿的豆角段和土豆块。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: A hand stir-fries bright green bean segments and potato cubes in a wok.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 豆角和土豆在沸水中煮着，手用筷子试土豆。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: Beans and potatoes boil while a hand tests a potato with chopsticks.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 手轻推锅底，豆角和土豆在浓稠番茄汁中熬煮。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: A hand gently pushes beans and potatoes through thick tomato sauce in the wok.

shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.zh: 手将带浓汁的豆角和土豆舀入碗中，撒有香菜。
shan-bei-ao-dou-jiao.en: A hand spoons beans and potatoes in thick sauce into a bowl topped with cilantro.

shan-xi-guo-you-rou.zh: 双手切蒜薹，案板上摆着木耳、洋葱和葱姜蒜。
shan-xi-guo-you-rou.en: Hands cut garlic scapes beside prepared wood ear, onion, scallion, ginger and garlic.

shan-xi-guo-you-rou.zh: 双手用筷子拌匀碗中薄薄挂浆的肉片。
shan-xi-guo-you-rou.en: Hands mix thinly coated pork slices with chopsticks in a bowl.

shan-xi-guo-you-rou.zh: 筷子在冒细泡的热油中拨散变色的肉片。
shan-xi-guo-you-rou.en: Chopsticks separate pale pork slices in gently bubbling oil.

shan-xi-guo-you-rou.zh: 锅铲翻炒鲜绿的蒜薹、木耳、洋葱和葱姜蒜。
shan-xi-guo-you-rou.en: A spatula stirs bright garlic scapes, wood ear, onion and aromatics.

shan-xi-guo-you-rou.zh: 往锅中肉片和配菜上淋生抽，翻炒至薄薄裹汁。
shan-xi-guo-you-rou.en: Soy sauce is poured over pork and vegetables as they are stirred in a thin glaze.

shan-xi-guo-you-rou.zh: 双手将肉片、蒜薹、木耳和洋葱从锅中盛入盘中。
shan-xi-guo-you-rou.en: Hands transfer pork, garlic scapes, wood ear and onion from the wok onto a plate.

shan-xi-you-po-mian.zh: 手在案板上切蒜，旁边摆着葱花、小白菜、豆芽和空碗。
shan-xi-you-po-mian.en: Hands mince garlic beside chopped scallion, bok choy, bean sprouts and an empty bowl.

shan-xi-you-po-mian.zh: 手用筷子在沸水锅中拨散宽面。
shan-xi-you-po-mian.en: A hand separates wide noodles with chopsticks in a pot of boiling water.

shan-xi-you-po-mian.zh: 手将小白菜放入煮着浮起宽面的沸水锅中。
shan-xi-you-po-mian.en: A hand adds bok choy to a boiling pot of floating wide noodles.

shan-xi-you-po-mian.zh: 手将辣椒碎撒在碗中宽面、青菜和葱蒜上。
shan-xi-you-po-mian.en: A hand sprinkles chili flakes over wide noodles, greens, scallion and garlic in a bowl.

shan-xi-you-po-mian.zh: 手将少量热油泼在面上的辣椒和葱蒜上，油接触处起泡。
shan-xi-you-po-mian.en: A hand pours a little hot oil onto the chili and aromatics on the noodles, where it bubbles.

shan-xi-you-po-mian.zh: 手用筷子拌匀碗中的宽面、青菜和红油。
shan-xi-you-po-mian.en: Hands toss wide noodles, greens and chili oil together with chopsticks.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 用漏勺撇去鸡块和姜片焯水时的浮沫。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: A hand skims scum from chicken and ginger blanching water.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 戴手套去除红枣核，旁边放着山药块和去壳板栗。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: Gloved hands pit a red date beside yam chunks and peeled chestnuts.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 用叉子将熟南瓜肉压成细泥。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: A hand mashes cooked pumpkin flesh into a smooth purée with a fork.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 鸡块、山药、板栗和姜片在盖锅中小火轻炖。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: Chicken, yam, chestnuts and ginger gently simmer in a covered pot.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 用筷子扎板栗，检查鸡汤里的食材是否软熟。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: Chopsticks pierce a chestnut to check the ingredients in the chicken broth.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 小火轻推金黄的南瓜鸡汤，锅里有山药、板栗和红枣。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: A hand gently stirs golden pumpkin chicken soup with yam, chestnuts and red dates over low heat.

shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.zh: 金黄鸡汤从勺中流下，锅旁放着盐。
shan-yao-nan-gua-dun-ji-tang.en: Golden chicken soup flows from a spoon above the pot, with salt beside it.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 手在碗中抓匀肉丝，旁边备好香菇、青菜和酱汁。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: A hand mixes pork strips in a bowl beside prepared shiitakes, bok choy and sauce.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 粗面在大火滚水中煮，筷子挑起面条。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: Chopsticks lift thick noodles from vigorously boiling water over high heat.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 筷子在漏篮中轻轻拨散沥干的粗面。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: Chopsticks gently separate drained thick noodles in a colander.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 锅铲翻炒散开的肉丝，肉丝表面已变色。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: A spatula stirs separated pork strips with their surfaces cooked pale.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 锅铲翻炒边缘微褐的香菇片和青菜梗。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: A spatula stir-fries lightly browned shiitake slices and bok choy stems.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 筷子和锅铲在锅中挑拌棕色面条、香菇和菜梗。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: Chopsticks and a spatula toss brown noodles with shiitakes and bok choy stems.

shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.zh: 手用锅铲将肉丝、香菇和青菜炒面盛入盘中。
shang-hai-cu-chao-mian.en: Hands use a spatula to transfer noodles with pork, shiitakes and bok choy onto a plate.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 用刀纵剖娃娃菜的厚菜帮，旁边摆着切好的配料。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: A knife splits the thick stem of a baby napa cabbage wedge, with prepared ingredients nearby.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 用刀切去金针菇紧实的根部，旁边放着分好的小束。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: A knife cuts the compact root from enoki mushrooms beside separated bundles.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 用漏勺捞出焯过的娃娃菜，锅里的水仍在沸腾。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: A slotted spoon lifts blanched baby napa cabbage from boiling water.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 小火翻炒葱姜蒜，蒜片边缘刚刚变金黄。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: Scallion, ginger and garlic are stirred over low heat until the garlic edges turn pale gold.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 用筷子把娃娃菜排入汤中，锅里有午餐肉和金针菇。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: Chopsticks arrange baby napa cabbage in broth with luncheon meat and enoki.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 用筷子翻动轻滚汤中的娃娃菜，旁边有午餐肉和金针菇。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: Chopsticks turn baby napa cabbage in gently simmering broth with luncheon meat and enoki.

shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.zh: 将热汤浇在铺有皮蛋丁和配料的娃娃菜上。
shang-tang-wa-wa-cai.en: Hot broth is ladled over plated baby napa cabbage topped with century egg and other ingredients.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 双手过滤葱姜花椒水，旁边放着泡软的配菜。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: Hands strain scallion, ginger and Sichuan pepper water beside the soaked ingredients.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 双手用筷子朝一个方向搅拌猪肉馅。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: Hands stir minced pork in one direction with chopsticks.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 手用勺舀起一团黏稠的肉馅，旁边放着蛋清、淀粉、油和香料水。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: A hand lifts a cohesive spoonful of meat mixture beside egg white, starch, oil and infused water.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 手将煮熟的粉丝、木耳和黄花菜从汤锅中捞出。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: A hand lifts cooked glass noodles, wood ears and daylily buds from the broth.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 手挤出肉馅，用勺拨向锅边冒小泡的汤中。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: Hands squeeze out meat mixture and guide it with a spoon toward gently bubbling broth.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 手将温度计探针插入浮起的丸子中心，锅边摆着配菜碗。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into a floating meatball beside a bowl of cooked accompaniments.

sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.zh: 手向丸子、粉丝和配菜汤上撒葱花，旁边放着香油。
sheng-cuan-wan-zi-tang.en: A hand scatters scallions over meatball soup with noodles and vegetables, beside sesame oil.

sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.zh: 案板上正斜切鱼片，旁边备有米、姜丝、葱绿和香菜。
sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.en: Fish is being sliced diagonally beside prepared rice, ginger, scallion greens and cilantro.

sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.zh: 双手轻拌鱼片，鱼片表面裹着薄浆。
sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.en: Hands gently mix fish slices coated in a thin marinade.

sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.zh: 揭开锅盖查看小火煮至开花的米粒。
sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.en: A lid is lifted to check rice grains swollen and blossoming over low heat.

sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.zh: 小火下用打蛋器轻搅绵滑的白粥。
sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.en: A whisk gently stirs smooth rice congee over low heat.

sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.zh: 用勺轻推微滚粥中已变白的鱼片和姜丝。
sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.en: A spoon gently moves opaque fish slices and ginger through simmering congee.

sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.zh: 往鱼片粥上撒葱绿和香菜。
sheng-gun-yu-pian-zhou.en: Scallion greens and cilantro are sprinkled over a bowl of fish congee.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 手将猪皮细条放进装有猪颈骨的小锅。
sheng-jian-bao.en: A hand adds thin strips of pork skin to a saucepan of pork neck bones.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 猪皮、姜和葱在半盖的小锅中小火慢熬。
sheng-jian-bao.en: Pork skin, ginger and scallion simmer gently in a partly covered saucepan.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 手将盛有猪皮汤的浅容器放入冷水浴。
sheng-jian-bao.en: A hand places a shallow container of pork stock in a cold water bath.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 手将皮冻丁轻拌进黏稠的猪肉馅。
sheng-jian-bao.en: Hands gently fold diced pork aspic into sticky pork filling.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 双手在案板上揉压柔软光滑的面团。
sheng-jian-bao.en: Hands knead soft, smooth dough on a board.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 双手捏合包子收口，馅碗放在冰水上。
sheng-jian-bao.en: Hands pinch a bun closed beside a filling bowl set over ice water.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 包子在锅中煎至底边浅金黄，周围冒着油泡。
sheng-jian-bao.en: Buns fry until their lower edges are pale gold with oil bubbling around them.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 手沿锅边倒入热水，锅盖放在一旁。
sheng-jian-bao.en: A hand pours hot water along the edge of the pan, with the lid nearby.

sheng-jian-bao.zh: 手用宽铲将撒有芝麻和葱花的生煎包盛出。
sheng-jian-bao.en: A hand lifts a sesame and scallion topped pan-fried bun with a wide spatula.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 双手在盆中揉成团的面，盆壁基本干净。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: Hands knead a cohesive dough in a nearly clean bowl.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 双手揉光滑的面团，旁边的面团盖着布。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: Hands knead smooth dough beside a covered portion.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 用筷子沿一个方向搅拌葱姜猪肉馅。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: Chopsticks stir pork filling with scallion and ginger in one direction.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 将切碎的韭菜拌入盆中成团的猪肉馅。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: Chopped chives are mixed into cohesive pork filling in a bowl.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 双手在撒粉的案板上擀圆饺子皮。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: Hands roll a round dumpling wrapper on a floured board.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 双手捏紧饺子边缘，包好的饺子分开放。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: Hands pinch a dumpling closed beside spaced uncooked dumplings.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 小火下用勺轻推锅中温和翻滚的饺子。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: A spoon gently moves dumplings in softly boiling water over low heat.

shou-gong-shui-jiao.zh: 探针插入捞起的饺子馅心，旁边放着饺子和醋。
shou-gong-shui-jiao.en: A probe enters the filling of a lifted dumpling beside a plate of dumplings and vinegar.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 手持菜刀切土豆薄片，旁边分放蒜苗白段和绿叶段。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: Hands slice a potato thinly beside separate piles of white and green garlic sprout sections.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 手用筷子轻拌碗中均匀挂浆的肉片。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: Hands gently mix evenly coated pork slices in a bowl with chopsticks.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 沸水锅中土豆片散开，漏勺捞起一片弯曲的土豆。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: A slotted spoon lifts a flexible potato slice from boiling water.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 手将土豆片摊在滤篮中沥水。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: A hand spreads potato slices in a draining basket.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 手用锅铲翻动炒锅中摊开的变色肉片。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: A hand turns separated, browned pork slices in a wok.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 手往土豆片、肉片和蒜苗中倒生抽并轻翻。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: Hands pour soy sauce into potato, pork and garlic sprouts while gently turning them.

shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.zh: 手将炒好的土豆片、肉片和蒜苗盛入盘中。
shou-rou-tu-dou-pian.en: Hands transfer cooked potato, pork and garlic sprouts from the wok to a plate.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 双手将包菜叶的粗叶脉撕细，案板上放着菜叶和硬芯。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: Hands tear a thick cabbage rib into narrower pieces, with leaves and the core on the board.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 双手晃动沥篮，甩去包菜叶上的水。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: Hands shake a colander to drain water from the cabbage leaves.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 双手将五花肉切成薄片，旁边摆着切好的配料和调味料。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: Hands slice pork belly thinly beside prepared aromatics and seasonings.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 大火翻炒包菜，一只手向锅里撒盐。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: Cabbage is stir-fried over high heat while a hand sprinkles in salt.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 大火翻炒五花肉片，肥肉渗出的油留在锅底。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: Pork belly slices are stir-fried over high heat as fat renders into the wok.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 锅中翻炒五花肉、姜、蒜、辣椒和蒜苗。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: Pork belly, ginger, garlic, chilies and garlic shoots are tossed in the wok.

shou-si-bao-cai.zh: 一只手倾斜锅，把炒好的包菜和五花肉倒入盘中。
shou-si-bao-cai.en: A hand tips the wok to plate the cooked cabbage and pork belly.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 一手倒开水，一手用筷子将面粉拌成絮状。
shou-zhua-bing.en: One hand pours boiling water while the other stirs flour into shaggy clumps with chopsticks.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 双手将面团擀成长薄片，另外两份盖在布下。
shou-zhua-bing.en: Hands roll dough into a thin long sheet while the other two portions rest under a cloth.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 双手将抹油撒盐的面片从长边卷起。
shou-zhua-bing.en: Hands roll an oiled and salted dough sheet from its long edge.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 双手从中间向外轻擀盘好的面团。
shou-zhua-bing.en: Hands gently roll the coiled dough outward from the center.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 小火上用铲子掀起鼓起的饼，查看金黄的底面。
shou-zhua-bing.en: A spatula lifts the puffing pancake over a small flame to reveal its golden underside.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 两把铲子从两侧轻推金黄的饼，露出薄层。
shou-zhua-bing.en: Two spatulas push the golden pancake inward from both sides, exposing its thin layers.

shou-zhua-bing.zh: 双手将蛋皮、生菜、火腿和芝士松松卷入饼中。
shou-zhua-bing.en: Hands loosely roll egg, lettuce, ham and cheese inside the flaky pancake.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 撇去猪骨汤表面的灰褐色浮沫，捆好的五花肉放在旁边。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand skims gray-brown foam from pork bone broth, with tied pork belly beside the pot.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 捞去沸腾的猪骨和五花肉汤表面的浮沫。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand skims foam from the boiling pork bone and pork belly broth.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 搅拌酱油汁，锅边冒出小泡。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand stirs the soy seasoning sauce as small bubbles form around the pan.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 向猪骨、五花肉和韭葱绿叶的沸汤中倒入鸡油。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand pours chicken fat into boiling broth with pork bones, pork belly and green leek leaves.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 用勺把酱油汁浇在小火轻煨的深褐色五花肉上。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand ladles soy sauce over deep brown pork belly simmering gently.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 在案板上把去线的叉烧切成薄片。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand slices the untied braised pork belly thinly on a cutting board.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 将猪骨汤倒过细筛，滤出骨头和香料。
shoyu-ramen.en: Hands pour pork bone broth through a fine sieve to remove bones and aromatics.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 把热汤舀进盛有酱油调味汁和韭葱白末的碗。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand ladles hot broth into a bowl containing soy seasoning and chopped white leek.

shoyu-ramen.zh: 把叉烧摆在拉面上，碗里配有葱、笋干和海苔。
shoyu-ramen.en: A hand places pork belly on ramen topped with scallions, bamboo shoots and nori.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 小火搅热牛奶，锅边细泡成圈并冒出蒸汽。
shuang-pi-nai.en: A hand stirs milk over low heat as small bubbles ring the pan and steam rises.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 三碗牛奶静置，表面形成完整微皱的奶皮。
shuang-pi-nai.en: Three bowls of milk rest with intact, slightly wrinkled skins.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 从奶皮边缘的小口将牛奶倒入大碗。
shuang-pi-nai.en: Milk pours through a small opening beside the skin into a large bowl.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 用筷子轻搅牛奶、蛋清和糖，混合液平滑无泡。
shuang-pi-nai.en: Chopsticks gently stir milk, egg whites and sugar into a smooth mixture.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 沿碗边将奶蛋液倒回，托起奶皮。
shuang-pi-nai.en: The milk and egg mixture is poured along the bowl edge, lifting the skin.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 三只盖碟的小碗放在蒸架上，水微沸生汽。
shuang-pi-nai.en: Three saucer-covered bowls sit on a rack above gently simmering water.

shuang-pi-nai.zh: 用勺舀起表面有薄皮的嫩滑奶羹。
shuang-pi-nai.en: A spoon lifts a soft, set portion of milk custard beneath its thin skin.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 双手在流水下冲洗生菜叶，旁边的菜叶正在沥水。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: Hands rinse a lettuce leaf under running water beside draining leaves.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 浅锅中的清水持续沸腾，水面冒出气泡。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: Water boils steadily in a shallow pot, with bubbles breaking the surface.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 一只手用勺向冒泡的调味水中倒入少量油。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: A hand pours a little oil from a spoon into bubbling seasoned water.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 一只手用夹子翻动锅中的生菜，让上层叶片碰到热水。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: A hand turns lettuce with tongs so the upper leaves touch the hot water.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 锅盖盖紧，蒸汽从边缘逸出，锅底有火。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: Steam escapes around the lid of a covered pot over a flame.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 揭盖后，一只手用夹子翻看锅中塌软的生菜。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: After uncovering the pot, a hand turns the softened lettuce with tongs.

shui-you-men-shu-cai.zh: 一只手用夹子将生菜和少量焖汁盛到红边盘中。
shui-you-men-shu-cai.en: A hand uses tongs to transfer lettuce and a little cooking liquid to a red-rimmed plate.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 案板上切牛肉薄片，姜蒜、辣椒和香菜分别备好。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: Beef is sliced on a board beside prepared ginger, garlic, chili and cilantro.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 用筷子轻拌裹浆的牛肉片和姜丝。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: Chopsticks gently mix coated beef slices with ginger.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 小火翻炒豆瓣、姜丝和蒜片，锅中油已泛红。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: Doubanjiang, ginger and garlic are stirred over low heat until the oil turns red.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 沥干的豆芽从漏勺铺入宽碗。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: Drained bean sprouts are tipped from a strainer into a wide bowl.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 筷子在微沸的红汤中轻轻分开熟牛肉片。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: Chopsticks gently separate cooked beef slices in simmering red broth.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 牛肉和豆芽上撒入香料粉，旁边有辣椒圈和香菜梗。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: Spices are sprinkled over beef and sprouts alongside chili rings and cilantro stems.

shui-zhu-niu-rou.zh: 热油细流淋在牛肉表面的香料上，油起小泡。
shui-zhu-niu-rou.en: A thin stream of hot oil bubbles as it hits the spices on the beef.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 用筷子顺一个方向拌匀上浆的里脊薄片。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Stir coated pork slices in one direction with chopsticks.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 案板上剁碎泡椒，旁边摆着切好的配菜和调料。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Chop pickled chilies beside the prepared vegetables and aromatics.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 小火翻炒干辣椒和青花椒，辣椒颜色稍深。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Stir-fry dried chilies and green Sichuan peppercorns over low heat until the chilies darken slightly.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 锅中翻炒豆芽、芹菜和叶菜，并撒入盐。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Stir-fry bean sprouts, celery and greens while sprinkling in salt.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 小火翻炒姜蒜末、泡椒和豆瓣，锅中炒出红油。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Stir-fry minced ginger, garlic, pickled chilies and doubanjiang over low heat until red oil appears.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 用筷子把上浆肉片逐片放入微沸的红汤。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Lower coated pork slices one at a time into gently simmering red broth.

shui-zhu-rou-pian.zh: 用勺将热油淋在肉片上的辣椒、蒜末和葱花上。
shui-zhu-rou-pian.en: Pour hot oil over the chilies, minced garlic and scallions on the pork.

shui-zhu-yu.zh: 双手用斜刀将巴沙鱼柳切成薄片。
shui-zhu-yu.en: Hands slice a basa fillet diagonally into thin pieces.

shui-zhu-yu.zh: 用勺轻拌鱼片，使表面均匀挂上豆瓣调料。
shui-zhu-yu.en: A spoon gently folds fish slices in a doubanjiang marinade.

shui-zhu-yu.zh: 锅中翻炒塌软的生菜，旁边碗里放着花菜。
shui-zhu-yu.en: Wilted lettuce is stirred in a pan beside a bowl of cauliflower.

shui-zhu-yu.zh: 往翻滚的红汤中倒水，锅里可见蒜末和豆豉。
shui-zhu-yu.en: Water is poured into bubbling red broth with minced garlic and fermented black beans.

shui-zhu-yu.zh: 用筷子将鱼片逐片放入轻沸的红汤。
shui-zhu-yu.en: Chopsticks lower a fish slice into gently simmering red broth.

shui-zhu-yu.zh: 将红汤浇到鱼片、花菜和生菜上。
shui-zhu-yu.en: Red broth is poured over fish, cauliflower, and lettuce.

si-xi-kao-fu.zh: 双手掰开泡软的烤麸，旁边分别泡着香菇、木耳和黄花菜。
si-xi-kao-fu.en: Hands pull apart softened wheat gluten beside bowls of soaking shiitakes, wood ear, and daylily buds.

si-xi-kao-fu.zh: 双手将泡好的烤麸切块，旁边摆着处理好的配料。
si-xi-kao-fu.en: Hands cut soaked wheat gluten into cubes beside the prepared ingredients.

si-xi-kao-fu.zh: 手用锅铲轻翻烤麸，姜片周围冒着小泡。
si-xi-kao-fu.en: A hand gently turns wheat gluten with a spatula as small bubbles form around ginger slices.

si-xi-kao-fu.zh: 手向锅中倒入调味汁，烤麸和配料周围冒泡。
si-xi-kao-fu.en: A hand pours sauce into the wok as bubbles form around the wheat gluten and other ingredients.

si-xi-kao-fu.zh: 烤麸和配料盖着锅盖在小火上微沸。
si-xi-kao-fu.en: Wheat gluten and the other ingredients gently simmer under a lid over low heat.

si-xi-kao-fu.zh: 手轻压润泽的烤麸，锅底留着浅浅的酱汁。
si-xi-kao-fu.en: A hand gently presses glossy wheat gluten in a shallow layer of sauce.

sigeumchi-namul.zh: 双手清洗菠菜，旁边备好蒜末、葱花和冷水。
sigeumchi-namul.en: Hands wash spinach beside minced garlic, sliced scallions, and a bowl of cold water.

sigeumchi-namul.zh: 大火煮沸的锅中，勺子将菠菜压入水里。
sigeumchi-namul.en: A spoon presses spinach into vigorously boiling water over high heat.

sigeumchi-namul.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞出鲜绿、柔软的菠菜。
sigeumchi-namul.en: A slotted spoon lifts bright green, wilted spinach from boiling water.

sigeumchi-namul.zh: 冷却后的菠菜在漏篮中沥出零星水滴。
sigeumchi-namul.en: Cooled spinach drains in a colander, releasing a few drops of water.

sigeumchi-namul.zh: 双手用刀将焯好的菠菜切成短段。
sigeumchi-namul.en: Hands use a knife to cut blanched spinach into short lengths.

sigeumchi-namul.zh: 用两把勺子将拌好蒜、葱和芝麻的菠菜盛入碟中。
sigeumchi-namul.en: Two spoons transfer spinach mixed with garlic, scallions, and sesame seeds onto a plate.

sogogi-muguk.zh: 用筷子拌匀腌牛肉，旁边备好萝卜片和葱段。
sogogi-muguk.en: Mix the seasoned beef with chopsticks beside prepared radish slices and scallion pieces.

sogogi-muguk.zh: 用木铲翻炒分散的牛肉片，肉片表面已变色。
sogogi-muguk.en: Stir-fry separated beef slices with a wooden spatula until their surfaces change color.

sogogi-muguk.zh: 用漏勺撇去牛肉清汤表面的浮沫。
sogogi-muguk.en: Skim foam from the surface of the clear beef broth.

sogogi-muguk.zh: 用筷子扎煮至半透明的萝卜片，检查是否软透。
sogogi-muguk.en: Pierce a translucent radish slice with chopsticks to check its tenderness.

sogogi-muguk.zh: 用汤勺将牛肉、萝卜和葱的清汤盛入碗中。
sogogi-muguk.en: Ladle clear soup with beef, radish and scallions into a bowl.

sole-meuniere.zh: 用纸巾吸干鳎鱼腹部和贴骨处的水。
sole-meuniere.en: Blot the sole’s belly and flesh near the bones with a paper towel.

sole-meuniere.zh: 轻拍薄裹面粉的鳎鱼，抖去多余面粉。
sole-meuniere.en: Pat the lightly floured sole to shake off excess flour.

sole-meuniere.zh: 用铲子轻抬锅中的鳎鱼，查看金黄的底面。
sole-meuniere.en: Lift the sole slightly in the pan to check its golden underside.

sole-meuniere.zh: 用宽铲托住金黄的鳎鱼，在小火上翻面。
sole-meuniere.en: Use a wide spatula to turn the golden sole over low heat.

sole-meuniere.zh: 离火轻晃小锅，黄油中出现浅褐色小点。
sole-meuniere.en: Swirl the pan off the heat as light brown flecks appear in the butter.

sole-meuniere.zh: 将榛色黄油浇在撒了欧芹的金黄鳎鱼上。
sole-meuniere.en: Pour brown butter over the golden sole and parsley.

som-tam.zh: 双手在砧板上将青木瓜切成细长丝。
som-tam.en: Hands cut green papaya into long thin strips on a cutting board.

som-tam.zh: 用杵在深钵里轻压蒜、辣椒和棕榈糖。
som-tam.en: A pestle gently presses garlic, chili and palm sugar in a deep mortar.

som-tam.zh: 用杵捣拌虾米和出现裂口的长豇豆段。
som-tam.en: A pestle pounds dried shrimp and split long bean segments.

som-tam.zh: 一手用勺翻起木瓜丝和番茄，一手轻捣。
som-tam.en: One hand lifts papaya and tomatoes with a spoon while the other gently pounds them.

som-tam.zh: 用勺舀起木瓜丝和微破的番茄品尝。
som-tam.en: A spoon lifts papaya strips and slightly broken tomato for tasting.

som-tam.zh: 用勺将拌有花生的青木瓜沙拉装盘。
som-tam.en: A spoon plates green papaya salad mixed with peanuts.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 将熟玉米粒倒入漏篮沥水。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Cooked corn kernels are poured into a colander to drain.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 用漏勺在沸水中翻动胡萝卜丁。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Diced carrots are moved with a slotted spoon in boiling water.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 用小火翻动干锅里的松仁，炒至微金黄。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Pine nuts are stirred in a dry pan over low heat until lightly golden.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 翻炒锅里的玉米和胡萝卜丁，旁边备好水淀粉。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Corn and diced carrots are stir-fried with starch slurry ready nearby.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 往玉米和胡萝卜丁中加入白糖和盐。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Sugar and salt are added to the corn and diced carrots.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 边翻动玉米和胡萝卜丁边倒入水淀粉，薄芡透亮。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Starch slurry is poured into the corn and carrots as they are stirred, coating them in a clear glaze.

song-ren-yu-mi.zh: 将油亮的玉米、胡萝卜丁和松仁盛入盘中。
song-ren-yu-mi.en: Glossy corn, diced carrots, and pine nuts are spooned onto a plate.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 双手沿鱼骨片开鱼肉，鱼尾仍相连。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: Hands fillet the fish along the backbone, leaving the flesh joined at the tail.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 双手在鱼肉上交叉切出菱形花刀。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: Hands score a diamond pattern into the fish flesh.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 手在碗中搅拌浅色糖醋混合液，旁边放着番茄混合物。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: A hand stirs the pale sweet-and-sour mixture beside a bowl of tomato mixture.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 双手将干淀粉压进鱼肉的花刀缝，后方油锅加热。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: Hands press dry starch into the scored fish as oil heats behind it.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 双手用长夹托住鱼身两端，放入热油中。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: Hands hold both ends of the fish with long tongs as it enters the hot oil.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 手将热油浇在锅中的鱼头上，炸好的鱼身放在旁边。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: A hand bastes the frying fish head with hot oil beside the fried fish body.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 手用细网漏勺捞起淡金色松子，旁边放着青豆。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: A hand lifts pale golden pine nuts in a fine strainer beside a bowl of peas.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 手在锅中翻炒番茄混合物和浅色洋葱末。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: A hand stirs the tomato mixture and pale minced onion in a wok.

song-shu-gui-yu.zh: 手将红色糖醋汁浇在鱼身上，盘中点缀青豆和松子。
song-shu-gui-yu.en: A hand pours red sweet-and-sour sauce over the fish garnished with peas and pine nuts.

souffle-au-fromage.zh: 双手转动模具，让奶酪丝薄薄裹住内壁。
souffle-au-fromage.en: Hands rotate the dish to coat its buttered walls with grated cheese.

souffle-au-fromage.zh: 一边搅拌浅色面糊，一边向小锅倒入牛奶。
souffle-au-fromage.en: Milk is poured into pale roux in a saucepan while it is whisked.

souffle-au-fromage.zh: 小火搅动浓白酱，锅底留下一道清晰的痕迹。
souffle-au-fromage.en: A spatula leaves a clear trail across the bottom of the pan of thick béchamel over low heat.

souffle-au-fromage.zh: 用刮刀将蛋白从底部翻入奶酪白酱。
souffle-au-fromage.en: A spatula folds whipped egg whites into the cheese béchamel from below.

souffle-au-fromage.zh: 将蓬松面糊倒入舒芙蕾模具，旁边放着奶酪丝。
souffle-au-fromage.en: Airy batter is poured into the soufflé dish beside a bowl of grated cheese.

souffle-au-fromage.zh: 用大匙分盛顶部金黄膨起的奶酪舒芙蕾。
souffle-au-fromage.en: A large spoon serves the risen cheese soufflé with its golden top.

spaghetti-alla-nerano.zh: 手在案板上切西葫芦圆片，旁边备有奶酪和罗勒。
spaghetti-alla-nerano.en: Hands slice zucchini into rounds on a board beside bowls of cheese and basil.

spaghetti-alla-nerano.zh: 手用漏勺捞起炸至金黄的西葫芦，放到厨房纸旁沥油。
spaghetti-alla-nerano.en: A hand lifts golden fried zucchini from the oil toward a paper-lined plate.

spaghetti-alla-nerano.zh: 手从煮着意面的锅中舀出一杯煮面水。
spaghetti-alla-nerano.en: A hand scoops a cup of pasta water from a pot of cooking spaghetti.

spaghetti-alla-nerano.zh: 手用夹子把沥好的意面放入盛有金黄西葫芦的锅中。
spaghetti-alla-nerano.en: A hand adds drained spaghetti to a pan of golden zucchini with tongs.

spaghetti-alla-nerano.zh: 手边加煮面水边拌西葫芦意面，锅中有奶酪、黄油和罗勒。
spaghetti-alla-nerano.en: Hands toss zucchini spaghetti with pasta water, cheese, butter and basil.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 手在碗中压碎番茄，旁边摆着备好的配料。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A hand crushes tomatoes in a bowl beside the prepared ingredients.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 浅金色蒜瓣和干辣椒在橄榄油中加热。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A lightly golden garlic clove and dried chili heat in olive oil.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 手用木勺在油中压碎凤尾鱼，旁边有辣椒。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A hand presses anchovies into the oil with a wooden spoon beside a chili.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 木勺压着浓稠番茄酱，酱中有黑橄榄和酸豆。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A wooden spoon presses thick tomato sauce with black olives and capers.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 手用夹子从沸水中提起意面，旁边留有煮面水。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A hand lifts spaghetti from boiling water with tongs beside a cup of pasta water.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 手用夹子翻拌裹着番茄酱、橄榄和酸豆的意面。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A hand tosses spaghetti coated with tomato sauce, olives and capers using tongs.

spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.zh: 手用夹子将拌有橄榄、酸豆和欧芹的意面装盘。
spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.en: A hand plates spaghetti with olives, capers and parsley using tongs.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 切猪颊肉条，旁边备有奶酪碎、番茄和划口红辣椒。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: A hand slices guanciale beside grated cheese, crushed tomatoes and a slit red chili.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 小火翻动猪颊肉和整只红辣椒，锅底积有油脂。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: A hand turns guanciale and a whole red chili in rendered fat over low heat.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 向猪颊肉和辣椒的锅里倒白葡萄酒，用木铲刮锅底。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: White wine is poured into the pan of guanciale and chili as a spatula scrapes the bottom.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 用木勺划过浓稠番茄酱，锅底短暂露出，猪颊肉在酱中。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: A spoon leaves a track in thick tomato sauce with guanciale, briefly exposing the pan.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 用夹子把意面从煮面锅捞入酱锅，旁边留有一杯面水。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: Tongs transfer spaghetti from the pot to the sauce pan beside a cup of reserved pasta water.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 中火翻拌意面，番茄酱裹住面条，锅中有猪颊肉。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: Spaghetti is tossed over medium heat with tomato sauce and guanciale.

spaghetti-allamatriciana.zh: 用夹子将裹着红酱的意面装盘，盘中有猪颊肉和奶酪碎。
spaghetti-allamatriciana.en: Tongs plate red-sauce spaghetti with guanciale and grated cheese.

spaghetti-alle-vongole.zh: 双手在水盆上刷洗蛤蜊外壳。
spaghetti-alle-vongole.en: Hands scrub a clam shell above a bowl of water.

spaghetti-alle-vongole.zh: 用夹子从煮面锅中夹起意面。
spaghetti-alle-vongole.en: Tongs lift spaghetti from a pot of boiling water.

spaghetti-alle-vongole.zh: 揭开锅盖，检查汤汁中开壳的蛤蜊。
spaghetti-alle-vongole.en: A hand lifts the lid to check clams opened in their broth.

spaghetti-alle-vongole.zh: 将蛤蜊原汁倒过铺有滤布的筛子。
spaghetti-alle-vongole.en: Clam broth is poured through a cloth-lined sieve.

spaghetti-alle-vongole.zh: 用夹子在锅中翻拌吸收原汁的意面。
spaghetti-alle-vongole.en: Tongs toss spaghetti as it absorbs clam broth in a pan.

spaghetti-alle-vongole.zh: 用夹子将蛤蜊、欧芹和意面装盘。
spaghetti-alle-vongole.en: Tongs plate spaghetti with clams and parsley.

spezzatino.zh: 手用夹子翻煎锅中相互分开的深褐色牛肉块。
spezzatino.en: A hand turns spaced, deeply browned beef cubes in the pan with tongs.

spezzatino.zh: 手翻炒裹着深色番茄膏的土豆、胡萝卜、西芹和洋葱。
spezzatino.en: A hand stirs potatoes, carrots, celery and onions coated in dark tomato paste.

spezzatino.zh: 手向牛肉、蔬菜和豌豆中倒入番茄泥，旁边是热高汤。
spezzatino.en: A hand pours tomato passata over beef, vegetables and peas beside hot stock.

spezzatino.zh: 手用叉子检验微微冒泡的炖牛肉，汤里浮着月桂叶。
spezzatino.en: A hand tests simmering beef with a fork as bay leaves float in the broth.

spezzatino.zh: 手把牛肉、土豆和豌豆炖菜舀进碗里。
spezzatino.en: A hand ladles beef, potato and pea stew into a bowl.

ssamjang.zh: 手在案板上切蒜末，旁边放着葱末和洋葱末。
ssamjang.en: A hand minces garlic on a board beside chopped scallion and onion.

ssamjang.zh: 手用勺背压匀碗里的红褐色酱，酱中留有豆粒。
ssamjang.en: A hand presses the reddish-brown paste with the back of a spoon, leaving some whole beans.

ssamjang.zh: 手用勺舀起有光泽的稠酱，旁边放着蜂蜜和香油。
ssamjang.en: A hand lifts a mound of glossy thick sauce beside bowls of honey and sesame oil.

ssamjang.zh: 手用勺翻拌稠酱，葱、洋葱和芝麻均匀散开。
ssamjang.en: A hand folds thick sauce with scallion, onion and sesame evenly distributed.

ssamjang.zh: 手用勺把少量包饭酱放在生菜叶上的米饭上。
ssamjang.en: A hand spoons a little ssamjang onto rice on a lettuce leaf.

steak-au-poivre.zh: 手将粗碎黑胡椒按在生牛排上。
steak-au-poivre.en: A hand presses coarsely crushed black pepper onto raw steaks.

steak-au-poivre.zh: 手用夹子翻动锅中的牛排，露出褐色焦壳。
steak-au-poivre.en: A hand turns a steak in the pan, revealing its brown crust.

steak-au-poivre.zh: 手将温度计从侧面插入锅中的牛排。
steak-au-poivre.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the side of a steak in the pan.

steak-au-poivre.zh: 手用木勺刮松锅底褐渣，锅中汤汁与红葱头正在收浓。
steak-au-poivre.en: A hand scrapes browned bits into reducing stock and shallots.

steak-au-poivre.zh: 手将白兰地倒入离火的红葱头锅汁中。
steak-au-poivre.en: A hand pours brandy into the shallot pan sauce off the heat.

steak-au-poivre.zh: 手将有光泽的锅汁浇在盘中的黑胡椒牛排上。
steak-au-poivre.en: A hand pours glossy pan sauce over the plated pepper steak.

steamed-fish.zh: 手用勺子在小碗里搅匀深色豉油汁。
steamed-fish.en: A hand stirs dark soy sauce mixture in a small bowl.

steamed-fish.zh: 手在架于三片姜上的整鱼厚处斜划刀口。
steamed-fish.en: A hand scores the thickest part of a whole fish resting on three ginger slices.

steamed-fish.zh: 双手将鱼盘放入蒸汽腾腾的大火蒸锅。
steamed-fish.en: Two hands lower the fish plate into a vigorously steaming pot over high heat.

steamed-fish.zh: 筷子拨开鱼背刀口，露出贴骨的白色鱼肉。
steamed-fish.en: Chopsticks open a cut in the fish, exposing white flesh at the bone.

steamed-fish.zh: 手将姜丝、葱绿丝和香菜铺在蒸鱼上。
steamed-fish.en: A hand places ginger, scallion greens and cilantro on the steamed fish.

steamed-fish.zh: 手向冒泡的姜丝豉油汁中放入葱白丝。
steamed-fish.en: A hand adds scallion whites to bubbling soy sauce and ginger.

steamed-fish.zh: 手将热油和豉油汁浇在铺有姜葱香菜的鱼上。
steamed-fish.en: A hand pours hot oil and soy sauce over fish topped with ginger, scallions and cilantro.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 双手在案板上将豆角斜切成段。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: Hands cut green beans diagonally into sections on a board.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 手在碗中搅拌料汁，旁边放着葱花、辣椒圈和蒜末。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: A hand mixes sauce in a bowl beside scallions, chili rings and minced garlic.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 锅中油热，手用锅铲翻炒葱花和辣椒圈。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: A hand stirs scallions and chili rings in oil in a heated wok.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 手将料汁倒入大火上的豆角锅中。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: A hand pours sauce over green beans in a wok over high heat.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 手翻动沸腾汤汁中的豆角，锅盖放在一旁。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: A hand stirs green beans in bubbling broth, with the lid set aside.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 手用筷子剖开一段豆角，检查内部。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: Hands split a green bean with chopsticks to inspect its interior.

su-chao-dou-jiao.zh: 双手将炒好的豆角从锅中盛入盘里。
su-chao-dou-jiao.en: Hands transfer the cooked green beans from the wok onto a plate.

suan-cai-yu.zh: 手拌匀薄浆鱼片，旁边放着鱼头鱼骨和调料。
suan-cai-yu.en: Hands mix thinly coated fish slices beside fish head, bones and seasonings.

suan-cai-yu.zh: 手将酸菜切段，案板上摆着斜切的菜梗。
suan-cai-yu.en: Hands cut pickled mustard greens into sections beside diagonally sliced stems.

suan-cai-yu.zh: 手在锅中翻炒酸菜、姜蒜、葱白和泡椒。
suan-cai-yu.en: Hands stir-fry pickled mustard greens with ginger, garlic, scallion whites and pickled chilies.

suan-cai-yu.zh: 鱼头鱼骨和酸菜在浅黄色浑汤中微微冒泡。
suan-cai-yu.en: Fish head, bones and pickled mustard greens simmer in cloudy pale yellow broth.

suan-cai-yu.zh: 筷子夹起煮至不透明的鱼片，旁边的碗里盛着鱼骨和酸菜。
suan-cai-yu.en: Chopsticks lift an opaque cooked fish slice beside a bowl of fish bones and pickled greens.

suan-cai-yu.zh: 热油浇在酸菜鱼的蒜末、葱绿和椒粒上，香料冒出细泡。
suan-cai-yu.en: Hot oil is poured over garlic, scallions and chilies on the fish, making the aromatics bubble.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 手用筷子搅拌碗中拌匀的猪肉末。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: Hands stir evenly coated ground pork in a bowl with chopsticks.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 手将酸豆角切成小粒，旁边摆着备好的配料。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: Hands cut pickled long beans into small pieces beside prepared ingredients.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 手用锅铲压散锅中炒至微黄的肉末。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: A hand breaks up lightly browned ground pork in a wok.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 肉末拨到锅边，手在另一侧炒姜蒜。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: A hand fries ginger and garlic beside ground pork pushed to one side of the wok.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 手翻炒肉末、青红椒和豆瓣酱，锅中油色泛红。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: A hand stir-fries ground pork, bell peppers and doubanjiang in red oil.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 手翻炒酸豆角、肉末和辣椒，锅底没有积汁。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: A hand stir-fries pickled long beans, ground pork and peppers with no pooled liquid.

suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.zh: 手将酸豆角肉末盛入白盘，旁边放着米饭。
suan-dou-jiao-rou-mo.en: Hands transfer pickled long beans and ground pork onto a white plate beside rice.

suan-la-fen.zh: 双手在水中弯曲泡软的红薯粉条。
suan-la-fen.en: Hands bend softened sweet potato noodles in water.

suan-la-fen.zh: 手搅拌调味碗，榨菜、葱花和花生分开放置。
suan-la-fen.en: A hand stirs a seasoning bowl beside separate dishes of mustard stem, scallions and peanuts.

suan-la-fen.zh: 大火下，手用筷子拨开沸水中的粉条。
suan-la-fen.en: A hand separates noodles with chopsticks in vigorously boiling water over high heat.

suan-la-fen.zh: 鸡汤在中火上冒热气，锅边环绕小泡。
suan-la-fen.en: Chicken stock steams over medium heat with small bubbles around the edge.

suan-la-fen.zh: 手用筷子挑开酸辣汤中的粉条。
suan-la-fen.en: A hand lifts and separates noodles in seasoned broth with chopsticks.

suan-la-fen.zh: 手向铺有榨菜、花生和葱花的酸辣粉上撒香菜。
suan-la-fen.en: A hand sprinkles cilantro over noodles topped with mustard stem, peanuts and scallions.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 用筷子拨散沸水中的蕨根粉。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: Chopsticks separate fern root noodles in boiling water.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 用筷子从锅中夹起一根蕨根粉。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: Chopsticks lift a strand of fern root noodle from the pot.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 用勺搅匀碗中的酸辣拌汁。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: A spoon stirs the spicy and sour sauce in a bowl.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 用勺舀起少量酸辣拌汁。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: A spoon lifts a little spicy and sour sauce from the bowl.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 用筷子拨散筛中沥水的蕨根粉。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: Chopsticks separate fern root noodles draining in a sieve.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 用筷子从碗底挑起蕨根粉翻拌酱汁。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: Chopsticks lift fern root noodles from the bottom of the bowl to coat them in sauce.

suan-la-jue-gen-fen.zh: 在拌好的蕨根粉上撒辣椒、蒜和葱花。
suan-la-jue-gen-fen.en: A hand sprinkles chili, garlic and scallions over the dressed fern root noodles.

suan-la-tang.zh: 手切泡软的香菇，旁边摆着木耳、黄花菜和泡发水。
suan-la-tang.en: A hand slices soaked shiitake beside wood ear, daylily buds and their soaking water.

suan-la-tang.zh: 手用筷子拌匀挂着薄浆的肉丝，旁边放着醋和白胡椒。
suan-la-tang.en: Hands mix thinly coated pork strips beside a bowl of vinegar and white pepper.

suan-la-tang.zh: 手搅动小火煮着的豆腐、香菇、木耳和黄花菜。
suan-la-tang.en: A hand stirs tofu, shiitake, wood ear and daylily buds in gently simmering broth.

suan-la-tang.zh: 手边推汤边淋入水淀粉，锅里的汤微微浓稠发亮。
suan-la-tang.en: Hands stir the glossy, slightly thick soup while pouring in starch slurry.

suan-la-tang.zh: 手轻推锅中分散的白色肉丝，汤保持小火微沸。
suan-la-tang.en: A hand gently separates the white pork strips in gently simmering soup.

suan-la-tang.zh: 手把带蛋花、肉丝和豆腐的酸辣汤盛入碗中。
suan-la-tang.en: A hand ladles hot and sour soup with egg ribbons, pork and tofu into a bowl.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 用菜刀将去皮土豆片切成粗细均匀的细丝。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook cuts peeled potato slices into even matchsticks.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞出土豆丝沥水。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook lifts potato matchsticks from boiling water to drain.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 切红椒丝，旁边备好青椒、干辣椒、蒜末和葱。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook slices red pepper beside prepared green pepper, dried chilies, minced garlic and scallions.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 小火翻动油中的葱白、蒜末和干辣椒。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook gently stirs scallion whites, minced garlic and dried chilies in oil over low heat.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 大火翻炒土豆丝、青红椒和干辣椒。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook tosses potato strips, green and red peppers, and dried chilies over high heat.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 用筷子夹起一根弯曲的土豆丝检查熟度。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook lifts a bending potato strip with chopsticks to check doneness.

suan-la-tu-dou-si.zh: 将炒好的土豆丝和青红椒盛入盘中。
suan-la-tu-dou-si.en: A cook transfers the stir-fried potato and peppers onto a plate.

suan-mei-tang.zh: 往装有果干和香料的锅中倒水。
suan-mei-tang.en: Water is poured into a pot of dried fruit and spices.

suan-mei-tang.zh: 果干和香料在盖着盖的锅中小火轻沸。
suan-mei-tang.en: Dried fruit and spices simmer gently in a covered pot.

suan-mei-tang.zh: 头遍汤滤入盛有黄冰糖的碗中，果干留在滤网里。
suan-mei-tang.en: The first infusion is strained into a bowl of yellow rock sugar, leaving fruit in the sieve.

suan-mei-tang.zh: 第二遍汤滤入头遍汤，果干留在滤网里。
suan-mei-tang.en: The second infusion is strained into the first, leaving fruit in the sieve.

suan-mei-tang.zh: 手将干桂花撒入深红褐色的汤中。
suan-mei-tang.en: A hand sprinkles dried osmanthus into the deep reddish-brown infusion.

suan-mei-tang.zh: 用勺将酸梅汤舀入碟上的玻璃杯。
suan-mei-tang.en: Sour plum drink is ladled into a glass on a saucer.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 双手用滤网沥去泡香料的水。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: Hands drain soaked spices in a strainer.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 小锅里的香料酱油半盖着用小火煮。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: Spiced soy sauce simmers in a partially covered saucepan over low heat.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 筷子扎入微沸汤中的整块五花肉。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: Chopsticks probe a whole piece of pork belly in gently simmering broth.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 整块熟五花肉放在盘上，旁边的肉汤盛在小碟里。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: A whole piece of cooked pork belly rests on a plate beside a small dish of broth.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 手用勺搅匀碗中的蒜泥红油汁。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: A hand stirs garlic and chili oil sauce in a bowl.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 手将熟五花肉切成薄片，旁边盘里铺着黄瓜块。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: Hands slice cooked pork belly thinly beside a plate of cucumber chunks.

suan-ni-bai-rou.zh: 手把红油淋在铺有肉片和黄瓜的盘中。
suan-ni-bai-rou.en: A hand drizzles chili oil over pork slices and cucumber.

suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.zh: 手持菜刀将香芹切成短段，旁边摆着剖细的梗。
suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.en: Hands cut Chinese celery into short lengths beside split stalks.

suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.zh: 双手轻晃漏篮，甩去芹菜梗和嫩叶上的水珠。
suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.en: Hands gently shake a colander of celery stalks and tender leaves to shed water.

suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.zh: 手持菜刀剁蒜末，旁边备好芹菜、盐和空盘。
suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.en: Hands mince garlic beside prepared celery, salt, and an empty plate.

suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.zh: 小火下将浅色蒜末倒入铺有融化猪油和盐的锅中。
suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.en: A hand adds pale minced garlic to melted lard and salt in a wok over low heat.

suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.zh: 大火下用锅铲向上翻炒翠绿挺直的芹菜和浅色蒜末。
suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.en: A hand lifts bright green celery and pale garlic with a spatula over high heat.

suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.zh: 用锅铲将翠绿的蒜蓉芹菜从锅中盛入红边白盘。
suan-rong-chao-qin-cai.en: Hands transfer bright green celery and garlic from the wok onto a red-rimmed white plate.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手用厨房纸吸干生扇贝肉。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: A hand pats raw scallops dry with kitchen paper.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手用筷子在离火的热水中拨散柔软粉丝。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: A hand separates softened glass noodles in hot water off the heat.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手搅动小火油锅中冒细泡的浅色蒜蓉。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: A hand stirs pale minced garlic bubbling gently in oil over a small flame.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手将蒜蓉和蒜油舀在粉丝上的生扇贝肉上。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: A hand spoons garlic and garlic oil onto raw scallops over glass noodles.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手将生抽倒入小火加热的酱汁锅中，旁边放着糖。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: Hands pour light soy sauce into gently bubbling sauce over a low flame, with sugar nearby.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手揭开蒸锅盖，查看粉丝上蒸至不透明的扇贝。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: A hand lifts the steamer lid to check opaque scallops on glass noodles.

suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.zh: 手将酱汁淋在蒜蓉扇贝和粉丝上，盘中点缀香菜。
suan-rong-fen-si-zheng-shan-bei.en: A hand spoons sauce over garlic scallops and glass noodles garnished with cilantro.

suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.zh: 双手抖散漏篮中的空心菜，水滴落入碗中。
suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.en: Hands loosen water spinach in a colander as water drips into a bowl.

suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.zh: 双手在案板上切蒜末，旁边备着调味料和空心菜。
suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.en: Hands mince garlic on a board beside prepared seasonings and water spinach.

suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.zh: 一只手倾斜热锅，让油流过锅底。
suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.en: A hand tilts a hot wok to spread oil across the bottom.

suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.zh: 空心菜从漏篮倒入大火锅中，锅底有浅色蒜末。
suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.en: Water spinach is tipped into a wok over high heat with pale garlic in the oil.

suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.zh: 锅铲从锅底翻起软叶和青绿的空心菜梗。
suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.en: A spatula lifts softened leaves and bright green water spinach stems from the wok.

suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.zh: 锅铲将炒熟的蒜蓉空心菜盛入红边盘中。
suan-rong-kong-xin-cai.en: A spatula transfers cooked garlic water spinach onto a red-rimmed plate.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 双手用刀纵剖西兰花粗梗，旁边放着小朵和削下的外皮。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: Hands split a thick broccoli stalk lengthwise beside florets and trimmed peel.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 双手搅拌碗里的酱汁，案板旁放着切好的蒜末。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: Hands stir sauce in a bowl beside a pile of minced garlic on the board.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 大火滚水中放入西兰花，用筷子轻轻拨散。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: A hand separates broccoli florets with chopsticks in vigorously boiling water over high heat.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 滚水中用筷子检查鲜绿西兰花的粗梗。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: A hand checks the thick stem of a bright green broccoli floret with chopsticks in boiling water.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 双手轻抖漏篮，沥去西兰花里的水，旁边放着空盘。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: Hands gently shake water from broccoli in a colander beside an empty plate.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 小火锅中蒜末边缘泛金，手正倒入调好的酱汁。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: A hand pours prepared sauce into a pan of garlic just turning golden over low heat.

suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.zh: 手将流动的蒜蓉酱汁淋在盘中的西兰花上。
suan-rong-xi-lan-hua.en: A hand pours fluid garlic sauce over the plated broccoli.

suan-rong-xia.zh: 扶稳生虾，沿背部切开虾肉并保留尾部连接。
suan-rong-xia.en: A hand steadies a raw shrimp as a knife cuts along its back, leaving the tail attached.

suan-rong-xia.zh: 用厨房纸吸干盘中展开的生虾。
suan-rong-xia.en: A hand blots the butterflied raw shrimp on a plate with kitchen paper.

suan-rong-xia.zh: 用勺将蒜蓉酱铺在生虾切口中。
suan-rong-xia.en: A spoon spreads minced garlic sauce over the opened raw shrimp.

suan-rong-xia.zh: 蒸锅冒着蒸汽，用筷子检查虾的白色厚肉。
suan-rong-xia.en: Chopsticks check the opaque white flesh of a shrimp in the steaming pot.

suan-rong-xia.zh: 将热油淋在熟虾的蒜蓉上，蒜蓉细细起泡。
suan-rong-xia.en: Hot oil is poured over garlic on the cooked shrimp, forming fine bubbles.

suan-rong-xia.zh: 沿盘边将生抽倒入蒜蓉虾的盘底汁中。
suan-rong-xia.en: Light soy sauce is poured along the edge of the plate into the shrimp juices.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 双手将蒜苔切段，粗细分开放在案板上。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: Hands cut garlic scapes into lengths, separating thick and thin pieces on the board.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 双手将肥瘦相间的五花肉切细末，蒜末另放在碗中。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: Hands mince pork belly with lean and fat mixed together, with minced garlic in a separate bowl.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 手持锅铲翻炒油中的蒜末，蒜末仍呈浅色。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: A hand stirs pale minced garlic in oil in the wok.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 手持锅铲拨炒变色的肉末，锅中有蒜末和酱油。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: A hand stirs cooked minced pork with garlic and soy sauce in the wok.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 一只手向锅中的蒜苔和肉末倒入生抽。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: A hand pours light soy sauce over garlic scapes and minced pork in the wok.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 手持锅铲翻动蒜苔和肉末，锅中少量水正冒泡。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: A hand turns garlic scapes and minced pork in a little bubbling water.

suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.zh: 双手将炒好的蒜苔和肉末从锅中盛入红边盘。
suan-tai-chao-rou-mo.en: Hands transfer cooked garlic scapes and minced pork from the wok onto a red-rimmed plate.

suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.zh: 用厨房纸吸干去壳留尾的虾，旁边备有蒜末、柠檬和黄油。
suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.en: Pat peeled, tail-on shrimp dry with paper towel, with minced garlic, lemon and butter nearby.

suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.zh: 用锅铲翻煎平铺在油中的带尾虾。
suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.en: Turn the tail-on shrimp arranged in a single layer in the oil.

suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.zh: 小火搅炒融化的黄油和浅色蒜末。
suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.en: Stir pale minced garlic in melted butter over low heat.

suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.zh: 小火搅拌锅中仍然湿润的蒜香黄油酒汁。
suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.en: Stir the moist garlic butter and wine sauce over low heat.

suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.zh: 用锅铲翻拌虾仁，使其裹上蒜香黄油。
suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.en: Turn the shrimp with a spatula to coat them in garlic butter.

suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.zh: 用锅铲将蒜末和黄油汁淋在盘中的虾上。
suan-xiang-huang-you-xia.en: Spoon the garlic and butter sauce over the plated shrimp with a spatula.

suan-xiang-jiang-you.zh: 用布擦干案板上切成小块的蒜。
suan-xiang-jiang-you.en: A hand blots chopped garlic dry on a cutting board.

suan-xiang-jiang-you.zh: 用勺搅拌碗里的生抽和熟白芝麻。
suan-xiang-jiang-you.en: A hand stirs soy sauce and toasted white sesame seeds in a bowl.

suan-xiang-jiang-you.zh: 小火轻推油中的蒜块，蒜边冒出细泡。
suan-xiang-jiang-you.en: Garlic pieces bubble gently in oil as a hand moves them over low heat.

suan-xiang-jiang-you.zh: 将浅黄色的蒜块连油从锅中倒入小碗。
suan-xiang-jiang-you.en: A hand pours pale golden garlic and oil from the saucepan into a small bowl.

suan-xiang-jiang-you.zh: 用勺将蒜和油舀入芝麻酱油碗中。
suan-xiang-jiang-you.en: A hand spoons garlic and oil into the bowl of soy sauce and sesame.

suan-xiang-jiang-you.zh: 碗里的蒜块和白芝麻均匀分布在酱油中。
suan-xiang-jiang-you.en: Garlic pieces and white sesame seeds are evenly distributed in the soy sauce.

sugo-di-pomodoro.zh: 用木匙压开锅中的整颗番茄，旁边有黄油和两半洋葱。
sugo-di-pomodoro.en: A hand presses a whole tomato with a wooden spoon beside butter and two onion halves.

sugo-di-pomodoro.zh: 番茄和两半洋葱在锅中小火慢煮，酱汁冒着小泡。
sugo-di-pomodoro.en: Tomatoes and two onion halves simmer gently over a low flame, with small bubbles in the sauce.

sugo-di-pomodoro.zh: 用木匙压碎锅里的番茄块，软洋葱仍保持大块。
sugo-di-pomodoro.en: A hand crushes a tomato piece with a wooden spoon while the softened onion halves remain intact.

sugo-di-pomodoro.zh: 木匙舀起浓稠番茄酱，酱缓缓落回锅中。
sugo-di-pomodoro.en: Thick tomato sauce falls slowly from a wooden spoon back into the pot.

sugo-di-pomodoro.zh: 用勺从浓番茄酱中取出半颗洋葱，旁边放着盐。
sugo-di-pomodoro.en: A hand lifts an onion half from the thick tomato sauce, with salt nearby.

sukiyaki.zh: 用筷子从清水中捞出泡软展开的昆布。
sukiyaki.en: Chopsticks lift softened, unfolded kombu from a bowl of water.

sukiyaki.zh: 用勺搅拌微微冒泡、糖已溶化的割下。
sukiyaki.en: A spoon stirs gently bubbling warishita with the sugar dissolved.

sukiyaki.zh: 从沸水中捞出蒟蒻丝，旁边是浸泡的牛蒡。
sukiyaki.en: Chopsticks lift shirataki from boiling water beside soaking burdock.

sukiyaki.zh: 用筷子从浅汁中夹出煮熟变色的牛肉。
sukiyaki.en: Chopsticks lift a cooked brown beef slice from the shallow sauce.

sukiyaki.zh: 用筷子夹起煮软的白菜帮，锅里摆着豆腐和蔬菜。
sukiyaki.en: Chopsticks lift a softened cabbage stem from a pan of tofu and vegetables.

sukiyaki.zh: 从蔬菜和浅汁中夹出煮熟的牛肉。
sukiyaki.en: Chopsticks lift cooked beef from vegetables in shallow sauce.

sukiyaki.zh: 向装有牛肉和蔬菜的浅锅里倒入少量昆布水。
sukiyaki.en: A hand pours a little kombu water into a shallow pan of beef and vegetables.

sundubu-jjigae.zh: 手持勺子将辣椒粉和油拌成湿润红糊。
sundubu-jjigae.en: A hand stirs chili flakes and oil into a moist red paste.

sundubu-jjigae.zh: 用勺翻炒泡菜、猪肉和洋葱丁。
sundubu-jjigae.en: A spoon stirs chopped kimchi, pork and diced onion in the pot.

sundubu-jjigae.zh: 辣椒糊倒入冒泡的猪肉泡菜汤中。
sundubu-jjigae.en: Chili paste is poured into bubbling pork and kimchi broth.

sundubu-jjigae.zh: 用勺轻推冒泡汤中的大块嫩豆腐。
sundubu-jjigae.en: A spoon gently pushes large pieces of soft tofu in bubbling broth.

sundubu-jjigae.zh: 嫩豆腐汤里有两个熟鸡蛋和葱花，旁边是一碗米饭。
sundubu-jjigae.en: The tofu stew is topped with two cooked eggs and scallions, with rice alongside.

suon-ram-man.zh: 用漏勺捞出焯白的排骨，锅中浮着沫。
suon-ram-man.en: A hand lifts blanched ribs from bubbling water with a slotted spoon, with foam floating in the pot.

suon-ram-man.zh: 用勺拌匀焯白的排骨，肉上沾满蒜末、红葱头末和胡椒。
suon-ram-man.en: A hand mixes blanched ribs coated with minced garlic, shallot, and pepper.

suon-ram-man.zh: 轻晃锅子，锅里的糖油融成琥珀色。
suon-ram-man.en: A hand tilts the pot as the sugar and oil melt into amber caramel.

suon-ram-man.zh: 排骨盖锅小火煨煮，汁中冒出小泡。
suon-ram-man.en: Ribs simmer under a lid over low heat, with small bubbles in the sauce.

suon-ram-man.zh: 用勺翻动排骨，褐色汁水薄薄裹住肉面。
suon-ram-man.en: A hand turns the ribs in brown sauce that coats the meat.

suon-ram-man.zh: 用勺将裹着亮汁的排骨盛入盘中，旁边放着白饭。
suon-ram-man.en: A hand spoons glossy ribs onto a plate beside a bowl of white rice.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 案板上正切带皮五花肉条，旁边分别放着红葱末和蒜末。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: Skin-on pork belly is cut into strips beside separate piles of minced shallot and garlic.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 手持小刀在剥壳熟鸡蛋上浅划，旁边放着另外三个鸡蛋。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: A hand scores a peeled boiled egg beside three more eggs.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 锅中肉条边缘微黄，清亮肉油中正翻炒着五花肉。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: Pork strips with lightly golden edges are stirred in clear rendered fat.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 小火锅中放着肉条和葱蒜末，手正倒入生抽。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: A hand pours light soy sauce into pork and minced aromatics over low heat.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 肉条、整蛋、八角和月桂叶在加盖的锅中小火微沸。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: Pork, whole eggs, star anise and bay leaves gently simmer in a covered pot.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 手举起沾着卤汁的勺子，汁流回盛有肉条和卤蛋的锅中。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: A hand lifts a sauce-coated spoon above a pot of pork strips and braised eggs.

tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.zh: 手将卤肉和卤汁浇在米饭上，碗边配着半个卤蛋。
tai-shi-lu-rou-fan.en: A hand spoons braised pork and sauce over rice beside half a braised egg.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 大火煮牛腱，勺子撇去沸水表面的浮沫。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: A spoon skims foam from the vigorously boiling water around a whole beef shank.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 锅中翻炒大块蔬菜，番茄开始出汁。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand stirs large vegetable pieces as the tomatoes begin to release their juices.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 蔬菜拨到一侧，勺子炒酱至油变红。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: A spoon fries the pastes beside the vegetables until the oil turns red.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 牛腱在汤中轻沸，筷子插入最厚处。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: Chopsticks test the thickest part of a whole beef shank simmering in broth.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 炖好的牛腱在案板上横切成薄片。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: Cooked beef shank is sliced crosswise on a cutting board.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 锅中翻炒酸菜丁、蒜末和辣椒圈，炒至没有积水。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: Diced pickled mustard greens, minced garlic and chili rings are stirred in a pan until no water pools.

tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.zh: 手向牛肉面碗里撒葱花，碗中有青菜和酸菜。
tai-shi-niu-rou-mian.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over beef noodle soup with bok choy and pickled mustard greens.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 浸泡后的白米在筛中沥水。
takikomi-gohan.en: Soaked white rice drains in a sieve.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 香菇泡发水经细筛倒入盛有出汁的量杯。
takikomi-gohan.en: Shiitake soaking liquid is strained into a jug of dashi.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 油豆腐在滚水中焯烫，旁边放着蒟蒻。
takikomi-gohan.en: Aburaage blanches in boiling water beside a dish of konnyaku.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 手将牛蒡削成薄片，旁边是胡萝卜条和鸡肉。
takikomi-gohan.en: Hands shave burdock beside carrot strips and chicken.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 手把香菇铺在电饭锅的米和配料上。
takikomi-gohan.en: A hand places shiitake on the rice and toppings in a rice cooker.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 电饭锅里炊熟的米饭饱满，表面没有汤水。
takikomi-gohan.en: Plump cooked rice and toppings sit in the rice cooker without free liquid.

takikomi-gohan.zh: 手往盛好的什锦炊饭上撒葱花。
takikomi-gohan.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over a bowl of mixed rice.

tamago-sando.zh: 三枚鸡蛋在小火锅中轻轻沸煮。
tamago-sando.en: Three eggs simmer gently in a saucepan over a low flame.

tamago-sando.zh: 双手剥冷却的鸡蛋，旁边的蛋黄已凝固。
tamago-sando.en: Hands peel a cooled egg beside a cut egg with a fully set yolk.

tamago-sando.zh: 手用叉子舀起能聚成团的鸡蛋馅。
tamago-sando.en: A hand lifts a cohesive forkful of egg filling.

tamago-sando.zh: 手将鸡蛋馅均匀抹在涂过黄油的吐司上。
tamago-sando.en: A hand spreads egg filling evenly over buttered bread.

tamago-sando.zh: 手将去边鸡蛋三明治对角切开，馅料保持整齐。
tamago-sando.en: A hand cuts a crustless egg sandwich diagonally, leaving a neat filling.

tamagoyaki.zh: 手将调味出汁倒入蛋液，用筷子轻轻搅匀。
tamagoyaki.en: A hand pours seasoned dashi into beaten eggs while gently stirring with chopsticks.

tamagoyaki.zh: 手用夹子夹油纸擦热锅，锅中一滴蛋液开始凝固。
tamagoyaki.en: A hand wipes the heated pan with oiled paper while a drop of egg begins to set.

tamagoyaki.zh: 手用宽铲折卷湿润的薄蛋皮，形成蛋卷芯。
tamagoyaki.en: A hand uses a broad spatula to fold the moist egg sheet into a small roll.

tamagoyaki.zh: 手倒入第二份蛋液，宽铲托起锅中蛋卷的边缘。
tamagoyaki.en: A hand pours in the second portion of egg while a spatula lifts the edge of the roll.

tamagoyaki.zh: 手将温度计插入小火加热的整条蛋卷中心。
tamagoyaki.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the center of the whole egg roll over low heat.

tamagoyaki.zh: 手用筷子将厚蛋烧放上盘，旁边配有白萝卜泥。
tamagoyaki.en: A hand places a slice of tamagoyaki on a plate beside grated daikon.

tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.zh: 手持小刀在整颗西红柿底部浅划十字。
tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.en: A hand scores a shallow cross on the bottom of a whole tomato.

tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞起划口卷皮的西红柿。
tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.en: A slotted spoon lifts a tomato with curling skin from boiling water.

tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.zh: 双手沿划口轻轻剥去凉水中西红柿的薄皮。
tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.en: Hands gently peel the loosened skin from a tomato in cool water.

tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.zh: 用刀将去皮西红柿切成瓣，砧板上留有果汁。
tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.en: A knife cuts a peeled tomato into wedges, leaving juice on the board.

tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.zh: 手将白糖撒在浅盘中层叠的西红柿瓣上。
tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.en: A hand sprinkles sugar over layered tomato wedges in a shallow dish.

tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.zh: 用勺将盘中的清汁浇在撒有少量糖粒的西红柿瓣上。
tang-ban-xi-hong-shi.en: A spoon pours the clear juice over tomato wedges with a few sugar crystals.

tang-cu-li-ji.zh: 手抓拌碗里的生里脊肉条和腌料。
tang-cu-li-ji.en: A hand mixes raw pork strips with marinade in a bowl.

tang-cu-li-ji.zh: 手搅拌碗中红色糖醋汁，旁边放着沥油架和空盘。
tang-cu-li-ji.en: A hand stirs red sweet-and-sour sauce beside a draining rack and an empty plate.

tang-cu-li-ji.zh: 一手撒淀粉，一手将碗里的肉条拌散。
tang-cu-li-ji.en: One hand sprinkles starch while the other separates pork strips in a bowl.

tang-cu-li-ji.zh: 手用漏勺从冒泡的油中捞起一条浅黄色肉条。
tang-cu-li-ji.en: A hand lifts a pale yellow pork strip from bubbling oil with a skimmer.

tang-cu-li-ji.zh: 手用漏勺捞出金黄色肉条，旁边放着沥油架。
tang-cu-li-ji.en: A hand lifts golden pork strips from the oil beside a draining rack.

tang-cu-li-ji.zh: 手将裹着红橙色糖醋汁的肉条从锅中盛入盘里。
tang-cu-li-ji.en: Hands slide red-orange glazed pork strips from a wok onto a plate.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 手按稳鲤鱼，横片鱼肉并保留根部相连。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: A hand steadies the carp while a knife slices a flap of flesh, leaving it attached.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 双手将姜片和葱段揉擦在剞刀后的鱼身上。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: Hands rub ginger slices and scallion sections over the scored fish.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 用勺将面糊浇在鱼身和刀口上，面糊连续流下。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: A spoon coats the fish and its cuts with a flowing batter.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 双手用长柄工具托住挂糊的鱼，缓缓放入热油。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: Two long-handled tools support the battered fish as it is lowered into hot oil.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 用长柄工具托起金黄的炸鱼，移向沥油架。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: Long-handled tools lift the golden fried fish toward a draining rack.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 向冒泡的红色糖醋汁中倒入少量芡汁并搅拌。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: A little starch slurry is poured into bubbling red sweet-and-sour sauce as it is stirred.

tang-cu-li-yu.zh: 用勺将糖醋汁浇在盘中的金黄炸鱼上。
tang-cu-li-yu.en: A ladle pours sweet-and-sour sauce over the golden fried fish on a platter.

tang-cu-pai-gu.zh: 用厨房纸吸干焯过的排骨，旁边放着姜片。
tang-cu-pai-gu.en: A hand pats blanched ribs dry with kitchen paper, with ginger slices beside them.

tang-cu-pai-gu.zh: 用漏勺捞起炸至浅金黄的排骨，沥去油分。
tang-cu-pai-gu.en: A slotted spoon lifts lightly golden ribs from the oil to drain.

tang-cu-pai-gu.zh: 小火搅拌锅中清亮的糖水。
tang-cu-pai-gu.en: A hand stirs clear sugar water in a pot over low heat.

tang-cu-pai-gu.zh: 往排骨和焖煮汤汁中倒入老抽，旁边放着调味料。
tang-cu-pai-gu.en: A hand pours dark soy sauce into ribs and braising liquid, with seasonings nearby.

tang-cu-pai-gu.zh: 给排骨锅盖上盖子，汤汁在小火上轻轻冒泡。
tang-cu-pai-gu.en: A hand covers the ribs as the broth gently bubbles over low heat.

tang-cu-pai-gu.zh: 翻动排骨收汁，锅中酱汁冒大泡，旁边放着醋和芝麻。
tang-cu-pai-gu.en: A hand turns the ribs as the sauce bubbles and reduces, with vinegar and sesame nearby.

tang-cu-zhi.zh: 手在碗中搅拌深褐色糖醋汁，旁边放着配料。
tang-cu-zhi.en: Hands stir dark brown sweet-and-sour sauce in a bowl beside the measured ingredients.

tang-cu-zhi.zh: 手沿锅边倒入糖醋汁，锅中已有肉片和肉汁。
tang-cu-zhi.en: A hand pours sweet-and-sour sauce along the edge of a wok containing cooked pork and juices.

tang-cu-zhi.zh: 手翻动小火微沸的糖醋汁和肉片。
tang-cu-zhi.en: A hand turns pork in gently simmering sweet-and-sour sauce over a low flame.

tang-cu-zhi.zh: 手在旺火上翻动肉块，锅中汁液减少并薄薄挂在肉上。
tang-cu-zhi.en: A hand turns pork over high heat as the reduced sauce coats it thinly.

tang-cu-zhi.zh: 手舀起一块肉和少许糖醋汁，准备放凉尝味。
tang-cu-zhi.en: A hand lifts a piece of pork with a little sauce to cool for tasting.

tang-mian.zh: 双手切小白菜梗，旁边摆着菜叶、香菇片和豆腐块。
tang-mian.en: Hands cut bok choy stems beside leaves, sliced shiitake and tofu cubes.

tang-mian.zh: 一只手把香菇片倒入微微冒泡的高汤。
tang-mian.en: A hand adds sliced shiitake to gently bubbling stock.

tang-mian.zh: 一只手用勺轻推汤锅里的豆腐块和香菇。
tang-mian.en: A hand gently pushes tofu cubes and shiitake in the simmering broth with a spoon.

tang-mian.zh: 一只手用筷子拨开沸水中的面条。
tang-mian.en: A hand separates noodles in gently boiling water with chopsticks.

tang-mian.zh: 一只手向豆腐香菇汤里加入小白菜叶。
tang-mian.en: A hand adds bok choy leaves to broth with tofu and shiitake.

tang-mian.zh: 一只手从煮面锅中挑起一根面条。
tang-mian.en: A hand lifts a single noodle from the pot with chopsticks.

tang-mian.zh: 一只手将热汤和配菜浇入盛有面条的大碗。
tang-mian.en: A hand ladles hot broth and vegetables onto noodles in a large bowl.

tang-xin-dan.zh: 手往锅中倒水，旁边备好鸡蛋、冷水和计时器。
tang-xin-dan.en: A hand pours water into a saucepan beside an egg, a bowl of cold water and a timer.

tang-xin-dan.zh: 手用勺子将鸡蛋缓缓放入微沸的水中。
tang-xin-dan.en: A hand lowers an egg on a spoon into gently simmering water.

tang-xin-dan.zh: 鸡蛋浸在微沸的水中，手启动计时器。
tang-xin-dan.en: An egg sits submerged in gently simmering water as a hand starts a timer.

tang-xin-dan.zh: 手用勺子把鸡蛋放入冷水中。
tang-xin-dan.en: A hand transfers an egg into cold water with a spoon.

tang-xin-dan.zh: 双手从鸡蛋较宽的一端轻轻剥壳。
tang-xin-dan.en: Two hands gently peel the shell from the wider end of an egg.

tang-xin-dan.zh: 切开的鸡蛋蛋白凝固，浓稠蛋黄缓缓流出。
tang-xin-dan.en: A cut egg has set whites and a thick yolk that slowly flows out.

tarte-tatin.zh: 双手将冷黄油和面粉搓成带颗粒的粗屑，旁边放着冰水。
tarte-tatin.en: Hands rub cold butter into flour to make coarse crumbs, with ice water nearby.

tarte-tatin.zh: 双手把去皮去核的苹果切成薄片，旁边放着糖。
tarte-tatin.en: Hands slice a peeled and cored apple thinly, with sugar nearby.

tarte-tatin.zh: 双手向模具里密铺的苹果片上撒糖。
tarte-tatin.en: Hands sprinkle sugar over tightly layered apple slices in the pan.

tarte-tatin.zh: 一只手用叉子在盖住苹果的生酥皮上戳排气孔。
tarte-tatin.en: A hand pricks steam holes in the raw pastry covering the apples.

tarte-tatin.zh: 双手戴手套轻倾模具，金黄酥皮边缘露出浓褐糖浆。
tarte-tatin.en: Oven-mitted hands tilt the pan, revealing thick brown syrup at the edge of the golden pastry.

tarte-tatin.zh: 双手揭起模具，盘中露出焦糖苹果挞。
tarte-tatin.en: Hands lift the pan to reveal a caramelized apple tart on a plate.

tebasaki.zh: 手持勺子提起酱汁，锅中姜蒜随汁小火煮至挂勺。
tebasaki.en: A hand lifts a spoon coated with sauce as ginger and garlic simmer in the pan.

tebasaki.zh: 手拿生鸡翅抖落多余淀粉，案板上摆着薄裹粉的鸡翅。
tebasaki.en: A hand shakes excess starch off a raw wing above the lightly coated wings on the board.

tebasaki.zh: 鸡翅在油锅中初炸至浅金色，周围冒着小气泡。
tebasaki.en: Chicken wings fry to a pale gold in oil, surrounded by small bubbles.

tebasaki.zh: 用夹子从油锅中夹起复炸至金黄的鸡翅。
tebasaki.en: Tongs lift a golden chicken wing from the oil during the second fry.

tebasaki.zh: 手向盘中挂汁鸡翅撒白芝麻。
tebasaki.en: A hand sprinkles white sesame seeds over glazed chicken wings on a plate.

tempura.zh: 小锅里的棕色蘸汁轻沸，旁边放着萝卜泥。
tempura.en: Brown dipping sauce simmers gently in a small saucepan beside grated daikon.

tempura.zh: 手在生虾腹部划浅口，旁边摆着茄子和南瓜片。
tempura.en: Hands make shallow cuts in a raw shrimp beside sliced eggplant and kabocha.

tempura.zh: 手持温度计测量锅中热油，旁边备有空网架。
tempura.en: A hand checks the hot oil with a thermometer beside an empty wire rack.

tempura.zh: 手用筷子轻拌面糊，碗中仍留着小粉团。
tempura.en: A hand gently stirs batter with chopsticks, leaving small lumps.

tempura.zh: 手用筷子拨动油锅里的茄子片，炸衣周围冒着细泡。
tempura.en: A hand tends battered eggplant with chopsticks as fine bubbles rise in the oil.

tempura.zh: 手用筷子试探油锅中的南瓜片，外衣周围冒泡。
tempura.en: A hand tests a kabocha slice with chopsticks as its batter bubbles in the oil.

tempura.zh: 手用筷子摆放炸虾，盘中还有茄子和南瓜，旁边是蘸汁与萝卜泥。
tempura.en: A hand arranges fried shrimp with eggplant and kabocha beside dipping sauce and grated daikon.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 把煮熟沥干的粉条切成短段。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Cut the cooked and drained glass noodles into short lengths.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 将豆腐切丁，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜和火腿丁。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Dice the tofu beside the prepared vegetables and diced ham.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 用锅铲翻炒粉条、蔬菜、豆腐和火腿丁。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Toss the noodles, vegetables, tofu, and diced ham in the pan.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 向炒熟的粉条菜馅撒入盐和香料。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Sprinkle salt and spices over the cooked noodle and vegetable filling.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 用锅铲翻转薄饼，让凝固的蛋皮朝上。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Flip the pancake with a spatula so the set egg layer faces up.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 在铺匀的熟馅上盖第二张薄煎饼。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Place the second thin pancake over the evenly spread cooked filling.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 用宽锅铲托起金黄色的夹馅饼翻面。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Lift and flip the golden filled pancake with a wide spatula.

teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.zh: 将折好的菜煎饼从中间切开。
teng-zhou-cai-jian-bing.en: Cut the folded vegetable pancake across the middle.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 手将热水缓缓倒入离火的深褐色糖色中。
thit-kho-trung.en: A hand slowly pours hot water into deep brown caramel off the heat.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 手用勺翻拌腌汁中的带皮生猪肉块。
thit-kho-trung.en: A hand turns raw skin-on pork pieces in marinade with a spoon.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 手在小火上轻翻锅中金褐色的肉块。
thit-kho-trung.en: A hand gently turns golden-brown pork pieces in a pot over low heat.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 手向盛有肉和熟蛋的锅中倒入椰子水。
thit-kho-trung.en: A hand pours coconut water into a pot containing pork and boiled eggs.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 锅中肉蛋微沸，手用刀尖试探肉的软度。
thit-kho-trung.en: As pork and eggs simmer gently, a hand tests the meat with a knife tip.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 手舀起卤汁，让汁液流回盛有肉蛋的锅中。
thit-kho-trung.en: A hand lifts a ladle of broth and lets it flow back into the pot of pork and eggs.

thit-kho-trung.zh: 手将卤汁浇在肉和切半的蛋上，旁边放着米饭。
thit-kho-trung.en: A hand pours broth over pork and halved eggs beside a bowl of rice.

tian-provencal.zh: 手将茄子切成圆片，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜和蒜。
tian-provencal.en: Hands slice eggplant into rounds beside prepared vegetables and garlic.

tian-provencal.zh: 手在锅中翻炒变软透明的洋葱丝和蒜。
tian-provencal.en: A hand stirs softened translucent onion and garlic in a pan.

tian-provencal.zh: 手将番茄片竖放在交替紧排的蔬菜中。
tian-provencal.en: A hand places a tomato slice upright among tightly arranged alternating vegetables.

tian-provencal.zh: 戴隔热手套的手从烤箱中取出表面微焦的烤蔬菜。
tian-provencal.en: An oven-mitted hand removes the lightly browned vegetable bake from the oven.

tiramisu.zh: 手将干手指饼干排入容器，旁边放着一碗咖啡。
tiramisu.en: A hand arranges dry ladyfingers in a dish beside a bowl of coffee.

tiramisu.zh: 提起打蛋器，浅黄色蛋黄糊落下并留下纹路。
tiramisu.en: A lifted whisk leaves a ribbon of pale yolk mixture on the surface.

tiramisu.zh: 用刮刀将马斯卡彭奶酪拌入蛋黄糊。
tiramisu.en: A spatula folds mascarpone into the yolk mixture.

tiramisu.zh: 手将完整的手指饼干从咖啡中取出，旁边容器里已排好一部分饼干。
tiramisu.en: A hand lifts an intact ladyfinger from coffee beside a partially lined dish.

tiramisu.zh: 用刮刀将奶酪霜推平，盖住下方的饼干。
tiramisu.en: A spatula spreads mascarpone cream over the biscuits.

tiramisu.zh: 手持筛网在提拉米苏上撒可可，切口露出两层饼干和奶酪霜。
tiramisu.en: A hand sifts cocoa over tiramisu, with two biscuit and cream layers visible at the cut edge.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 勺子舀起带红椒粒的酸甜汁，薄汁挂在勺上。
tod-mun-pla.en: A spoon lifts sweet-and-sour sauce with red chili flecks, leaving a thin coating.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 勺子从料理机舀起细滑黏稠、能堆住的鱼浆。
tod-mun-pla.en: A spoon lifts a mound of smooth, sticky fish paste from the food processor.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 手持勺将豆角圈和香草细丝拌入鱼浆。
tod-mun-pla.en: A hand folds long-bean rings and fine herb strips into the fish paste.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 一小块鱼浆在油锅中试炸，周围持续起泡。
tod-mun-pla.en: A small dollop of fish paste fries in oil with bubbles around it.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 沾湿的手在掌心把鱼浆拍成薄饼。
tod-mun-pla.en: Wet hands pat fish paste into a thin cake on the palm.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 漏勺从油锅中捞起金棕色鱼饼。
tod-mun-pla.en: A slotted spoon lifts a golden-brown fish cake from the oil.

tod-mun-pla.zh: 金黄鱼饼摊放在盘中，旁边另盛黄瓜酸甜汁。
tod-mun-pla.en: Golden fish cakes are spread on a plate beside cucumber sweet-and-sour sauce.

tom-kha-gai.zh: 双手把生鸡腿肉切成均匀薄片。
tom-kha-gai.en: Hands slice raw chicken thigh into even thin pieces.

tom-kha-gai.zh: 用刀拍裂香茅，旁边摆着南姜片和青柠叶。
tom-kha-gai.en: Hands bruise lemongrass beside galangal slices and lime leaves.

tom-kha-gai.zh: 将南姜、香茅和青柠叶倒入小火轻煮的椰奶汤。
tom-kha-gai.en: A hand adds galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves to gently simmering coconut broth.

tom-kha-gai.zh: 用温度计测量轻煮的鸡肉，汤里有蘑菇和香料。
tom-kha-gai.en: A hand checks a piece of chicken with a thermometer in gently simmering soup with mushrooms and aromatics.

tom-kha-gai.zh: 往离火的鸡肉蘑菇汤里倒入青柠汁，汤中有辣椒。
tom-kha-gai.en: A hand pours lime juice into the off-heat chicken and mushroom soup with chilies.

tom-kha-gai.zh: 往鸡肉蘑菇椰奶汤上撒香菜叶。
tom-kha-gai.en: A hand sprinkles cilantro over a bowl of coconut chicken and mushroom soup.

tom-rim.zh: 用牙签从带壳去头的生虾背部挑出虾线。
tom-rim.en: A hand uses a toothpick to remove the vein from a raw, headless shell-on shrimp.

tom-rim.zh: 用勺拌匀生虾和带葱蒜碎的腌汁。
tom-rim.en: A spoon mixes raw shrimp with a marinade flecked with minced garlic and shallot.

tom-rim.zh: 将腌虾和腌汁倒入有葱蒜碎的平底锅。
tom-rim.en: Marinated shrimp and their liquid are poured into a skillet with minced aromatics.

tom-rim.zh: 翻炒虾至琥珀色浓汁贴壳，锅底近乎收干。
tom-rim.en: Shrimp are turned in the skillet until amber glaze clings to their shells and the pan is nearly dry.

tom-rim.zh: 将焦糖虾和葱蒜碎铲入盘中，旁边配白饭。
tom-rim.en: Caramelized shrimp and minced aromatics are transferred to a plate beside a bowl of rice.

tom-saep.zh: 用勺撇去沸腾排骨汤表面的浮沫。
tom-saep.en: A hand skims foam from boiling pork rib broth.

tom-saep.zh: 排骨汤盖着留缝的锅盖，小火轻轻冒泡。
tom-saep.en: Pork ribs simmer gently under an ajar lid.

tom-saep.zh: 用漏勺从排骨汤里捞出香茅、南姜和橙叶。
tom-saep.en: A hand lifts lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves from the rib broth.

tom-saep.zh: 用锅铲翻炒深金黄的糯米，旁边放着干辣椒。
tom-saep.en: A hand stirs deep golden glutinous rice beside dried chilies.

tom-saep.zh: 往煮有排骨和蔬菜的汤里倒入鱼露。
tom-saep.en: A hand pours fish sauce into rib and vegetable soup.

tom-saep.zh: 往盛好的酸辣排骨汤上撒香菜和葱。
tom-saep.en: A hand scatters cilantro and scallions over the finished pork rib soup.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 用刀挑出带头带壳生虾背部的虾线。
tom-yum-goong.en: A hand removes the vein from a raw, head-on, shell-on shrimp.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 用刀拍裂香茅，旁边摆着香料和青柠汁。
tom-yum-goong.en: Hands bruise lemongrass beside prepared aromatics and lime juice.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 把香茅、南姜、青柠叶、蒜和辣椒倒入微沸的水中。
tom-yum-goong.en: A hand adds lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, garlic and chili to simmering water.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 往小沸的蘑菇、洋葱和番茄汤里倒鱼露。
tom-yum-goong.en: A hand pours fish sauce into gently simmering mushroom, onion and tomato soup.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 用温度计探入汤中不透明虾肉的厚处。
tom-yum-goong.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the thick flesh of an opaque shrimp in the soup.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 往离火的虾和蔬菜汤中倒入青柠汁。
tom-yum-goong.en: A hand pours lime juice into the shrimp and vegetable soup off the heat.

tom-yum-goong.zh: 用汤勺把虾、蔬菜和汤分到碗里。
tom-yum-goong.en: A hand ladles shrimp, vegetables and soup into a bowl.

tomates-farcies.zh: 用小勺挖出番茄籽和软瓤，旁边放着完整的盖子。
tomates-farcies.en: A spoon scoops seeds and pulp from a tomato beside its intact lid.

tomates-farcies.zh: 手将番茄倒扣在架上沥水，旁边放着盐和番茄瓤。
tomates-farcies.en: A hand places tomatoes upside down on a rack beside salt and tomato pulp.

tomates-farcies.zh: 小火炒透明洋葱时，往锅里加入蒜末。
tomates-farcies.en: Minced garlic is added to translucent onions cooking over a low flame.

tomates-farcies.zh: 手在碗里轻拌牛肉末、洋葱蒜末和欧芹。
tomates-farcies.en: A hand gently mixes ground beef, onion, garlic and parsley in a bowl.

tomates-farcies.zh: 用勺将松软的生肉馅装入烤盘里的番茄。
tomates-farcies.en: A spoon places loose raw meat filling into tomatoes in a baking dish.

tomates-farcies.zh: 将温度计从侧面插入烤皱的酿番茄肉馅中。
tomates-farcies.en: A thermometer is inserted from the side into the filling of a wrinkled baked tomato.

tomates-farcies.zh: 用勺把汁水淋在盘中的烤酿番茄上。
tomates-farcies.en: A spoon drizzles juices over the baked stuffed tomatoes on a plate.

tomato-egg.zh: 手将番茄瓣和汁从案板拨入碗中，旁边放着葱花。
tomato-egg.en: A hand transfers tomato wedges and juice from a cutting board into a bowl beside chopped scallions.

tomato-egg.zh: 手用打蛋器搅匀蛋液，碗边放着调味料。
tomato-egg.en: A hand whisks the eggs until uniform, with seasonings beside the bowl.

tomato-egg.zh: 锅铲将刚凝固的鸡蛋推成湿润的大块。
tomato-egg.en: A spatula pushes the just-set eggs into large, moist curds in the wok.

tomato-egg.zh: 锅铲翻炒番茄瓣和葱花，锅底已有红色汁液。
tomato-egg.en: A spatula stirs tomato wedges and scallions in a wok with red juices at the bottom.

tomato-egg.zh: 锅铲轻压软番茄，浓汁沾在铲面上。
tomato-egg.en: A spatula presses softened tomatoes as thick sauce coats its surface.

tomato-egg.zh: 手用锅铲将番茄炒蛋盛入盘中。
tomato-egg.en: A hand uses a spatula to serve tomato and egg onto a plate.

tonjiru.zh: 切芋头片，旁边摆着切好的肉和蔬菜。
tonjiru.en: Slice taro beside the prepared pork and vegetables.

tonjiru.zh: 将蒟蒻片放入大火滚沸的水中。
tonjiru.en: Lower konnyaku slices into vigorously boiling water over high heat.

tonjiru.zh: 将油豆腐放入沸水，水面浮着油珠。
tonjiru.en: Lower fried tofu into boiling water with oil droplets on the surface.

tonjiru.zh: 用筷子摊开炒至不再粉红的五花肉。
tonjiru.en: Spread pork belly slices with chopsticks until no longer pink.

tonjiru.zh: 将蒟蒻、油豆腐和大葱倒入肉与根菜中。
tonjiru.en: Add konnyaku, fried tofu and leek to the pork and root vegetables.

tonjiru.zh: 用竹签检查小火煮着的芋头是否软透。
tonjiru.en: Test a simmering taro slice with a bamboo skewer.

tonjiru.zh: 往盛好的猪肉味噌汤上撒葱花。
tonjiru.en: Sprinkle scallions over a bowl of pork miso soup.

tonkatsu.zh: 手从漏盆中提起卷心菜细丝，水滴落入碗中。
tonkatsu.en: A hand lifts finely shredded cabbage from a colander as water drips into a bowl.

tonkatsu.zh: 手用刀在生猪排肥瘦交界处划浅口。
tonkatsu.en: A hand scores shallow cuts along the boundary between the fat and lean meat of a raw pork cutlet.

tonkatsu.zh: 手将粗面包糠轻按在猪排上，旁边放着面粉和蛋液。
tonkatsu.en: A hand presses coarse panko onto a pork cutlet, with flour and beaten egg nearby.

tonkatsu.zh: 手用筷子翻动油锅中炸至金黄的猪排。
tonkatsu.en: A hand turns a golden pork cutlet in bubbling oil with chopsticks.

tonkatsu.zh: 手将温度计从侧面插入油锅中金黄的猪排。
tonkatsu.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the side of a golden pork cutlet in the pot.

tonkatsu.zh: 手将金黄猪排切条，盘中配卷心菜丝，酱汁另盛。
tonkatsu.en: A hand slices a golden pork cutlet served with shredded cabbage and a separate bowl of sauce.

tortellini-in-brodo.zh: 用夹子翻煎黄油锅中表面金黄的猪通脊。
tortellini-in-brodo.en: A hand turns browned pork loin in a pan of melted butter.

tortellini-in-brodo.zh: 用勺搅拌撒有肉豆蔻的细腻肉馅。
tortellini-in-brodo.en: A hand stirs finely ground filling dusted with nutmeg.

tortellini-in-brodo.zh: 手托薄面片，隐约透出手影，旁边的面团盖着布。
tortellini-in-brodo.en: A hand holds a thin pasta sheet with its silhouette visible through it, beside covered dough.

tortellini-in-brodo.zh: 双手将面皮绕在指尖，捏合两角。
tortellini-in-brodo.en: Hands wrap the pasta around a fingertip and pinch the corners together.

tortellini-in-brodo.zh: 用汤勺将馄饨和金黄清汤盛入白碗。
