tortellini-in-brodo.en: A hand ladles tortellini and golden broth into a white bowl.

tteokbokki.zh: 双手在冷水中轻轻分开粘连的条状年糕。
tteokbokki.en: Hands gently separate stuck rice cakes in cold water.

tteokbokki.zh: 去头鳀鱼和昆布在锅中煮出底汤。
tteokbokki.en: Headless anchovies and kombu simmer in a pot of stock.

tteokbokki.zh: 双手将滤净的底汤倒入量杯。
tteokbokki.en: Hands pour the strained stock into a measuring jug.

tteokbokki.zh: 将条状年糕倒入盛有红汤、葱段、鱼糕和熟蛋的锅中。
tteokbokki.en: Rice cakes are tipped into red broth with scallions, fish cake and boiled eggs.

tteokbokki.zh: 用木勺轻推冒泡红汤中的年糕和配料。
tteokbokki.en: A wooden spoon gently pushes rice cakes and accompaniments through bubbling red broth.

tteokbokki.zh: 木勺推开浓亮的酱汁，短暂露出锅底。
tteokbokki.en: A wooden spoon pushes glossy sauce aside, briefly revealing the pot bottom.

tteokbokki.zh: 用木勺将裹酱的年糕和鱼糕盛入浅碗。
tteokbokki.en: A wooden spoon serves sauced rice cakes and fish cake into a shallow bowl.

tteokguk.zh: 双手在冷水中分开年糕薄片。
tteokguk.en: Hands separate rice cake slices in cold water.

tteokguk.zh: 用勺撇去翻滚牛肉汤上的浮沫。
tteokguk.en: A spoon skims foam from boiling beef broth.

tteokguk.zh: 盖上锅盖，牛肉汤在小火上轻轻冒泡。
tteokguk.en: A lid covers the beef broth as it gently simmers over low heat.

tteokguk.zh: 用锅铲翻动小火煎至凝固的薄蛋黄皮。
tteokguk.en: A spatula turns a thin, set egg-yolk sheet over low heat.

tteokguk.zh: 向牛肉年糕汤中倒入鱼露，旁边备着盐。
tteokguk.en: Fish sauce is poured into beef and rice cake soup, with salt nearby.

tteokguk.zh: 将蛋清细细淋入沸腾的牛肉年糕汤。
tteokguk.en: Egg white is poured in a thin stream into boiling beef and rice cake soup.

tteokguk.zh: 给三碗年糕汤放上蛋黄丝和海苔。
tteokguk.en: Egg-yolk strips and seaweed are added to three bowls of rice cake soup.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 手把土豆块放入清水，旁边备有姜片和葱。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: A hand puts potato chunks in water beside prepared ginger and scallions.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 手搅拌酱汁，旁边备好香料与热水。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: A hand mixes sauce beside the spices and hot water.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 手用纸巾擦干沥水后的焯排骨。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: A hand pats the drained blanched ribs dry with a paper towel.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 锅中翻炒排骨，裹上冒泡的红棕糖色。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: Ribs are turned in bubbling reddish-brown caramel in a wok.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 排骨拨到锅边，姜片和香料倒入空处。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: Ginger and spices are tipped into a clear space beside the ribs.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 排骨在接近没过的汤汁中小火轻炖。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: Ribs simmer gently in broth that nearly covers them.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 筷子插入锅中软土豆，排骨在汤汁中轻炖。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: Chopsticks pierce a soft potato while ribs simmer in broth.

tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.zh: 手在装盘的土豆炖排骨上撒葱花。
tu-dou-dun-pai-gu.en: A hand scatters scallions over the plated ribs and potatoes.

tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.zh: 手持刀切土豆细丝，旁边备有胡萝卜丝和葱蒜辣椒。
tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.en: Hands cut potato into thin strips beside prepared carrot, scallion, garlic and dried chili.

tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.zh: 双手将薄薄裹粉的土豆丝和胡萝卜丝抓起拨散。
tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.en: Hands lift and separate lightly floured potato and carrot strips.

tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.zh: 大火蒸制垫有蒸布的土豆丝和胡萝卜丝。
tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.en: Potato and carrot strips steam over high heat in a cloth-lined steamer.

tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.zh: 用筷子拨散盘中温热的土豆丝和胡萝卜丝。
tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.en: Chopsticks separate warm steamed potato and carrot strips on a plate.

tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.zh: 锅铲翻炒土豆丝、胡萝卜丝和葱蒜辣椒。
tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.en: A spatula tosses potato and carrot strips with scallion, garlic and dried chili in a wok.

tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.zh: 向锅中热透的土豆胡萝卜丝撒盐，旁边放着味精。
tu-dou-hu-luo-bo-zheng-cai.en: Salt is sprinkled over hot potato and carrot strips in the wok, with MSG nearby.

tu-dou-shao-ji.zh: 用厨房纸吸干鸡块，旁边分开放着土豆、姜和葱。
tu-dou-shao-ji.en: Pat the chicken dry with kitchen paper beside separately prepared potatoes, ginger and scallions.

tu-dou-shao-ji.zh: 用锅铲翻起皮面浅金黄的鸡块。
tu-dou-shao-ji.en: Turn a piece of chicken with a spatula to reveal its lightly golden skin.

tu-dou-shao-ji.zh: 将酱油淋入鸡块、姜片和葱白中。
tu-dou-shao-ji.en: Pour soy sauce over the chicken, ginger and scallion whites.

tu-dou-shao-ji.zh: 小火慢烧鸡块，锅中汤汁冒着小泡。
tu-dou-shao-ji.en: Gently push the chicken as the broth bubbles over low heat.

tu-dou-shao-ji.zh: 用筷子扎入锅中的土豆，检查软度。
tu-dou-shao-ji.en: Pierce a potato in the pan with a chopstick to check its tenderness.

tu-dou-shao-ji.zh: 将葱段倒入裹着浓汁的鸡块和土豆中。
tu-dou-shao-ji.en: Add scallions to the chicken and potatoes coated in thick sauce.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手持勺搅拌斑兰糖水，锅底小火轻煮。
tub-tim-krob.en: A hand stirs pandan syrup over a low flame.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手搅拌斑兰椰奶，锅边冒出小泡。
tub-tim-krob.en: Hands stir pandan coconut milk as small bubbles form at the edge.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手将椰奶倒入浅容器，旁边另放清糖水。
tub-tim-krob.en: A hand pours coconut milk into a shallow dish beside clear syrup.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手持筛子沥去染红荸荠丁上的红水。
tub-tim-krob.en: Hands drain red dye water from red water chestnut cubes in a sieve.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手轻晃筛子，抖落荸荠丁上多余的白粉。
tub-tim-krob.en: Hands shake excess white starch from water chestnut cubes in a sieve.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 红宝石浮在滚沸的水中，旁边备有冰水。
tub-tim-krob.en: Rubies float in vigorously boiling water beside a bowl of ice water.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手从冰水中舀起一粒红宝石，检查透明粉皮。
tub-tim-krob.en: A hand lifts one ruby from ice water to check its translucent coating.

tub-tim-krob.zh: 手轻拌椰奶、红宝石和碎冰。
tub-tim-krob.en: A hand gently stirs coconut milk, rubies and crushed ice.

tuong-dau-phong.zh: 一边倒入清汤，一边搅匀碗里的褐色酱液。
tuong-dau-phong.en: Pour in clear broth while stirring the brown sauce until smooth.

tuong-dau-phong.zh: 小火上拨散油里的浅色蒜末。
tuong-dau-phong.en: Stir pale minced garlic in oil over a low flame.

tuong-dau-phong.zh: 小火搅拌褐色酱汁，表面均匀冒出小泡。
tuong-dau-phong.en: Stir the brown sauce over low heat as small bubbles form across the surface.

tuong-dau-phong.zh: 搅动浅碗里放温的顺滑褐色蘸汁。
tuong-dau-phong.en: Stir the smooth brown dipping sauce as it cools in a shallow bowl.

tuong-dau-phong.zh: 向褐色蘸汁上撒花生碎和红辣椒末。
tuong-dau-phong.en: Sprinkle chopped peanuts and minced red chili over the brown dipping sauce.

vichyssoise.zh: 手把去皮土豆切成薄片，旁边放着切好的韭葱白。
vichyssoise.en: A hand slices peeled potato beside sliced leek whites.

vichyssoise.zh: 锅里韭葱和土豆轻轻煮着，手用勺压碎土豆。
vichyssoise.en: Leeks and potatoes simmer gently as a hand presses a potato with a spoon.

vichyssoise.zh: 手用勺背将熟蔬菜压过细筛，细汤流入碗中。
vichyssoise.en: A hand presses cooked vegetables through a fine sieve into a bowl.

vichyssoise.zh: 手把奶油倒入细滑的汤中，旁边放着盐和白胡椒粉。
vichyssoise.en: A hand pours cream into smooth soup beside bowls of salt and white pepper.

vichyssoise.zh: 手搅动放在冰水中的浅碗汤，为汤降温。
vichyssoise.en: A hand stirs soup in a shallow bowl set in ice water to cool it.

vichyssoise.zh: 手向红边白碗里的冷汤撒上切细的香葱。
vichyssoise.en: A hand sprinkles chopped chives over cold soup in a white bowl with a red rim.

vinaigrette.zh: 用勺搅拌碗中的葡萄酒醋，盐已溶解。
vinaigrette.en: Stir the wine vinegar in a bowl until the salt dissolves.

vinaigrette.zh: 一边搅打醋汁，一边细细倒入油，汁液变浑浊。
vinaigrette.en: Whisk the vinegar while pouring in a thin stream of oil, turning the mixture cloudy.

vinaigrette.zh: 用打蛋器搅拌带有黑胡椒碎的浅黄色油醋汁。
vinaigrette.en: Whisk the pale yellow vinaigrette with flecks of black pepper.

vinaigrette.zh: 用勺将碎欧芹拌入油醋汁，旁边放着一片菜叶。
vinaigrette.en: Stir chopped parsley into the vinaigrette beside a lettuce leaf.

vinaigrette.zh: 双手轻拌裹着油醋汁的菜叶，旁边放着酱汁。
vinaigrette.en: Gently toss the dressed lettuce leaves by hand beside the bowl of vinaigrette.

vitello-tonnato.zh: 手将凤尾鱼段嵌入绑好的小牛肉浅口。
vitello-tonnato.en: Hands tuck a piece of anchovy into a slit in the tied veal roast.

vitello-tonnato.zh: 绑好的小牛肉与蔬菜香料在锅中小火微沸。
vitello-tonnato.en: The tied veal simmers gently with vegetables and aromatics.

vitello-tonnato.zh: 手从侧面将探针插入锅中的整块小牛肉。
vitello-tonnato.en: A hand inserts a probe into the side of the whole veal roast in the pot.

vitello-tonnato.zh: 手举起勺子，带刺山柑的金枪鱼酱缓缓流回碗中。
vitello-tonnato.en: A hand lifts a spoon as tuna sauce with capers slowly flows back into the bowl.

vitello-tonnato.zh: 手在浅盒中交替铺放小牛肉片和金枪鱼酱。
vitello-tonnato.en: Hands layer slices of veal and tuna sauce in a shallow dish.

vitello-tonnato.zh: 双手端着铺有金枪鱼酱和刺山柑的小牛肉片。
vitello-tonnato.en: Hands hold a platter of sliced veal covered with tuna sauce and capers.

wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.zh: 手持勺子将料酒淋在铺有葱白姜丝的两片鱼上。
wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.en: A hand spoons cooking wine over two fish fillets topped with scallion whites and ginger.

wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.zh: 手将盖子盖在铺有葱姜的两片鱼上。
wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.en: A hand places a lid over two fish fillets topped with scallion and ginger.

wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.zh: 手在微波炉内转动盖着盖子的鱼盘。
wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.en: A hand rotates the covered dish of fish inside the microwave.

wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.zh: 叉子拨开熟鱼厚处，露出不透明的鱼肉片。
wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.en: A fork separates opaque flakes at the thickest part of the cooked fish.

wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.zh: 手把酱汁淋在铺有葱绿姜丝的两片鱼上。
wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.en: A hand pours sauce over two fish fillets topped with green scallion and ginger.

wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.zh: 手持小锅将热油浇在鱼上的葱姜丝上，油滋滋起泡。
wei-bo-cong-jiang-hei-xue-yu.en: A hand pours hot oil from a small pan onto the scallion and ginger on the fish, where it bubbles.

wen-si-dou-fu.zh: 在湿砧板上将叠好的豆腐薄片切成细丝。
wen-si-dou-fu.en: Thin stacked tofu slices are cut into fine threads on a damp cutting board.

wen-si-dou-fu.zh: 用宽刀将豆腐丝滑入清水，旁边摆着切好的配料。
wen-si-dou-fu.en: A broad knife slides tofu threads into water beside the prepared shredded ingredients.

wen-si-dou-fu.zh: 香菇、笋和火腿丝在清鸡汤中小火煮至微沸。
wen-si-dou-fu.en: Shiitake, bamboo shoots and ham simmer gently in clear chicken broth.

wen-si-dou-fu.zh: 用汤勺背向前轻推，让豆腐丝和鸡丝在微沸的汤中散开。
wen-si-dou-fu.en: The back of a ladle gently pushes tofu and chicken threads through simmering broth.

wen-si-dou-fu.zh: 提起汤勺，薄芡汤汁流回锅中，菠菜丝已软。
wen-si-dou-fu.en: A ladle lifts the lightly thickened soup above the pot, where spinach has softened.

wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.zh: 手抓拌碗中的薄浆猪肉片，碗底没有积水。
wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.en: Hands mix lightly coated pork slices in a bowl with no pooled liquid.

wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.zh: 手将去皮莴笋斜切成薄片。
wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.en: Hands cut a peeled celtuce stem diagonally into thin slices.

wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.zh: 用筷子拨松腌肉，旁边备好莴笋和姜蒜片。
wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.en: Chopsticks separate marinated pork beside prepared celtuce, ginger and garlic.

wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.zh: 锅铲将肉片炒散，肉片已变得不透明。
wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.en: A spatula spreads the pork slices in the wok until opaque.

wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.zh: 锅中翻炒莴笋和姜蒜片，莴笋边缘透亮。
wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.en: A spatula stir-fries celtuce with ginger and garlic until its edges are translucent.

wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.zh: 用锅铲将莴笋炒肉片盛入盘中。
wo-sun-chao-rou-pian.en: A spatula transfers the pork and celtuce from the wok to a plate.

wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.zh: 双手在案板上切碎沥干的莴笋叶。
wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.en: Hands finely chop drained celtuce leaves on a cutting board.

wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.zh: 双手搅拌碗中的蛋液和碎莴笋叶。
wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.en: Hands stir beaten eggs and chopped celtuce leaves in a bowl.

wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.zh: 双手转动平底锅，让油铺开，少量饼浆轻轻冒泡。
wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.en: Hands tilt a frying pan to spread the oil as a drop of batter bubbles gently.

wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.zh: 用铲子将锅中的莴笋叶蛋浆摊成薄饼。
wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.en: A spatula spreads celtuce leaf and egg batter into a thin pancake in the pan.

wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.zh: 用铲子托起煎饼边缘，露出浅金黄色的底面。
wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.en: A spatula lifts the edge of the pancake to reveal its pale golden underside.

wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.zh: 将切好的莴笋叶煎饼摆在红边盘中。
wo-sun-ye-jian-bing.en: A cut celtuce leaf pancake is arranged on a red-rimmed plate.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 往没过鸡爪、姜片和葱段的冷水中倒入料酒。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: A hand pours cooking wine into cold water covering chicken feet, ginger and scallions.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 锅中鸡爪沸煮时，用温度计探入鸡爪厚肉。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the thick flesh of a chicken foot in the boiling pot.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 用夹子把熟鸡爪放入盛有冰块的水中。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: A hand lowers a cooked chicken foot into ice water with tongs.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 双手将冷却鸡爪的皮肉从趾骨上推开。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: Hands push the skin and flesh of a chilled chicken foot away from a toe bone.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 砧板上切蒜末，旁边备有辣椒、洋葱、香菜和柠檬汁。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: Hands mince garlic beside prepared chilies, onion, cilantro and lemon juice.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 向加有蒜、辣椒、洋葱和香菜的拌汁倒入柠檬汁。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: A hand pours lemon juice into sauce with garlic, chilies, onion and cilantro.

wu-gu-ji-zhao.zh: 用筷子将去骨鸡爪与酸辣拌汁拌匀。
wu-gu-ji-zhao.en: A hand tosses boneless chicken feet with spicy sour sauce using chopsticks.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手正打散鸡蛋，旁边摆着番茄丁、豆腐块、葱花和姜片。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: A hand beats an egg beside diced tomato, tofu cubes, chopped scallion and a ginger slice.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手正搅匀碗里的白色淀粉浆，旁边一锅水正在沸腾。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: Hands stir smooth white starch slurry beside a pot of boiling water.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手在小火上翻炒番茄丁和姜片，锅底渗出红汁。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: Hands stir softened diced tomatoes and a ginger slice over a small flame as red juice collects.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手沿锅边轻推豆腐块，番茄汤正在沸腾。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: A hand gently pushes tofu cubes along the edge of bubbling tomato broth.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手将蛋液细淋入微沸的番茄豆腐汤，蛋液凝成薄片。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: A hand pours a thin stream of egg into simmering tomato tofu soup, forming thin ribbons.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手边轻推汤边淋入淀粉浆，锅中有豆腐、番茄和蛋花。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: Hands pour starch slurry and gently stir the simmering tomato, tofu and egg soup.

xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.zh: 手用勺将番茄豆腐蛋花汤盛入碗中，汤面撒着葱花。
xi-hong-shi-dou-fu-tang-geng.en: A hand ladles tomato, tofu and egg soup topped with scallions into a bowl.
